article.articleHeadline: Menguak Beban Kasus TB Tersembunyi Lewat Cek Kesehatan Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uncovering the Hidden Burden of TB Cases Through Free Health Screenings
article.articleSummary: Indonesia remains a major TB burden. The Global Tuberculosis Report 2025 places Indonesia as a 10% contributor to global TB cases, with an estimated 1.08 million cases and 126,000 deaths annually. SITB, the national TB information system, centralizes reporting of diagnoses and treatment across hospitals, puskesmas, and clinics, including drug-susceptible and drug-resistant TB, but captures only patients who actively seek care (about 60%), leaving roughly 40% undiagnosed. To close this gap, Free Health Check-ups (CKG) using AI-powered portable chest X-ray conducts Active Case Finding, screening over 20.6 million people and identifying 25,660 new TB cases; 11,800 positives are reported in 530 prisons. Bacteriological confirmation remains a bottleneck: smear microscopy is limited; GeneXpert is rapid but cartridge access is uneven; culture is scarce. Next-Generation Sequencing is being piloted for precision TB care. TB drug-resistant TB enrollment is about 85%, with cure around 50–60%; second-line drugs include Bedaquiline and Linezolid.

triage.headline_ja: 無料健康診断で明らかになるTB(結核)の隠れた負担
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの結核は既知の慢性的な公衆衛生課題であり突発的異常事態ではないが、多数の未診断例と薬剤耐性結核の管理課題が継続しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 結核は既存の風土病でありEBSの急性感染症シグナルとは性質が異なるが、疾病負荷の大きさと薬剤耐性結核の課題から継続的なモニタリング対象として記録。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño pode aumentar casos de dengue no ES; veja por que o risco preocupa - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño could increase dengue cases in Espírito Santo; see why the risk is concerning - Folha Vitória
article.articleSummary: El Niño is forecast to bring heavy rainfall and heat to Espírito Santo, Brazil, raising health risks beyond climactic stress to include arboviruses such as dengue and chikungunya. The Ministry of Health warns that in the Southeast, the second half of 2026 could see a surge in dengue and other mosquito-borne diseases, with cases expanding into areas previously with lower circulation as temperatures rise. Espírito Santo already hosts Aedes aegypti transmission. Heat and extreme events may strain the SUS, while floods and landslides can trigger waterborne illnesses and impede access to care; mental health and chronic disease exacerbations are also anticipated. Brazil’s health ministry is coordinating contingency plans across states, including a National SUS Task Force base in Rio de Janeiro, a Health and Climate Information Center in Belo Horizonte, heat maps, cooling zones, hydration points, and region-specific clinical protocols, aiming to anticipate demand and stock essential medicines.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョがエスピリトサント州のデング熱症例を増加させる可能性；懸念される理由とは - Folha Vitória
triage.triage_reason: エルニーニョによる将来的なデング熱・チクングニア熱の増加リスクに関する予測的・準備的な記事であり、現時点で具体的な症例急増や異常事態は報告されていないため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動（エルニーニョ）による将来的な媒介動物感染症リスクの予測と保健省の準備計画に焦点を当てており、現時点での具体的な症例数急増や異常な発生状況の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 爱挑"外地人"下手，去青藏高原玩的朋友千万注意这种病！（不是高反）
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Those who love to pick on 'outsiders'—friends traveling to the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, beware of this disease (not altitude sickness).
article.articleSummary: Hydatid disease (echinococcosis), caused by Echinococcus larvae, is a chronic parasitic infection with cystic lesions that infiltrate like tumors; untreated, mortality can reach about 90% within 10 years. The article targets travelers to the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and western highland pastoral areas, noting endemicity is prominent there. The core source is infected canids; parasite eggs shed in feces contaminate pastures, water, and soil. Humans acquire infection via hand-to-mouth contact after touching contaminated grass, soil, or animal fur, and by drinking polluted water or eating unwashed wild vegetables/fruit; raw vegetables and dried meat are discouraged, all foods should be cooked. Prevention emphasizes: avoid close contact with dogs and wildlife; wash hands thoroughly (20 seconds, seven-step method) after environmental or animal contact; drink boiled or sealed water; cook all foods; avoid skin contact with grass/soil when resting; and do not bring pastoral-area dogs home. Share this guidance with travelers to reduce exposure risk.

triage.headline_ja: 「よそ者」を狙う病—青海チベット高原へ旅行する友人は要注意！（高山病ではない）
triage.triage_reason: 青海チベット高原など既知の風土病地域におけるエキノコックス症（包虫病）に関する旅行者向け一般予防啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の風土病（人畜共通感染症、イヌ科動物由来）に関する啓発・予防情報であり、アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ヒト-ヒト感染なし。

article.articleHeadline: जौनपुर में लंपी स्किन डिजीज को लेकर अलर्ट, पशुपालक ऐसे करें बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert over Lumpy Skin Disease in Jaunpur: How livestock owners can protect themselves.
article.articleSummary: Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh, India reports no Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) cases yet, but authorities are vigilant after cases emerged in other districts of the state. The Chief Veterinary Officer, Dr. Sanjay Kumar, says vaccination and surveillance are being intensified district-wide, with livestock owners advised to isolate any cow or other bovines showing fever, nodules/lesions, swelling, or weakness and contact a veterinarian promptly. Symptoms include fever, body lumps, sores, swelling in legs, and reduced appetite or movement. Preventive measures: separate sick animals, maintain clean, dry housing, regular disinfection and lime spraying, and prioritize healthy animals’ feed. Early identification and veterinary guidance improve recovery; vaccines and medicines are available through the department. Do not panic; follow veterinary guidance to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: ジャウンプルでランピースキン病への警戒、家畜飼育者はこうして予防を
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病であり人への公衆衛生上の影響はなく、当該地域では感染例も未確認で予防的な注意喚起に留まる。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病は牛などの家畜に感染するウイルス性疾患でヒトには感染しない。ジャウンプル地区では未発生で、他地区での発生を受けた予防的注意喚起記事。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola | Ebolaepidemian huippu saavutettu Kongossa, sanovat paikalliset viranomaiset
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola | The peak of the Ebola epidemic has been reached in Congo, local authorities say.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has peaked according to authorities in Ituri province. The Bundibugyo variant is spreading in northern and eastern regions where health infrastructure is weak and armed groups hinder the response. New infections are decreasing, from about 120 per day previously to about 80 per day. Ten of 62 health zones have not reported new cases for more than 22 days. As of September 14, 2026, the country has more than 7,200 confirmed Ebola infections and over 3,475 deaths, making it the deadliest outbreak in its history. The World Health Organization notes some progress in containment, but transmission continues. There is no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus, which is transmitted via bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ | コンゴでエボラ流行のピークに達したと現地当局が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)のアウトブレイクで7,200人以上の感染、3,475人以上の死亡と過去最悪の規模であり、ワクチン・治療法がなく国際的拡大リスクもあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・治療法が存在せず、武装勢力による対応妨害も報告されており、封じ込めの困難さが懸念される。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Influenza, leptospirosis emerge as major killers this season in Keralam
article.articleSummary: Influenza and leptospirosis emerge as major killers in Keralam. As of September 15, 2026, influenza cases total 10,244 with 109 deaths, predominantly A H1N1, A H2N3 and Influenza B. Confirmed leptospirosis deaths reach 100, with 78 probable deaths; together the diseases have claimed nearly 300 lives this season. Unpredictable weather, heat, humidity, and possible mutations are cited as contributors to influenza's spike, with rising H1N1 activity and greater impact on the elderly. Testing under the Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme is reserved for severe cases; masking and respiratory hygiene are urged in hospitals. Oseltamivir is advised for selected patients; mild cases can be managed with home isolation and supportive care, with red-flag signs triggering hospitalization. For leptospirosis, late diagnosis drives fatalities; doxycycline is recommended for fever without respiratory symptoms, and workers in agriculture should use protective gear and consider prophylaxis. Vaccination for the elderly is encouraged where affordable.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州で今シーズン、インフルエンザとレプトスピラ症が主要な死因として浮上
triage.triage_reason: インドのケララ州で季節性インフルエンザとレプトスピラ症による死者が多数(合計約300人)発生しており重症度は高いが、既知の季節性疾患で国際的拡大リスクは低く、州レベルのサーベイランス下で管理されているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: インフルエンザ(H1N1、H2N3、Influenza B)とレプトスピラ症は季節性の要因(天候・湿度)によるものとされ、既存のIDSP下でのサーベイランス・治療体制で対応中。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候は記事内に見られない。

article.articleHeadline: 男子买鹦鹉后家中73岁老人确诊鹦鹉热 疑与新购鹦鹉相关
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 73-year-old at home diagnosed with psittacosis after a man buys a parrot; suspected to be related to the newly purchased parrot.
article.articleSummary: In Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, a 73-year-old grandmother developed fever on September 4 and was diagnosed with severe pneumonia. On September 7 she was hospitalized; September 8 bronchoscopy confirmed psittacosis (Chlamydia psittaci) infection. She spent five days in ICU and was discharged September 12. Medical costs exceeded 17,000 yuan, most reimbursed by insurance. The patient’s grandson, Mr. Hu, had recently bought a fully feathered parrot from a local flower-bird market for 600 yuan; the bird lacked leg bands and identification cards. On September 10 Hu returned to the market to seek a refund; police mediated, and the parrot was returned with the 600-yuan payment refunded. The market could not confirm the parrot as the infection source, noting many birds can carry psittacosis and that birds came from a centralized breeding facility with no testing reports. No other family members showed symptoms. Authorities are investigating and will cooperate.

triage.headline_ja: 男性がインコを購入後、自宅の73歳高齢者がオウム病と診断される 新しく購入したインコとの関連が疑われる
triage.triage_reason: 単発の家族内感染事例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や地域的拡大の兆候はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響も認められない。
triage.notes: オウム病は人畜共通感染症で通常ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。単発の家庭内感染事例であり、他の家族に症状なし。市場側は感染源を特定できていないが、地域的な公衆衛生上の懸念には至っていない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A di Surabaya Meningkat, Rumah Sakit Dikabarkan Penuh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A in Surabaya on the Rise, Hospitals Reported to be Full.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases in Surabaya, Indonesia, are rising with hospitals reportedly reaching capacity. RS Husada Utama confirms increased admissions, predominantly among children; a dedicated pediatric floor was filled, with one wing housing about 44 children, prompting transfers to upper floors. Common symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, and weakness, most patients aged 2–5 years, though adults are also susceptible. The surge has emerged over the past week and is suspected to be influenced by weather changes and higher activity. Preventive measures include hygiene, healthy living, masks, and influenza vaccination when possible. Dinkes Surabaya notes services remain normal; inpatients are those needing advanced care such as severe respiratory distress, while mild fever cases are treated as outpatients. City authorities coordinate with hospitals and puskesmas to monitor bed availability and workforce, advising calm and careful information sourcing.

triage.headline_ja: スラバヤでインフルエンザA型が増加、病院は満床と報道
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる患者増加で地域病院が逼迫しているが、当局は通常運用の範囲内としており、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは低い。今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの流行によりスラバヤの一部病院（RS Husada Utama）で小児科病床が逼迫。市保健局（Dinkes Surabaya）はサービスは正常範囲内としており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。天候変化が要因と推測されている。

article.articleHeadline: Rabid dog bites 18 people in Gujarat town, locals beat canine to death
article.articleSummary: Rabies exposure from a rabid dog in Kathlal town, Kheda district, Gujarat, led to 18 people being bitten. The dog attacked on streets and outside homes, triggering panic in Kathlal as residents sought safety. All 18 victims were taken to the Community Health Centre in Kathlal, where anti-rabies injections were administered; three with serious injuries were referred to a hospital in Nadiad for further treatment. The incident prompted the local administration and stray-animal control unit to search for and capture the dog, which was eventually surrounded and beaten to death by a crowd. The episode raises ongoing concerns about stray and aggressive dogs in residential areas and the need for preventive measures, though the report does not provide laboratory confirmation details.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州の町で狂犬病の犬が18人を襲う、住民が犬を撲殺
triage.triage_reason: 単一地域での散発的な狂犬病曝露事案であり、適切な医療対応（抗狂犬病注射）も実施済みで、公衆衛生上の深刻な拡大リスクや国際的懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染しないため流行拡大リスクは低い。地域の野良犬管理の課題を示す事例だが、単発的なインシデントであり続報の必要性も低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola response in drc requires more funding -- WHO chief | New Straits Times
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows encouraging signs of containment, but funding remains insufficient, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said at a Geneva briefing. In Ituri Province transmission is falling, and South Kivu has reported no new cases since May. The outbreak has been contained largely to the northeastern DRC, with a small outbreak in Uganda that was swiftly stopped. As of 17 September 2026, the national tally stands at 7,258 confirmed cases and 3,510 deaths since May, with more than 1,700 recoveries. WHO urges donors to fully fund both the government’s response plan and the broader humanitarian response to sustain gains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応、さらなる資金が必要 ― WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,258例・3,510人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、ウガンダへの越境伝播も発生したため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの小規模な越境流行があったが速やかに封じ込められたと報告されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。既存の大規模流行に関する資金要請の続報であり、既知イベントの更新情報である可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasusnya di Jabar Mulai Naik, Apa Itu Influenza A? Waspadai Bedanya dengan Batuk Pilek
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases in West Java Are Beginning to Rise: What Is Influenza A? Be Aware of the Difference Between It and the Common Cold.
article.articleSummary: West Java, Indonesia — Early September 2026 surveillance shows a rise in influenza A infections, with a higher proportion of positive specimens dominated by Influenza A. No specific case or death counts are provided; authorities say overall influenza activity remains low and controlled. Dr. Moh. Luthfi (IDI West Java) notes influenza A is an acute respiratory infection caused by Orthomyxoviridae with rapid mutation and potential zoonotic transmission. Distinguish from the common cold: influenza A typically presents suddenly with high fever, chills, dry cough, sore throat, myalgia, headache, and fatigue, whereas the common cold is milder and gradual. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets and contaminated surfaces. High-risk groups include infants and children, the elderly, pregnant women, and individuals with chronic diseases or immunocompromised states. Management emphasizes rest and symptomatic care; antivirals such as oseltamivir are used for severe cases, and antibiotics are not routinely indicated. Report cited from Tribun Jabar (Bandung, West Java), dated 17 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャワで感染者数が上昇中、インフルエンザAとは何か？普通の風邪との違いに注意
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの感染者増加が報告されているが、当局は流行を「低く管理下にある」と評価しており、重症例・死亡者数などの具体的データは不明。通常の季節性変動の範囲内である可能性が高いが、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAに関する一般向け啓発記事の側面が強く、具体的な症例数・死亡者数のデータは提示されていない。当局は流行状況を『低く管理下にある』としており、異常性は低いと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 青岛发布无犬只狂犬病区建设方案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Qingdao Releases Plan to Establish a Dog-Free Rabies Zone.
article.articleSummary: Qingdao releases the Plan for Establishing a Rabies-Free Zone for Dogs, targeting completion in one year and a citywide urban-rural synchronized dog rabies immunization to pursue national rabies-free zone status. The plan centers on four systems—disease prevention, epidemic surveillance and early warning, animal health supervision, and reporting and emergency management—and details 12 key tasks across all districts. It mandates full-area implementation with a dog rabies immunization density of at least 70% and an antibody seropositive rate above 70%. It emphasizes continued science education to raise rabies prevention knowledge to over 90%. A governance framework of government-led, department-coordinated, grassroots-linked, and socially co-governed aims to form a comprehensive, end-to-end preventive system. The city seeks to sustain zero canine rabies cases and meet national rabies-free-zone criteria.

triage.headline_ja: 青島市、犬の狂犬病フリーゾーン建設計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: これは新規の疾病発生報告ではなく、青島市による狂犬病予防・撲滅計画の発表であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病の発生事例ではなく、青島市が犬の狂犬病免疫接種と監視体制強化を通じて『狂犬病フリーゾーン』認定を目指す政策発表である。感染症危機情報としてのトリアージ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழகத்தில் வைரஸ் காய்ச்சல்! பொது இடங்களில் முகக்கவசம் கட்டாயம்! முக்கிய அறிவுறுத்தல்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral fever in Tamil Nadu! Face masks are mandatory in public places! Important advisory!
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, Tamil Nadu reports widespread viral fevers from influenza A, adenovirus, RSV, and coronaviruses, with additional pox-like infections such as smallpox/chickenpox/measles also noted. Dengue fever continues to be monitored due to monsoon rainfall. Common symptoms include severe headache, sore throat, joint pains, fatigue, cough and cold; children may experience respiratory distress. Those with comorbidities, pregnancy, old age, or children can be more severely affected. Most fevers resolve within about a week, but severity varies. Official counts are unclear: about 200,000 people are said to have been affected and treated in hospitals, but exact timeframe and notifiability are not specified. Public health measures include mandatory masks in public places (buses, trains, markets, hospitals), handwashing, and coughing etiquette. Schools should disinfect facilities and keep feverish students at home until recovered; seek medical care for persistent symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州でウイルス性発熱が拡大！公共の場でのマスク着用を義務化！重要な注意事項！
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン季節に伴う複数ウイルス（インフルエンザA、RSV、アデノウイルス等）混合の季節性発熱流行であり、重症度・正確な症例数・期間が不明確なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事では『天然痘（Smallpox）』への言及があるが、水痘（chickenpox）との混同・誤訳の可能性が高い。天然痘は1980年に世界根絶済みであり、実際の発生ではないと考えられる。複数の呼吸器系ウイルスが混在した季節性流行報道であり、正確な症例数・重症度データが不足している。

article.articleHeadline: WHO catat penurunan penularan kasus Ebola di wilayah Ituri, Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO records a decrease in Ebola transmission in the Ituri region, Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of Sept. 16–17, 2026, the World Health Organization reports a decline in Ebola virus disease transmission in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, though the outbreak remains widespread overall. In Ituri, about 300 new cases and 160 deaths occurred in the past week, accounting for roughly half of the national total across seven provinces (over 7,200 cases and more than 3,500 deaths). South Kivu has recorded no new cases since May, with more than 1,700 recoveries. The outbreak remains largely concentrated in eastern DRC, with a small Ugandan cluster quickly contained. North Kivu shows a weekly rise, with infections approaching 200 over two weeks. The Ugandan outbreak is described as quickly halted. Authorities caution that key indicators have not yet improved and that sustained, strengthened response efforts will be needed for months.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ・イトゥリ州でのエボラ感染拡大の減少を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7州にわたり7,200例超・3,500人超の死者を出す大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、ウガンダへの越境伝播も発生していることから、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの小規模クラスターは迅速に封じ込められたと報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。北キブ州で症例増加傾向があり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 北, 에볼라 우려에 무역박람회 외국인 방문객 참석 금지
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Korea bans foreign visitors from attending a trade fair due to Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: North Korea will bar Western and Chinese spectators from the Pyongyang Trade Fair scheduled for late October due to Ebola concerns, NK News reports. Russia’s attendance remains unclear, though the Far East Export Promotion Center is recruiting a Pyongyang business delegation for Oct 26–30, suggesting potential participation. North Korea previously eased border restrictions during a spring trade fair but is tightening again. About 3,623 Russians visited North Korea in the first half of 2026. The restriction extends to Russians with travel histories to Ebola-risk African nations—Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, South Sudan, and Kenya—though other pathogens such as MERS, hantavirus, and Nipah virus are cited as contributing factors. As context, the Democratic Republic of the Congo had 7,258 cumulative Ebola cases and 3,510 deaths as of Sept 13, 2026 (case fatality rate 48.4%).

triage.headline_ja: 北朝鮮、エボラ懸念で貿易博覧会への外国人訪問客の参加を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行（累計7,258例、死者3,510人、致死率48.4%）は深刻な公衆衛生事案であり、これを受けて北朝鮮が渡航制限措置を講じている点でIHR基準（深刻性・渡航制限）に複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Cepat Bermutasi Pemicu 'Super Flu', Dokter Spesialis Paru Bandung Ungkap Gejalanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapidly Mutating Influenza A Triggers 'Super Flu,' Bandung Pulmonologist Reveals Its Symptoms
article.articleSummary: Influenza A mutates rapidly, generating subtypes such as H1N1, H5N1, and the recent H3N2 (the so-called 'super flu'), per Dr. Satya Setiadi of RS Murni Teguh Naripan in Bandung, West Java. In Bandung, acute respiratory infections and pneumonia cases are rising; laboratory confirmation requires PCR for influenza A and culture to identify the strain. Transmission occurs mainly via respiratory droplets from coughing or sneezing. Management emphasizes rest and nutrition; antibiotics are strictly discouraged because the infection is viral. Influenza A typically resolves within about one week. No specific imported/exported case details are reported.

article.articleHeadline: Pune witnesses surge in hand, foot, mouth disease cases among children
article.articleSummary: HFMD surge in Pune, India, among children aged 2–7 years, with repeated infections reported for the first time this year. Doctors note four to five new cases weekly and about 30 cases in a month, spreading within families, housing societies, and schools. Transmission is linked to seasonal weather changes and close-contact settings in day care and schools; HFMD is highly contagious. Most children recover with symptomatic treatment in one week to 10 days; severe cases or high-risk children may require hospitalization. Symptoms include fever, mouth sores, fatigue, and rashes with blisters on hands, feet, tongue, gums and inner cheeks; elbows, buttocks, and knees can also be affected. Prevention relies on handwashing, surface disinfection, and isolating symptomatic children; no specific drug exists. Pune experiences HFMD activity during June–October and December–January; authorities urge preventive measures in schools.

article.articleHeadline: Đừng chủ quan với bệnh tay chân miệng: Thấy 6 biểu hiện này cần đi khám sớm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't ignore hand, foot, and mouth disease: If you notice these 6 signs, seek medical attention early.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) is an enterovirus illness spreading rapidly among Vietnamese children. Transmission occurs via saliva, respiratory secretions, blister fluid, feces, or contaminated surfaces; outbreaks peak in March–May and September–December. In the first eight months of 2026, Vietnam reported nearly 100,000 HFMD cases, with young children at highest risk in nurseries, kindergartens, and schools. Common signs include a rash with 2–5 mm blisters on hands, feet, and buttocks, and oral ulcers 4–8 mm. Fever may be mild or high; severe signs include persistent fever, lethargy, rapid or irregular breathing, sweating, and tremors. No antiviral treatment exists; care is supportive. Prevention emphasizes hygiene, cleaning surfaces, separate laundry for infected children, and avoiding shared utensils. In Hue, HFMD cases rose 1.9-fold as schools reopened.

article.articleHeadline: Tamil Nadu: Nodal officers to monitor dengue, special wards to be set up in hospitals across districts
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu reports 15,933 dengue cases and 9 deaths in 2026, prompting intensified measures. To curb spread, special dengue wards are being set up in government and government medical college hospitals. District Collectors have been ordered to carry out dengue monitoring and coordination work, with 45 district nodal officers appointed to visit districts, record daily incidence, and inspect mosquito breeding sites. Authorities will also conduct inspections and studies to prevent mosquito breeding and intensify preventive measures across Tamil Nadu, with high incidence reported in Chennai, Coimbatore, Cuddalore, and Chengalpattu. District administrations have been advised to keep medicines such as platelets available 24 hours a day, and the public is urged to seek hospital care promptly on fever.

article.articleHeadline: 胸片正常≠绝对安全！医生揭秘：结核杆菌如何在肺内"潜伏装死"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A normal chest X-ray is not absolutely safe! Doctors reveal: how Mycobacterium tuberculosis can lie dormant in the lungs.
article.articleSummary: Normal chest X-ray is not a guarantee against TB. Globally ~1.7 billion people have latent Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection; China accounts for over 200 million. After infection, people may clear the bacteria, harbor latent infection without symptoms, or develop active pulmonary TB. Latent infection carries reactivation risk, particularly in the first five years; preventive therapy in high‑risk latent cases can cut progression by 60–90%. Screening uses tuberculin skin test (TST) and IFN-γ release assays (IGRA); in a 6,893-person school-contact study, TST positivity was 22.62% vs IGRA 8.33%, suggesting TST may overestimate latent infection. Diagnostic workup should combine imaging, sputum testing, and exposure history. High‑risk groups include child contacts under five, HIV patients, recently infected students, and other immunocompromised individuals. Treatments: INH 6–9 months; INH+rifapentine 3 months; INH+rifampin 3 months; rifampin alone 4 months. Active TB symptoms—prolonged cough, afternoon low fever, night sweats, weight loss, chest pain, or hemoptysis—require medical evaluation.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Satun Livestock Office and Koh Saha Rai SAO push to establish a rabies-free area, advancing spaying/neutering and vaccination of dogs and cats.
article.articleSummary: On a multi-agency initiative in Satun Province, Thailand, the Satun Livestock Office and Koh Saha Rai Subdistrict Administrative Organization launched an integrated rabies-free area program under 'Rabies-free animals, people safe from rabies.' At Ban Koh Saha Rai Chai Phat School in Mueang Satun, officials and mobile services conducted proactive vaccination and spay/neuter campaigns for dogs and cats, plus public and student education on rabies prevention and responsible pet care. Participants included school administrators, police, teachers, village chiefs, volunteers, and residents. Over the 3-day activity: 81 animals sterilized (dogs: 19 males, 23 females; cats: 18 males, 21 females); 45 animals vaccinated against rabies; 30 adults and 45 students attended trainings.

article.articleHeadline: WHO: There are encouraging signs in the fight against Ebola in the DRC
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-17, WHO reports ongoing Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with encouraging signs in Ituri province where transmission is decreasing; South Kivu has not reported new cases since May, and more than 1,700 people have recovered. Over four months the epidemic has been contained mainly in the northeast of the DRC, with a small cross-border outbreak in Uganda that was quickly stopped. Nevertheless, the epidemic continues to grow and has caused more than 7,200 cases and over 3,500 deaths across seven provinces. Last week, Ituri logged 300 new cases and 160 deaths; in North Kivu, weekly cases rose sharply, nearly doubling in two weeks from about 100 to over 200. Challenges include conflict, population movements, and attacks on humanitarian workers and health centers, making response efforts demanding and requiring sustained action for many difficult months.

article.articleHeadline: OMS: hay señales alentadoras en lucha contra el ébola en la RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Encouraging signs in the fight against Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports encouraging signs in Ebola fight in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as transmission declines in Ituri, the hardest-hit province. South Kivu has not reported new cases since May, and more than 1,700 people have recovered. Over four months, the outbreak has been contained mainly in northeastern DRC, with a small outbreak in Uganda halted quickly. Nonetheless, the epidemic continues to grow and cause deaths: more than 7,200 cases and over 3,500 deaths across seven provinces. Last week, Ituri logged 300 new cases and 160 deaths; North Kivu saw rapid increases, with weekly cases nearly doubling in two weeks (roughly 100 to over 200). Response work remains challenging in a conflict-affected region with large population movements and attacks on aid workers and health facilities, requiring sustained, coordinated action for many months.

article.articleHeadline: Gejala Influenza A saat Menyerang Tubuh, Apakah Seperti Flu Biasa?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Symptoms of Influenza A as It Attacks the Body: Is It Like the Common Flu?
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is an acute viral respiratory infection caused by the influenza A virus (Orthomyxoviridae) with pandemic potential due to broad host range and rapid antigenic change. In Indonesia, Influenza A circulated during 2005–2017, first as H5N1 (avian flu) and later as H1N1 in 2009. Transmission is via respiratory droplets from sneezing, coughing, or talking. Typical symptoms include sudden high fever, dry cough, sore throat, runny nose or nasal congestion, muscle and joint pain, headache (frontal or retro-orbital), and marked malaise. Incubation is 1–5 days (average 2); individuals can spread the virus from before symptom onset up to 5–7 days after infection. While often manageable, Influenza A can be severe, leading to pneumonia, respiratory failure, or death, especially in children, the elderly, and those with uncontrolled comorbidities such as diabetes, heart, kidney, or liver disease. Prevention emphasizes masking, rest, fluids, and balanced nutrition.

article.articleHeadline: How climate change could reshape Kerala's dengue threat
article.articleSummary: Kerala, India faces escalating dengue risk as warming, humid climate supports transmission. A GeoHealth study led by IITM researcher Sophia Yacob finds El Niño can intensify these conditions, particularly before the monsoon, elevating dengue risk in June–July, including in El Niño year 2026. The team links temperature, humidity, ENSO conditions, rainfall, and monsoon phases to Kerala dengue incidents, with notable regional variation within the state. In Kerala, pre-monsoon March–May is hot and humid with thunderstorms; dengue cases rise in May and peak in June–July, while about 60% of annual cases occur during the Southwest Monsoon (June–Sept). A machine-learning model combining real-time climate forecasts with health surveillance can explain up to 72% of dengue variation and offer five-month lead-time for preparedness. The IITM team previously studied Pune and plans to extend to Chennai and Bhopal.

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ заявила, что вспышка Эболы в ДР Конго еще далека от завершения -- НИАТ "Ховар"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says that the Ebola outbreak in the DRC is far from over — NIAT 'Khovar'.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 September 2026, the World Health Organization reports that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has slowed but remains far from over. The country has recorded more than 7,000 confirmed Ebola cases and over 3,500 deaths, with transmission reaching a seventh province. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that ongoing spread remains possible given high population mobility in the region, despite encouraging signs. The situation underscores the need for sustained surveillance, response activities, and public health measures to halt transmission across affected areas.

triage.notes: WHOが公式に流行継続を警告しており、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの進行状況報告。継続的なモニタリングとフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 11 African countries record 1,153 mpox cases in 6 weeks - Blueprint Newspapers Limited
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, WHO reports active mpox transmission in 11 African countries during 6 July–16 August 2026, with 1,153 confirmed cases and seven deaths. Madagascar recorded 785 cases—the highest in the period—followed by Angola (184), Kenya (94), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (41), and Cameroon (28). Weekly confirmed cases on the continent have hovered around 200, though figures may be underestimated due to reporting delays and reduced surveillance. The multi-country mpox outbreak has affected 35 African countries since January 2025. In Africa, 52,424 confirmed mpox cases and 238 deaths were reported from 1 January 2025 to 16 August 2026. Globally, 65,784 cases and 264 deaths were reported across 105 countries between 1 January 2025 and 31 July 2026. In July 2026, 32 countries reported 1,370 cases and seven deaths; Africa accounted for 74.8% of these. Notably, Chile and Hungary reported clade Ib mpox for the first time, while several European countries reported community transmission; Madagascar's outbreak is described as the largest mpox outbreak globally and in Africa since December 2025.

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: مؤشرات مشجعة على إحراز تقدم في مكافحة "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Encouraging signs of progress in the fight against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows encouraging signs, with over 7,200 cases and 3,500 deaths reported across seven provinces and about 1,700 recoveries. South Kivu has reported no new cases since May, while the outbreak remains concentrated in the northeast. In Ituri, approximately 300 cases and 160 deaths occurred in the past week, and in North Kivu weekly cases have nearly doubled over two weeks to exceed 200. Therapeutic and post-exposure prophylaxis trials are accelerating, with vaccine trials expected in the coming weeks. A decline in transmission in some areas does not indicate the outbreak has ended; sustained response and funding are essential.

article.articleHeadline: Pimpri Chinchwad Dengue Cases: पिंपरी-चिंचवडमध्ये डेंग्यूचा डंख; १५ दिवसांत ३८ रुग्ण पॉझिटिव्ह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pimpri-Chinchwad Dengue Cases: Dengue strike in Pimpri-Chinchwad; 38 patients test positive in 15 days.
article.articleSummary: In Pimpri-Chinchwad, the first 15 days of September recorded 38 dengue positives among 905 suspected dengue cases and 2 malaria positives among 21,497 suspected malaria cases. The city faces rising vector-borne disease risk linked to changing weather and monsoon conditions that favor mosquito breeding. After rainfall, drains overflow and waste buildup persists, sustaining transmission. The Pimpri-Chinchwad Municipal Corporation's Break the Chain campaign targets dengue, malaria, and chikungunya through prevention, public awareness, and sanitation measures. Data reflect ongoing vector-borne activity in this urban area, with lab-confirmed positives within a larger pool of suspected cases, highlighting the need for community participation to reduce breeding sites.

article.articleHeadline: Wamendagri Wiyagus Dorong Pemda Percepat Penanggulangan Tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wiyagus, Deputy Minister of Home Affairs, Urges Local Governments to Accelerate Tuberculosis Control.
article.articleSummary: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Akhmad Wiyagus urged local governments in Central Java to accelerate tuberculosis (TB) control, stressing TB’s health, productivity, and economic impacts, including rising poverty and unemployment. Speaking at the 16 September 2026 Coordinating Meeting on Accelerating TB Control in Central Java at RSUP Dr. Kariadi, Semarang, he noted TB treatment for suspected cases can last up to six months, causing substantial productivity losses—about 26% of patients lose or suspend work. He called for strong central–local collaboration, drawing on lessons from the COVID-19 response, and for translating plans into concrete district and provincial programs. Wiyagus also urged leveraging the Desa Siaga (Village Alert) system to strengthen community involvement in TB control.

triage.triage_reason: 既知の結核流行対策に関する行政的な会議・呼びかけの内容であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規感染拡大を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核の既存の慢性的流行に対する行政対応の記事であり、急性の感染症危機シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: "에볼라 들어올라"... 북한, 10월 평양 박람회 외국인 방문 전격 금지-국제ㅣ한국일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Ebola Is Coming In"... North Korea Bans Foreign Visitors to October Pyongyang Expo - International | Hankook Ilbo
article.articleSummary: North Korea will ban Western and Chinese visitors from the late-October Pyongyang Trade Fair to block potential importation of Ebola and other dangerous infections amid Africa-linked spread concerns. The policy targets Ebola, Middle East respiratory syndrome (MERS), and Nipah virus, emphasizing hardened border controls to prevent entry. This marks a reversal from spring, when Western visitors were briefly allowed, and contrasts with last autumn’s limited attendance from China, Russia, Thailand, Mongolia, India, Cambodia, and Switzerland. Russia remains an exception; the Far East Export Support Center advertised a Oct 26–30 Russian business delegation to Pyongyang, continuing a pattern of Russian participation after thousands of Russians visited in the past two years, including 3,623 in the first half of this year. Russians with recent travel to Africa (DRC, Uganda, Kenya) remain barred regardless of nationality.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラが入ってくる」... 北朝鮮、10月平壌博覧会への外国人訪問を電撃禁止
triage.triage_reason: 北朝鮮がエボラ・MERS・ニパウイルスの流入を懸念して博覧会への外国人訪問を禁止したという政策対応の記事であり、実際の感染症発生に関する疫学的詳細（症例数、重症度等）が記事内に存在しないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は北朝鮮による渡航制限政策に関する報道であり、実際のエボラ・MERS・ニパウイルスの発生状況や症例データについての具体的記述はない。DRC・ウガンダ・ケニアへの渡航歴がある者を対象とした規制という文脈から、アフリカでのエボラ流行への懸念が示唆されるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。中国・タイ・インド・カンボジア等は博覧会への過去の訪問国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola face ravagii în Congo de 120 de zile. Peste 3.500 de decese au fost confirmate - Știrile ProTV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has ravaged the Democratic Republic of the Congo for 120 days. More than 3,500 deaths have been confirmed - ProTV News.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, Ebola has ravaged the Democratic Republic of the Congo for about 120 days, with more than 3,500 confirmed deaths. The outbreak has spread across seven provinces, complicating detection and case monitoring. Ongoing armed conflict, population displacement, and strikes by healthcare workers hinder response efforts. The episode involves a rarer Ebola strain for which no vaccine is licensed. Clinicians are using serum intended for a different Ebola strain in hopes of offering protection, but the effectiveness remains unclear. Surveillance and control remain severely challenged by security and logistical obstacles. The report notes confirmed deaths but provides limited detail on laboratory methods, infection sources, or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で猛威を振るい120日、3,500人以上の死亡が確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラの大規模アウトブレイクで死者3,500人超・7州に拡大し、ワクチン未承認株かつ紛争・人道危機で対応が著しく困難であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ワクチン未承認の希少エボラ株、武力紛争・人口移動・医療従事者ストライキが対応を阻害。7州に拡大し越境リスクも懸念されるが、他国への感染拡大の具体的事実は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Gajah Diego Mati di PLG Minas Riau, Diduga akibat Infeksi Pencernaan Kronis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elephant Diego Dies at PLG Minas Riau, Suspected to Be Due to a Chronic Gastrointestinal Infection
article.articleSummary: Elephant Diego, a 17-year-old tame elephant bred at PLG Minas in Siak Regency, Riau, died on 16 September 2026 at 12:00 WIB after several days of treatment. Illness began 10 September with diarrhea and reduced appetite. Initial evaluation suspected intestinal parasitism with worms found in feces; he was treated with antibiotics, anti-inflammatories, and dewormer. Fecal testing at PPS Yayasan Arsari Djojohadikusumo in Pekanbaru later showed negative results for parasites. After partial improvement, Diego’s condition worsened on 15 September: anorexia, frequent watery diarrhea, extreme weakness, and minimal drinking. On 16 September, during a second-day of treatment with IV fluids and blood sampling, his condition abruptly declined and he died at 12:00 WIB. The BBKSDA Riau attributes the death to a suspected chronic gastrointestinal infection, though no specific pathogen is confirmed in the report. No details on imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: リアウ州ミナス保護区のゾウ「ディエゴ」死亡、慢性消化器感染症が疑われる
triage.triage_reason: 単一の飼育象における消化器疾患による死亡例であり、病原体も特定されておらず、人への公衆衛生上の影響やヒト-ヒト感染の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 動物（ゾウ）1頭の単発死亡事例であり、病原体不明・伝播性の証拠もないため公衆衛生シグナルとしての重要性は低い。継続報道があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 猴痘｜再增兩男確診 近期14宗個案有9宗報稱交友APP尋性伴侶 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox — Two more men diagnosed; nine of the fourteen recent cases reported using dating apps to seek sexual partners
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox in Hong Kong: As of 16 September 2026, two more men diagnosed, bringing the recent outbreak to 14 cases, with 9 reporting use of dating apps to find sexual partners. The new patients are a 48-year-old and a 30-year-old male, both in hospital isolation and stable; there is no epidemiological link between these two cases and earlier cases. Since 2022, Hong Kong has reported 107 monkeypox cases (85 local, 22 imported). Since August, 23 cases (18 local, 5 imported), with 14 in August–September. All patients are male; investigations show men who have sex with men or bisexual men engaging in high-risk sex during incubation, with 9 cases reporting dating-app use. The first case developed lip ulcers on Aug 8, fever, cervical lymphadenopathy, and a rash on palms, forearms, and upper back; the second began Aug 7 with fever, sore throat, and a rash around genitals, mouth, neck, and fingers. Both were treated at Queen Mary Hospital and Social Hygiene Clinics, and remain in isolation.

triage.headline_ja: サル痘（Mpox）―男性2名が新たに確診、直近14例中9例が出会い系アプリで性交渉相手を探していたと報告
triage.triage_reason: 香港でMpoxの局所感染クラスターが継続的に拡大しており（8月以降23例、直近14例）、MSMコミュニティ内での性的接触を介した人-人感染が続いている点でWPRO基準（異常性・曝露継続・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、メディア報道による社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 香港はChina（1814991）に統合して分類。2022年以降の累積107例、直近クラスターはMSM間の性的接触を介した感染拡大が中心で、重症例・死亡の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO catat penurunan penularan kasus Ebola di wilayah Ituri, Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO records a decline in the transmission of Ebola cases in the Ituri region, Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 September 2026, Ebola transmission is decreasing in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, but the outbreak remains widespread overall. In Ituri, about 300 new cases and 160 deaths were recorded in the past week, nearly half of the national totals. South Kivu Province has reported no new cases since May, with more than 1,700 people recovered. The outbreak remains largely confined to eastern DRC, with a smaller outbreak in Uganda quickly halted. Across seven provinces, the cumulative toll exceeds 7,200 cases and 3,500 deaths. North Kivu has seen a sharp weekly rise, with infections climbing from around 100 to more than 200 in two weeks. Tedros warned that key indicators have not yet improved sufficiently and that the response must be sustained and strengthened for months to come.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ・イトゥリ州でのエボラ感染拡大の減少を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,200例超・死者3,500人超に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。北キブ州で新規感染が急増している点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: HYROX faecal incident may spread 'highly contagious' disease warns health expert
article.articleSummary: Beijing, China, 12 September HYROX race: Australian athlete Joanna Wietrzyk, 22, experienced bowel incontinence yet finished first, triggering debate over event safety and refunds. Infectious-disease expert Professor Ramon Shaban of the Sydney Infectious Disease Institute warns mass gatherings can spread fecal-oral infections, notably norovirus and giardiasis. Transmission can occur via contaminated food or water, or surfaces and objects such as gym equipment, with symptoms including stomach cramps, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea lasting days. HYROX co-founder Moritz Fuerste apologised and announced immediate rulebook changes and new event procedures to prevent recurrence. The commentary emphasizes shared responsibility of individuals and organisers to minimise infection risk at mass events, in light of concerns raised by this incident.

triage.headline_ja: HYROXでの排便事故、専門家が「感染力の高い」疾患拡散の恐れを警告
triage.triage_reason: 単一の個別事例に基づく専門家コメントであり、実際の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の被害は報告されていない。IHR・WPRO基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は北京で開催されたHYROXレース中の1選手の排便失禁事故に関する報道で、実際の感染症発生を報じたものではない。専門家の一般的な注意喚起にとどまり、対象国での感染症アウトブレイクとは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola din Congo este departe de a se fi încheiat. A depășit 120 de zile de la declararea focarului și a ucis cel puțin 3.500 de persoane
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is far from over. It has passed more than 120 days since the outbreak was declared and has killed at least 3,500 people.
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has persisted for more than 120 days since its declaration (as of 17 September 2026), with at least 3,500 deaths. The virus has spread to seven provinces. Authorities face difficulties monitoring cases amid armed conflict, population displacement, and strikes in the health system. There is no vaccine authorized for the outbreak’s specific strain, further hindering response efforts. Doctors are using a serum intended for another Ebola strain in the hope of some protection, but the efficacy is unclear. The fatality toll continues to rise as the outbreak persists in a context of insecurity and healthcare workforce disruptions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は終息にはほど遠い。発生宣言から120日以上が経過し、少なくとも3,500人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、7州への拡大・ワクチン未承認・武力紛争下での対応困難など重大な懸念があるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 対応する特異株に承認済みワクチンがなく、武力紛争・住民避難・医療従事者ストライキが対応を妨げていると報告されている。致死率・拡大範囲ともに深刻でフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Gajah Diego PLG Minas Mati Akibat Infeksi Saluran Pencernaan Kronis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elephant Diego PLG Minas Died Due to Chronic Gastrointestinal Infection
article.articleSummary: Diego, a 17-year-old male elephant at PLG Minas in Riau, Indonesia, died on 16 September 2026 at 12:00 WIB after a several-day health decline. Illness began on 10 September with reduced appetite and loose stools; initial veterinary assessment suggested parasitic infection, with parasites detected in feces. Treatment included antibiotics, anti-inflammatories, supportive care, and deworming. A fecal lab test at PPS Yayasan Arsari Djodjohadikusumo later was negative for parasites. Despite temporary improvement, Diego deteriorated and collapsed on 16 September, dying soon after. Necropsy indicated a chronic gastrointestinal infection as the probable cause, with tissue samples taken for further laboratory confirmation. Diego, known for his friendly demeanor with visitors, is buried at PLG Minas. BBKSDA Riau urged habitat conservation to reduce conflicts and bolster wildlife rescue efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 象のディエゴ(PLG Minas)、慢性胃腸感染症により死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一の飼育象における個別死亡例であり、人獣共通感染症やヒトへの公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 単一動物の死亡例で、感染症のヒトへの拡大や動物集団への広がりを示す情報はない。生息地保全に関する呼びかけがあるのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Уже в Германии и Франции: смертельная Эбола перешагнула границы Африки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Already in Germany and France: the deadly Ebola virus has crossed Africa's borders.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has surpassed 7,258 confirmed cases and 3,510 deaths (approximately 48% fatality) across seven provinces and 62 health zones as of 13 September 2026. The epicenter remains Ituri, though transmission is easing there, while North Kivu reports a weekly rise to over 200 new cases. Sud-Ubangi in the northwest is the latest province affected, bordering the Central African Republic and Republic of Congo. Cross-border spread is a clear risk; cases have previously been reported in Uganda, Germany, and France. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; Congo is testing several therapeutics, and researchers are evaluating whether Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) may offer partial protection. Ongoing conflict, displacement, crowded camps, and contact-tracing challenges hinder control. In May, WHO declared the outbreak a PHEIC; the outbreak remains large and expanding.

triage.headline_ja: すでにドイツとフランスへ：致死性エボラ出血熱がアフリカの国境を越えた
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,258例・致死率約48%の大規模エボラ流行が拡大中で、ウガンダ・ドイツ・フランスへの越境感染も報告されており、WHOはPHEICを宣言している。IHR基準を複数満たす明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: ドイツ・フランス・ウガンダ・中央アフリカ共和国は記事中で言及されるが対象国リスト外、または発生地ではなく感染拡大先のため verified_locations には含めない。WHOは本流行を2026年5月にPHEICと宣言済み。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: എച്ച് വൺ എൻ വൺ പ്രതിരോധം: ജാഗ്രത വേണം | H1N1 Prevention: Caution is needed
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 Prevention: Caution is needed.
article.articleSummary: Palakkad district (Kerala) warns public to guard against H1N1 influenza A, a respiratory illness that spreads rapidly through the air. Symptoms: high fever, shivering/chills, sore throat, cough, runny or congested nose, body aches, headache, and fatigue. Transmission occurs via droplets when coughing or sneezing or by touching contaminated surfaces and then touching eyes or nose. Most recover in a few days, but breathing difficulty or chest pain warrants urgent hospital care. High-risk groups include hospitalized patients, others with serious illnesses, pregnant women, and children under two; pregnancy raises risk of pneumonia, fetal distress, and preterm birth, so medical advice should be sought promptly. Infected individuals should isolate from others at home as far as possible. Prevention: cover coughs or sneezes with the elbow, wash hands with soap or use sanitizer, avoid touching the face, and wash hands after returning home. If in public, wear a mask and maintain social distancing.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1予防：注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例急増などの報告はなく、既知の疾患に対する定型的な注意喚起である。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体による季節性H1N1インフルエンザの一般的な予防啓発情報であり、具体的な患者数増加や異常な流行状況の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Prevention: डेंगू से बचाव में काम आएगी सावधानी, स्वास्थ्य मंत्रालय ने बताया क्या करें | Dengue Prevention Tips Health Ministry Guidelines Hindi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Prevention: Caution Will Prove Useful in Preventing Dengue; The Health Ministry Has Explained What to Do | Dengue Prevention Tips Health Ministry Guidelines Hindi.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention guidelines issued by India's Ministry of Health and Family Welfare emphasize proactive measures during the monsoon season and afterward. Dengue mosquitoes (Aedes) breed in clean, standing water, so households should regularly empty, clean, and cover water containers and prevent water from accumulating in pots, tires, and other receptacles. Personal protection includes dressing in full sleeves, using mosquito repellents, sleeping under a mosquito net, and installing fine-mesh screens on windows and doors to keep mosquitoes out. The clinical picture to watch for includes sudden high fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, intense muscle and joint pain (bone-breaking fever), vomiting, loss of appetite, and mild skin rashes. The ministry stresses community responsibility: even if one home is clean, nearby stagnant water can invite mosquitoes; thus awareness and neighborhood action to remove standing water are essential, as prevention is the best cure.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱予防：注意がデング熱予防に役立つ、保健省が対策を説明
triage.triage_reason: インドの保健省による季節性デング熱予防の一般啓発ガイドラインであり、具体的な発生急増や異常な事象の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は毎年恒例の季節性デング熱予防に関する保健省の啓発情報であり、具体的な症例数増加や集団発生の報告は含まれていない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: A parasitic bug that eats human skin cells is thriving in the UK right now
article.articleSummary: Harvest mites (neotrombicula autumnalis) are thriving in the UK, with activity peaking in September–October as eggs hatch. These tiny six-legged parasites latch onto humans or dogs after brushing through grass and soil, inject enzymes, and feed on liquefied skin. Bites are usually invisible, with itching starting about 24 hours later and presenting as itchy red bumps (often in clusters) around the waist, ankles, and skin folds; the condition is trombiculosis. UK mites do not transmit disease, unlike scrub typhus in East Asia/South Pacific; in the USA chigger bites have been linked to summer penile syndrome. Management includes showers, antihistamines, and hydrocortisone cream; cold packs help itching. For dogs, monitor for itching and vet-check suspected infestation due to seasonal canine illness (SCI). Prevent exposure by keeping skin covered and maintaining flea prevention; treat bites early to avoid infection.

triage.headline_ja: 皮膚細胞を食べる寄生虫が今、英国で大量発生中
triage.triage_reason: 英国のツツガムシ（ハーベストマイト）による軽微な皮膚炎の一般的な健康情報記事であり、疾患媒介性はなく公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は英国のハーベストマイトによる無害な虫刺され（trombiculosis）であり、ツツガムシ病（scrub typhus）は東アジア等での比較のために言及されているのみ。対象国での実際の発生ではないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: Fiji declares national HIV crisis
article.articleSummary: Fiji has declared a national HIV emergency as sexual transmission and injecting drug use drive the epidemic, with 2025 new diagnoses reaching 2,016—16 times the 2019 level. An estimated 1 in 60 adults are living with HIV; about 2 in 100 pregnant women carry the virus, and 18 of 59 HIV-exposed infants born in 2025 died before age one. The government is expanding free HIV testing, prevention services, and treatment, including rapid testing, prevention medicine for people at higher risk, harm-reduction measures for people who inject drugs, and free treatment for those diagnosed. External support comes from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the UN. UNAIDS notes that among known transmissions, roughly half are sexual and more than 42% are due to injecting drug use. Fiji also aims to implement a needle-syringe programme; transmission has risen since 2019 amid high-risk injectors, with drug flows via Pacific transit hubs.

triage.headline_ja: フィジー、HIV国家緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常・予想外」の2つに該当し、フィジー政府が国家緊急事態を宣言するなど社会的・政治的関心も高いため、フルRRAへの移行が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 本イベントの主たる発生国はフィジーであり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。インド・オーストラリア・ニュージーランドは外部支援提供国として記載されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Is Outrunning The Response In Eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has produced at least 7,200 confirmed cases and nearly 3,500 deaths, the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history and the second-deadliest on record. Containment could be achieved in about three months with sufficient resources, yet only 60% of the WHO’s funding needs are met. Armed conflict, weak infrastructure, difficult terrain, and surveillance gaps—estimated 70–80% of new cases have no known epidemiological link—hamstring response. The United States remains the largest donor, with direct assistance surpassing $512 million after an August pledge of $242 million. The CDC Foundation bridges public health agencies with private resources to accelerate urgent needs—earlier in 2014–16 West Africa mobilized nearly $57 million from 1,600 donors, enabling operations and research despite funding delays. A rapid, flexible funding approach is essential to control the outbreak at its source; current risk to the U.S. remains low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国東部で対応能力を上回る拡大を続ける
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪規模（7,200症例・約3,500人死亡）のエボラ流行が続いており、資金不足・武装紛争・監視体制の欠如により制御が困難な状況であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国・アンゴラも発生地域として挙げられているが、記事の主題はDRC国内での流行拡大であり、米国・アンゴラでの感染発生は言及されていないため除外した。国際的拡大リスクは、武装紛争・監視ギャップ・国境地域の脆弱性から推定されるが、具体的な越境事例の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk ghi nhận 6.715 trường hợp mắc sốt xuất huyết Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak reports 6,715 Dengue fever cases.
article.articleSummary: 6,715 dengue cases and 2 fatalities reported in Dak Lak Province as of 16 September 2026, with 314 dengue clusters and 90 active clusters. Buon Ma Thuot City accounts for the highest caseload (1,532), followed by Ea H'leo (858), Cu M'gar (571), Krong Pac (555), and Krong Ana (496). Very high risk areas include Cu M'gar, Ea Tul, Buon Ma Thuot wards, Tan Lap ward, and Hoa Phu commune; high risk areas include Ea Drang, Ea Súp, Ea Na, Krong Pac, Ea Ktur, Song Hinh, and Ea Kao ward. Health authorities urge enhanced surveillance, early detection, and rapid outbreak response. Vector control focuses on eliminating larval habitats (loăng quăng and bọ gậy) and insecticide spraying per guidelines with effectiveness evaluation. Emphasis on environmental sanitation: remove standing-water containers, clean debris, and dispose of waste at communities, construction sites, dormitories, schools, and crowded places. Citizens should cover water containers, remove water-holding items, and seek medical care if dengue symptoms appear, avoiding self-treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省でデング熱6,715例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダクラク省で季節性デング熱の症例数（6,715例、死亡2例）が報告されているが、同国の風土病として例年発生する範囲内であり、国際的拡大や異常性は認められない。死亡例・多数クラスターの動向は注視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで季節性・地域的に流行する風土病であり、本記事はダクラク省内の症例集計と対策強化の呼びかけを報じるもの。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、死亡例増加やクラスター拡大の推移は継続的な観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: മുംബൈയിൽ അപകടകാരിയായ മലേറിയ വകഭേദം പടരുന്നു ; ഫാൽസിപാറം മലേറിയയുടെ ലക്ഷണങ്ങളെ കുറിച്ച് അറി‍ഞ്ഞിരിക്കൂ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Mumbai, a dangerous malaria strain is spreading; learn about the symptoms of falciparum malaria.
article.articleSummary: Plasmodium falciparum malaria is increasing in Mumbai, rising from 375 cases in 2015 to 2,382 in 2025 (535% growth). The falciparum share among Mumbai’s total malaria cases grew from 5.5% in 2015 to 25.3% in 2025, per the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) Health Department. Transmission remains seasonal and is driven by Anopheles mosquitoes; the surge followed the COVID-19 period, with migrant workers from eastern India and Chhattisgarh identified as key contributors. Gadchiroli district shows a similar pattern, underscoring migrant labor and vector prevalence. Clinically, falciparum malaria can cause kidney dysfunction and significant anemia (low hematocrit). Early fever may be indistinguishable; high fever with dehydration, fainting, or vomiting requires urgent medical care. Common symptoms include fever, chills, headache, myalgia, fatigue, dizziness, dehydration, vomiting, and abdominal discomfort. WHO warns treatment within 24 hours to prevent severe disease or death; at‑risk groups include children, pregnant women, and HIV/AIDS patients.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイで危険なマラリア株が拡大中 ― 熱帯熱マラリアの症状に注意
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイでの熱帯熱マラリア症例が過去10年で535%増加という統計的傾向を報じているが、突発的な異常事象というより季節性・経年的な増加であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 記事はムンバイ市保健当局(BMC)のデータに基づく熱帯熱マラリア増加傾向の解説記事であり、移民労働者やハマダラカによる季節性伝播が主因とされる。新規の異常な流行や国際的な健康危機を示す情報はなく、既知の公衆衛生課題としての継続的モニタリングが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு பாதிப்பு நடப்பாண்டில் 16 ஆயிரத்தை நெருங்கியது.. வீடுகளில் தண்ணீர் தேங்காமல் பார்த்துக்கொள்ளுங்கள் - முக்கிய அறிவுறுத்தல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases near 16,000 this year... Ensure water does not stagnate in homes - important advisory.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, dengue cases in Tamil Nadu have approached 16,000 this year, with authorities intensifying prevention and surveillance. The Tamil Nadu Department of Public Health says there is no need for public panic and urges precautions during the monsoon season, when transmission commonly rises due to weather changes. Special officers have been appointed in all districts to monitor the situation and bolster containment efforts. To curb mosquito breeding, residents are advised to prevent water from stagnating in homes and surrounding areas. Those experiencing fever or dengue-like symptoms should seek prompt medical evaluation and appropriate treatment. The report notes that dengue outbreaks correlate with seasonal rainfall patterns, and ongoing government actions aim to maintain vigilance and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 今年のデング熱患者数が16,000人に迫る…自宅で水がたまらないよう注意 - 重要な勧告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱流行であり毎年発生する既知の疾患だが、症例数増加と当局の監視強化があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・タミルナードゥ州で季節性（モンスーン期）に毎年発生する既知の風土病であり、当局はパニックの必要はないとしている。重症度や死亡者数の情報は記事に記載なし。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: പാലക്കാട് ജില്ലയിൽ എച്ച്1എൻ1 ജാഗ്രതാ നിർദേശം; കടുത്ത പനി, ചുമ, തൊണ്ടവേദന, ശരീരവേദന തുടങ്ങിയ ലക്ഷണങ്ങൾ അവഗണിക്കരുത്, ഗർഭിണികൾ, കിടപ്പുരോഗികൾ, ഗുരുതര രോഗബാധിതർ, രണ്ട് വയസ്സിന് താഴെയുള്ള കുട്ടികൾ എന്നിവർ പ്രത്യേകം ശ്രദ്ധിക്കണമെന്ന് ഡി.എം.ഒ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 Vigilance Directive in Palakkad District; Do not ignore symptoms such as high fever, cough, sore throat, and body pains; pregnant women, those with chronic illnesses, severely ill patients, and children under two years old should take special care, according to the DMO.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, Palakkad District Medical Officer warns the public about influenza A (H1N1), a rapidly spreading respiratory illness transmitted via airborne droplets and contaminated surfaces. Major symptoms include severe fever, chills, sore throat, cough, runny nose, body pains, headache, extreme fatigue, and weakness. Transmission occurs when infected individuals cough/sneeze or touch contaminated objects and then touch eyes or nose. Most infections resolve in a few days, but breathing difficulties or chest pain require immediate hospital care. Vulnerable groups—pregnant women, individuals with chronic illnesses, severely ill patients, and children under two—should take special precautions and seek medical attention if symptoms arise. Household members with symptoms should minimize close contact. Pregnancy increases susceptibility and risk of pneumonia-like serious lung disease and potential premature birth, prompting the DMO to urge heightened vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: パラッカド県でH1N1警戒指示；高熱、咳、喉の痛み、体の痛みなどの症状を軽視しないこと。妊婦、寝たきり患者、重症患者、2歳未満の子供は特に注意するようDMOが呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1に対する地域保健当局の注意喚起であり、既知の疾患・毎年見られる公衆衛生対応のため異常性は低いが、脆弱層への影響拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)に関する地域保健当局(DMO)からの注意喚起記事。症例数や死亡者数などの具体的な疫学データは記載されておらず、国際的な脅威度は低いと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Sebut Kasus Influenza A Naik, Balita Jadi Kelompok Paling Banyak Terinfeksi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Says Influenza A Cases Are Rising, Toddlers Are the Most Infected Group.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in Indonesia, with East Java among affected areas, according to the Ministry of Health. Authorities tightened surveillance at sentinel health facilities to anticipate broader transmission. Kemenkes spokesperson Aji Muhawarman said the uptick aligns with expected seasonal patterns as year-end approaches. Surveillance data show young children are most affected, with about 33% of detected cases in the 0–4 year age group. Despite higher patient visits at some regional hospitals, national health facilities remain safe and not overcapacity, and the rise is not expected to become a significant surge. Officials reiterate that management relies on standard treatment and strict local monitoring. Parents are urged to watch for cough and fever in children and continue basic hygiene practices to bolster immunity.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、インフルエンザA型の症例が増加していると発表、幼児が最も感染している層に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の増加であり、当局は医療体制に余裕があると説明しており、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクはいずれも低い。
triage.notes: 季節性の想定範囲内の増加であり、保健省は監視強化のみで特別な対応は不要としている。

article.articleHeadline: മുംബൈയില്‍ അപകടകാരിയായ മലേറിയ വകഭേദം പടരുന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dangerous malaria strain is spreading in Mumbai.
article.articleSummary: Plasmodium falciparum malaria cases are rising in Mumbai, with patients experiencing kidney dysfunction and anemia as the parasite burden grows. In the first two days of illness, fever is accompanied by dehydration, fainting, and vomiting. Anopheles mosquitoes and seasonal transmission contribute to the surge, according to Mumbai entomologists. Experts cite post-COVID dynamics and migrant workers from eastern India and Chhattisgarh as key drivers of the rise, with Mumbai’s vector-borne diseases showing seasonal spikes. Case counts climbed from 375 in 2015 to 2,382 in 2025—a 535% increase. The share of falciparum infections among all malaria cases rose from 5.5% in 2015 to 25.3% in 2025, per the Brihan Mumbai Municipal Corporation health department. Ongoing outbreaks emphasize kidney damage risk, highlighting need for targeted vector control and early diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイで危険なマラリア変異株が拡大
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイでのP. falciparumマラリア症例増加と重症化(腎障害等)が報告されているが、既知の季節性流行の範囲内であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 10年間で症例数が535%増加し、falciparum比率も上昇しているが、これは既知の季節性・地域的マラリア流行パターンであり、既存の疾病サーベイランスの範疇。移民労働者の流入が要因として指摘されている点は継続監視の価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Kolkata tamed dengue. Can Bangladesh learn how?
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh faces a nationwide dengue spread, with 78% of hospitalised dengue patients outside Dhaka in June 2026. Kolkata has tamed dengue to a degree through year-round municipal control rather than emergency response. The Kolkata Municipal Corporation (KMC) covers 144 wards and 16 boroughs, conducting fever surveillance, larval searches, household visits, breeding-site elimination and rapid action when cases are detected. A 2014 databank of thousands of potential breeding sites—open masonry tanks, overhead reservoirs, construction sites, surface drains—guides repeated inspections. Field teams focus on Aedes aegypti habitats; fogging is deemphasized in favor of eliminating water containers. Dengue numbers reflect a collapse from 12,334 cases Jan–Nov 2023 to 1,316 in 2024 and 1,106 in 2025 (≈91% drop), though the disease is not eliminated. Bangladesh should adopt a tiered national system with year-round surveillance and local responsibility.

triage.headline_ja: コルカタはデング熱を制圧した。バングラデシュはその方法から学べるか？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱に関する公衆衛生政策の比較分析記事であり、新規の異常な流行や緊急事態を報じるものではない。コルカタでは症例数が大幅に減少しており、既知の風土病対策の成功事例紹介が主眼。
triage.notes: 記事の主な懸念国であるバングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インド（コルカタ）はデング熱制圧の成功事例として言及されており、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではないが、実際に疾患が発生している地域として参考に記載。

article.articleHeadline: राजस्थान में लंपी का बढ़ा खतरा, 2 बड़े पशु मेले रद्द, गांव-गांव होगा सर्वे
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rajasthan: Increased risk of Lumpy Skin Disease; two major livestock fairs canceled; surveys will be conducted village by village.
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan tightens LSD containment in cattle, restricting inter-district movement and halting livestock fairs to curb spread. The Beri fair in Sikar and Todpura fair in Jhunjhunu, each with 20,000+ animals and visitors from Punjab and Haryana, are canceled. A two-tier plan isolates infected cattle, reduces vectors, and establishes isolation centers at village and block levels. Measures include vector control, sanitization, fogging, and door-to-door surveys, with a central infection database and block-level rapid-response teams. 24-hour control rooms operate at state and district levels; Sikar has hotlines 9829531178 and 9460836035. State funding totals 2.5 crore rupees, with five lakh per district for medicines and emergencies; stock is monitored daily. Farmers are urged to isolate symptomatic cattle, report promptly, avoid grazing, and refrain from buying or importing infected animals; turmeric, giloy, black pepper, and amla are advised.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州でランピースキン病の脅威拡大、大規模家畜市2件を中止、村ごとに調査実施へ
triage.triage_reason: ランピースキン病は牛のポックスウイルス感染症でヒトへの感染性（人獣共通感染症性）は報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低いため。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家畜（牛）のみが罹患するランピースキン病であり、ヒトへの感染は報告されていない。州政府は自己資金（2.5クロールルピー）で対応しており、国際支援の必要性は示唆されていない。動物衛生・農業経済上の関心事項であり、ヒト感染症サーベイランスの観点からはDISMISSと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 안전하고 효과적인 백신으로 아프리카돼지열병(ASF) 넘는다
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Overcome African swine fever (ASF) with a safe and effective vaccine.
article.articleSummary: ASF, with near-100% mortality, poses a critical threat to pig farming. Korea’s Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency (APQA) hosted an international symposium on safe, effective ASF vaccines at its Gimcheon headquarters in North Gyeongsang Province on Sept 15, 2026, drawing about 120 participants from academia, agencies, and veterinary drug firms. Earlier this year, Korea reported 24 ASF outbreaks across seven provinces, with transmission from wild boars and a newly identified route via contamination of pig plasma protein–based feed ingredients. The event featured two sessions: the first covered Asian vaccine and surveillance efforts in Vietnam and the Philippines, and highlighted a Chinese report of a high-pathogenic ASFV variant (rASFV I/II) from recombination, now spreading toward the Russian Far East. The second session focused on domestic research and policy, including vaccine commercialization by private labs and APQA’s DIVA (differentiating infected from vaccinated animals) approach with a live-attenuated vaccine. The Ministry of Agriculture outlined national ASF prevention efforts. KomiFarm seeks Philippine product approval and export, and on Sept 16 Viktor Yushchenko visited KomiFarm in Siheung, Gyeonggi.

triage.headline_ja: 安全で効果的なワクチンでアフリカ豚熱（ASF）を克服する
triage.triage_reason: ASFは豚のみに感染する動物疾病でヒトへの公衆衛生影響はないが、中国で新たな高病原性組換え株（rASFV I/II）が報告されロシア極東への拡大が懸念されており、農業・貿易面での動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は韓国（対象国外）で開催されたASFワクチンに関する国際シンポジウムの報告が主体。中国で確認された新規高病原性組換え株のロシア極東への拡大リスクが言及されているため、続報を注視する必要がある。ASFはヒトに感染しないため公衆衛生上の直接的リスクはないが、畜産・貿易への影響が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak showing "encouraging signs"... but
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows 'encouraging signs' but is far from over, according to WHO. Transmission is declining in Ituri province, the outbreak’s original epicentre, yet population mobility means risk remains as cases continue to spread. Since May, the DRC has reported more than 7,200 confirmed Ebola cases, with the outbreak now reaching seven provinces. The outbreak is the second-deadliest on record after West Africa’s 2014–2016 flare. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns that progress masks a shifting epicentre: new, underprepared areas reporting cases while response in initial hotspots remains incomplete. North Kivu now accounts for nearly half of all newly confirmed cases, and South Ubangi has become the seventh affected province, with test positivity rising. Although Ituri shows slowing transmission, national cases have not fallen. MSF has deployed teams for detection, treatment, infection control, contact tracing, surveillance, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、『明るい兆し』を見せるが──まだ終息せず
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,200例超の確定エボラ症例が報告され、7州に拡大する大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: Angolaが発生地域として付与されているが、記事サマリーではAngolaでの症例発生は言及されておらず、DRC国内（イツリ州、北キブ州、南ウバンギ州等7州）での拡大が主題であるため、verified_locationsからは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: "犬风铃"狂犬病防控行动在福建福州市启动
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "'Canine Wind-Chime' Rabies Prevention and Control Campaign Launched in Fuzhou City, Fujian Province"
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention campaign 'Canine Wind-Chime' launched in Fuzhou City, Fujian Province, China on Sep 17, 2026, by the China Animal Disease Prevention and Control Center and the Fujian Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs. Rabies remains China’s deadliest notifiable zoonosis with near-100% fatality; dog vaccination is the most direct, economical control measure. The action aims to have over 70% of dogs vaccinated to build herd immunity and reduce transmission. It integrates baseline surveys, canine immunization, effectiveness evaluation, and public outreach, and expands from 2025’s nationwide effort in eight provinces and one city to include Fujian and seven more provinces in 2026. The initiative emphasizes government-led, cross-department collaboration, door-to-door vaccination, risk screening, and broad public education via short videos, mini-program popups, community displays, and rural radio. It calls for enforcing Fujian’s Animal Epidemic Prevention regulations and improving digital dog registration and vaccination sites.

triage.headline_ja: 「犬風鈴」狂犬病防疫キャンペーン、福建省福州市で開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新規の狂犬病発生報告ではなく、既存の予防接種・啓発キャンペーンの開始告知であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病自体は中国で既知の風土病であり、本記事は政府主導の予防接種率向上キャンペーンの開始を報じるルーティン的な内容。新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Pengendalian terpadu perlu dilakukan cegah dampak kesehatan dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Integrated control measures need to be carried out to prevent the health impacts of dengue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue control in Indonesia requires broad engagement across government, health workers, academia, business, media and communities, with integrated measures: 3M Plus vector control, early detection, vector control, and ongoing education. Jakarta-based Koalisi Bersama leader Dr. Suir Syam notes dengue remains a serious health issue with a substantial economic toll. A 2024 study by UGM’s Center for KPMAK estimates dengue’s economic burden at $550.9 million (Rp9 trillion) and more than two million hospitalizations. For JKN-insured patients, per-episode out-of-pocket costs are Rp1.09–1.33 million; uninsured cases incur Rp4.27–5.60 million. Dengue disrupts daily life, including school absences and parental work loss. Prevention includes draining standing water, covering containers, waste recycling, and larval monitoring; reinforced by Wolbachia technology and government-approved dengue vaccines. UGM’s CCHPRO finds school-age vaccination potentially cost-saving. These points were highlighted ahead of the Asia Dengue Summit 2026 in Singapore.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の健康影響を防ぐため統合的な対策が必要
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドネシアで既知の風土病であり、記事は経済的負担と予防啓発に関する一般的な報告であって、異常な発生や急激な拡大を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱対策の啓発と経済負担に関する報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。シンガポールでのアジアデングサミットへの言及があるが、シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Penanganan Ebola di RD Kongo butuh lebih banyak dana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola response in the DRC needs more funding.
article.articleSummary: WHO notes Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is beginning to bear fruit but requires more funding. In Ituri Province, the hardest hit, transmission is falling, while South Kivu has reported no new cases since May. More than 1,700 people have recovered. After four months, the outbreak in the eastern DRC is largely under control, except for a small Ugandan flare promptly contained. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged donors to fully fund the government’s 180-day plan and broader humanitarian efforts. Clinical trials are expected to begin in the coming weeks. The outbreak remains capable of spreading in high-mobility areas. The DRC government’s plan totals $1.3 billion. As of the latest government update, confirmed cases reach 7,258 with 3,510 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応にはさらなる資金が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの飛び火）の2つに該当し、資金不足による対応の遅れが懸念されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中エボラアウトブレイク（DRC東部）。イトゥリ州で感染者減少、南キブ州は5月以降新規症例なしと改善傾向にあるが、ウガンダへの飛び火が発生し封じ込め済み。累計確定症例7,258人、死亡3,510人。WHOはドナーに180日計画（総額13億ドル）への資金拠出を要請しており、資金不足が対応の課題となっている。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Beban Dengue 2024 Tembus Hampir Rp9 Triliun, KOBAR Dorong Pencegahan Jadi Prioritas Nasional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Burden in 2024 Reaches Nearly Rp9 Trillion, KOBAR Urges Prevention to Become a National Priority
article.articleSummary: Dengue burden in Indonesia for 2024 is estimated at USD 550.9 million (about Rp9 trillion), with more than two million hospitalizations, based on research presented at the Asia Dengue Summit 9 in Singapore (June 2026). The analysis highlights dengue as a rapidly expanding vector-borne disease and notes 2024 marked the highest global dengue incidence per WHO. Indonesia, a tropical hyper-endemic country, faces year-round transmission; anyone can be infected, regardless of residence or lifestyle, and a dengue infection can recur, with subsequent infections potentially more severe. The Center for Health Financing Policy and Insurance Management (KPMAK) at Universitas Gadjah Mada found that in 2024 most economic burden fell on patients insured by BPJS Kesehatan. Although JKN covered medical costs, direct medical costs for dengue among JKN patients were about Rp3 trillion, representing only a share of total costs. KOBAR Lawan Dengue urges integrated prevention as a national priority.

triage.headline_ja: 2024年のデング熱による負担は約9兆ルピアに達し、KOBARは予防を国家優先事項とするよう推進

article.articleHeadline: Chính sách hỗ trợ người chăn nuôi bị thiệt hại do Dịch tả lợn Châu Phi

article.articleSummary: Policy to support pig farmers affected by African swine fever in Vietnam is implemented via Decree No. 116/2025/NĐ-CP dated 5 June 2025, governing government policies to mitigate losses from animal diseases. The Department of Livestock and Veterinary, under the Ministry of Agriculture and Environment, confirms that compensation and assistance for ASF damages follow this decree. Farmers and livestock operators impacted should contact their local commune-level People’s Committee (UBND cấp xã) where they raise pigs to receive guidance, help with applications, and processing of relief measures. The article does not provide ASF case counts, mortality figures, laboratory confirmation details, or outbreak status. It emphasizes administrative channels for assistance rather than epidemiological data, with no additional international or exported/imported case information disclosed. As of 2026-09-17, the focus remains on official guidance and government-supported relief pathways.
