article.articleHeadline: Benarkah Influenza A Bisa Picu Pneumonia? Kenali Tandanya! : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is Influenza A Really Able to Trigger Pneumonia? Recognize Its Signs! : Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Surabaya, Indonesia, hospitals report a surge in influenza A cases as of Sept 17, 2026. Influenza A is not merely a common cold; it can cause severe disease in children, with persistent cough, runny nose, high fever, and extreme fatigue warranting medical evaluation. If untreated, influenza A can lead to pneumonia and bronchiolitis. Dr. Ardi Santoso, a pediatric specialist, explains that influenza A (and B and C) is highly contagious and spreads via droplets and contaminated hands, with subtypes such as H1N1 and H3N2 circulating. PCR testing can identify the specific virus responsible for pneumonia or bronchiolitis and guide isolation to prevent spread. Schools should enforce health protocols, and influenza vaccination is urged to reduce transmission and severe outcomes.

triage.notes: 記事は小児科医による一般向け健康啓発コンテンツであり、具体的な患者数・集団発生規模・行政対応についての情報がない。季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の可能性が高いが、増加報告の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk ghi nhận 6.715 trường hợp mắc sốt xuất huyết Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak records 6,715 dengue fever cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Đắk Lắk Province, Vietnam, reached 6,715 cases as of the morning of 17 September 2026. The Dak Lak Center for Disease Control reports a complex and rapidly increasing outbreak, with a rising number of patients and multiple new outbreak clusters across several localities. The article provides no data on fatalities, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The ongoing situation indicates persistent dengue transmission within the province, with little detail on affected demographics or hospitalization, and emphasizes the need for heightened surveillance and targeted outbreak response. No additional regional or national context is offered. Public health stakeholders will require continued monitoring and rapid reporting to inform response.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省でデング熱6,715例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダクラク省でデング熱患者数が急増し新規クラスターも発生しているが、死亡・重症度データが不明であり、ベトナムでは季節性に流行する既知の感染症であるため異常性は低い。continued monitoringが必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: 斐濟宣布全國HIV危機 每60名成年人1人感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiji declares a nationwide HIV crisis; one in 60 adults infected.
article.articleSummary: Fiji declares a nationwide HIV emergency, with an estimated 1 in 60 adults infected. In 2025, HIV diagnoses rose to 2,016, about 16 times higher than 2019, triggering an “all-government” response. Health Minister Atonio Lalabalavu says the nation is in an HIV crisis requiring coordinated action. About 2 in every 100 pregnant women are HIV carriers. Among HIV-affected births in 2025, 59 infants were born with HIV, and 18 died before turning one. Fiji will expand free HIV screening, prevention, and treatment, including rapid testing, pre-exposure prophylaxis for high-risk groups, harm-reduction for people who inject drugs, and free treatment for all diagnosed individuals. External support comes from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the UN. UNAIDS notes over half of known infections are sexually transmitted, and about 42% relate to injection drug use.

article.articleHeadline: தமிழகத்தில் டெங்கு பரவலைத் தடுக்க சுகாதாரத் துறை தீவிர நடவடிக்கை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department steps up action to curb the spread of dengue in Tamil Nadu.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak intensifies in Tamil Nadu, with Chennai, Coimbatore, Erode, Tiruppur, Salem, and Krishnagiri districts most affected. More than 16,000 people have been infected, and up to 100 new cases are reported daily. To curb transmission, the government has instructed district administrations to establish dedicated wards in government hospitals and ensure adequate medicines. Public Health Director Somasundaram said 25,158 workers are engaged in identifying and eradicating Aedes mosquitoes and their larvae, alongside fever-area medical camps and ongoing preventive measures. Across 45 health districts, 12 coordinators have been appointed; each coordinates with 3–4 districts, working with local bodies and medical staff to lead dengue prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: タミルナドゥ州でデング熱の拡大を抑制するため保健当局が対策を強化

triage.notes: デング熱はインドで毎年季節的に発生する既知の感染症であり、州政府が既に大規模な対策（25,158人の作業員動員、専用病棟設置等）を実施中。外部支援の必要性は記事から読み取れない。

article.articleHeadline: فيجي تعلن حالة طوارئ وطنية لمكافحة تفشي فيروس "اتش اي في"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiji declares a national state of emergency to combat the HIV outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Fiji declares a national state of emergency to address an HIV/AIDS outbreak. In 2025, new HIV infections reached 2,016, about 16 times the 2019 level. Current prevalence is roughly 1 in 60 adults; 2 in 100 pregnant women are HIV-positive. Among 59 HIV-infected infants born in 2025, 18 died before age one. The government will implement a whole-of-government response, expanding free HIV testing, prevention, and treatment, including rapid testing, preventive medications for high-risk groups, harm-reduction measures for injection drug users, and free antiretroviral therapy for those infected. International support comes from Australia, New Zealand, India, The Global Fund, and the United Nations. UNAIDS notes more than half of transmissions are sexual, with over 42% linked to injection drug use. Pacific islands, including Fiji, are transit routes for drugs toward Australia and New Zealand.

triage.headline_ja: フィジー、HIV流行対策のため国家緊急事態を宣言

article.articleHeadline: Exotic pet trade poses rising zoonotic disease risks in India
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-17, India's exotic pet trade heightens zoonotic spillover risk from close contact with imported wild animals. Mumbai veterinarian Dr. Rina Dev treated seized wildlife and developed a lung infection, highlighting avian chlamydiosis (psittacosis) linked to parrots. Traded animals can carry salmonellosis from reptiles, tuberculosis from primates, and avian influenza from birds, with TB increasingly detected among primates. Conservation researcher Uttara Mendiratta notes human–nonhuman primate transmission is especially likely due to close relatedness; Ebola and HIV are cited as possible spillovers. Global analyses show traded mammals are 1.5 times more likely to share pathogens with humans, with traded species sharing one extra pathogen per decade. A 2026 Humane World for Animals report estimates 75% of emerging infectious diseases are zoonotic and about 850,000 unknown viruses in birds and mammals could infect people. Risks rise in pet cafes, petting zoos, and public events; first responders often lack PPE during seizures, and illegal trade bypasses quarantine. One Health advocacy is urged but underfunded.

triage.notes: 記事は具体的な集団発生事例ではなく、野生動物・エキゾチックペット取引に伴う潜在的な人獣共通感染症リスク（オウム病、結核、サルモネラ症、鳥インフルエンザ、エボラ、HIV等）についての総説的な内容。単一の獣医師の肺感染症事例が言及されているが、詳細な症例情報や公衆衛生上の緊急対応は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Gaduh Influenza A, Kemenkes RI Sebut Subtipe Ini Paling Banyak Ditemukan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Uproar: The Indonesian Ministry of Health says this subtype is the most commonly detected.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health reports low influenza activity for 2024–2026 (M-34) based on Sentinel Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) and Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) surveillance from 39 Puskesmas and 35 hospitals. In August 2026, dominant subtypes were influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, influenza A(H3N2), and influenza B Victoria, with an overall positivity rate of 28%, well below the 2025 season. Surveillance indicates A(H1N1)pdm09 as the prevailing subtype. Senior pulmonologist Prof Dr Tjandra Yoga Aditama notes the situation does not warrant undue alarm, as these circulating strains are common; H1N1pdm09 is the legacy 2009 pandemic swine flu lineage, while H5N1 or H7N9 would be more concerning. Preventive measures remain the same as for seasonal flu: if ill, wear a mask and stay home.

triage.notes: 見出しに『騒動(Gaduh)』とあるが、内容は通常の季節性インフルエンザサーベイランス報告であり、専門家が懸念不要と明言している。市中の話題性はあるが公衆衛生上の異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: എൽ നിനോയും കാലാവസ്ഥ വ്യതിയാനവും ഡെങ്കിപ്പനിയും തമ്മിൽ എന്തു ബന്ധം? പുതിയ പഠനം പറയുന്നതിങ്ങനെ... | Climate change indicator: El Nino warns of the spread of dengue fever too
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the connection between El Niño, climate change, and dengue fever?
article.articleSummary: Kerala, India faces higher dengue fever risk linked to El Niño and climate change, with temperature and monsoon rainfall shaping transmission. A GeoHealth study using Kerala climate and dengue data from 2016–2025 finds that higher temperatures and El Niño provide 2–3 month lead indicators, while monsoon rainfall offers a near-term signal. Dengue typically rises in May, peaks in June–July, with about 60% of reported cases during the southwest monsoon. Before the monsoon, temperatures reach 30.5–32.5°C, relative humidity 66–79%, and monthly rainfall 180–450 mm—conditions favorable for spread. Very heavy rains can temporarily reduce transmission by washing away eggs and larvae. From June–August 2026, Kerala recorded 7,188 confirmed dengue cases—roughly 60% above the 2016–2025 three‑month average and over fivefold the 2006–2015 average. Projections indicate a 16–20% rise during 2021–2040 due to climate change; by century’s end, increases range from 46% (low emissions) to 113% (high emissions).

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョと気候変動、デング熱の関係とは？新たな研究が示す知見
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で2026年6月〜8月に平年比約60%増のデング熱症例（7,188例）が報告されているが、記事は気候変動と発生予測に関する研究紹介が主体で、重症度や医療体制への影響、国際的拡大の情報は不明であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動とデング熱流行の関連性を分析した研究（GeoHealth誌掲載）の紹介記事であり、ケララ州における2016-2025年の気候・デング熱データを用いた予測モデルが中心。2026年6-8月の実際の症例数増加（平年比60%増）も報告されているが、重症度・死亡者数・医療機関の逼迫状況などの詳細情報は記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola on alkanut talttua Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa, viranomaiset väittävät
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has begun to subside in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities say.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has begun to subside after peaking, with daily new infections dropping from about 120 to 80 and expected to fall further, according to Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamban. The epidemic still spreads regionally, with South Ubangi Province reporting the first cases in the northwest near the borders with the Central African Republic and the Republic of Congo, marking the sixth province affected. The country has endured 17 Ebola outbreaks since 1976. By September 14, the current outbreak had reported over 7,200 cases and nearly 3,500 deaths, making it the deadliest in the nation’s history. The Bundibugyo virus variant has no vaccine, underscoring the need to maintain strict public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱が収束し始めたと当局が発表

triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国はBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、記事は国境付近への拡大リスクに言及するのみで実際の症例発生国としては確認できないため除外した。ブンディブギョ株にはワクチンがなく、致死率が高い点にも留意。

In 2025, new HIV cases reached 2,016, about 16 times the 2019 level. The government pledges a whole-of-government response with expanded access to free testing, prevention, and treatment, including rapid testing, PrEP for high-risk groups, harm-reduction services for injection-drug users, and free antiretroviral therapy. Data show roughly 1 in 60 adults HIV-positive; among pregnant women, 2 in 100 carry the virus, and of 59 HIV-infected births in 2025, 18 infants died before age one. Fiji receives support from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the UN. UNAIDS notes over half of transmissions stem from non-marital sex, and more than 42% from injection drug use. Pacific islands, including Fiji, are transit hubs for drugs toward Australia and New Zealand.

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola vaccine research gets $3.9 million as deaths surpass 3,500
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the DRC, centered in North Kivu, has reported more than 7,200 confirmed cases and over 3,500 deaths. North Kivu weekly cases recently nearly doubled from about 100 to over 200. CEPI awarded $3.9 million to three research projects aimed at real-time epidemic intelligence to guide vaccine trials and interventions, led by INRB. The largest award, $2.5 million over 12 months for B-REACT, will combine surveillance, laboratory, genomic and population-movement data. A second project led by Imperial College London receives $1.1 million to model outbreak scenarios and simulate vaccine trials; a third led by Makerere University in Uganda gets $300,000 to model ring-vaccination strategies and estimate vaccine needs. No licensed Bundibugyo-specific vaccine exists; WHO says Ervebo lacks sufficient evidence for rollout against Bundibugyo. In July, Hilleman Laboratories received up to $8.5 million for vaccine development.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラワクチン研究に390万ドル、死者数が3,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な感染拡大、国際的拡大リスク）に加え、WPRO基準も複数該当し、国際機関による大規模な資金投入・支援が進行中であるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 北キブ州でのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が拡大中（週次症例が約100から200超に倍増）。ウガンダは発生地域として記載されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行であり、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため除外。ブンディブギョ型に対する承認済みワクチンが存在せず、WHOはErvebo展開のエビデンス不足を指摘している点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Brazzaville: Congo's Ebola Epidemic May Have Gone Undetected for Months
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province, Mongbwalu) may have started months before official declaration on May 15, 2026. First known infection in a health worker around April 24–25; death in Bunia; Ituri accounts for about 80% of cases. Lab confirmation occurred roughly three weeks after onset; Africa CDC criticized slow initial response. Red Cross reported widespread fear since March 30 and deaths with Ebola-like symptoms. US CDC study (June 11) suggests animal-to-human spillover plausibly in February; late-April spillover would be hard to reconcile with the outbreak’s scale. WHO genome sequencing (Aug 10) indicates onset as early as February 2026, with substantial reporting gaps (only about one-third of patients accessible in three months) and initial misattribution to malaria/typhus, leaving ongoing questions about undetected transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ共和国（ブラザビル）：コンゴのエボラ流行は数か月間検出されていなかった可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行が、公式宣言（2026年5月15日）より数か月前（2月頃）から未検出のまま拡大していた可能性が高く、報告の遅れ・誤診・広範な伝播疑いなどIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 既に5月15日に公式宣言済みのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行に関する追跡報道。WHO・US CDCのゲノム解析により2月頃から未検出のまま拡大していた可能性が指摘されており、報告体制・初期対応の遅れが問題視されている。フルリスク評価済みの可能性もあるため、既存評価の更新要否を確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 每60人就1人中標！這度假天堂驚爆「全國愛滋緊急狀態」｜壹蘋新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1 in 60 People Infected! This Vacation Paradise Reveals a National HIV/AIDS Emergency
article.articleSummary: Fiji declares a national HIV emergency after 2025 HIV diagnoses surged to 2,016, 16-fold higher than in 2019. Health authorities warn that about 1 in 60 adults are living with HIV, and 2 in 100 pregnant women are HIV-positive. In 2025, 59 HIV-infected infants were born, with 18 dying before reaching age one. The government will expand free HIV screening, prevention, and treatment, including rapid tests, pre-exposure prophylaxis for high-risk groups, harm-reduction programs for people who inject drugs, and free antiretroviral therapy for all diagnosed individuals. External support comes from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the United Nations. UNAIDS notes that among known transmission routes, more than half are sex-related, and over 42% involve injecting drug use.

triage.headline_ja: 60人に1人が感染！この楽園リゾート地が「全国エイズ緊急事態」を宣言
triage.triage_reason: フィジーが2025年のHIV新規診断数が2019年比16倍に急増したことを受け「国家的HIV緊急事態」を宣言。深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常な増加が確認され、IHR基準を2つ満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本イベントの発生国はフィジーであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。インドはオーストラリア・ニュージーランド・国連等と並び外部支援国として言及されているのみで、発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: フィジー、HIV危機を宣言 性行為と違法薬物の回し打ちで成人の60人に1人が感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiji declares an HIV crisis; one in 60 adults infected due to sexual activity and needle sharing among illicit drug users.
article.articleSummary: Fiji declares a national HIV emergency as of September 16, 2026, after alarming rises in infections driven by sexual activity and needle sharing among illicit drug users. In 2025, new HIV cases reached 2,016, about 16 times higher than in 2019. Adult HIV prevalence is estimated at 1 in 60, up from about 1 in 167 five years earlier. Among pregnancies, 2 in 100 pregnant women are HIV-positive; 59 mother-to-child infections were recorded in 2025, with 18 deaths before age one. UNAIDS notes that among diagnosed cases, sexual transmission accounts for the majority, with more than 42% linked to injection drug use. The government pledges a whole-of-government response. Fiji, with a population around 930,000, receives support from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the UN. Cross-border illicit drug trafficking and the Pacific as a transit hub are highlighted, with rising methamphetamine and cocaine flows post-COVID.

triage.headline_ja: フィジー、HIV危機を宣言 性行為と違法薬物の回し打ちで成人の60人に1人が感染
triage.triage_reason: フィジーが国家的HIV緊急事態を宣言し、感染率が急増（成人60人に1人）していることから、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常事態）を2つ以上満たし、WPRO基準・社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 本イベントの主題国フィジーは対象国リストに含まれない。インドは支援提供国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Salud acciona contra el dengue en Santa Rosa | Diario de Centro América
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health acts against dengue in Santa Rosa.
article.articleSummary: On 17 September 2026, the Ministry of Health in Santa Rosa, Guatemala launched dengue prevention interventions across homes, communities, public spaces, and water bodies to reduce Aedes mosquito populations and breeding sites. Activities included intra-domiciliary and peri-domiciliary nebulization, anti-larval control, and epidemiological surveillance. Fumigations were conducted in Cerro Gordo and Barberena. In El Jícaro, Mal País, and the Los Pocitos farm, breeding sites in water bodies were eliminated. In the hamlet of Camalote and in Guazacapán, surveys and treatments were carried out. In San Rafael Las Flores, Nueva Santa Rosa, and Agua Blanca, aerosol therapy and complete treatment were applied. The operation emphasizes vector control and monitoring to curb dengue transmission; no case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: サンタ・ロサでデング熱対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: 記事はグアテマラでのデング熱予防・媒介蚊対策活動を報じたものであり、対象国（Bluedot対象国リスト）に該当する発生地域はなく、症例数等の情報もない日常的な公衆衛生活動である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippinesが含まれるが、記事本文はグアテマラのサンタ・ロサ県における蚊媒介対策活動のみを扱っており、フィリピンでの発生については言及がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Fiji declares HIV emergency as one in 60 adults affected
article.articleSummary: Fiji has declared a national HIV emergency as sexual transmission and injecting drug use drive rising infections, with an estimated 1 in 60 adults living with HIV. New HIV diagnoses reached 2,016 in 2025, about 16 times higher than 2019. About two in every 100 pregnant women are HIV positive, and of the 59 babies born with HIV in 2025, 18 died before age one. Authorities are expanding free HIV testing, prevention, and treatment, including rapid testing, pre-exposure prophylaxis for high-risk individuals, and harm-reduction measures for people who inject drugs. The government pledges a whole-of-government response, supported by Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the United Nations. UNAIDS data show transmissions were predominantly sexual, with over 42% linked to injecting drug use.

triage.headline_ja: フィジー、成人60人に1人がHIV感染 国家的HIV緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: フィジー政府がHIV流行拡大（2019年比16倍増、母子感染死亡例あり）を受け国家緊急事態を宣言し、国際支援を要請しているため、IHR・WPRO基準を複数満たす。ただし発生国は監視対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 発生国はフィジーであり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には含まれない。インドは支援国として言及されているのみで、感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Deadly violence displaces civilians, complicates Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo worsened by ongoing violence that has displaced tens of thousands and hindered surveillance. In Ituri's Mambasa Territory, at least 60 civilians were killed since the start of month, triggering fresh displacement. In South Kivu’s Fizi Territory, clashes have displaced more than 40,000 people since July, while North Kivu remains embroiled in active fighting that forces families to flee. As of 14 September, national health authorities reported over 7,300 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 3,500 deaths. Despite these challenges, UN and partners are scaling up response: three additional Ebola treatment facilities are under construction in North Kivu, with expanded screening and control points for early detection. UNICEF supports 190 schools in outbreak hotspots with infection prevention and control supplies; WFP continues nutritional support for patients, caregivers and frontline health workers. OCHA urges protection and unhindered humanitarian access to deliver life-saving interventions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：暴力による死者が住民を避難させ、エボラ対応を複雑化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例7,300例超、死者3,500人超という大規模アウトブレイクであり、武力紛争による住民避難がサーベイランスと対応を著しく妨げているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にFijiが含まれているが、記事内容とは無関係であり誤付与と判断し除外。South Kivu、Ituri、Mambasaはいずれも DRC 国内の地域であるため、DRCのみを検証済み地域とした。武力紛争による人道アクセス制限がアウトブレイク対応の大きな障害となっている点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Kemarau, Kasus Muntaber Anak Melonjak di Kayuagung, RSUD Khawatir KLB Jika Ruang Perawatan Penuh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drought triggers a surge in pediatric gastroenteritis cases in Kayuagung; RSUD fears an outbreak if inpatient wards are full.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, RSUD Kayuagung in Kayuagung, Indonesia, reports a surge in pediatric gastroenteritis (muntaber) linked to prolonged drought and scarce clean water. The weather is raising hygiene challenges, including dust that may contaminate food, increasing enteric infection risk among children. Over the last three months, July saw 4 outpatient and 10 inpatient cases; August had no outpatients but 12 inpatients; September shows a significant uptick, predominantly among children. Illnesses present with vomiting more than three times daily and diarrhea up to five times daily, with dehydration and reduced strength. The hospital fears a potential outbreak (KLB) if inpatient capacity is exceeded. Initial treatment typically occurs at primary care facilities for one to two days before escalation; prevention hinges on access to clean water and proper food hygiene amid dry-season conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 乾季で子供の嘔吐下痢症が急増、カユアグンのRSUDが病床逼迫による集団発生を懸念
triage.triage_reason: 局地的な小児胃腸炎の増加であり国際的拡大の兆候はないが、病院側がKLB（集団発生）を懸念しており続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は特定されておらず、乾季による衛生状態悪化が主因とされる地域限定の胃腸炎増加。重症例や死亡の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza Disebut Naik di Indonesia, Kemenkes: Belum Ada Lonjakan Signifikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza Said to Be Rising in Indonesia, Health Ministry: No Significant Surge Yet.
article.articleSummary: Influenza in Indonesia shows no significant surge according to the Health Ministry, with surveillance indicating seasonal, not outbreak-level increases. Across 2024–2026, two seasonal peaks occurred: December 2024–January 2025 (positivity ~53%) and September–October 2025 (~51%). By August 2026, influenza positivity stood at 28%, below peak levels, with nationwide activity categorized as low. The dominant influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 subtype was noted. Data come from the Sentinel ILI-SARI surveillance covering 39 puskesmas and 35 hospitals; last data access was 5 September 2026. Anecdotal social media reports of fever in children exist but are not indicative of a surge. Potential drivers include forest fires, volcanic activity, and the dry season. Public health measures (PHBS) are encouraged; no details on imported/exported cases are provided. The article is dated 17 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザがインドネシアで増加していると報じられるも、保健省「まだ大きな急増はない」
triage.triage_reason: 保健省が季節性の範囲内であり顕著な急増はないと明言しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低い季節性インフルエンザの通常報告である。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)pdm09の通常のサーベイランス報告であり、保健省は急増を否定している。SNS上の散発的な発熱報告も急増の根拠とはされていない。

article.articleHeadline: 男孩野泳后高烧呕吐休克患鼠尿病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boy diagnosed with leptospirosis after open-water swimming, presenting with high fever, vomiting and shock.
article.articleSummary: In Qingyuan, Guangdong, China, a 12-year-old boy (pseudonym Xiao Wei) developed sudden high fever (39.1°C) after outdoor swimming, with chills, headache, vomiting, and mild cough. Initial home care and outpatient treatment failed to improve him. He was hospitalized, rapidly deteriorated into septic shock with risk of multi‑organ failure, and required urgent resuscitation. After targeted management and investigations, clinicians diagnosed leptospirosis presenting as a toxic form with meningitis‑encephalitis type. Leptospirosis is a Category B infectious disease in China. Following precise treatment, he stabilized and was moved to a regular ward as organ function gradually recovered. The case underscores leptospirosis risk following open‑water exposure and highlights the need for rapid recognition and treatment to prevent severe outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 野外遊泳後に高熱・嘔吐・ショックを発症した少年、レプトスピラ症と診断
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の個別報告であり、公衆衛生上の広範な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 重症例ではあるが単発の個人症例報告であり、アウトブレイクや集団発生を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Melonjak, Waspada Gejala dan Risiko Penularannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases surge: watch for symptoms and the risk of transmission.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases surge in Indonesia with reports of flu-like symptoms at several health facilities, including Surabaya, East Java. While some hospitals acknowledged increased visits, one Surabaya hospital said the rise does not mean influenza dominates inpatient wards. National surveillance by the Ministry of Health shows a rising proportion of influenza-positive specimens. In week 35, the share reached 27%, up from 17% the previous week. By week 36, it rose to 38%, up from 22%. Data through 12 September 2026 indicate higher activity, but the Ministry still classifies Indonesia’s influenza activity as low level, meaning the uptick in positive tests does not necessarily signal a national outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型の症例が急増、症状と感染リスクに注意
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの陽性率上昇が報告されているが、保健省は依然として低水準と分類しており、全国的アウトブレイクを示すものではないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの陽性率上昇に関する報道。保健省は国レベルでは低水準と評価しており、通常のサーベイランス範囲内の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Fever | Disease | தீவிரமாய் பரவும் டெங்கு - ஹாஸ்பிடலில் குவியும் மக்கள்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever | Disease | Dengue spreading rapidly - people crowd into hospitals
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, dengue fever is spreading rapidly in Tamil Nadu, India, with hospitals crowded as patients seek urgent care and healthcare facilities brace for surges. The report notes rising dengue incidence and calls for intensified prevention and surveillance measures. In response, the Department of Public Health has ordered strengthened preventive actions and enhanced monitoring across the state. To reinforce the outbreak response, 45 special officers have been appointed in Tamil Nadu. No detailed case counts or fatalities are provided in the article. The piece centers on government action to curb transmission and manage increased patient load amid the ongoing dengue situation.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱 | 疾病 | 急速に拡大するデング熱 - 病院に押し寄せる人々
triage.triage_reason: インド・タミルナドゥ州でデング熱患者が急増し当局が対応強化しているが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数など詳細情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年流行する季節性感染症であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。ただし病院の逼迫と当局による特別対応官の配置など地域内での懸念は高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO sees progress against Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, warns threat remains
article.articleSummary: 7,022 Ebola cases and 3,398 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 1,671 recovered, since the outbreak began. Transmission is declining in Ituri province, the hardest-hit area, as of 17 September 2026. The World Health Organization says there are encouraging signs of progress in containment but warns the outbreak is far from over and could spread again, particularly in areas with high population movement. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cautions that the virus could still spread, while Maria Van Kerkhove notes that intensified surveillance and contact tracing may reveal more cases, indicating many months of response ahead. The update underscores ongoing containment efforts in DR Congo and the need for sustained public health measures to avert renewed transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行に進展を認めつつ、脅威は継続していると警告
triage.triage_reason: 累計7,022症例・3,398死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続中で、WHOが再拡大リスクを警告しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Ituriはコンゴ民主共和国内の州であり、独立した対象国ではないためDRCとして集約。WHO幹部（Tedros氏、Van Kerkhove氏）のコメントにより国際的な注目度が高いことが確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: 性传播与毒品滥用失控 斐济爆发全国HIV危机
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sexual Transmission and Drug Abuse Out of Control: Fiji Faces a Nationwide HIV Crisis
article.articleSummary: Fiji declares a nationwide HIV emergency as the crisis deepens, driven by sexual transmission and illicit drug use. In 2025, new HIV diagnoses reached 1,616—about 16 times the 2019 peak—with an estimated 1 in 60 adults living with HIV. The Ministry of Health reports 2 of every 100 pregnant women are HIV-positive. In 2025, 59 babies born to HIV-infected mothers were born, 18 of whom died before age one. The government will expand free HIV screening, prevention, and treatment, including rapid testing, pre-exposure prophylaxis for high-risk groups, harm-reduction programs for injecting drug users, and free antiretroviral therapy for all diagnosed. External support comes from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the UN. UNAIDS notes that over half of known transmissions are via sex, and more than 42% involve injection drug use.

triage.notes: 発生国はフィジーであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には含まれないためverified_locationsは空。インドは支援提供国として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: แพทย์เตือนโรคปอดอักเสบจากไวรัส RSV ไม่ใช่แค่โรคในเด็ก ผู้สูงอายุเสี่ยงโรครุนแรง - สยามรัฐ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors warn RSV-related pneumonia is not just a childhood disease; the elderly are at risk of severe illness - Siam Rath
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-17, Thai doctors warn that respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)–related pneumonia poses a serious threat to older adults, not just children. Dr. Kamol Kaewkitinrong of Chulalongkorn University notes seniors, especially those over 75 and individuals with chronic diseases (lung, heart, diabetes, liver or kidney), face severe RSV pneumonia with higher mortality; older adults >65 years have about 10 times the death risk versus children aged 2–5. RSV infection can start with cold-like symptoms and progress to pneumonia, wheezing, and exacerbations of COPD or heart disease; severe cases may require ICU ventilation and may involve bacterial superinfection. There is no RSV-specific cure; treatment is supportive. Vaccines exist (two types: adjuvanted and non-adjuvanted) protecting against RSV A and B. High-risk groups should consult clinicians about vaccination and preventive measures: hand hygiene, masks, distancing, regular exercise, and balanced nutrition to reduce household transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が警告：RSVによる肺炎は子供だけの病気ではない、高齢者は重症化リスクあり - サイアムラット
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSVに関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の集団発生ではなく、RSVによる高齢者の重症化リスクに関する一般的な医療啓発・予防啓発の内容。

article.articleHeadline: יותר מ-7,200 חולים: מגפת האבולה רחוקה מסיום - אמס MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 7,200 patients: The Ebola outbreak is far from over - AMS MS.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports Ebola transmission decreasing in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, but Bundibugyo virus outbreak remains widespread with over 7,200 cases and more than 3,500 deaths across seven provinces. In North Kivu, weekly cases nearly doubled in two weeks (roughly 100 to over 200); in Ituri, transmission slowed; in South Kivu, no new cases since May. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus, the second-deadliest Ebola strain after the West Africa 2014–2016 outbreak. Transmission occurs by direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; incubation up to 21 days; infectious after symptom onset, not airborne. WHO warns improved surveillance may raise reported counts. Expanded testing, isolation, and contact tracing are under way. More than 3,000 health workers have been vaccinated with Merck's Ervebo (Zaire strain), whose protection against Bundibugyo is unproven; trials for alternative vaccines from Moderna and Oxford are planned in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 7,200人以上の患者:エボラ流行は終息にはほど遠い - WHO
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,200例超・死亡3,500例超のBundibugyoエボラウイルス流行が7州に拡大し、北キブ州では症例が倍増するなど拡大傾向にあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 南キブ州は5月以降新規症例なしだが、北キブ州で症例が急増しており全体としては拡大傾向。ワクチン(Ervebo)のBundibugyo株への有効性は未確認で、Moderna・Oxfordの新規ワクチン治験が計画中。

article.articleHeadline: Gaduh Kasus Influenza A, Anak Jadi yang Paling Banyak Terinfeksi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outcry Over Influenza A Cases: Children Are the Most Infected
article.articleSummary: As of September 17, 2026, influenza A cases are rising in Indonesia, with hospitals in several regions reporting increased numbers. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin confirms the uptick but stresses influenza is seasonal, with activity expected to rise toward year-end, a view echoed by Aji Muhawarman of the Health Ministry. Surveillance shows children aged 0–4 are the most affected, accounting for about 33% of detected cases. Despite the uptick, national health facilities remain safe and not overcapacity, and the rise is unlikely to trigger a significant surge. Parents are advised to monitor for cough and fever in children, maintain basic hygiene protocols, and support immune health. Influenza A, common with Influenza B, circulates with subtypes such as H1N1 and H3N2. Symptoms include fever, chills, cough, headache, body aches, fatigue, sore throat, and runny nose; high-risk groups may develop more severe illness.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型症例が騒動に、子どもが最も多く感染
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の増加であり、当局も医療体制の逼迫はないと説明しているため、IHR・WPROいずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の増加として保健省が説明しており、重症化や医療逼迫の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Selain ISPA, Kasus DBD di Inhu Juga Melonjak Drastis di Bulan Agustus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In addition to acute respiratory infections, dengue fever cases in Indragiri Hulu also rose drastically in August.
article.articleSummary: August 2026 saw a dengue fever surge in Indragiri Hulu Regency, Riau, Indonesia, with 235 reported cases—up from 31 in July, according to the Inhu Health Office. The four hardest-hit service areas were Sipayung Puskesmas (66 cases), Pangkalan Kasai Puskesmas (45), Kambesko Puskesmas (28), and Pekan Heran Puskesmas (25). Concurrently, acute respiratory infections rose in the district, linked to haze from nearby fires. The outbreak prompted the acting head of the Health Office, Indrawansyah, to attribute DBD to environmental and human behaviors and to implement epidemiological investigations, transmission-chain checks, patient monitoring, fogging, and larvicide (abate) distribution. Authorities mobilized trash-clearing campaigns, community education, and the 3M Plus preventive measures—drain, close, recycle, plus mosquito nets and repellents—to curb transmission and protect residents. No mortality data provided.

triage.headline_ja: ISPA(急性呼吸器感染症)に加え、インフー県のデング熱(DBD)症例も8月に急増
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例の顕著な増加が報告されているが、地域限定的で重症度・死亡情報が不明であり、国際的拡大リスクも低いためフルRRAには至らない。
triage.notes: デング熱は東南アジアで季節性・地域性の流行が一般的であり、インドネシア国内の一県における症例急増であるため、IHR基準には該当しない。地元保健当局が対応を実施中で管理可能と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Jelang Hari Rabies Sedunia, Dispernakan KBB Tingkatkan Kewaspadaan Gigitan Hewan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of World Rabies Day, KBB's Department of Animal Husbandry Increases Awareness of Animal Bites
article.articleSummary: Rabies awareness and prevention efforts in West Bandung Regency (Kabupaten Bandung Barat), Indonesia, ahead of World Rabies Day. The Department of Fisheries and Livestock (Dispernakan) warns residents not to underestimate bites from dogs, cats, or other animals that may carry the rabies virus. Immediate post-bite care is emphasized: wash exposed skin with running water and soap for about 15 minutes and seek medical evaluation to determine whether anti-rabies vaccination or further treatment is needed, without waiting for symptoms. The agency coordinates with the Health Department and local zoonosis cadres to ensure rapid reporting and response when biting animals are nearby. Preventive measures include free rabies vaccination for about 2,000 pets before September 28, 2026, delivered through multiple partners and venues. A subsidized sterilization program targets 200 cats (100 males, 100 females) to control populations; owners are urged not to let animals roam unsupervised.

triage.headline_ja: 世界狂犬病デー前に、KBB畜産・漁業局が動物咬傷への警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: 世界狂犬病デーに向けた通常の予防啓発・ワクチン接種活動の報告であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地域の畜産局による定例的な狂犬病予防・ワクチン接種プログラムの案内記事であり、具体的な感染者数や異常発生の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola epidemic may have gone undetected for months
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province (Mongbwalu, Bunia) was declared May 15, 2026. The first infections likely occurred earlier: retrospective identification of the index case, a Mongbwalu health worker, with symptom onset around April 24–25 and death in Bunia. By May 5 WHO was informed of an unknown high-mortality illness in Mongbwalu; three days later the National Institute for Biomedical Research confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola. Africa CDC criticized a ~three-week delay between onset and lab confirmation, which aided spread; about 80% of cases are in Ituri. Red Cross noted fear since March 30. Early symptoms include high fever, chest pain, severe exhaustion, persistent cough, nosebleeds, vomiting, loss of consciousness, progressing to coma and death. CDC (June 11) linked possible February spillover; WHO genome sequencing (Aug 10) suggests the outbreak began as early as February 2026. The outbreak remains ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、数ヶ月間気づかれていなかった可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行であり、検知の大幅な遅延、高い致死率、国際機関（WHO・Africa CDC）の関与が確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 検知の遅延（発症から検査確認まで約3週間）と、2月に遡る可能性のある感染起源（WHOゲノム解析）が報告されており、実際の流行規模・期間が過小評価されている可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Jaundice outbreak in tribal girls' hostel, over 20 affected
article.articleSummary: Jaundice outbreak at Rabadi Girls Sevashram in Kolnara block, Rayagada district, Odisha, has infected more than 20 students. About three days earlier, affected girls developed mild fever and yellowing of the eyes; an ANM provided initial treatment, and tests later confirmed jaundice on Wednesday evening. The hostel houses over 200 girls; several parents have taken their children home amid fears of spread. Contaminated drinking water is identified as the infection source; tubewell use is prohibited, and safe water is being supplied while RWSS plans a new tubewell. District Welfare Officer Ashima Rao said regular medical care is being provided and the situation is closely monitored; parents are urged not to panic. The outbreak remains under active monitoring as authorities identify and secure the water source.

triage.headline_ja: 部族女子寮で黄疸の集団発生、20人以上が感染
triage.triage_reason: 汚染水源による黄疸（肝炎疑い）の局地的集団発生で、当局が対応・監視中。重症例や死亡の報告はなく国際的懸念は低いが、水系感染症としてWPRO基準の一部に該当するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: インド・オディシャ州の単一施設（女子寮）における汚染飲料水由来の黄疸アウトブレイク。地元当局（District Welfare Officer）が対応中で、新たな水源確保が進められている。重症化や死亡の報告はなく、局地的・管理下にある事案。

article.articleHeadline: Sida: les îles Fidji face à une explosion des contaminations
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AIDS: the Fiji Islands facing a surge in infections
article.articleSummary: Fiji faces a surge in HIV/AIDS with 2,016 new diagnoses in 2025, 16 times the 2019 level, prompting the government to declare a national health emergency. Authorities vow to widen free HIV testing, prevention, and treatment, including rapid tests, pre-exposure prophylaxis for those at risk, harm-reduction for people who inject drugs, and free antiretroviral therapy for people living with HIV. Estimated adult HIV prevalence is about one in 60; two pregnant women per 100 are HIV-positive. Of 59 children born in 2025 with HIV, 18 died before their first birthday. Fiji, an archipelago of over 300 islands with more than 900,000 people, reports more than half of transmissions sexually and over 42% linked to injecting drug use with contaminated equipment, and serves as a drug hub for Australia and New Zealand. International support comes from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the UN; UNAIDS calls for stronger Pacific-wide cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: エイズ：フィジー諸島で感染急増、国家非常事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急増）に該当し、フィジー政府が国家保健緊急事態を宣言、国際支援も要請されているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてIndiaが挙げられているが、記事内ではIndiaは国際支援提供国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はフィジー（対象国リスト外）であるためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: В ДРК от лихорадки Эбола погибло 3577 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 3,577 people died from Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 7,404 confirmed cases and 3,577 deaths since the outbreak began, per the National Institute for Public Health (INSP). In the past 24 hours, 59 new cases and 32 deaths were recorded, with 23 recoveries, bringing totals to 7,404 cases, 3,577 deaths. The current outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain; there is no licensed vaccine or treatment for this strain yet, though laboratory data suggest the Russian vaccine Ervebo may offer some protection. Photographs in the report show medical staff in Bunia, DRC. The Russian Foreign Ministry states there have been no Ebola infections among Russians in the DRC. No details on imported or exported cases are provided beyond these counts and updates.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により3,577人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（7,404症例、3,577死亡、致死率約48%）で、当該株（ブンディブギョ株）にはワクチン・治療法が未確立という深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事象であるため。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在せず、致死率が非常に高い（約48%）ため、フルリスク評価が必要。ロシア外務省がロシア人感染者なしと言及しており国際的な関心も高い。国境を越えた拡大の有無については記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Muntaber di Kayuagung Melonjak, RSUD Waspada KLB karena Pasien Anak Terus Bertambah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gastroenteritis cases in Kayuagung surge as RSUD Waspada issues an outbreak alert due to rising pediatric patients.
article.articleSummary: Gastroenteritis, presenting as vomiting and diarrhea, has surged at RSUD Kayuagung in Kayuagung, Ogan Komering Ilir Regency, South Sumatra, with a marked rise in pediatric patients and concern over a potential outbreak (KLB) if admissions keep climbing beyond ward capacity. Data show July 2026: 4 outpatient visits and 10 inpatient admissions; August 2026: 0 outpatient, 12 inpatients; September 2026: a further uptick dominated by children. Health officials attribute the surge to the prolonged dry season and limited access to clean water, which compromise food hygiene and utensil cleanliness; dust exposure may also facilitate bacterial/viral entry. Dr. Mustika Wati, head of medical services at RSUD Kayuagung, emphasizes weather-related transmission and water scarcity as key risk factors. The report does not mention laboratory confirmation or imported/exported cases. Awareness and capacity monitoring continue as the facility weighs an official KLB declaration.

triage.headline_ja: カユアグンで嘔吐下痢症の症例が急増、小児患者の増加によりRSUDがアウトブレイク（KLB）警戒を発令
triage.triage_reason: 南スマトラの一病院で小児を中心とした胃腸炎患者が増加しKLB警戒中だが、病原体の検査確認がなく、乾季・水不足による季節性要因と説明されており国際的拡大の兆候はない。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 病原体の検査確認情報がなく、地域の一病院レベルでの報告に留まる。乾季・水不足による衛生環境悪化が主要因とされており、ヒト-ヒト感染の明確な証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: НЕОЖИДАННОЕ ОТКРЫТИЕ ⟩ Найденное в природе вещество эффективно подавляет коронавирус
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNEXPECTED DISCOVERY ⟩ A naturally occurring substance effectively inhibits the coronavirus.
article.articleSummary: Plant-derived compounds from leaves of a tree native to Brazil's forests show multi-target activity against coronavirus. Scientists report these compounds can block the virus from entering cells, halt its replication, and ease severe inflammation. The discovery highlights Brazil's biodiversity as a potential source of antiviral candidates. Compounds extracted from the tree's leaves are described as interfering with key stages of the coronavirus life cycle and inflammatory responses. No clinical data are mentioned in the report, and it remains unclear how these findings translate to human treatment. If confirmed and developed, these natural substances could complement existing coronavirus strategies and guide future antiviral research, leveraging Brazil's natural ecosystems.

triage.headline_ja: 予想外の発見 ⟩ 自然界に見つかった物質がコロナウイルスを効果的に抑制
triage.triage_reason: 研究段階の抗ウイルス化合物発見に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や症例の発生を示すものではないため、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル産植物由来化合物の抗コロナウイルス活性に関する基礎研究の紹介であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクとは無関係。臨床データも存在しないため、公衆衛生イベントとしての重要性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Purwakarta Masih Nol Kasus Rabies, Diskanak Tetap Gencarkan Vaksinasi Ribuan Hewan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Purwakarta Still Zero Rabies Cases, Diskanak Continues to Ramp Up Vaccination of Thousands of Animals
article.articleSummary: Purwakarta remains rabies-free as of 17 September 2026, with Diskanak continuing vaccination outreach to dogs, cats, civets, monkeys, and horses in local stables to maintain disease-free status. The vaccination drive, aligned with World Rabies Day and the Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Health Month, involved health checks before vaccination. Despite zero rabies cases, bite incidents continue, including three cat bites and one dog bite, all animals observed and tested negative for rabies. Officials note integrated management: animal bites are observed by Diskanak, while human victims receive care and monitoring from the Health Department. Community members bitten are advised to report to Diskanak or Health Department. The campaign underscores preventive vaccination to sustain rabies-free status in Purwakarta.

triage.headline_ja: プルワカルタ、狂犬病症例ゼロを維持 動物畜産局は数千匹の動物へのワクチン接種を継続強化
triage.triage_reason: プルワカルタでは狂犬病症例はゼロで、予防的ワクチン接種活動が順調に進んでいることを報じる内容であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急対応の必要性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病予防のための日常的なワクチン接種活動を紹介する内容で、症例ゼロを強調しており、シグナルとしての懸念要素はない。

article.articleHeadline: ابهامات و تناقضات درباره سرنوشت یک واکسن؛ سه ویروس خطرناک‌تر آنفلوآنزا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ambiguities and contradictions surrounding the fate of a vaccine; three viruses more dangerous than influenza.
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccine supply and distribution remain unclear as of 2026-09-17, with government statements cited alongside conflicting signals about imports. Sanctions and related barriers are complicating vaccine imports, but are not the sole cause. Debate centers on sourcing: imports from China opposed due to unconfirmed vaccine quality, while a Russian vaccine is deemed suitable by Dr. Masoud Mardani of the national influenza committee. Despite delays in foreign vaccine production amid strain updates, some countries have begun influenza vaccination while others report vaccines ready for distribution. Emphasis on early procurement planning, diversification of supply channels, quality control, and coordination among responsible agencies. Citizens are advised not to purchase vaccines from previous years, as older vaccines are unreliable for the current season.

triage.headline_ja: あるワクチンの行方についての曖昧さと矛盾；インフルエンザより危険な3つのウイルス
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はイランにおけるインフルエンザワクチンの供給・流通問題（輸入元の選定や制裁の影響）を扱っており、実際の感染症発生や異常な感染拡大に関する情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はイラン国内のインフルエンザワクチン供給・輸入をめぐる政策的議論が主題であり、中国・ロシアはワクチン供給元として言及されているのみで、実際の感染症発生国ではない。従って対象国リストに該当する発生国はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Gajah Diego di PLG Minas Mati, Diduga Akibat Infeksi Saluran Pencernaan Kronis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diego the Elephant at PLG Minas Dies, Suspected to be Caused by Chronic Gastrointestinal Infection.
article.articleSummary: Diego, a 17-year-old male elephant at PLG Minas in Riau, Indonesia, died on 16 September 2026 around 12:00 WIB after a sudden health decline. The animal first deteriorated on 10 September with diarrhea and loss of appetite. Fecal examination revealed parasites, prompting deworming, antibiotics, anti-inflammatories, and supportive care. A subsequent fecal test at PPS Yayasan Arsari Djodjohadikusumo in Pekanbaru reportedly showed no worm infection. On 15 September, Diego became markedly weaker, stopped eating, and experienced frequent diarrhea with very limited water intake. He received intravenous fluids, vitamins, and anti-inflammatory treatment. Preliminary necropsy results indicate death due to a chronic gastrointestinal infection, though the earlier parasite finding was negative in follow-up testing. This case highlights gastrointestinal disease concerns in captive elephants in Pekanbaru, Riau.

triage.headline_ja: PLGミナスのゾウ「ディエゴ」死亡、慢性消化器感染症が疑われる
triage.triage_reason: 単一飼育象の死亡事例であり、ヒトへの感染リスクや公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大の可能性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 1頭の飼育象における消化器疾患による死亡事例であり、感染症としてのヒト-ヒト感染や動物間伝播の証拠は示されていない。動物福祉・獣医学的関心事項に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu spreads to Barunguba Island; public urged to follow these safety rules
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza H5 detected on Barunguba Montague Island (Narooma) on NSW's Far South Coast, prompting temporary access and activity changes to protect public safety and biosecurity. NSW government confirmed detections across the region including a sick silver gull on Barunguba and other reports—white-fronted tern in Congo, crested terns between Narooma, Merimbula and Snug Cove in Eden, and a Moruya silver gull. Across Australia, 542 events have been detected; NSW accounts for 45, mostly seabirds; mammals such as a long-nosed fur seal in South Australia have tested positive. No detections in commercial poultry or captive birds; human risk considered low. Barunguba will continue vaccination programs; a poultry housing recommendation is advised. Public should report signs of illness in wildlife via the 1800 675 888 hotline. An information session on Sep 28 at Moruya Golf Club 6-7:30pm will cover situation and precautions.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザがバルンゴバ島に拡大、当局が安全対策の順守を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: オーストラリア（NSW州）の野生鳥類における高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（H5）の検出事例であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）には該当しない。記事中の「Congo」はNSW州の地名であり、コンゴ民主共和国ではない。
triage.notes: 発生地域データにDemocratic Republic of the Congoが含まれるが、これは記事中の『Congo』というNSW州の地名の誤認識によるもの。実際の発生国はオーストラリアであり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。家禽・飼育鳥での検出はなく、ヒトへのリスクも低いとされている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Outbreak May Have Circulated for Months Undetected
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak may have circulated for months before official declaration on May 15. The first known case was a health worker in Ituri province with symptoms in late April; reports of unexplained deaths in Mongbwalu emerged weeks earlier. Genetic analysis cited by WHO suggests transmission may have begun as early as February. WHO warns that delayed detection raises transmission risk, especially in areas of insecurity, displacement, overcrowding, and poor healthcare access. As of September 7, WHO reports over 6,700 confirmed cases and more than 3,200 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with additional cases in Uganda and France. The outbreak's protracted undetected circulation underscores challenges in surveillance and response in conflict-affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、数ヶ月間未検出のまま拡大していた可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（確定症例6,700例超、死亡3,200例超）で、公式発表前に数ヶ月間検出されずに拡大していた可能性があり、ウガンダ・フランスへの国際的な症例拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよびフランスへの症例拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOによる大規模流行としてすでに国際的関心が高い事案であり、紛争地域における監視体制の課題も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 斐濟HIV危機 每60名成年人1人感染 | UNAIDS | 聯合國
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiji HIV Crisis: 1 in 60 Adults Infected | UNAIDS | United Nations
article.articleSummary: Fiji has declared a national HIV emergency as UNAIDS reports an estimated prevalence of 1 in 60 adults. In 2025, new HIV diagnoses reached 1,616, about 16 times higher than 2019. Among 2025 births, 59 infants were HIV‑positive, and 18 died before age one. Pregnant women have a 2 in 100 carrier rate. Health Minister Atonio Lalabalavu announced the emergency and a whole‑government response. Fiji will expand free HIV screening, prevention, and treatment, including rapid tests, PrEP for high‑risk groups, harm reduction for people who inject drugs, and free antiretroviral therapy for all diagnosed individuals. External support comes from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the United Nations. UNAIDS notes that among known transmission routes, over half are sexual and more than 42% involve injection drug use.

triage.headline_ja: フィジーHIV危機 成人60人に1人が感染 | UNAIDS | 国連
triage.triage_reason: フィジー政府がHIV国家非常事態を宣言し、新規感染者数が2019年比16倍、乳児死亡例も報告されるなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な状況であり、国際支援も要請されているため。
triage.notes: 発生地域はフィジー（対象国リスト外）であり、インドは外部支援提供国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Число заболевших Эболой в ДРК достигло 7404 человека, умерли 3577
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in the DRC has reached 7,404; 3,577 have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues with 7,404 confirmed cases and 3,577 deaths, per the National Institute of Public Health (INSP). In the latest daily update, 59 new cases, 32 deaths, and 23 recoveries were reported. Since the outbreak began, totals remain 7,404 cases and 3,577 fatalities. There is currently no licensed vaccine or treatment for the new Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain; laboratory data suggest the Ervebo vaccine (rVSV-ZEBOV-GP) may provide some protection against Ebola disease. Separately, African states have expressed interest in a Russian Ebola vaccine, with clinical trials ongoing for that candidate. The report notes ongoing research and references updates from OSN.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が7,404人に達し、3,577人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が継続中で、致死率が高く、新規のBundibugyo株に対するライセンス済みワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 新規のBundibugyoエボラウイルス株が報告され、既存のErveboワクチンの有効性は実験室データのみで確認中。ロシア製ワクチンの臨床試験にも言及あり。致死率約48%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Is DRC's Worst: Where Is The Vaccine? - Explainer
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the largest Bundibugyo outbreak on record and the world’s second-largest Ebola epidemic after West Africa 2014–16. As of 7 September, WHO reports 6,757 confirmed cases and 3,267 deaths (case fatality ≈48.3%), spanning six provinces, with Ituri the heaviest transmission and spillover into North Kivu, Haut‑Uélé, South Kivu, Tshopo and Bas‑Uélé. The outbreak is expanding faster than any prior Ebola epidemic and is far from under control; onset is traced to mid‑January, with early cases misdiagnosed as malaria/typhoid. No licensed Bundibugyo vaccine exists; existing Ervebo targets Zaire, with limited cross-protection evidence. CEPI has funded up to $8.5 million to Hilleman Laboratories to advance a Bundibugyo vaccine (originating from IAVI/WHO) with first trial doses by year‑end; Ervebo production upgrades aim to reduce costs and enable standard refrigeration. About 70,000 Ervebo doses will be delivered to DRC (50,000 for health workers, 20,000 for a cross‑protection trial).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行はDRC史上最悪：ワクチンはどこにあるのか？－解説
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が発生し、6州に拡大、致死率約48%、制御不能な拡大が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリー上ではDRC国内（Ituri、North Kivu、Haut-Uélé、South Kivu、Tshopo、Bas-Uélé）での流行のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Bangladesh Reports 4th H5N1 Human Infection for 2026
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh reports its 4th human H5N1 infection in the past 9 months, a Bangladeshi child with household exposure to ducks and chickens; no travel history outside residence. Previously, a fatal H5N1 case occurred in Chattogram Division (ill Jan 22; hospitalized Jan 28; died Feb 1; lab-confirmed Feb 7), a second case from Sylhet Division (hospitalized Mar 28; discharged Mar 31; positive Apr 20), and a third Sylhet case (ill May; diagnosed July; recovered; no travel or poultry exposure). Poultry testing from backyard chickens on 26 Aug was negative for influenza A(H5). The H5N1 circulating in India and Bangladesh is typically clade 2.3.2.1a, not the 2.3.4.4b currently dominant elsewhere. This is Bangladesh’s 16th H5 case since 2008 (2 fatalities: 2013, 2026); about 10 human H5 cases were reported to WHO in 2026, with many unreported globally.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: バングラデシュで2026年4例目のH5N1ヒト感染例を報告
triage.triage_reason: H5N1ヒト感染はバングラデシュで継続的に発生しているが対象国リストに該当せず、渡航歴なし・家禽曝露のみで国際的拡大の兆候は乏しい。今後の推移を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Ungkap 3 Subtipe Influenza Paling Banyak Ditemukan di RI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Reveals the Three Most Common Influenza Subtypes Found in Indonesia
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s Ministry of Health reports the three most common influenza subtypes in August 2026 are influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, influenza A(H3N2), and influenza B/Victoria. Sentinel Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) and Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) surveillance for 2024–2026 through week 34 covers 39 puskesmas and 35 hospitals nationwide. By week 34, influenza activity remains low with a 28% positivity rate, and A(H1N1)pdm09 is the predominant subtype. Expert Tjandra Yoga Aditama emphasizes that A dominance is not unusual and that H1N1pdm09 is not a new virus; the pandemic strain from 2009 (swine flu) remains common. Greater concern would arise if rarer subtypes such as H5N1 or H7N9 emerge. Preventive measures include seasonal vaccination against influenza (covering H1N1pdm09 and H3N2) and reducing contact or wearing masks for those with symptoms to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省、国内で最も多く検出される3つのインフルエンザ亜型を発表

triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1pdm09, H3N2, B/Victoria)の通常のサーベイランス結果であり、H5N1やH7N9などの高懸念亜型は検出されていない。専門家も『異常ではない』と明言している。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு பாதிப்பு - ICU-வில் சிகிச்சைப் பெற்றால் ரூ.2 லட்சம் வரை கட்டணம்? சில தனியார் மருத்துவமனைகள் மீது புகார் வந்துள்ளது - சுகாதாரத்துறை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue infection - Would you be charged up to Rs 2 lakh if treated in ICU? Complaints have been filed against some private hospitals - Health Department.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Tamil Nadu are nearing 16,000, with 9 deaths reported to date, according to the Health Department. As dengue cases rise, complaints have been filed against private hospitals accused of overcharging patients. Reported charges range from Rs 22,000 to Rs 75,000 for standard dengue treatment, while ICU admissions can attract Rs 75,000 up to Rs 2 lakh. The Health Department says it will take stringent action against hospitals that bill dengue as a reason for inflated fees. If the public suspects overcharging, they can report via the 104 helpline. The article focuses on the state's dengue burden and enforcement against fee hikes but does not specify other affected districts or hospital names.

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு காய்ச்சல் : மருத்துவத்துறையின் அலட்சியப் போக்கே உயிரிழப்புகளுக்குக் காரணம் - டிடிவி தினகரன் குற்றச்சாட்டு! - News7 Tamil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever: The medical department's negligence is the cause of deaths - DTV Dinakaran's accusation! - News7 Tamil
article.articleSummary: DTV Dinakaran, general secretary of AMMK, posted on X accusing Tamil Nadu’s health department of negligence in the dengue outbreak. He cites media reports that about 16,000 people in Tamil Nadu were infected with dengue and nine deaths have occurred, calling these figures alarming. Dinakaran contends that failures to detect dengue early, implement sufficient preventive measures, and eradicate Aedes mosquitoes have driven the fatalities. He argues that after climate-change-driven disease spread, the health department must shift from reactive to proactive action—intensifying vector control and ensuring appropriate treatment for dengue patients. He urges the health department and the state government to strengthen prevention and care, while asking the public to remain vigilant as dengue remains a concern in Tamil Nadu, according to the 2026-09-17 publication. Keywords: dengue, Tamil Nadu, Aedes, outbreak, public health, vector control.

article.articleHeadline: Φίτζι: Το νησιωτικό έθνος κήρυξε κατάσταση εθνικής κρίσης για τον ιό HIV έπειτα από τη ραγδαία αύξηση των κρουσμάτων
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiji: The island nation declared a state of national crisis over HIV following a rapid increase in cases.
article.articleSummary: Fiji, a Pacific island nation of about 900,000, declared a national emergency over HIV after a rapid rise in infections. In 2025, 2,016 people were diagnosed with HIV, and UNAIDS estimates that about 9,100 residents were living with HIV last year; only 39% knew their status and 22% were on antiretroviral therapy. The government notes 59 babies were born with HIV last year, with 18 dying before their first birthday. Among cases with known transmission routes, more than half were through sexual contact and over 42% through intravenous drug use. The prevalence is about 1 in 60 adults, and about 2 in 100 pregnant women live with HIV. Fiji, with support from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the UN, aims to enhance testing, prevention, and treatment. The measure highlights that HIV has not been eliminated.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising dengue fever: Efforts to eradicate mosquitoes must be intensified - DTV Dinakaran
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, dengue fever in Tamil Nadu has risen to about 16,000 cases with 9 deaths, according to DTV Dinakaran. He calls for intensified efforts to eradicate Aedes mosquitoes, the primary dengue vector, and for the health authorities to ensure adequate treatment for affected patients. Dinakaran criticizes perceived laxity by the health department in preventive measures and warns that climate-change-driven spread requires proactive, preemptive actions rather than reactive responses. The statement urges stronger mosquito-control campaigns, preemptive safeguards to curb outbreaks, and accountability from the health department and state government. Public vigilance and timely medical care for dengue patients are emphasized as essential to address the ongoing outbreak in Tamil Nadu.

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : plus de 7.400 cas, la dynamique de l'épidémie évolue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: more than 7,400 cases, the outbreak dynamics are evolving.
article.articleSummary: As of September 15, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 7,404 confirmed cases and 3,577 deaths (case fatality 48.3%), with 1,776 recoveries. Across 62 health zones in seven provinces, Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for 77.7% of confirmed cases, but its curve has peaked and is descending. Nord-Kivu is rising, with 373 hospitalizations and bed occupancy at 94.7%; 42.1% of hospitalized patients are treated outside standard facilities, and there is no bed availability in Butembo and Katwa. WHO notes early signs of progress in Ituri, but cautions the outbreak continues to grow and kill. In the past week, Ituri reported about 300 new cases and 160 deaths; Nord-Kivu’s weekly cases nearly doubled to over 200. This outbreak is the largest and deadliest Ebola event in the DRC and the second largest globally.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国/エボラ出血熱：症例数7,400人超、流行の動態が変化
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%の大規模エボラ流行が継続・拡大しており、複数州で病床不足が発生、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大・最悪のエボラ流行かつ世界で2番目に大きい流行と報告されている。Nord-Kivuでは病床稼働率94.7%、Butembo・Katwaでは病床が枯渇するなど医療体制の逼迫が顕著。WHOも流行継続・拡大に警戒を継続。

article.articleHeadline: Εθνική κρίση για το AIDS στα νησιά Φίτζι - Ένας στους 60 ζει με τον ιό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National crisis over AIDS in the Fiji Islands - One in 60 lives with the virus.
article.articleSummary: Fiji declares a national health emergency over HIV/AIDS as infections surge, with 2,016 new HIV diagnoses in 2025. The government reports about 1 in 60 adults and 2 in 100 pregnant women live with HIV/AIDS, a 16-fold increase since 2019, and a 27% rise in new diagnoses last year. Last year, 59 babies were born with HIV, 18 of whom died before age 1. Fiji’s population is ~900,000; UNAIDS estimates 9,100 residents were living with HIV last year, with only 39% aware of their status and 22% on antiretroviral therapy. Health Minister Antonio Lalabalabalavu announced the emergency to mobilize testing, prevention, and treatment. Transmission: over half with known mode via sexual contact; over 42% via injection drug use. Fiji is a drug-trafficking hub for Australia and New Zealand; external support comes from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the UN. WHO notes Fiji’s rate remains lower than parts of Africa (about 1 in 35 adults).

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Où en est-on avec le vaccin contre la souche Bundibugyo du virus Ebola ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Where do we stand on the vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus?
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo species, the largest Ebola event in the country and second-largest worldwide (2014-2016 West Africa). As of Sept 7, 2026, WHO reports 6,757 confirmed cases and 3,267 deaths ( CFR 48.3%), across six provinces, with Ituri as the main hotspot and sustained transmission in North Kivu and Haut-Uélé; cases also in South Kivu, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé. UNICEF estimates children account for about a quarter of cases and roughly a third of deaths; WHO notes 155 health workers infected, 45 dead. Onset occurred mid-January, with declaration in mid-May after initial misdiagnosis with malaria/typhoid. No approved Bundibugyo vaccine; existing vaccines target Zaïre Ebola, with limited cross-protection data. CEPI funded US$8.5 million to Hilleman Laboratories to advance a Bundibugyo-focused rVSV vaccine, with first doses for clinical trials by year-end, leveraging Ervebo platform improvements for refrigerated storage.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラウイルスのブンディブギョ株に対するワクチンの現状は?
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が継続中で、致死率約48%、6州に拡大、承認済みワクチンがなく国際的対応が必要な深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文で言及なく、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。DRC国内の複数州(Tshopo, South Kivu, Ituriなど)で流行中。CEPIとHilleman Laboratoriesによる新規ワクチン開発が進行中だが未承認。

article.articleHeadline: Measles is making a comeback. Will we end it for good? - Phnom Penh Post
article.articleSummary: Measles is resurging in the Western Pacific, eroding decades of progress toward elimination. Globally, vaccination has prevented about 154 million deaths since 1974, with measles vaccination saving roughly 94 million lives (including 12 million in the Western Pacific). Outbreaks reappear as COVID-19-era disruptions and antivaccine misinformation weaken coverage, revealing immunity gaps. The region, home to 2.2 billion people, reported about 1.6 million zero-dose children in 2025. In 2024 and 2025, nearly 20 million births occurred, all needing routine immunisation. Last year, WHO certified measles and rubella elimination as a public health threat in all 21 Pacific island countries and areas, yet nine countries remain not yet eliminated: Cambodia, China, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Mongolia, Papua New Guinea, the Philippines, and Vietnam. Elimination by 2030 requires renewed political commitment, robust routine immunisation and surveillance, resilient supply chains, and sustained funding, recognizing immunisation as long-term health security.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が再興している。今度こそ根絶できるか？ - プノンペンポスト

triage.notes: 記事はWHOの麻疹・風疹排除認証の進捗と、依然として排除未達成の9カ国（カンボジア、中国、インドネシア、ラオス、マレーシア、モンゴル、パプアニューギニア、フィリピン、ベトナム）を挙げる政策・啓発的なオピニオン記事であり、特定の急性アウトブレイク事例の報告ではない。対象国リストに含まれる国（中国、インドネシア、フィリピン、ベトナム）のみをverified_locationsに記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Pakar UGM Buka Suara Soal Bakteri 'Tahan Panas' di Kasus Keracunan MBG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UGM expert speaks out about heat-resistant bacteria in MBG poisoning case
article.articleSummary: Bacillus cereus, Staphylococcus aureus, and Escherichia coli are repeatedly detected in MBG (Makan Bergizi Gratis) poisoning cases across Indonesia, highlighting food-safety gaps beyond cooking. UGM Food Safety expert Endang Sutriswati Rahayu explains Bacillus cereus forms heat-resistant endospores that survive ordinary cooking, enabling toxin production if cooked food sits for more than four hours. Laboratory findings include Karo Regency, North Sumatra: S. aureus, B. cereus, and E. coli; Tana Toraja, South Sulawesi: E. coli in yellow-spiced chicken; Bantul Regency: Bacillus sp. in galantin; and Sidoarjo: E. coli, S. aureus, and B. cereus linked to hundreds of students and santri. Emphasis is on strict time–temperature control and hygiene from preparation to serving, as food must be consumed promptly to prevent bacterial growth, even with existing SOPs.

triage.headline_ja: UGMの専門家、MBG食中毒事件における「耐熱性」細菌について見解を述べる
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの学校給食プログラム(MBG)で複数地域にわたりE. coli等による食中毒が繰り返し発生しているが、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大の可能性は低く、食品衛生管理の構造的問題として続報を注視すべき事案。
triage.notes: 食中毒は複数地域（北スマトラ、南スラウェシ、バントゥル、シドアルジョ）の政府給食プログラム(MBG)関連施設で発生しており、国内の食品衛生管理体制の問題として継続的な監視が必要。感染症の国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Chipangali Records Reduction In Malaria Cases
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Chipangali District, Eastern Province, Zambia, has fallen to about 50 cases per 1,000 people from 1,021 per 1,000 three years earlier. At a malaria task force and epidemic preparedness meeting, District Health Promotions Officer Mutale Musonda cited a drop from 600–800 per 1,000 in 1Q2025 to a 200-per-1,000 reduction in 2Q2025, continuing down to 55.6 per 1,000 in 2Q2026. Higher incidences persist in Madzi-a-tuwa (74/1,000), Chakoloma (74/1,000), Mpawa (70/1,000), and Mshawa catchment (55/1,000). Community testing by health workers and expanded Polyvalent CBVs within ICCM have accelerated early treatment and reduced transmission. In 2Q2025, 90,853 people were tested at community level with ~35,000 positives; in 2Q2026, 50,037 tested with ~9,000 positives. Indoor Residual Spraying is set to begin Sept 22, 2026, covering eligible structures to prevent escalation.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア:チパンガリでマラリア症例が減少
triage.triage_reason: マラリア症例は継続的に減少しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威や異常事態ではなく、対策も順調に進んでいるためピックアップ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア症例数の改善を報告する内容であり、地域保健当局によるコミュニティ検査・治療・室内残留噴霧（IRS）などの対策が功を奏している事例。ネガティブなシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: 27 Kasus Baru HIV di Sidrap hingga Agustus, 239 Orang Terapi, Bisa Menular Lewat ASI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 27 New HIV Cases in Sidrap as of August; 239 People on Therapy; Can Be Transmitted Through Breast Milk.
article.articleSummary: Sidrap, South Sulawesi, recorded 27 new HIV cases from January to August 2026, with 239 people on antiretroviral therapy (ART) across facilities including puskesmas centers and Rumah Sakit Nene' Mallomo in Rijang Pittu, Maritengngae. Data from the Sidrap Health Office were presented at a provincial AIDS Control Commission (KPA) meeting in Makassar on 17 September 2026, under the theme Ending AIDS 2030. Deputy Regent Nurkanaah called for strengthened prevention, case finding, treatment, and HIV education through coordinated action among government, health workers, communities, and stakeholders. The report notes that HIV can be transmitted through breast milk. ART is highlighted for suppressing the virus, and authorities plan ongoing socialization and education efforts with districts, hospitals, and community groups to sustain HIV-AIDS responses in Sidrap.

article.articleHeadline: Sida : l'explosion des contaminations déclarée "urgence nationale" aux îles Fidji - Outre-mer La 1ère
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AIDS: the surge in infections declared "national emergency" in the Fiji Islands - Overseas La 1ère
article.articleSummary: HIV/AIDS surge in Fiji declared a national emergency after 2025 infections reached 2,016—roughly 16 times 2019 levels. Health Minister Atonio Lalabalavu announced the emergency and pledged expanded free testing, prevention, and treatment, including rapid tests, pre-exposure prophylaxis for high-risk groups, harm-reduction for people who inject drugs, and free antiretroviral therapy for people living with HIV. Fiji, an archipelago of over 300 islands with more than 900,000 residents and a young demographic, shows an estimated adult HIV prevalence of about 1 in 60 and HIV positivity among about 2 in 100 pregnant women. In 2025, 59 HIV-exposed births yielded 18 infant deaths before age one. Transmission is over 50% sexual and more than 42% linked to injecting drug use with contaminated equipment. International support comes from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and UN agencies, with UNAIDS urging stronger Pacific regional cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: エイズ：感染爆発的増加によりフィジー諸島で「国家緊急事態」を宣言
triage.triage_reason: フィジーでHIV感染者数が2019年比約16倍に急増し国家緊急事態が宣言された。深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性がIHR基準で2つ該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が適切。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola response making progress, but more support urgently needed, Senior Ebola Coordinator says
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak shows progress in Ituri (Bunia) but rising transmission in Butembo (North Kivu) and across Sud-Ubangi, with transmission spanning multiple locations including Kisangani. The response is integrated across government, WHO, UN agencies, NGOs, and Africa CDC, and bed capacity at Ebola treatment centres has grown from about 900 to an additional 440 beds in the past month. International support exists from the US, UK, EU, Germany, and others, but funding remains insufficient: the Government plan and WHO financing are urgently needed, and the Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan is only 49% funded. Aimed measures include post-exposure prophylaxis, therapies, and soon vaccines tested in clinical trials, alongside cross-border control along the Congo River. Operational challenges include poor roads and violence against responders, with consequences for hunger, health-centre attendance, maternal mortality, and HIV treatment. article.articleHeadline: Число жертв Эболы в ДР Конго выросло до 3577 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 3,577 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo totals 7,404 cases and 3,577 deaths since the outbreak began, per the National Institute of Public Health cited by RIA Novosti. The latest daily report records 59 new cases, 32 deaths, and 23 recoveries. The outbreak remains ongoing and challenging for public health response. Separately, Russian microbiologists report successful trials of a new Russian Ebola vaccine, effective against the Bundibugyo strain currently circulating in Africa. The World Health Organization has stopped sharing fresh viral variants, complicating global situational awareness and monitoring of evolving strains.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ死者数が3,577人に増加

article.articleHeadline: La OMS ve "señales alentadoras" en la lucha contra la epidemia de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO sees "encouraging signs" in the fight against the Ebola epidemic in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows encouraging signs but could last several months. Since mid-May, the DRC's seventeenth Ebola outbreak has produced over 7,200 cases and more than 3,500 deaths across seven provinces. Transmission is falling in Ituri, the epicenter, while South Kivu has had no new cases since May. Trials of treatments and post-exposure prophylaxis are accelerating with greater community participation, and vaccine trials are expected to begin in the coming weeks. The outbreak remains deadly, with more than 15,000 Ebola deaths in Africa in the past 50 years before this outbreak. WHO officials emphasize that key indicators have not yet improved sufficiently and that the response must be maintained and reinforced for many months ahead, per Maria Van Kerkhove.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ流行との闘いに「明るい兆し」を見出す

triage.notes: 既知の大規模流行（第17次DRCエボラ流行）に関する継続報道。WHO事務局長の発言によると流行は数ヶ月継続する可能性があり、対応の維持・強化が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A pada Anak Meningkat, Kapan Harus Dibawa ke Rumah Sakit? : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Influenza A in Children Have Increased, When Should They Be Taken to the Hospital? : Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Influenza A infections are increasing among children in Indonesia, with Surabaya hospitals reporting more pediatric influenza-related visits and crowded emergency departments. While flu can be severe, many pediatric cases do not require hospitalization. Dr. Yogi Prawira, Sp.A, of Siloam Hospitals TB Simatupang, states that children with mild illness can often be managed at home if they remain active, eat and drink, and can interact normally, especially when fever has subsided. Home care is appropriate provided respiration is not rapid and there is no chest indrawing. Parents should monitor for warning signs of respiratory distress: rapid breathing, use of chest muscles, chest indrawing, and blue coloration of lips or tongue indicating possible hypoxemia, which requires urgent medical attention. Vaccination may lessen severity. Guidance reflects current conditions as of 17 September 2026 in Surabaya and Jakarta-area healthcare settings.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアで小児のインフルエンザA症例が増加、いつ病院に連れて行くべきか

article.articleHeadline: 斐济进入爱滋病危机状态　每60成人1人感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiji enters an AIDS crisis; one in sixty adults infected.
article.articleSummary: Fiji declares a nationwide AIDS crisis, with HIV infection estimated at one in sixty adults. In Suva and nationwide, 2025 new HIV diagnoses reached 2,016, a 16-fold rise since 2019. Among pregnant women, about 2 in every 100 are HIV-positive. Of 59 HIV-infected babies born in 2025, 18 died before turning one. The government has formally declared a national HIV emergency and will pursue a whole-government response, expanding free HIV testing, prevention services, and treatment, including rapid testing, PrEP for high-risk groups, and harm-reduction for people who inject drugs. Treatment for diagnosed individuals will be provided at no cost. External support comes from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the United Nations. UNAIDS reports that over half of known transmissions are sexual, with more than 42% linked to injection drug use.
