article.articleHeadline: 开学季"撞上"流感季：多地班级停课，疫苗、抗病毒药如何应对？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back-to-school season collides with flu season: class suspensions in many places; what role can vaccines and antiviral drugs play?
article.articleSummary: Influenza clusters in China remain concentrated in schools and childcare facilities, with Shanghai and Hangzhou reporting rapid class suspensions as the 2026 flu season appears earlier. National surveillance (Aug 31–Sep 6) shows influenza-like illness at 3.8% of outpatient visits; southern provinces 4.6% vs northern 2.9%. Among 216 respiratory multi-pathogen sites, influenza positivity is 18.4%; hospitalized severe acute respiratory infections testing positive for influenza are 7.5%. Circulating strains are B/Victoria and A/H3N2, with A(H3N2) rising; 15–59-year-olds show the highest positivity. Prevention relies on vaccination. The 2026–2027 China influenza vaccine guideline recommends trivalent vaccines (IIV3 and LAIV3) for people aged 6 months and older; LAIV3 targets 3–17 years. Priority groups include healthcare workers, adults ≥60, chronic-disease patients, residents and staff in congregate settings, and children 6 months–5 years. Vaccination campaigns began in Sep–Oct; clinic doses priced at 63, 98, or 308 yuan, plus a 15 yuan service fee. Antivirals remain essential; treatment within 48 hours. Main drugs include neuraminidase inhibitors (oseltamivir) and baloxavir marboxil, which has expanded to younger ages. The anti-flu drug market grew from 32B yuan (2018) to 44B (2022) and is projected to 116B by 2030. Roche’s Tamiflu dominates; domestic brands and five new domestic anti-flu drugs are entering the market, intensifying competition.

triage.headline_ja: 開学シーズンとインフルエンザ流行が重なる：各地でクラス閉鎖、ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬の対応は？

article.articleHeadline: Fiji declares HIV a national crisis, 1 in 60 adults carry it
article.articleSummary: Fiji declares HIV a national health crisis as 2025 HIV diagnoses reach 2,016—16x 2019; estimated adult HIV prevalence about 1 in 60 (≈1.67%), with pregnant women at 2 in 100 and 59 babies born with HIV in 2025, 18 died before age one. article.articleHeadline: Ghebreyesus : Progrès réalisés dans la lutte contre l'épidémie d'Ebola en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ghebreyesus: Progress made in the fight against the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows progress; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reports transmission declines in Ituri province’s hardest-hit areas, and no new cases in South Kivu since May, with over 1,700 patients recovered. Across seven provinces, the outbreak has surpassed 7,200 cases and 3,500 deaths, though transmission is now largely limited to the northeast of the DRC after four months of response. In Ituri, nearly 300 new cases and 160 deaths were reported last week; North Kivu weekly cases nearly doubled in the past two weeks. Trials of treatments and post-exposure prophylaxis are accelerating, with vaccine trials set to begin in coming weeks and efforts to widen access if proven effective. The epidemic worsens humanitarian and health outcomes, including hunger, reduced health-centre attendance, rising maternal mortality, and interruptions to HIV treatment; donors are urged to fund the government response plan and the humanitarian response.

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Meningkat, Haruskah Waspada? Ini Saran Dokter Paru Senior
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A is on the rise, should we be vigilant? Here is the advice of a senior pulmonologist.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia reports rising influenza activity, with August 2026 data showing influenza A subtypes predominate: A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2), and influenza B Victoria. Senior pulmonologist Prof Dr Tjandra Yoga Aditama notes this pattern reflects the long-standing dominance of influenza A, especially during dry-season or transitional weather; increases in influenza B or C would be unusual. He advises personal protection and to avoid transmission when sick—wear a mask and stay home. Kemenkes public communications head Aji Muhawarman says the year-end uptick is a normal seasonal cycle. MoH Jakarta briefing indicates most detected influenza cases occur in children aged 0–4 years, making up about one-third of cases. Data are from Kemenkes RI and detikcom as of August 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Россияне пожаловались на кишечную инфекцию с крапивницей в Китае
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians complained about a gastrointestinal infection with urticaria in China.
article.articleSummary: Gastroenteritis with urticaria among Russians in China, potentially due to contaminated food and water, per Telegram channel Shot. A 36-year-old Saint Petersburg resident, Renita, traveled to China with her husband; late in the trip she developed red hives, but delayed medical care until hospitalization after a Bali layover, where she was diagnosed with a gastrointestinal infection with urticaria. A second Russian, Lana, who relocated to China for work, reported similar GI symptoms and hives for a second time and likewise avoided medical care, using Smecta and activated charcoal for relief. Urticaria can be treated with antihistamines, but GI issues require prompt medical consultation. Major suspected causes include raw foods, undercooked meat, and beverages of dubious origin. Separately, Phuket remains a site of concern with a new COVID-19 outbreak infecting at least five compatriots.

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Menjinak di Ituri, WHO Lihat Tanda Menggembirakan di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak subsiding in Ituri, WHO sees encouraging signs in Kongo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is subsiding in Ituri Province, though overall transmission remains widespread, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said Sept 16. Across seven provinces, more than 7,200 cases and over 3,500 deaths have been reported. In Ituri, about 300 new cases and 160 deaths were recorded in the past week, nearly half of the national total. South Kivu has not reported new cases since May, with more than 1,700 recovered. North Kivu infections have risen, with weekly cases nearly doubling in two weeks—from around 100 to over 200. The outbreak has persisted for four months and remains largely confined to eastern DRC, with a small outbreak in Uganda quickly halted. WHO cautioned that primary indicators have not yet improved as hoped, and sustained effort is required.

article.articleHeadline: フィジー、ＨＩＶ危機を宣言 性行為と違法薬物の回し打ちで成人の６０人に１人が感染：時事ドットコム
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiji Declares HIV Crisis, One in 60 Adults Infected Through Sex and Needle-Sharing for Illegal Drugs
article.articleSummary: Fiji declared a national HIV crisis on September 16, 2026, as infections surged through sex and injecting drug use. Among adults, HIV prevalence is now about 1 in 60, up from 1 in 167 five years earlier; the government has declared a national emergency and pledged whole-government action. In 2025, new HIV infections reached 1,616, roughly 16 times the level in 2019. Among pregnant women, 2 in 100 are HIV-positive; 59 HIV-exposed infants in 2025 experienced mother-to-child infection, 18 of whom died before their first birthday. UNAIDS data show over half of known infections via sex and more than 42% via syringe-sharing, with high-risk groups around sex work and injecting drug use emerging around 2019. Fiji, a transit point for illegal drugs, has seen methamphetamine and cocaine trafficking rise post-COVID. Australia, New Zealand, India, Global Fund, and UN agencies are supporting.

article.articleHeadline: Aux Fidji, l'explosion des contaminations au VIH déclarée "urgence nationale" - Outre-mer La 1ère
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Fiji, the surge in HIV infections has been declared a "national emergency".
article.articleSummary: Fiji has declared its HIV epidemic a national emergency amid a rapid surge in infections. In 2025, 2,016 new HIV diagnoses were recorded, up 27% from 2024 and roughly 16 times higher than 2019, with increases attributed to both transmission and improved testing. UNAIDS estimates about 9,100 people living with HIV in Fiji in 2025, of whom only 39% know their status and 22% receive antiretroviral therapy. Among pregnant women in prenatal care, HIV prevalence is about 2% (roughly 1 in 50). In 2025, 59 babies were born with HIV and 18 died before age one. Transmission sources: over half via sexual contact; about 42% linked to injection drug use and shared injection equipment. Fiji will scale up free rapid testing, ART and PrEP access, and implement a syringe-exchange program, with a five-minister interagency committee and international support from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund and the UN.

article.articleHeadline: Warga Purwakarta Antusias Antre Vaksin Rabies Gratis, Bawa Kucing dan Anjing sejak Pagi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Purwakarta Residents Eagerly Queue for Free Rabies Vaccination, Bringing Cats and Dogs Since This Morning.
article.articleSummary: Free rabies vaccination for pets underway in Purwakarta Regency, West Java, Indonesia, on 17 September 2026, with residents queuing since early morning at the Diskanak Purwakarta to vaccinate dogs, cats, civets, and monkeys. The drive, held to mark World Rabies Day and aligned with a Pet Husbandry and Veterinary Health Month, offers no-cost shots after animal examinations. Officials say the rollout aims to prevent human rabies transmission; ongoing program targets 2,500 animals for the year, with today’s target at 390. A resident, Iin, vaccinated her Persian cat and reported good health with no post-vaccination reactions. Head of the Diskanak division, Wini Karmila, emphasized the vaccination plan focuses on rabies carriers such as dogs and cats, and other susceptible species. The event underscores community demand for affordable preventive care for pets.

article.articleHeadline: Stray Dog Terror In Beed's Parli Vaijnath: 47 Bitten In Single-Day Rampage
article.articleSummary: Beed's Parli Vaijnath town in Maharashtra faced a rabies-suspected stray-dog rampage, with 47 people bitten in a single day across multiple localities, including Vaijnath Temple Road, Bhoi Galli, 40-Feet Road, Barkat Nagar, Sathe Nagar, Ambewes, Zam Zam Park and Azad Nagar. Two aggressive dogs, a golden-colored and a black one, reportedly tormented residents and a hospital premises in Ganeshpar where a staffer, a schoolchild, and another resident were bitten. Of the injured, 27 were discharged after initial wound care and vaccination; 19 were referred to Swami Ramanand Teerth Rural Government Medical College and Hospital (SRTRGMCH), Ambajogai, for specialised treatment. Municipal authorities could not trace the dogs; a capture drive was planned within two days. An Animal Birth Control (ABC) drive occurred two months earlier with an estimated stray-dog population exceeding 6,000. A new sterilisation and vaccination campaign and pet vaccination urged, with recommendations to keep dogs from roaming.

triage.headline_ja: ビードのパルリー・ヴァイジュナートで野良犬による恐怖：1日で47人が咬まれる被害

triage.notes: 狂犬病確定例ではなく『疑い』段階の咬傷事件。野良犬6000匹超の個体群管理と狂犬病ワクチン接種体制の課題が背景にあり、地域の公衆衛生対応能力の問題として継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Hadapi Dengue di Indonesia, Penanganan Tak Cukup Hanya Mengandalkan 3M Plus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Facing Dengue in Indonesia: Management Alone Is Not Enough, Relying Only on 3M Plus Is Not Sufficient.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's dengue management requires a broader strategy beyond patient care, integrating prevention, vector control, early detection, and strengthened clinical management to reduce health and economic burden. A study presented at the Asia Dengue Summit 9 in Singapore (June 2026) estimates Indonesia's dengue burden at USD 550.9 million in 2024 (about IDR 9 trillion). Household costs remain high: insured patients incur about IDR 1.09–1.33 million out-of-pocket per episode; uninsured patients pay roughly IDR 4.27–5.60 million. Dengue, transmitted by Aedes, continues in Indonesia's tropical climate, and reinfections can be more severe. Control measures include 3M Plus (drain/clean water storage, cover containers, reuse containers) and Jumantik to reduce breeding sites, alongside strengthened surveillance. Innovations such as Wolbachia and dengue vaccination are discussed; school-based vaccination could save 1.1–1.3 million healthy life years and net USD 329.3–731.5 million over 20 years. A National Dengue Control Action Plan 2026–2029 is being prepared to coordinate efforts.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアにおけるデング熱対策：3M Plusだけに頼るのでは不十分
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドネシアの地域流行病であり、本記事は経済的負担や対策強化に関する政策論的内容で、急性の異常事態や新規発生を示すものではないため、通常のサーベイランス範囲として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: シンガポールは会議開催地として言及されているのみで、発生地域としての言及ではないため除外した。記事は流行対策・経済負担に関する分析記事であり、新規の異常発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola on alkanut talttua Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa, viranomaiset väittävät
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has begun to subside in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities say.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has begun to subside in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with daily new infections falling for the first time since May—from about 120 to 80 cases, while strict health measures remain in place. The outbreak has reached a sixth province, South Ubangi in the northwest, near the borders with the Central African Republic and the Republic of the Congo. Since 1976, the DRC has experienced 17 Ebola outbreaks; this current epidemic is the deadliest, with over 7,200 cases and nearly 3,500 deaths reported by September 14. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo virus variant, for which there is no vaccine. Ongoing transmission and cross-border spread underscore the need for continued surveillance and public health interventions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が沈静化し始めたと当局が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（7,200例超、死者約3,500人）が継続し、国境地域への拡大や新変異株（ワクチンなし）による重症例が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyoウイルス変異株にはワクチンがなく、致死率が高い点に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Did Ebola start spreading before officials even knew?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo variant) has killed more than 3,000 people. Evidence from WHO, Africa CDC, US CDC and Red Cross indicates the virus circulated weeks to months before official detection. The first retrospectively identified case was a healthcare worker in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, who developed Ebola-like symptoms around 24–25 April and died in Bunia. The WHO was alerted on 5 May to an unknown disease with unusually high deaths; ten days later Kinshasa laboratories confirmed Ebola. Africa CDC later noted almost four weeks elapsed between first symptoms and lab confirmation, delaying containment measures and enabling spread. As of 17 September 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak remains ongoing in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは当局が把握する前から拡大していたのか？
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが継続中で既に3,000人超の死亡が報告されており、検出遅延によるヒトーヒト感染拡大の懸念があるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHO・Africa CDC・US CDC・赤十字が関与しており、既に国際的な対応が進行中の重大アウトブレイクである。検出までに約4週間を要した点が今後の対応能力評価において重要な論点となる。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 cases on the rise, health officials say
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 infections in Thailand are rising, averaging 15,000 new cases per week over the past four weeks. From Jan 1 to Sept 15, cumulative Covid-19 cases reached 135,667 with 26 deaths (morbidity 206 per 100,000). Aug 9–Sept 8 added 64,937 cases nationwide; deaths run at 2–4 weekly. Highest case numbers are in Chon Buri, Bangkok and Phuket; the youngest age groups show the highest incidence, especially under one year and ages 1–4, while working-age adults 20–29 and 30–39 are most affected. Of 26 fatalities this year, 21 were in the high-risk “608” group (60+ or with comorbidities). Dominant strains NB.1.8.1 and JN.1; PQ.16.1.1 under monitoring with six Thai cases. Influenza remains prevalent: 359,672 cases, 57 deaths (most unvaccinated); RSV infections total 8,578 with one infant death. Other high-fatality illnesses include rabies, Legionnaires’, melioidosis, streptococcal toxic shock syndrome, and encephalitis.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルス感染症の症例が増加、保健当局が発表
triage.triage_reason: タイで季節的なCOVID-19感染増加が報告されているが、死亡率は低く重症度も限定的。新変異株PQ.16.1.1が監視下にあり、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 定例的な感染症サーベイランス報告。COVID-19は季節的増加傾向にあり、新変異株PQ.16.1.1が国内6症例で監視中。インフルエンザ・RSV等他疾患の状況も併記されているが、いずれも深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Mulai Merebak di Indonesia? Kenali Gejala dan Tanda Bahayanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Has Influenza A Started Spreading in Indonesia? Recognize Its Symptoms and Danger Signs.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s influenza A activity shows seasonal patterns but no significant surge, per the Ministry of Health. Sentinel ILI-SARI surveillance (2024–2026) across 39 public health centers and 35 hospitals recorded two seasonal peaks: December 2024–January 2025 with a 53% positivity rate, and September–October 2025 with 51%. By August 2026, positivity was 28%, still below the prior peaks. The dominant subtype during this period is influenza A (H1N1pdm09). Aji Muhawarman, head of Public Communications at Kemenkes, says the late-year uptick is a normal pattern rather than a spike. Andi Khomeini Takdir Haruni, MD, notes influenza A is not a new disease and not the same as the common flu; influenza can circulate year-round in Indonesia due to its tropical climate, with activity rising during certain periods. Symptoms are generally similar to other influenza and may vary. Data last accessed 5 September 2026, published 17 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAがインドネシアで拡大し始めている？症状と危険な兆候を知ろう
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア保健省によれば季節性パターンの範囲内であり、過去のピークを下回る通常の流行状況で、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1pdm09)の通常の年次変動であり、保健省が公式に「サージではない」と説明している。

article.articleHeadline: 秋季开学，专家提示警惕诺如病毒"吐"然来袭
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Autumn term begins as experts warn of a Norovirus vomiting outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-17, Henan Province, China, health authorities warn that Norovirus infections surge as the autumn term begins, especially in schools and nurseries. Norovirus causes acute gastroenteritis; typical symptoms are sudden nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and watery diarrhea, sometimes with fever, headache, or muscle aches. The virus is highly contagious with multiple transmission routes; peak activity runs from October to March. Preventive measures focus on strict hand hygiene with soap and running water, thorough cleaning of vomit and diarrheal waste, and environmental sanitation. Alcohol-based sanitizers are not effective against Norovirus. When handling vomit or stool, wear disposable protective clothing, gloves, masks, and ensure waste is sealed in double bags; wash hands after disposal. Improve ventilation; consider air sterilizers or UV lights if needed. Infected individuals should rest at home and only return to school/work 72 hours after symptoms end, with separate dining utensils and medical care if dehydration signs appear.

triage.headline_ja: 秋の新学期開始、専門家がノロウイルスによる嘔吐症状の流行に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のノロウイルス感染注意喚起であり、例年発生する既知の感染症で、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性の予防啓発記事であり、学校・保育施設での集団感染に注意を促す通常の公衆衛生広報。特段の異常事態や重症例の急増は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Crise dans l'Est : bilan alarmant en août entre déplacés, aides et choléra (OCHA)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Crisis in the East: alarming toll in August among the displaced, aid workers and cholera (OCHA).
article.articleSummary: August 2026 OCHA humanitarian snapshot for the Democratic Republic of Congo's East (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) reports 312,900+ internally displaced people (IDPs) across 69 sites in Ituri, with Djugu territory alone noting food assistance for over 103,000 in August. In North Kivu, food aid reached more than 197,500, while hostilities trigger new displacements in Masisi, Rutshuru, Walikale, Beni and Lubero, complicating aid access. In South Kivu, fighting intensifies in Fizi, Mwenga and Uvira, elevating protection risks, amid a cholera outbreak with 1,696 cases in August and rising trends in several health zones. Across all provinces, ongoing clashes and armed attacks hinder humanitarian access and aid delivery to displaced families. Armed groups cited include M23, ADF, CODECO and other militiamen, driving displacement and insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: 東部の危機：8月の深刻な被害状況、避難民・援助・コレラ（OCHA）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で武力紛争による大規模避難民発生と並行し、コレラ症例が8月に1,696件発生し複数の保健地区で増加傾向にあるため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と対応能力の懸念からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 武力紛争（M23、ADF、CODECO等）による大規模避難民発生と人道アクセス制限が、コレラ拡大リスクを増大させている。フィジー（Fiji）は記事主題と無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Limitation of pantothenate bioavailability in Anopheles stephensi by second-generation pantazines enhances restriction of Plasmodium development
article.articleSummary: Anopheles stephensi (Indian strain) exposed to pantazines PZ-3022 and PZ-3883 showed marked suppression of Plasmodium development. Six pantazines all reduced Pan levels in mosquito bodies as measured by AOAC-based Pan quantification. Using the two most effective compounds, PZ-3022 and PZ-3883, midgut oocyst and salivary gland sporozoite infections declined for both P. yoelii (rodent malaria) and P. falciparum (human malaria) at 10 days and at 14–16 days post-infection, with greater reductions than the earlier PZ-2891. Efficacy persisted across a range of concentrations (1, 10, 100 nM), but the greatest inhibition occurred at intermediate doses; higher or lower doses did not increase infection, consistent with allosteric pantazine behavior. Findings support potential deployment in attractive bait stations to block mosquito infection with diverse Plasmodium spp. Laboratory work included P. falciparum NF54 cultures and independent replication across mosquito cohorts.

triage.headline_ja: パンタゼン第二世代化合物によるハマダラカのパントテン酸生物学的利用能の制限がプラスモディウムの発育抑制を強化する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実験室ベースの基礎研究論文であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実験室でのマラリア媒介蚊に対する化合物（パンタゼン）の効果を検証した基礎科学研究であり、インドでの実際の感染症発生を報告するものではない。インド株の蚊が実験に使用されているが、これは研究材料としての言及であり、現地でのアウトブレイクを示すものではないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Três pessoas morrem de febre maculosa em Jeceaba, na Região Central de Minas | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three people die of Rocky Mountain spotted fever in Jeceaba, in the Central Region of Minas Gerais | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Rocky Mountain spotted fever (febre maculosa) in Jeceaba, Central Region, Minas Gerais, Brazil. As of Sept 16, 2026, SES-MG confirms 39 cases and 14 deaths statewide; two cases under investigation are now confirmed, updating earlier figures. The Barbacena Regional Health Unit coordinates local monitoring with state authorities. Nationally, Minas Gerais has seen 48 cases and seven deaths in 2025; 2023 recorded 90 cases with 20 deaths, and 2024 had 95 cases with four deaths. The state’s approximate case fatality rate is 30%. Prevention emphasizes avoiding tick exposure: icaridin repellent, light-colored clothing, long sleeves and pants, closed footwear, long socks, and, in risk settings, protective equipment. After exposure, prompt tick removal is advised. Treatment with antimicrobials should start early and is free through the SUS. Environmental monitoring with Funed and local health departments targets risk areas with horses, capybaras, and dogs, where the star tick is prevalent.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州中央部ジェセアバでロッキー山紅斑熱により3人死亡（イタチアイア放送）
triage.triage_reason: 州全体で39例14死亡と重症度は高いが、過去数年（2023年90例20死亡等）と比較して特に異常な増加ではなく、ダニ媒介性で人-人感染もないため国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 致死率約30%と高いが、ダニ媒介性感染症で人-人感染はなく、州保健当局（SES-MG）と地域保健ユニットが監視・治療（SUS無償提供）を継続実施中。過去数年のデータと比較して顕著な異常増加は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox : une nouvelle épidémie déclarée au Kasaï
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: a new outbreak declared in Kasai.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) outbreak declared in Kasai Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of September 16, 2026. Governor Chrispin Mukendi Bukasa announced circulation across the province, with five health zones affected, including Kanzala covering Tshikapa, the provincial capital. Alerts from early September were confirmed: in Luebo, authorities reported more than 30 suspected cases and four deaths in Mukuandianga and Kambangoma health areas; in Tshikapa, three family members were suspected in Kanzala. The National Institute of Public Health (INSP) has strengthened surveillance. The governor said care is free in all targeted health facilities and urged adherence to WHO/INSP infection-prevention measures: avoid close contact with lesions, regular handwashing, do not handle linens or objects from suspected cases, and seek care for fever, headache, rash, or swollen lymph nodes. Authorities call against stigma and urge reporting of suspected cases. Kasai's first major mpox outbreak was documented in August 2024.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox：カサイ州で新たな流行が宣言される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）で3項目該当し、WHOにより既に注目されているMpoxの新規流行がDRCカサイ州で宣言されたため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: DRCは2024年よりMpox Clade IによるPHEIC対象国であり、カサイ州は2024年8月にも大規模流行を経験している。今回は5つの保健地帯に拡大し、30例以上の疑い例と4名の死亡が報告されている。国際的なMpox警戒状況を踏まえ、続報の確認とフルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Meningite: saiba os sintomas, tipos, transmissão e como prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis: learn the symptoms, types, transmission, and how to prevent.
article.articleSummary: Endemic in Brazil, meningitis occurs year-round, with bacterial and viral forms common. In Ceará state, surveillance records spikes; a 12-year-old girl died from pneumococcal meningitis in Quixeramobim. Meningitis is inflammation of the meninges caused by various agents: bacteria (Neisseria meningitidis, Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae); viruses (enteroviruses, HSV, varicella-zoster, arboviruses); plus fungal and parasitic forms. Bacterial meningitis is typically the most severe; viral forms are often milder. Meningococcal disease can cause meningitis and meningococcemia, with rash, cold extremities, severe pain, and rapid breathing. Transmission varies: bacteria and some viruses via droplets; enteroviruses fecal-oral; fungi rarely spread person-to-person. Symptoms include fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, vomiting, altered mental status; infants may be irritable, feed poorly, lethargic. Diagnosis relies on clinical assessment with CSF and blood tests; vaccination via the National Immunization Program is the main prevention. 2026 Ceará data show 123 cases and seven deaths across 51 municipalities, indicating a return to pre-pandemic levels.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎：症状、種類、感染経路、予防法について
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州における髄膜炎の一般教育記事であり、風土病として年間を通じて発生するもの。2026年のデータはパンデミック前の水準への回帰を示しており、異常な増加や国際的懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は髄膜炎の一般的な医学教育コンテンツであり、セアラ州の2026年データ（123例、7死亡、51自治体）はパンデミック前レベルへの回帰と説明されている。突発的アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Risco de dengue e incêndio: podas abandonadas geram perigo no Bairro Feliz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue and fire risk: abandoned pruning poses danger in Bairro Feliz.
article.articleSummary: Abandoned pruning debris at Praça Pedro Gorneiro, at the entrance to Bairro Feliz in the East region of Goiânia, Brazil, has created hazards for residents for about two weeks. The leftover branches trap standing water, turning the area into a breeding ground for dengue-carrying mosquitoes, while the accumulation of dry leaves elevates fire risk. The city government conducted pruning in the area, but waste collection has not yet occurred, leaving a persistent public health and safety concern in a populated urban space. The article does not report dengue case counts, laboratory confirmation, or details about infection sources or imported/exported cases. Ongoing risk depends on inadequate debris removal and water stagnation, underscoring the need for prompt cleanup and vector-control measures to mitigate dengue transmission and fire hazards in Bairro Feliz, Goiânia.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱と火災のリスク：放置された剪定枝がフェリス地区に危険をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: デング症例数や確定情報の記載がなく、単なる蚊の発生源となりうる環境リスクの指摘に留まり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は地域ニュースであり、症例数・重症度・流行状況の記載なし。ブラジル・ゴイアニア市の環境衛生問題としての報道。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A dan Covid-19 Sama-sama Serang Pernapasan, Ini Bedanya Kata Dokter
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A and COVID-19 Both Attack the Respiratory System; Here's How They Differ, According to a Doctor.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in Indonesia, with Ministry of Health surveillance through Sept 12, 2026 showing influenza share increasing to 38% in week 35 from 22% a week earlier. Of detected influenza, 33% are in children aged 0–4. Sentinel hospital data show influenza admissions at 26.3%, though overall influenza activity remains low and seasonal. In Surabaya, doctors report escalating influenza cases and crowded emergency departments and pediatric wards at RSHU Surabaya. Dr. Ivan Andre Hartono of RS Mayapada Surabaya stresses that influenza A is not a COVID-19 variant; the two viruses cause similar respiratory symptoms but are different pathogens. Influenza viruses mutate easily via antigenic shift and drift, necessitating annual vaccine updates. While COVID-19 can co-occur, influenza can also infect alongside SARS-CoV-2. High-risk groups include children under 5, adults 65+, and pregnant women. Local health authorities link increases to extreme weather changes, underscoring vaccination and vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAとCOVID-19はともに呼吸器を攻撃するが、医師によるとその違いはこうだ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで季節性インフルエンザAの割合が増加し小児科病棟が混雑しているが、全体活動は低く季節性の範囲内とされており、重症度や国際的拡大の情報は不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は主に医師によるインフルエンザAとCOVID-19の症状鑑別の解説であり、季節性インフルエンザの増加は極端な気象変化との関連が指摘されているが、深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事象とは位置づけられていない。続報でサーベイランスデータの推移を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: OMS vê Sinais Encorajadores no Combate ao Surto na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO Sees Encouraging Signs in the Fight Against the Outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization sees encouraging signs in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, but warns the epidemic is far from over. Transmission is decreasing in the most affected Ituri province, even as the outbreak has spread to a seventh province. As of 11 September, the DRC had recorded more than 7,000 confirmed Ebola cases, making it the second deadliest outbreak on record behind West Africa's 2014–2016 epidemic. The WHO cautions that strengthened surveillance may temporarily raise detected case counts as authorities boost detection capacity. Contact tracing has been intensified. More than 3,000 frontline health workers have been vaccinated with Merck's Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) against Zaire ebolavirus; its efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus—the strain causing the current outbreak—remains unknown. An observational vaccine-efficacy study among frontline workers will start soon, with an INRB-led clinical trial to follow, including other candidates from Moderna and University of Oxford.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOはコンゴ民主共和国での流行対策に明るい兆候を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,000人超の確定症例を記録する大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、7州に拡大、致死率も高く国際的懸念が大きいためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文中で流行発生国として言及されていないため除外。原因株はBundibugyoエボラウイルスで、既存ワクチン(Ervebo)の有効性が不明である点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 骨痛热症病例激增　罗白4社区同步大扫除防蚊 - 地方 - 花城大小事
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever cases surge as Luobai Fourth Community conducts synchronized mosquito-prevention cleanup.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases surge in Fuyong County as Luobai constituency conducts synchronized mosquito-prevention cleanup across four communities: Baile Garden, Diamond Garden, Gem Garden, and a 14-storey housing block on Jalan Doktor. Four teams of about 10 people each worked roughly one hour per area, clearing litter, debris, and clogged drains to eliminate standing water that serves as Aedes mosquito breeding grounds. The effort, led by the Luobai Members’ Service Center, was coordinated with the Fuyong Municipal Health Unit to address drainage issues observed in some locations. The official notes dengue risks are especially high for the elderly and children and plans to expand actions to commercial districts such as Huacheng Square and Millennium Square. Residents are urged to routinely check for standing water around homes every three days and participate in environmental sanitation to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱症例が急増、ロバイ第4地区が蚊対策の一斉清掃を実施
triage.triage_reason: 記事はマレーシア（Negeri Sembilan州）における通常のデング熱対策活動を報じたものであり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではない。異常性や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: Bluedotは発生地域をChinaとしているが、記事本文の地名（Luobai、Fuyong、Negeri Sembilan州の地方紙sembilan.sinchew.com.my）からマレーシアの地方コミュニティの蚊対策活動と判断される。中国での発生ではないため対象国リストに該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: 简易四针法联合无血清疫苗工艺：2026年狂犬病疫苗接种的优选方案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Simple four-needle method combined with serum-free vaccine technology: the preferred approach to rabies vaccination in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains fatal after symptoms and transmits through bites, scratches, or licking broken skin by dogs, cats, or bats. Post-exposure management follows a graded approach (I–III): I requires wound cleansing; II requires wound treatment and rabies vaccination; III requires wound care, vaccination, and passive immunization. The WHO and ACIP currently favor the simplified four-dose vaccine schedule over 5-dose or 2-1-1 regimens: doses on days 0, 3, 7, with a fourth dose on day 14–28, completing within 14 days. This regimen shows comparable immunogenicity, safety, and cost-effectiveness, and is endorsed by Chinese expert consensus (2019) and other global guidance. Vaccines are produced on Vero or human diploid cell substrates; serum-free processes are increasingly used to reduce contamination and allergy risk. A 2026 randomized Phase III trial (n=2000, ages 10–60) reported 100% seroconversion by day 14, 28, and 42, with >97% durability at 6 months and mostly mild adverse events.

triage.headline_ja: 簡易四回接種法と無血清ワクチン技術の組み合わせ：2026年狂犬病ワクチン接種の推奨アプローチ
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例ではなく、狂犬病ワクチン接種プロトコルに関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の国での感染事例やアウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、狂犬病ワクチン接種スケジュールに関する医学的解説（研究レビュー・臨床試験結果紹介）であるため、地域特定は不要。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola'nın Kontrolünde Umut Veren İşaretler
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Promising Signs in Ebola Control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows promising signs of control but remains far from over, according to the World Health Organization. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said on Sept. 16 that transmission is down in Ituri Province, the region most affected, yet the overall risk of spread persists, particularly in areas with high population movement. Maria Van Kerkhove, head of the WHO's Epidemic and Pandemic Alert and Response, noted that strengthened surveillance and intensified contact tracing may lead to identifying more cases. As of the outbreak's start, the DRC has recorded 7,022 cases and 3,398 deaths, with 1,671 recoveries. The statements underscore cautious optimism paired with ongoing vigilance and measures to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ制圧に有望な兆候
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WHOも継続的な警戒を呼びかけているためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長及びWHO緊急事態対応責任者の発言に基づく continuing outbreak。累計7,022症例、3,398死亡、致死率約48%と非常に高い。イトゥリ州での感染拡大が主だが人口移動による拡散リスクが継続。

article.articleHeadline: विदेश::फिजी में एचआईवी राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल घोषित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foreign: HIV national emergency declared in Fiji
article.articleSummary: Fiji has declared a national HIV emergency as infections surge, driven by unsafe sex and injection-drug use. The population is about 900,000, with 9,100 people living with HIV; only 39% know their status, 22% are on antiretroviral therapy, and 2% of pregnant women are HIV-positive. In 2025, new HIV infections rose to 2,016—roughly 16 times the 2019 level—and were up 27% from the previous year. Among HIV-exposed births, 18 of 59 babies died before their first birthday in 2025. Transmission is predominantly via sexual contact (over 50%) and injection drug use (over 42%). Fiji acts as a transit hub for drugs bound for Australia and New Zealand, with methamphetamine and cocaine fueling local markets post-COVID. The government is expanding free testing, prevention, and treatment, including rapid testing for high-risk groups and universal ART, with support from India, Australia, New Zealand, the Global Fund, and UN agencies.

triage.headline_ja: フィジー、HIV感染急増により国家非常事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: フィジーで新規HIV感染が2019年比16倍に急増し国家非常事態が宣言されるなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であり、国際支援も既に要請されている。
triage.notes: 本イベントはフィジーで発生しており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しないため verified_locations は空とした。インドは支援国として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Vệ sinh nhà cửa đúng cách để giảm lây truyền bệnh truyền nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proper home cleaning to reduce the spread of infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot and Mouth disease is rising in Vietnam amid broader global infectious-disease activity. Vietnam’s tropical monsoon climate and flood season heighten outbreak risk, with the 2026 plan emphasizing vaccination and robust environmental hygiene. To curb household transmission, clean frequently touched surfaces—door handles, light switches, faucets, tables, chairs, railings, and remotes—plus kitchen counters where foods contact raw meat or produce. Regular bathroom cleaning and thorough drying of damp areas prevent mold and bacteria. Bedding, pillows, blankets, carpets, curtains, and fabric furniture should be washed regularly (hot water when possible) or vacuumed for non-washables; HVAC filters and air ducts require periodic cleaning or replacement. Prefer damp cloths over dry brooms to reduce dust, maintain ventilation during cleaning, and dry hidden corners. After cleaning, wash hands and store cleaning products safely out of children’s reach.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症の伝播を減らすための正しい家庭清掃法
triage.triage_reason: 記事は家庭内衛生・清掃に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、疾患名タグ（口蹄疫）は誤りで実際は手足口病（HFMD）についての言及。具体的な症例数・重症度・国際的拡大等の情報がなく、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: Bluedotの疾患タグ「Foot And Mouth Disease（口蹄疫、動物疾患）」は誤り。記事本文は「Hand, Foot and Mouth disease（手足口病、ヒト疾患）」がベトナムで増加している背景を踏まえた家庭清掃・衛生管理のアドバイス記事であり、具体的な発生状況や規模のデータは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Lotta all'Ebola, l'Oms frena i facili entusiasmi: "Segnali incoraggianti, ma mancano le risorse"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight against Ebola, WHO dampens premature enthusiasm: "Encouraging signs, but resources are lacking"
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) shows encouraging signs but remains precarious, according to the World Health Organization. Transmission is waning in the eastern Ituri province, while South Kivu has reported no new cases since May; the north-east remains the main hotspot. A small cross-border cluster in Uganda was contained rapidly. Since May, confirmed cases have reached 7,258 with 3,510 deaths; more than 1,700 patients have recovered under advanced treatment protocols. The DRC government has unveiled a 180-day emergency plan requiring $1.3 billion, and WHO urges donors to fully fund both national response and humanitarian efforts. Despite optimism on field gains, WHO Director-General Tedros warned that high population mobility could rekindle transmission unless resources are secured. Planned clinical trials will test new prevention and treatment tools, contingent on sustained international funding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとの闘い、WHOが安易な楽観論に警鐘：「明るい兆しはあるが資源が不足」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中の大規模エボラ流行（確定7,258例、死亡3,510例）であり、ウガンダへの越境例も発生。国際的拡大リスクと資源不足によるリスク再燃の懸念がありIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、越境クラスターの発生国として関連情報として記録。WHOは資金不足により流行再燃のリスクを警告している。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS ve "señales alentadoras" en la lucha contra la epidemia de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO sees "encouraging signs" in the fight against the Ebola epidemic in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows encouraging signs but remains deadly. Since mid-May, DRC has declared its seventeenth Ebola outbreak, with more than 7,200 cases and over 3,500 deaths across seven provinces. Transmission is decreasing in Ituri, the epicenter, while South Kivu has had no new cases since May. Trials of treatments and post-exposure prophylaxis are accelerating thanks to greater community involvement, and vaccine trials should begin in the coming weeks. Yet health officials warn the outbreak continues to cause deaths and key indicators have not yet improved as hoped, demanding a sustained, intensified response for many months. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Maria Van Kerkhove stressed the long road ahead.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行対応に「励みとなる兆し」
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,200例以上・死亡3,500人超の第17次エボラ流行が進行中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的懸念があるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中エボラ流行（第17次）に関する継続報道。既存のRRA/モニタリング対象であれば重複確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tiongkok gunakan deteksi cerdas untuk peringatan dini penyakit menular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China Uses Smart Detection for Early Warning of Infectious Diseases.
article.articleSummary: AI-driven, multi-source surveillance in China flags infectious-disease risks for proactive response. In Tianjin, a hospital alert during a routine hepatitis B evaluation triggered a 30-second AI scan of the patient’s records, flagging diagnostic cues and prompting follow-up testing while preserving privacy. A second AI agent assessed risk and drafted epidemiologic reports. This shifts detection from largely passive diagnosis to proactive monitoring. In Shanghai’s Jing’an District, December 2025 identified a potential spatial cluster of three pneumonia patients with no known contact; investigations quickly ruled it out, final results within 24 hours. China has built eight surveillance systems under the 14th Five-Year Plan (2021–2025), backed by 40,000+ laboratories and 50,000+ medical institutions using intelligent software, reducing diagnosis-to-reporting time from 5.2 to 3.7 hours. The 15th Five-Year Plan (2030) seeks a modern, multi-channel framework capable of rapid large-scale outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、感染症の早期警戒にスマート検知技術を活用
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は中国のAIを活用したサーベイランス体制の紹介であり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は中国の疾病監視システム（AI技術）に関する紹介記事。天津での肝炎症例や上海での肺炎クラスターは、システムの機能例として言及されているのみで、いずれも調査の結果特に問題なしと確認されている。実際の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではないため対象国なしと判定。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Ajukan Pendanaan Tambahan untuk Tangani Ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Seeks Additional Funding to Tackle Ebola in Kongo
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged donors to fully fund the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) government’s Ebola response and broader humanitarian relief. Although transmission is falling in Ituri and South Kivu has reported no new cases since May, the outbreak is not over. Over 1,700 patients have recovered, and after four months the outbreak is largely controlled in northeastern DRC. A small Uganda outbreak occurred but was contained quickly. As of Sept 11, confirmed Ebola cases reached 7,258 with 3,510 deaths since the May start, with more than 7,000 cases across seven provinces, spreading to a seventh province. More than 3,000 frontline workers have received Merck’s Ervebo (Ebola Zaire vaccine); effectiveness against Bundibugyo virus remains unknown. An observational vaccine study is planned, and mid-to-late-stage trials are expected soon, led by INRB, evaluating Ervebo and Bundibugyo-targeting candidates from Moderna and Oxford.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴでのエボラ対応のため追加資金を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,258症例・3,510人死亡、7州に拡大し隣国ウガンダにも波及した大規模エボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも小規模流行が発生し封じ込められたと報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: First local chikungunya case this year in Tai Kok Tsui
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, Hong Kong reports its first locally acquired chikungunya fever case this year: a 55-year-old woman living on Li Tak Street, Tai Kok Tsui. She is stable in a mosquito‑free ward at Queen Elizabeth Hospital after chikungunya virus was lab‑confirmed by CHP's Public Health Laboratory Services Branch. Symptoms began 7 September with fever, headache and joint pain in the fingers and wrists, followed by a rash. She sought care on 16 September and was admitted that day. The incubation period (26 August–5 September) occurred mainly at home; she had not traveled abroad, indicating local transmission. Exposure likely near her residence, including Cherry Street Park and Lok Kwan Street Park. One household contact is asymptomatic; medical surveillance is in place. Hong Kong has three confirmed chikungunya cases in 2026 (1 local, 2 imported); last year saw 82 cases, 11 local. Public health measures emphasize eliminating breeding sites and personal protection.

triage.headline_ja: 香港・大角咀（タイコクツイ）で今年初の地元感染チクングニア熱症例
triage.triage_reason: 渡航歴のない地元感染チクングニア症例が確認され、蚊媒介による地域内継続感染リスクと衛生当局の監視強化が認められるため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討する。
triage.notes: 症例は軽症・安定しており大規模流行の兆候はないが、渡航歴なしの地元感染例であるため蚊媒介感染の継続的リスクとして注視が必要。米国オハイオ州は記事主題と無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 本港錄今年首宗本地基孔肯雅熱個案 55歲婦感染｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong records this year's first locally acquired Q fever case; a 55-year-old woman infected.
article.articleSummary: Q fever locally acquired case in Hong Kong: a 55-year-old woman from Lai Tak Street, Tai Kok Tsui, developed fever on Sept 7, 2026, with headache, joint pain, and later facial/body rash. She tested positive for Coxiella burnetii, with incubation from Aug 26 to Sept 5, and was admitted to Queen Elizabeth Hospital on Sept 16; her condition is stable. No travel history in the incubation period; exposure occurred near home, including Cherry Street Park and Lok Kwun Street Park areas, with a report of mosquito bites. One household contact has no symptoms. This year Hong Kong records three confirmed Q fever cases (one local, two imported); last year had 82 cases, with 11 local. Public health actions include contact tracing, environmental/medi­cal investigations, a hotline (2125 2373), a Tai Kok Tsui health station, and educational talks. Global context: WHO cites >500,000 cases globally last year; Guangdong reports 739 cases through Aug, including 496 in August.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で今年初の地元感染チクングニア熱症例、55歳女性が感染
triage.triage_reason: 香港での今年初の地元感染例であり異常性が認められ、蚊媒介感染症としての流行しやすさ・環境曝露継続の可能性があり、地元メディア・政府の関心も高いためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 見出し・記事内容はチクングニア熱(基孔肯雅熱)についてだが、BluedotのAPI疾患名は'Q Fever'およびCoxiella burnetii陽性と記載されており矛盾がある。データ入力または翻訳の誤りの可能性が高く、実際の病原体・疾患名の確認が必要。広東省での739例（8月まで）という文脈も踏まえ、地域的な蚊媒介感染症動向の注視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Naik, Puan imbau Warga Terapkan Prokes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases on the rise, Puan urges residents to adhere to health protocols.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases rise in Indonesia, though Health Ministry says national activity remains low and under control, with seasonal uptick. In Jakarta, DPR Speaker Puan Maharani urged clear government communication and renewed adherence to health protocols amid reports of crowded emergency departments due to Influenza A. In Bandung and Surabaya, social media complaints described children with high fever and full EDs, though official surveillance shows national influenza activity at a low level in week 34 (through September 5, 2026). Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin acknowledged increases but stated the situation is managed and seasonal. Puan called for strengthened health infrastructure and accessible protection measures, particularly in areas with higher spread, ensuring ED availability. No outbreak counts are provided; emphasis on trusted information and ongoing vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型患者増加、プアン氏が住民に健康プロトコル遵守を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの増加が報告されているが、公式には全国的な活動レベルは低く管理下にあるとされており、IHR基準の該当は乏しい。ただし救急外来混雑や社会的関心の高まりがあり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの増加報告だが、保健省は全国的には低水準・管理下と発表。地方（バンドン、スラバヤ）でのSNS上の懸念や救急外来混雑が報告されているが、公式統計による裏付けは限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Presidente Bernardes registra casos frequentes de raiva e orienta vacinação do rebanho
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Presidente Bernardes Records Frequent Cases of Rabies and Advises Vaccination of the Herd.
article.articleSummary: Frequent rabies cases in Presidente Bernardes, Brazil, have prompted local authorities to issue an alert to animal breeders to vaccinate the herd against the disease, a key preventive measure to curb spread. Rabies is a serious, fatal zoonosis that can affect animals and pose a risk to humans. The notice, signed by the Prefeitura de Presidente Bernardes, the Department of Agriculture, Supply and Environment of the municipality, and the Instituto Mineiro de Agropecuária (IMA), urges proactive vaccination regardless of on-property cases. Given the ongoing frequency of reports in the municipality, herd immunization is described as a barrier that protects families and rural properties in Presidente Bernardes, extending public health safeguards beyond livestock to the wider community.

triage.headline_ja: プレジデンテ・ベルナルデス市、狂犬病の頻発を記録し家畜のワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの一地方自治体における家畜狂犬病の予防的注意喚起であり、ヒトへの感染拡大や公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルの家畜向け狂犬病予防啓発記事。ヒト症例の報告はなく、通常の獣医公衆衛生活動の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: مؤشرات مشجعة على احتواء إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية لكن الوباء لم ينتهِ | وكالة النبأ الخبرية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Encouraging signs of Ebola containment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, but the outbreak is not over | Al-Naba News Agency
article.articleSummary: WHO notes encouraging signs of Ebola virus disease containment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, but the outbreak continues. As of 13 September, 7,258 confirmed cases and 3,510 deaths across seven provinces and 62 health zones, with more than 1,700 recoveries. Ituri remains the epicenter, though transmission there is decreasing, while cases persist in North Kivu and Haut-Uele, and Sud-Ubangi reports its first confirmed case, the seventh province affected. The outbreak is the largest in DRC's history and the second-largest globally by case count. Improved surveillance may reveal more cases as detection expands. Vaccination and post-exposure treatment trials are expected to begin in coming weeks, driven by community engagement. Challenges include population movement, displacement, and armed conflict that hinder monitoring, contact tracing, and cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の抑制に前向きな兆候、しかし流行は終息していない
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行（7,258例、3,510人死亡）が7州62衛生区に拡大し、武力紛争や住民移動により監視・接触者追跡が困難な状況が続いているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大かつ世界で2番目に大きいエボラ流行。新たにSud-Ubangi州で初の確認例が報告され、7州目の感染拡大地域となった。武力紛争・住民移動が監視・対応の障害となっており、ワクチン接種や暴露後治療の試験が今後数週間で開始予定。

article.articleHeadline: कानपुर में डेंगू पसार रहा पैर, गुरुवार को 7 लोग हुए शिकार; जिले के ये इलाके बने हॉटस्पॉट! - kanpur records 7 new dengue cases hotspots identified
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue spreading in Kanpur; seven people fell victim on Thursday; these areas in the district have become hotspots!
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is spreading in Kanpur district, India, with seven new cases reported on Thursday (17 September 2026). Patients include a 17-year-old girl from Sachendi; a 50-year-old woman from Govind Nagar; a 37-year-old man from Barra-3; a 17-year-old man from Yashoda Nagar; a 31-year-old man from Gumti; and a 7-year-old child from Gujaini. Rain-driven breeding around homes and rooftops yielded larvae, and teams inspecting affected sites destroyed large numbers of larvae. The district has already recorded 40 swine flu (H1N1) cases to date; all patients are under monitoring and treated in government hospitals, with daily updates for those in home isolation. Dengue symptoms include high fever, severe eye pain, and risk of platelet drop; warning signs prompting medical care include fever lasting over two days, breathing difficulty, extreme weakness, or bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: カンプールでデング熱が拡大、木曜日に7人が新規感染;これらの地域がホットスポットに
triage.triage_reason: インド国内の地方都市での季節性デング熱の局地的増加であり、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は乏しいが、H1N1症例の併発報告もあり継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: FDA's New Outbreak Summaries on Moringa, Raw Farm Cheese, Guatemalan Cantaloupe and Requesón: 138 Sick, a Supplier That Refused FDA, and a Lot of Black Ink

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gastrointestinal Infection, Tame Elephant at PLG Minas Riau Dies.
article.articleSummary: Diego, a 17-year-old male Sumatran elephant at PLG Minas in Siak Regency, Riau Province, Indonesia, died on 17 September 2026 from a suspected chronic gastrointestinal infection. Illness began 10 September with diarrhea and reduced appetite; initial diagnosis suggested parasitic infection after worms were found in feces, followed by antibiotics, anti-inflammatory therapy, and deworming. Fecal testing at PPS Yayasan Arsari Djodjohadikusumo lab in Pekanbaru later was negative for parasites. On 15–16 September, he again showed anorexia, diarrhea, weakness, and low fluid intake; IV fluids and supportive meds were given, with fecal samples collected for parasite tests. Diego collapsed on 16 September and died; necropsy pointed to chronic gastrointestinal tract infection, with organ samples sent for laboratory confirmation. Born 3 September 2009, he was a tame elephant raised at PLG Minas and served visitors.

article.articleSummary: Beijing HYROX race last week featured Australian athlete Joanna Wietrzyk who finished and won after defecating during the event, continuing to use the same equipment others had to use afterward. Health experts warned of biohazard potential due to fecal contamination; infectious disease specialist Professor Ramon Shaban of the Sydney Infectious Disease Institute said gastrointestinal infections such as norovirus spread via the fecal-oral route, so particles from feces can reach mouths and cause illness. He emphasized mass gatherings require both individual hygiene and event-level safeguards to minimize transmission. HYROX China said the affected area and track were isolated, with comprehensive disinfection and removal of equipment, and waste disposed per municipal standards. The company introduced a new 'faeces' rule: if a racer's blood, vomit, urine, or faeces poses welfare or contamination risk to themselves or others, they will be withdrawn on medical grounds. Symptoms like nausea, vomiting, and diarrhoea are possible outcomes; no illnesses were confirmed in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 健康専門家が明かす、『バイオハザード』懸念後のHYROXでの排便事案がどれほど危険か
triage.triage_reason: 単発のイベントでの排便事案に関する専門家コメント記事であり、実際の感染例や集団発生は確認されていない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はオーストラリア人選手が北京のHYROXレースで排便した事案に関する専門家コメント記事。感染症の実際の発生や症例確認はなく、疾病アウトブレイクとしての実態はない。中国・オーストラリアともに対象国リストに含まれるが、実際の感染症発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : à Beni, les mototaxistes sensibilisés à la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: In Beni, moto-taxi drivers sensitized to the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 17 September 2026, in Beni, Democratic Republic of the Congo, an Ebola treatment center opened its doors to moto-taxi drivers to bolster their knowledge of the disease and counter misinformation. The training covers the center's operations from patient admission to follow-up by medical teams, aiming to reduce mistrust of health facilities and workers. Given their daily proximity to communities, moto-taxi drivers can identify symptomatic individuals and encourage prompt care at health establishments. Ebola survivor and driver Josias Tengé-Tengé urges colleagues to protect themselves and guide ill passengers to medical centers. The initiative follows a climate of fear and misinformation, with health workers, burial teams, and treatment centers having previously been targeted. Health authorities rely on local actors to build trust, improve patient uptake, and strengthen Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:ベニで、バイクタクシー運転手がエボラ対策について啓発を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 既存のエボラ治療センターでの地域啓発活動に関する記事であり、新規症例数や感染拡大等の具体的な疫学情報は含まれていないため、フルRRAに進むには情報不足。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ治療センターでのコミュニティ啓発活動（バイクタクシー運転手への研修）を報じるもので、新規症例や死亡者数など具体的な疫学データは含まれていない。既存のエボラ流行への対応活動の一環と見られ、続報での新規感染状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Boa Esperança homologa compra de R$ 44,2 mil em brindes contra Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boa Esperança City Hall approves purchase of R$ 44.2 thousand in giveaways against Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: Boa Esperança's Municipal Health Fund in Espírito Santo approved 44,282.75 reais to purchase customized promotional items for educational actions against Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Formalized via Electronic Bidding Notice No. 5/2026 (FMS) and published in the Official Diary of the Union on September 15, 2026, the procurement aims to engage residents in campaigns and prevention mutirões by distributing items branded with the municipality and educational messages. Four suppliers were awarded contracts: Airam Brindes e Presentes Ltda (R$16,900); Nova Vida Solucoes e Comercio de Utilidades Ltda (R$11,483.75); Distribuidora M H Ltda (R$8,450); Velha Grafica Ltda (R$7,449). The funds come from the municipal health budget. Messages emphasize eliminating standing water and empower field teams of the Secretaria Municipal de Saúde, aligning with Ministry of Health surveillance guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: ボア・エスペランサ市庁、ネッタイシマカ対策の啓発グッズ購入(4万4200レアル)を承認
triage.triage_reason: 行政の予防啓発グッズ調達に関する行政手続き記事であり、感染症の発生や症例報告を伴わないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱等の症例発生を報じるものではなく、蚊対策グッズ調達の行政手続きに関する内容のため対象国の実際の発生事例とはみなさない。

article.articleHeadline: وزارت بهداشت: تامین واکسن آنفلوآنزا قطعی نیست؛ کرونا از مرز هشداربالا گذشت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: The supply of the influenza vaccine is not guaranteed; COVID-19 has crossed the high-alert threshold.
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccine supply in Iran is not guaranteed as import efforts for European vaccines Influvac and Vaxigrip remain unsettled, while domestic influenza production has halted ahead of autumn amid rising respiratory infections. MOH spokesperson Hossein Kermanpour noted that orders placed in Bahman 1404 have yet to secure deliveries, with details on quantities, arrival times, or contract outcomes still unclear. Import barriers include currency transfer limits, transportation difficulties, and banking sanctions; authorities attribute shortages to higher foreign prices and wartime conditions. The FDA had earlier announced efforts to obtain about one million doses from China and Russia, with some doses slated for high-risk groups from late September or early October. Domestic production cessation followed poor uptake and stock depletion. Influenza B accounted for 66.6% of positives, with children comprising 36.8% of cases. Bushehr exceeded the high alert threshold (11.9%), while Khuzestan and Kerman were above the low alert threshold. COVID-19 positives rose to 11.7% in the week ending 20 Shahrivar.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省:インフルエンザワクチンの供給は確定していない;COVID-19は警戒閾値を超えた
triage.triage_reason: イラン国内における季節性インフルエンザ・COVID-19の流行状況とワクチン供給問題に関する記事であり、対象国（GeoNames ID指定国）はいずれも発生地として該当しないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はイランにおける季節性インフルエンザ・COVID-19の流行とワクチン輸入問題を扱っており、中国・ロシアはワクチン調達先として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。対象国リストに該当する発生国がないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Les Fidji déclarent une crise nationale du VIH après une flambée des cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiji declares a national HIV crisis after a surge in cases.
article.articleSummary: Fiji declares a national HIV emergency as infections surge. About 1 in 60 adults are HIV-positive, up from roughly 1 in 167 five years earlier. New diagnoses reached 2,016 in 2025, a 16-fold rise since 2019. Among transmissions with known mode, over 50% are sexual and 42% involve injection drug use; a high-risk injector group linked to sex workers drives spread. Two out of 100 pregnant women are HIV-positive; 59 HIV-exposed babies were born in 2025, with 18 dying before age one. The government will expand free HIV testing, prevention, and treatment, including rapid tests, PrEP for high-risk groups, harm reduction for people who inject drugs, and free ART. Fiji also seeks support from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the UN, and plans a needle-syringe program.

triage.headline_ja: フィジー、HIV症例急増を受けて国家的危機を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常・予想外」の2基準に該当し、国家的HIV緊急事態宣言という社会的関心の高い事案であるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてFiji、Australia、New Zealand、Indiaが挙げられているが、記事の主題はフィジー国内のHIV危機であり、インド等は支援要請先として言及されているのみで実際の発生地ではないため、対象国リストに該当する国はなし（verified_locationsは空配列）。

article.articleHeadline: Khoảng trống miễn dịch khiến thanh thiếu niên dễ mắc não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An immunity gap makes teenagers more susceptible to meningococcal disease.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease due to Neisseria meningitidis poses a growing risk for teenagers in Vietnam, with rapid progression to meningitis and/or septicemia and mortality up to 50% if untreated. Serogroups A, B, C, X, Y and W are the major threats, with 53 nationwide cases reported as of July 30, 2026; Ho Chi Minh City accounts for 20 cases (37.7%). Southern Vietnam in 2025 saw cases belonging to serogroup B. The disease predominates in children under 5 and youths aged 15–24; about 25–32% of teens and young adults may carry N. meningitidis in the nasopharynx, enabling transmission and potential invasive disease. Teen vaccination adherence is waning, creating an immunity gap. The report advocates life‑course vaccination amid Vietnam’s aging population, where nearly two‑thirds of those over 60 have at least one chronic condition, increasing risks from infections such as RSV, herpes zoster, influenza, and pneumococcus. It also notes advances in non‑infectious disease care, including biologics for severe asthma, underscoring an integrated, tailored, life‑course approach to prevention and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 免疫のギャップが青少年を髄膜炎菌感染症にかかりやすくする
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで髄膜炎菌感染症の症例が報告され重症化リスクがあるが、急性のアウトブレイクではなくワクチン接種率低下による免疫ギャップへの注意喚起記事であり、社会的関心の高まりも不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はホーチミン市を含む全国で2026年7月30日時点53例（うちホーチミン20例）の髄膜炎菌感染症を報告し、10代・若年層のワクチン接種率低下による免疫ギャップとライフコースワクチン接種の重要性を論じる啓発的内容。急性の大規模流行や国際的拡大の兆候は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Febre maculosa já matou 14 pessoas em MG em 2026; três mortes foram registradas em Jeceaba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rocky Mountain spotted fever has already killed 14 people in Minas Gerais in 2026; three deaths were recorded in Jeceaba.
article.articleSummary: Rocky Mountain spotted fever (febre maculosa) has caused 14 deaths in Minas Gerais in 2026, with 39 confirmed cases as of September 16. In Jeceaba, a Central-Minas town 113 km from Belo Horizonte, three people were diagnosed and died. Early antibiotic treatment is essential and available through the SUS, with ongoing surveillance and prevention actions across the state. Historical data show 2023: 20 deaths among 90 cases; 2024: 95 diagnoses and four deaths; 2025: 48 cases and seven deaths. The disease is transmitted by the star tick, with higher risk in areas with horses, capybaras, and dogs—pastures, parks, reserves, and river/lake margins. Preventive measures include repellents, long clothing, periodic body checks, prompt tick removal with tweezers, and veterinary-guided acaricide use on animals; workers should use PPE. Early treatment prevents complications; SES-MG monitors suspected cases daily and coordinates alerts and environmental surveillance with Funed and local health secretariats.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州で2026年にロッキー山紅斑熱により14人死亡、うちジェセアバでは3人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: ダニ媒介性の紅斑熱で死亡者が発生しているが、例年発生している既知の風土病であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは認められないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ロッキー山紅斑熱（febre maculosa）はダニ媒介性で、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。ミナスジェライス州では毎年一定数の症例・死亡が報告される風土病であり、州保健当局（SES-MG）が日常的に監視・対応している。2023〜2026年の死亡者数の推移からも突発的異常事象とは言えず、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは評価されない。

article.articleHeadline: 开学季提醒！收好这份校园防流感指南
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back-to-school season reminder! Keep this campus flu prevention guide handy.
article.articleSummary: Influenza is an acute respiratory infection caused by influenza viruses. Incubation 1–7 days (mostly 2–4). Symptoms include sudden high fever, headache, muscle aches, fatigue, sore throat, and cough; vomiting/diarrhea can occur in children. Most infections are mild, but pneumonia or myocarditis can occur and may be life-threatening. Transmission is mainly via droplets from coughing or sneezing and contaminated surfaces. Distinguish flu from cold; seek prompt medical evaluation for sudden fever and body aches. Prevention centers on vaccination—the most cost-effective and protective measure. Best to vaccinate in Sep–Nov before flu season. Jiujiang First People’s Hospital offers the trivalent inactivated influenza vaccine, affordable, with protection 2–4 weeks after vaccination; suitable for all ages 6 months and older. Schools should monitor illness, isolate confirmed cases, and enforce return-to-school rules (fever-free and symptoms resolved for 48 hours or seven days since onset). Family tips: vaccinate, ventilate homes, wash hands, seek care when needed.

triage.headline_ja: 開学シーズンの注意喚起！この学校向けインフルエンザ予防ガイドを保存しておこう
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、異常な流行や重篤な集団発生の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種と学校での予防策を促す一般的な啓発コンテンツであり、特定の異常な発生を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Predicting dengue incidence in China using SARIMA and hybrid neural network models: insights for public health planning
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains a persistent public health challenge in tropical and subtropical regions of China; the study analyzes dengue incidence in mainland China using forecasting models from 2004–2024. Monthly case data from the Chinese CDC; annual average incidence 0.486 per 1,000,000, ranging 0.031–34.161 per 1,000,000. Six models evaluated: SARIMA, Prophet, XGBoost, LSTM, and two hybrids: SARIMA-BPNN and SARIMA-ERNN. Model performance via MAE, RMSE, cMAPE, and R; all six captured general temporal trends; hybrids better reflected seasonal fluctuations and autocorrelation. SARIMA-BPNN yielded the highest predictive accuracy, especially for peak incidences and abrupt temporal changes. Implications: hybrid SARIMA-neural network models can provide reliable dengue simulations for early warning and resource allocation in high-risk, resource-limited areas in China, informing public health planning. Generalization to other settings should be cautious.

triage.headline_ja: SARIMAおよびハイブリッドニューラルネットワークモデルを用いた中国におけるデング熱発生数の予測：公衆衛生計画への洞察
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去（2004-2024年）のデータを用いた予測モデルの学術研究であり、新規の感染症発生や異常事態を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は疫学的予測モデルに関する学術論文であり、特定の発生イベントを報じるものではないため、地域発生の検証対象外としてverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisa revela que moléculas contra o câncer têm potencial para combater a malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Research Reveals That Cancer-Fighting Molecules Have the Potential to Combat Malaria.
article.articleSummary: Researchers at the University of São Paulo’s Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences report that cancer-fighting molecules show strong activity against Plasmodium falciparum, the main malaria parasite. In vitro tests identified 14 derivatives derived from anti-neoplastic drugs that killed the parasite in two essential life-cycle stages: the asexual blood stage and gametocytes, suggesting potential to cure infections and interrupt transmission to mosquitoes. This offers a rapid, accessible repurposing route amid rising resistance to chloroquine and artemisinin. However, safety remains a concern, as cancer therapies commonly cause nausea, fatigue, and blood abnormalities; scientists are exploring chemical modifications to increase parasite selectivity and reduce human toxicity. Next steps include in vivo studies and assessing efficacy against Plasmodium vivax, a tropical Brazil parasite prevalent in the region. As of 17 September 2026, researchers emphasize continuing evaluation for safety and effectiveness in living systems.

triage.headline_ja: がん治療分子がマラリア対策に有望であることが研究で判明
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、抗がん剤分子の抗マラリア活性に関する基礎研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究成果報告であり、実際のマラリア発生・流行事例ではないため対象国の発生地域として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Angola: Des mesures de santé contre la variole et le choléra sont renforcées à Lunda-Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angola: Health measures against smallpox and cholera are strengthened in Lunda-Norte.
article.articleSummary: Border health measures in Lunda-Norte province, Angola, are intensified to contain cholera and smallpox (variole) along the Angola–DRC frontier. Provincial health director Augusto Miguel announced urgent steps including reinforced epidemiological surveillance at all border posts with the Democratic Republic of Congo, deployment of multi-disciplinary teams equipped with screening tools, medicines, and technical resources, and safeguards to prevent entry of symptomatic individuals. The communication chain for suspected cases is maintained, and the outbreak response protocol has been disseminated to hospitals, particularly in neighboring municipalities, to ensure rapid detection and response. As of now, Lunda-Norte has no reported cholera or smallpox cases. In the country, Angola has recorded 442 confirmed smallpox (variole) cases and two deaths across 11 of its 21 provinces.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラ：ルンダ・ノルテ州で天然痘とコレラに対する衛生対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: アンゴラ国内で天然痘(variole)442例・死亡2例が11州に拡大しており、DRCとの国境地帯で予防的な検疫強化が行われている。天然痘の再出現自体が異常事態であり、公衆衛生上重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 疾患名は'Smallpox（天然痘）'とされているが、天然痘は1980年に根絶済みであり、アフリカの文脈では'variole'がMpox（サル痘）を指す誤分類・誤訳の可能性が高い。実際の感染発生国はアンゴラであり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。DRCは国境対策の対象として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での症例発生は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Usutu in Italia, un altro virus trasmesso dalle zanzare: i sintomi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Usutu in Italy, another mosquito-borne virus: the symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Usutu virus, a mosquito-borne flavivirus transmitted by Culex (the same vector as West Nile), has caused 12 human infections in Italy as of September 9, 2026, with Lombardy reporting 7 cases and Emilia Romagna, Marche, Lazio, Piedmont, and Veneto each reporting 1 case. Infections are of avian origin and extremely rare in humans; symptoms are typically flu-like, while severe disease can include meningitis. Italy is contending with Dengue and West Nile as well, and Usutu is a newly noted arboviral presence. A dead seagull on a Rapallo beach tested positive for Usutu, prompting commentary from infectious-disease expert Matteo Bassetti and Rapallo mayor Elisabetta Ricci. The virus is named after a Swaziland river, near Natal, where the first isolation occurred in a Culex mosquito; like West Nile, it is a flavivirus affecting birds with potential human spillover.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアでウストゥウイルス発生、蚊が媒介する別のウイルス:症状について
triage.triage_reason: イタリアでのウストゥウイルス感染事例であり、対象国リストに含まれない国での発生であるため、対象国に関するトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: El número de muertos por el brote de ébola en RDC roza los 3.600, con más de 7.400 casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the DRC nears 3,600, with more than 7,400 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: DRC's eastern Ebola outbreak totals 7,404 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,577 deaths, with 59 new cases and 32 deaths reported in the last 24 hours. There are 1,776 recovered patients and 930 currently hospitalized or in isolation. Case fatality rate stands at 48.3%; contact tracing is 87.4% complete. The Ituri province remains the epicenter, accounting for about 77.7% of cases, with additional transmission in North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Ubangi-Sud. This outbreak is the deadliest in DRC history and could surpass Africa’s 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which recorded 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths (per WHO). DRC, which ended a Kasai outbreak in December 2025, remains one of the most experienced Ebola responders. Ebola virus disease was first identified in 1976 in Yambuku, near the Ebola River.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ流行による死者数が約3,600人に迫り、確認症例は7,400人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、致死率48.3%と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際的拡大リスクや外部支援の必要性も高いためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 史上最悪のDRCエボラ流行で、2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性が指摘されている。フルリスク評価が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Electronic tongue detects avian influenza in six minutes
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers demonstrated an electronic tongue capable of detecting antibodies against H5N1 avian influenza in about six minutes with 98.6% accuracy. The device uses four sensors coated with zein (corn), jacalin and concanavalin A (jackfruit/jack beans), and sericin-modified gold nanoparticles to produce an electrical fingerprint as antibodies interact with sensor surfaces, with a machine-learning model classifying results. While aimed at rapid screening and potential surveillance across regions and species, the approach detects antibodies rather than the virus itself and remains lab-validation; real-world deployment will require clinical testing, sensor wear recalibration, and scalable, low-cost manufacturing. AI could help infer responses for new sensors, enabling adaptation to other viral targets. Rooted in Brazil, with testing context in a lab setting; not yet a routine diagnostic tool.

triage.headline_ja: 電子舌が6分で鳥インフルエンザを検出
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、抗体検出技術の研究開発に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルの研究機関によるH5N1抗体検出用センサー技術（電子舌）の開発に関する科学ニュースであり、実際の感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: La riposte contre Ebola à la frontière de Kasindi perturbe les
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola response at the Kasindi border disrupts them.
article.articleSummary: Kasindi border closure at Beni, North Kivu, due to the Ebola virus disease response disrupts cross-border trade with Uganda. Traders can no longer travel to Uganda, driving procurement costs up and delaying shipments from about one week to three months. Merchants report reduced revenues as shipments stall and money transfers become costlier due to Ebola controls. Consumers face higher prices for essentials, with examples such as a carton of mayonnaise rising from $68 to $73 in Kampala. The economic squeeze worsens household living costs and erodes purchasing power. Families say normal market flows and price stability depend on ending the Ebola outbreak and fully reopening supply chains across the Kasindi–Beni–Uganda corridor.

triage.headline_ja: カシンディ国境でのエボラ対応が貿易を混乱させる
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で進行中のエボラアウトブレイクに対する対応措置（国境閉鎖）がウガンダとの越境貿易に深刻な経済的影響を及ぼしており、IHR基準（深刻性・国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRC北キブ州（ベニ、カシンディ）で進行中のエボラアウトブレイク対応が国境貿易に及ぼす経済的影響を報じたもの。ウガンダ（カンパラ）は貿易相手国として登場するが、エボラ発生国ではなく対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。既存のエボラアウトブレイクの続報である可能性が高く、初発かどうかは記事から不明。

article.articleHeadline: Zone de santé de Lubero : sur une dizaine de cas d'Ebola confirmés, 11 décès enregistrés à Munyakondomi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lubero Health Zone: About a Dozen Confirmed Ebola Cases, 11 Deaths Recorded in Munyakondomi
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu’s Lubero Health Zone, with Munyakondomi Health Area as the epicenter. As of the latest update, 16 confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded in Munyakondomi, including 11 deaths; four patients have abandoned care, and one active case is under treatment in a health facility. A Lubero meeting on September 15 with health officials and community leaders identified delays in seeking care as a key challenge, limiting survival and driving transmission. Community resistance and refusals to treatment were noted, with patients leaving facilities before completing therapy. Dr. Charles Kaviri, the zone’s medical chief, urged rapid care for suspected cases and stronger community sensitization on prevention and control. Despite government, WHO, and ALIMA support, authorities request increased resources for surveillance, patient management, and community outreach in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: ルベロ保健地区:ムニャコンドミで約10例のエボラ確定症例、死亡11人を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例と高い死亡率（11/16）が確認されており、治療拒否・遅延受診によるヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが存在するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率が非常に高く（約69%）、患者の治療離脱やコミュニティの抵抗が感染拡大要因となっている。WHO・ALIMAが支援中だが追加リソースが要請されている。

article.articleHeadline: हरियाणा में लंपी वायरस का कहर, अब तक 70 गायों की मौत; 7577 गोवंश संक्रमित - lumpi virus wreaks havoc in haryana 70 cows dead so far 7577 cattle infected
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lumpy skin disease virus wreaks havoc in Haryana; 70 cows dead so far; 7,577 cattle infected.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, Haryana reports a rapid Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) outbreak in cattle, with 7,577 infections and 70 deaths. Kurukshetra samples confirmed LSD, with laboratory confirmation by Lala Lajpat Rai Veterinary University, Hisar. Of the affected animals, 6,135 cows in towns and villages and 1,442 cattle in dairy sheds are ill. A 2022 LSD outbreak in the state caused 2,937 deaths (2,929 cattle, 8 buffalo). To curb spread, the government barred inter-state animal movement and cattle fairs. An advisory mandates 15-day quarantine before mixing new stock, immediate isolation of ill animals, and reinforced biosecurity (nets, insecticide spray, fogging). Entry points for dairies should be disinfected with sodium hypochlorite or formalin, and carcasses buried in deep pits. District offices must upload daily data to a central portal by 4 PM.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州でランピースキン病が猛威、これまでに牛70頭死亡、7577頭感染
triage.triage_reason: ランピースキン病は牛のウイルス性疾患であり人には感染しないため公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低いが、感染拡大の速さや州内での移動制限措置がとられている点から経過観察が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病（LSD）は牛に感染するウイルス性疾患であり、ヒトへの感染性はない。州内での家畜移動制限や検疫措置が取られているが、国際的な拡大や貿易制限の兆候は記事内に記載なし。過去（2022年）にも同州で大規模な発生歴があり、再燃の可能性として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: हरियाणा में लंपी का बढ़ा प्रकोप: अब तक 7,577 गायें संक्रमित, 70 की मौत, बॉर्डर पर पशुओं की आवाजाही और पशु मेलों पर रोक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising outbreak of Lumpy Skin Disease in Haryana: to date 7,577 cows infected, 70 dead; movement of animals at the border and a ban on animal fairs.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) outbreak in Haryana has intensified, with 7,577 cows infected and 70 deaths reported as of 17 September 2026. Kurukshetra samples were confirmed LSD by Lalaji Lajpat Rai Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (LUVAS), Hisar. The animal husbandry department issued statewide alerts, barring inter-state animal movement and animal fairs to prevent further spread. A 15-day quarantine is mandatory before introducing new animals to a herd; symptomatic animals should be isolated promptly.
