Preventive measures include mosquito netting in sheds, insecticide spraying and fogging, and footbaths at gaushala and dairy entries. Dead animals must be buried in deep pits. Daily 4 pm LSD reporting to a provincial portal is mandated, with subsequent state-wide reviews. In 2022 Haryana also faced a large LSD impact, with 2,937 animal deaths (2,929 cows, 8 buffalo).

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤーナ州でランピースキン病の発生拡大：これまでに7,577頭の牛が感染、70頭死亡、国境での家畜移動および家畜市場を禁止
triage.triage_reason: Lumpy Skin Diseaseは牛のウイルス性疾患でヒトに感染しない動物疾患であり、公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威とはならない。2022年にも同規模の発生歴があり異常性も低い。
triage.notes: Lumpy Skin Diseaseは人獣共通感染症ではなく、牛など反芻動物のみに感染するウイルス性疾患。家畜経済・農業への影響はあるが、ヒトの公衆衛生リスクは想定されない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases top 7,400 as transmission shifts
article.articleSummary: Dr Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 7,404 confirmed cases and 3,577 deaths (case fatality 48.3%), with 1,776 recoveries, across 62 health zones in seven provinces. Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for 77.7% of cases, while transmission is shifting to North Kivu, where 373 patients are hospitalized and bed occupancy is 94.7%. The government reports Ituri has passed a peak and entered a downward slope, but North Kivu's epidemic curve continues to rise and has not plateaued, making it another major hotspot. WHO Director-General Tedros acknowledged early signs of improvement in some worst-affected areas, yet warned that the epidemic is expanding and killing more people; weekly North Kivu cases nearly doubled over two weeks (from ~100 to >200). This outbreak is the largest and deadliest Ebola epidemic in DRC history and second-largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例数が7,400件を超え、感染の中心が移動
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC史上最大規模の流行となっており、致死率48.3%と極めて深刻で、感染地域が拡大中であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長も懸念を表明しており、DRC史上最大かつ2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ世界第2位の規模のエボラ流行。北キブ州で感染拡大中で病床占有率94.7%と医療逼迫の兆候あり。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : une école de Kisangani appelée au respect des mesures barrières contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: a Kisangani school urged to respect barrier measures against Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola prevention measures urged in Kisangani, Tshopo, DRC, as authorities visited Lycée Anuarite to reinforce barrier measures. Provincial Education Minister David Bolunda Lotumbe called on school principals and students to strictly adhere to preventive practices to curb the spread of Ebola in the province and its schools. In the coming days, the provincial government under Governor Paulin Lendongolia will distribute thermoflashes and hydroalcoholic gels across Kisangani and its outskirts. The initiative aims to bolster infection prevention in educational facilities amid ongoing efforts to control Ebola. The minister's itinerant school visits began shortly after the new school year to assess conditions and ensure smooth teaching. No specific cases are cited; focus remains on prevention and readiness in schools.

triage.headline_ja: トショポ州:キサンガニの学校がエボラ対策の予防措置遵守を呼びかけられる - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCトショポ州で継続的な対策活動が行われていることから、実際の流行状況を確認するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事自体は学校での予防措置遵守の呼びかけであり具体的な新規症例は報告されていないが、州内でエボラ対策が継続中であることが示唆されており、現地の流行状況確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie sous contrôle mais la surveillance renforcée jusqu'au cas zéro (Professeur Jean-Jacques Muyembe) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the outbreak is under control but intensified surveillance up to patient zero (Professor Jean-Jacques Muyembe) - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 17 September 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains under control with a downward trend in several provinces, but surveillance must be intensified until case zero is reached. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, director-general of the National Institute of Biomedical Research (INRB) and outbreak response coordinator, said the epidemic is being managed but not finished, calling for doubled contact-tracing efforts. Epidemiological data should be analyzed province by province; progression differs: Ituri shows a downward curve, while North Kivu remains rising. Cumulative case counts alone do not reflect true trends, as recoveries and deaths alter the picture; after accounting for these, the overall trajectory is downward. He stressed that control does not equal eradication and urged a strengthened village-based surveillance via community relays to ensure rigorous household contact follow-up. Sustained funding is needed until the last case is identified and treated to declare the outbreak ended.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：流行は制御下にあるが、患者ゼロまで監視強化が必要（ジャン=ジャック・ムイエンベ教授）
triage.triage_reason: 既知のエボラ流行の継続報道だが、依然として活動的な感染連鎖があり、WPRO基準（重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に複数該当し、資金支援の必要性など社会的関心も高いため、状況を注視しつつフルRRA相当の確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のエボラ流行（北キブ州・イツリ州）の進捗報告であり、新規発生ではないが、地域差（イツリは減少、北キブは増加）や資金継続の必要性が指摘されており、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le respect des mesures barrières dans les écoles kimbanguistes saluées à Kisangani - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: adherence to barrier measures in Kimbanguist schools praised in Kisangani - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, in Kisangani, Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola prevention measures in Kimbanguist schools in Tshopo were praised after visits by Rev. Clément Kasongo, provincial coordinator. Schools have handwashing stations at classroom entrances and enforce use. He noted the absence of essential Ebola prevention and response kits in the schools, urging health authorities to accelerate delivery to bolster surveillance and rapid entry screening—ideally thermoflash devices to detect a case at the gate. He called for intensified sensitization of pupils and staff during morning gatherings and for health services to participate in school campaigns. School managers should self-fund handwashing upgrades and hydroalcoholic gel, ensuring hand hygiene after restroom use and before class. Ebola is transmitted via contact with blood or body fluids; prevention centers on handwashing, temperature checks, and community awareness in crowded settings like schools.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：キサンガニのキンバングイスト系学校におけるバリア対策の遵守が称賛される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 新規感染例やアウトブレイク拡大の報告ではなく、既存のエボラ予防対策（学校での手洗い設備等）の実施状況に関する広報的な記事であるため、直接のシグナルとは言えないが、DRCのエボラ関連動向として継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は新規感染例の報告ではなく、学校での予防対策遵守状況の視察・評価に関する内容。予防キット（手洗い設備、体温計等）の不足が指摘されており、地域でのエボラ対応が継続中であることを示唆するが、具体的な症例数や感染拡大状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : 28 cas confirmés d'Ebola enregistrés au 13 septembre dont 11 guéris (Rapport épidémiologique) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: 28 confirmed Ebola cases recorded as of September 13, including 11 recoveries (Epidemiological Report) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Tshopo province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, has 28 laboratory-confirmed cases as of 13 September 2026, with 12 deaths, 11 recoveries, and 5 active cases. Case fatality among confirmed cases is 43% (57% alive). Of the 28 cases, 19 are men (68%) and 9 are women (32%). There is one probable case; 691 contacts are under surveillance. Four health workers are among the cases. Geographical distribution: Makiso-Kisangani health zone accounts for 10 confirmed cases (5 deaths), Bafwasende 7 (3 deaths), Kabondo 4 (1 death), Mangobo 4 (2 deaths), and Tshopo, Wanie-Rukula, and Lubunga each have one confirmed case. Challenges include community resistance to investigations, sampling, isolation, and transfer to Ebola Treatment Centers, plus delays in sampling and transport. One confirmed patient who left the CTE without authorization is unaccounted at home. A Rapid Response Team is deployed in Bafwandambo to bolster surveillance as resurgence continues; ongoing active surveillance and contact tracing aim to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:9月13日時点でエボラ出血熱の確定患者28例、うち回復11例（疫学報告）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国チョポ州でエボラ出血熱の確定患者28例（死亡12例、致死率43%）が発生し、医療従事者への感染や無許可退院患者の行方不明など感染拡大リスクが高い状況であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 医療従事者4名の感染、無許可退院した確定患者の行方不明、地域社会の調査・検体採取・隔離への抵抗など、感染拡大の懸念材料が複数存在する。複数の保健区（Makiso-Kisangani、Bafwasende、Kabondo、Mangobo等）に拡散しており、迅速対応チームが展開されているが、再燃が継続中との記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola di Kongo: Catatan dan Protokol Perburuan Sumber Virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: Notes and Protocols for Tracing the Source of the Virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is linked to the Bundibugyo variant, with about 3,000 deaths and roughly 80% of cases from Ituri Province in the northeast. The earliest suspected case was a health worker in Mongbwalu who developed Ebola-like symptoms around April 24–25 and died in Bunia. On May 5, the WHO warned of an unknown high-fatality illness; Kinshasa announced the outbreak on May 15, the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak. Africa CDC criticized the slow response, noting a ~three-week gap between symptom onset in the index case and laboratory confirmation. Some evidence suggests the outbreak began earlier, with panic reported since March 30 and infections possibly linked to contaminated corpses and coffins in Mongbwalu and Bunia. A US CDC MMWR (June 11) modeling study points to spillover from animals to humans in mid-to-late February; WHO, on Aug 10, said genomic sequencing supports a February start.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：ウイルス源追跡の記録とプロトコル
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が発生し、約3,000人が死亡、検知の遅れがAfrica CDCから批判されるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: WHO・Africa CDC・US CDCが関与する大規模エボラ流行（DRC17回目のアウトブレイク）。検知遅延や感染源追跡（動物由来スピルオーバーの可能性）が焦点。すべての発生地点（Mangbwalu, Bunia, Kinshasa）はDRC国内。

article.articleHeadline: В Таиланде предупредили об угрозе опасной лихорадки из-за укусов клещей
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand warns of the threat of a dangerous fever from tick bites.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Disease Control warns of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) risk from tick bites. SFTS is a viral infection primarily transmitted by infected ticks; human-to-human spread via blood or body fluids is possible but rare. Symptoms appear 1–2 weeks post-exposure and include high fever, muscle and head pain, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea, with thrombocytopenia as a hallmark. Severe cases may involve abnormal bleeding, neurological symptoms, and multiorgan failure, posing life threats. Reservoirs include wild and domestic animals—dogs, cats, pigs, chickens, cows, sheep, and goats—within grassy habitats where ticks reside. Tick activity may continue through November, with expansion into new areas. In China, researchers identified Asian long-tailed tick nairovirus (ALTNV) detectable in more than 10% of patients seeking care after tick bites.

triage.headline_ja: タイでダニ媒介による危険な熱病（重症熱性血小板減少症候群）のリスクが警告される
triage.triage_reason: タイ政府がSFTSのリスクを公式に警告しており、中国では新種ウイルス（ALTNV）の検出も報告されているため、異常性・重症度の観点からフルリスク評価への移行が適切と判断。
triage.notes: タイ疾病対策局によるSFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症候群）に関する公式注意喚起。中国では新種のAsian long-tailed tick nairovirus（ALTNV）がダニ咬傷患者の10%以上から検出されたとの報告があり、新規病原体の可能性がある点に留意が必要。ヒト-ヒト感染は稀とされるが、詳細な感染者数・地域分布は不明。

article.articleHeadline: No Anthrax Detected in Livestock This Year - ZNBC
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-17, anthrax has not been detected in livestock in Zambia; there is no need to stop eating meat sold in butcheries. Wildlife anthrax cases have been reported, notably in the Luangwa and Zambezi ecosystems. Fisheries and Livestock Veterinary Services Director Charles Maseka said vaccination is active in at-risk livestock areas, with public awareness campaigns to discourage consuming meat from wildlife carcasses. Some 600,000 vaccine doses are available nationwide, including 20,000 doses sent to Muchinga Province to boost livestock vaccination and the safe disposal of wildlife carcasses. The update, delivered from Livingstone, underscores efforts to prevent spillover from wildlife to livestock while maintaining a safe meat supply and ongoing wildlife outbreak monitoring in the Luangwa and Zambezi regions.

triage.headline_ja: 今年は家畜に炭疽菌は検出されず - ZNBC
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物における炭疽の発生が継続しているが、家畜への感染はなく、当局が予防的ワクチン接種と監視を実施中であり、現時点で公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 野生動物（ルアングワ・ザンベジ生態系）での炭疽発生が継続中であり、家畜へのスピルオーバー防止のためワクチン接種・啓発活動が実施されている。家畜感染は未検出で、人への感染報告も本文中にはない。

article.articleHeadline: Forty-Seven Children Developed MRSA Skin Infections After a Neighborhood Party Near Dublin Featuring Three Bouncy Castles
article.articleSummary: 48 cases of community-associated MRSA skin infections linked to a Dublin suburb party involving three inflatables, with 47 attendees aged 5–16 developing skin infections and one non-attendee with close contact also infected. All sought medical care; four were hospitalized. Genetic analysis of 22 isolates showed a single strain, ST22-MRSA-IV, producing Panton-Valentine leukocidin, a toxin associated with more severe infections and previously noted in India, China, and Japan; sporadic in Ireland. Outbreak containment involved treatment, decolonizing household contacts, and instructing the inflatables supplier to not reuse equipment until adequately cleaned. Transmission could occur via infected individuals or contaminated equipment; a novel mechanism for an outbreak of this size noted by authors. Emphasizes CA-MRSA risk in close-contact, crowded settings; parents should monitor skin after play and maintain hygiene to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: ダブリン近郊で開催された近隣パーティーで、3台のバウンシーキャッスル（エア遊具）を介して47人の子供がMRSA皮膚感染症を発症
triage.triage_reason: 発生地はアイルランド（ダブリン）であり、対象国リストに含まれないため。インド・中国・日本への言及は過去の菌株報告例に過ぎず、実際の発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 発生地はアイルランド・ダブリン近郊であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。記事中のインド・中国・日本への言及はPVL産生ST22-MRSA-IV株の過去の検出例としての記述であり、今回の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: تحذير أممي من تفشي إيبالا وأزمة اليمن الصحية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN warns of an Ebola outbreak and Yemen's health crisis.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with more than 7,200 confirmed infections and over 3,500 deaths across seven provinces. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus notes some positive signs: decreasing transmission in Ituri and no new cases in South Kivu since May, with over 1,700 recoveries. Vaccine trials are expected in the coming weeks, and expansion of vaccine access is planned if efficacy is confirmed. North Kivu shows a rapid rise, with weekly cases exceeding 200. The outbreak compounds crises such as rising hunger, reduced healthcare-seeking behavior, and disrupted HIV treatment. In Yemen, about 20 million people need health assistance amid ongoing attacks on facilities, shortages of supplies and fuel, and impaired ambulance services. Ongoing risks include cholera, measles, polio, dengue, and malnutrition, especially among displaced populations in crowded settings; urgent international support is needed to protect health workers and ensure safe access.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラ出血熱の流行拡大とイエメンの健康危機に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7000人超の感染・3500人超の死亡を伴う大規模エボラ流行が継続し、北キブ州では週200例超と急増しており、国際的拡大・保健医療体制への深刻な影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: イエメンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事はDRCのエボラ流行が主題であり、北キブ州での急増が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Kepulauan Seribu vaksinasi seratusan kucing cegah penyebaran rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Thousand Islands vaccinate hundreds of cats to prevent the spread of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Across Pulau Kelapa and Pulau Kelapa Dua in Kepulauan Seribu Utara, Jakarta, the Thousand Islands district's Department of Food Security, Marine and Agriculture (KPKP) vaccinated and sterilized 111 cats to curb rabies transmission and manage the feline population. The operation involved 60 females and 51 males, providing both vaccination and sterilization. For feral cats, a Trap-Neuter-Return (TNR) approach was used before returning animals to their locations; owned pets could enroll after owner registration. The service was offered free of charge, with involvement from Let’s Adopt Indonesia and the support of Pulau Kelapa's village head. The effort aims to enhance animal health and welfare, reduce rabies risk, and complement ongoing rabies-prevention measures in the Thousand Islands area.

triage.headline_ja: プラウ・スリブ諸島、狂犬病の蔓延防止のため猫数百匹にワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: 動物へのワクチン接種・去勢による予防的措置であり、ヒトへの感染拡大や異常な公衆衛生事象を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 動物の狂犬病予防のためのルーティンなワクチン接種・去勢活動を報じたもので、ヒト感染事例や異常発生の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Kepulauan Seribu lakukan vaksinasi 111 ekor kucing cegah penyebaran rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Thousand Islands Regency Vaccinates 111 Cats to Prevent the Spread of Rabies.
article.articleSummary: On 17 September 2026, Kepulauan Seribu Regency's Department of Food Security, Oceans and Agriculture (KPKP) vaccinated and sterilized 111 cats on Pulau Kelapa and Pulau Kelapa Dua in Kepulauan Seribu Utara to curb rabies transmission and manage the local cat population. The 111 animals comprise 60 females and 51 males. The program uses Trap-Neuter-Return (TNR) for feral cats, sterilizing and vaccinating before returning them to their location; pet cats may receive services after owner registration. Services are free, with involvement from Let's Adopt Indonesia. Pulau Kelapa Village Head Muhammad Adriansyah supported the effort, noting benefits for animal health and community comfort. The initiative targets rabies prevention and improved welfare within the Thousand Islands.

triage.headline_ja: プラウ・スリブ諸島で狂犬病拡大防止のため猫111匹にワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: 動物への予防的ワクチン接種・不妊手術活動を報じる内容で、ヒトへの感染や異常な流行拡大を示す情報はなく、通常の予防的獣医活動である。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の発生報告ではなく、地域行政による猫への予防的ワクチン接種・不妊去勢プログラムの実施を報じるものである。

article.articleHeadline: Coopération Suisse-RDC : engagement pour lutter contre Ebola à travers le projet " Nanobola 26 " - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swiss-DRC Cooperation: Commitment to Combat Ebola Through the "Nanobola 26" Project - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains the focus as the Nanobola 26 project in Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, led by CRMD Bunia and funded by the Swiss Development Cooperation (DDC). The nine-month, two-phase initiative deploys Nano Aid, a system that electrochemically produces sodium hypochlorite from water and salt for disinfection, handwashing, and drinking-water treatment in ten Bunia-area health facilities. Production costs fall from about $2.50 to under $0.05 per liter, reducing plastic waste. The project strengthens infection prevention and potable water access at health centers and trains local operators for sustainability, with expansion planned to other Ituri areas and North Kivu. It builds on Sankuru’s Project Minga, which cut waterborne diseases by up to 75% in three months. Partners include CSN, Université de Kinshasa, University of Geneva, and Antenna Technology Association (Geneva).

triage.headline_ja: スイス・DRC協力:「Nanobola 26」プロジェクトを通じたエボラ対策への取り組み
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラ流行そのものの発生報告ではなく、既存の感染予防・水衛生インフラ支援プロジェクトの紹介であり、新規感染事例や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はイトゥリ州における感染予防・給水インフラ整備の開発協力プロジェクト（Nanobola 26）に関する内容であり、新規エボラ症例や流行状況の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Deadly Falciparum Malaria Cases Jump From 375 to 2,382 in Mumbai
article.articleSummary: Mumbai's Plasmodium falciparum malaria cases climbed from 375 in 2015 to 2,382 in 2025, a 535.2% rise, with the share of falciparum infections increasing from 5.5% to 25.3% of all malaria cases. Officials attribute part of the rise to expanded testing, though testing grew 32.3% from 1,428,265 to 1,889,012 in the same period, leaving questions about ulterior factors. The increase is noted in the post-Covid period and is linked to labour migration from eastern India and Chhattisgarh; Mumbai’s environment and Anopheles mosquitoes sustain transmission. Plasmodium falciparum is the most dangerous malaria parasite, causing rapid progression and potential cerebral malaria. Early symptoms include fever, chills, headache, body aches, nausea and dark urine. Diagnosis uses blood-smear microscopy or rapid tests; treatment for uncomplicated cases is artemisinin-based combination therapy, while severe malaria requires urgent intravenous antimalarials. Prompt evaluation is advised for persistent fever.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイで悪性(熱帯熱)マラリア症例が375件から2,382件に急増
triage.triage_reason: 10年間の熱帯熱マラリア症例増加という統計的トレンド報告であり、急性の国際的公衆衛生上の脅威ではないが、検査拡大以外の要因も示唆されており今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はムンバイにおける熱帯熱マラリア症例の10年間の増加傾向を報じる統計的記事であり、単発の急性アウトブレイクではない。国内の労働移住や検査拡大が要因として挙げられているが、原因不明の増加分も指摘されており、続報を注視する必要がある。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo : formation des membres du Parlement des jeunes sur la prévention contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo: Training of Youth Parliament members on Ebola prevention - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease training for Butembo Youth Parliament members in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, aims to empower youth as prevention ambassadors amid a deadly outbreak centered in Butembo. The workshop, organized by the Butembo Youth Parliament with logistical support from Médecins Sans Frontières, equipped participants to counter fear, rumors, and infodemic, and to educate peers and families on Ebola prevention measures. Participants pledged to extend outreach beyond peers to their families and to act as credible communicators. Butembo remains the outbreak’s epicenter, especially in the Katwa health zone, which has reported over 485 laboratory-confirmed cases of the Bundibugyo strain. The Ebola treatment center in Katwa has discharged four patients recently, including an infant. The event underscores community-based prevention efforts as authorities contend with ongoing transmission. As of 17 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボ：エボラ予防に関する青年議会メンバー向け研修 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ブテンボを中心に485例以上の検査確定例を伴う進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに関する内容であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際支援（MSF関与）が明確であるため。
triage.notes: 既に確認されている進行中のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、Katwa保健区で485例以上確認）に関する続報記事。新規発生の兆候ではなく既存アウトブレイクの一環だが、継続的な監視と公衆衛生対応が必要な重大事案としてPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Projeto Cuida Chagas da Fiocruz faz busca casos de infecções de bebês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz's Chagas Care Project searches for cases of infant infections.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz-led international project Cuida Chagas ends field activities after five years, focusing on congenital Chagas disease care, diagnosis, and treatment among vulnerable populations in 31 municipalities across Brazil, Bolivia, Colombia and Paraguay. Congenital transmission occurs from mother to child during pregnancy or birth, via Trypanosoma cruzi. The program screened 81,000 people and confirmed more than 2,600 infections. Many newborns with infection lack classic symptoms such as prematurity, low birth weight, and hepatosplenomegaly. The initiative strengthened primary care, implemented active case-finding, trained health professionals, and built community leadership. A key advance was PCR testing to detect parasite DNA in blood, enabling treatment within the first months of life. The project also promoted integration into Brazil’s SUS, planning testing of women of reproductive age, decentralizing tests, and linking primary care, surveillance, labs, and specialty services. With field work ended, data analysis will translate findings into sustained health-system actions and policy.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルスの「クイーダ・シャーガス」プロジェクト、乳児感染症例の探索を実施
triage.triage_reason: シャーガス病は既知の風土病であり、本記事は研究・医療プログラムの終了報告であって新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではないため、シグナルとして扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル、ボリビア、コロンビア、パラグアイにまたがる研究プロジェクトの終了報告であり、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。新規感染急増や異常事態の報告ではなく、既存の医療プログラムの成果報告である。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : plus de 7.400 cas, la dynamique de l'épidémie évolue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: more than 7,400 cases, the epidemic dynamics are evolving
article.articleSummary: As of 15 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak has reached 7,404 confirmed cases, 3,577 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%), and 1,776 recoveries. The epidemic spans 62 health zones across seven provinces, with Ituri alone accounting for 77.7% of confirmed cases. Ituri is said to have peaked and entered a downward trend, while North Kivu continues to rise and remains a major hotspot. North Kivu reports 373 hospitalized patients and an overall bed occupancy of 94.7%, with 42.1% of care occurring outside standard facilities; no beds are available in Butembo and Katwa. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cautions that, despite encouraging signals in some areas, transmission persists and fatalities accumulate. Ituri shows about 300 new cases and 160 deaths in the past week; North Kivu’s weekly cases nearly doubled to over 200. This is the largest Ebola outbreak in DRC and the second-largest worldwide since 2014-2016.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ:症例数7,400人超、流行の様相が変化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行(7,404症例、致死率48.3%)が継続し、7州62保健区に拡大、病床逼迫等の深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 史上最大級のDRCエボラ流行で、WHO事務局長も懸念を表明。北キブ州で病床占有率94.7%、一部地域で病床ゼロと医療体制逼迫が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC deja 3.600 muertos y más de 7.400 casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has left 3,600 dead and more than 7,400 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has so far recorded 7,404 cases and 3,577 deaths, including 59 new cases and 32 deaths in the last 24 hours. So far, 1,776 patients have recovered and 930 remain hospitalized or in isolation. Case fatality rate is 48.3%; contact tracing coverage is 87.4%. Ituri Province remains the epicenter, representing 77.7% of total cases, with transmission also ongoing in North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Ubangi-Sud. This outbreak is the deadliest in the country’s history and could exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which logged 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths per WHO. The DRC, which declared the Kasai outbreak over in December 2025, has the most Ebola experience globally, dating back to the 1976 Yambuku outbreak near the Ebola River.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者3,600人・確定症例7,400人超に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%の大規模エボラ流行が複数州で継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模となる可能性があり、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える恐れがあると報告されている。国際的な支援・監視が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia Warns Against Eating Wildlife as Anthrax Spreads
article.articleSummary: Anthrax outbreak in Zambia prompts officials to urge residents to avoid wild game meat after wildlife deaths and at least 12 human infections. The Munyamadzi Game Management Area has seen deaths of hippos, elephants, buffalo, and a crocodile since July. Infected people are being treated, and officials say there have been no human fatalities so far, though experts cited by Global News expect the number of cases to rise. The health warning comes as authorities monitor ongoing wildlife disease activity and emphasize prevention measures in handling and consumption of wild meat. This event highlights zoonotic transmission risk from wildlife to people in this region, with the focus on preventing exposure from game meat while the outbreak continues.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア、炭疽菌の拡大受け野生動物肉の摂取を警告
triage.triage_reason: 動物からヒトへの人獣共通感染が継続しているが、死亡例なく国際的拡大の兆候も乏しいため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 炭疽は野生動物間で継続的に発生しており、少なくとも12人のヒト感染例あり。死亡者なしと報告されているが、専門家は症例増加を予測しており、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rentrée scolaire et prévention contre les épidémies : objet de sensibilisation à Kikwit - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back to school and epidemic prevention: an awareness-raising effort in Kikwit - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Tshikapa, the capital of Kasaï Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, about 1,875 residents were sensitized on 16–17 September 2026 by an NGO coalition on back-to-school and epidemic prevention focusing on Mpox and Ebola. The effort mobilized 925 people in the Sokajik and Tshinza markets (605 women, 65 men, 255 unschooled children; including 188 girls and 67 boys) and reached 950 additional students in La Borne and La Triomphante schools. Coordinated by the AMA, ASID, RUPFA, and ADPS Education cluster, the aim is to reduce out-of-school children and encourage parental enrollment while preventing Mpox and Ebola transmission in schools to avoid disruptions in the 2026–2027 academic year. Plans include continued door-to-door visits, advocacy with partners for school supplies for vulnerable families, enhanced proximity sensitization, involvement of community leaders, and distribution of hygiene kits in schools.

triage.headline_ja: 新学期と流行病予防：キクウィットでの啓発活動 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はMpox・Ebolaに関する新規感染症例の報告ではなく、学校再開に合わせた予防啓発活動（衛生教育・啓発キャンペーン）についての記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新たな流行の兆候は示されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はMpox・Ebola予防のための地域啓発活動（学校・市場での教育活動）を報告しているのみで、新規感染者や症例数の報告はない。DRCはMpox・Eboloの既知の流行地域だが、本記事自体は新規発生イベントを示すものではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito control drive launched to prevent spread of dengue in Tiruchi
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Tiruchi (Tamil Nadu) is being tackled as the delayed onset of the rainy season heightens risk. Dengue is a viral infection caused by dengue virus (DENV) transmitted by infected mosquitoes. Authorities have held awareness meetings across all 14 blocks to prevent water stagnation. Sanitation workers are conducting dengue source reduction, collecting old rubber tyres, empty containers and other water-holding items. Domestic Breeding Checkers (DBCs) are inspecting 50 homes daily to identify and eradicate breeding sites. Officials say rainfall is intermittent, increasing mosquito breeding potential; therefore enhanced surveillance and prevention of dengue and malaria are being enforced. Sources at Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Government Hospital report fever cases are nominal so far, with arrangements in place to deal with dengue if required. As of 17 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ティルチラーパッリでデング熱拡大防止のため蚊対策活動を開始
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節的なデング熱・マラリア予防対策であり、症例数も少なく異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による予防的な蚊対策活動の報道。発熱症例は「わずか」と報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Melonjak, Kemenkes Sebut Kenaikan Secara Nasional Tak Signifikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases surge, the Ministry of Health says the nationwide increase is not significant.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases surge in several cities, but the Indonesian Ministry of Health says the nationwide increase is not significant and remains under control as of 17 September 2026. Public chatter on social media includes parents reporting influenza A-like illness in children, with one user, @mavelmaven, claiming their child tested positive after a swab and experienced fever for more than three days; symptoms were described as resembling COVID, even with a COVID-like swab test. Officials note that the apparent rise is not uniform: some areas show upticks while national figures remain manageable. Aji Muhawarman, head of the Ministry’s Public Communications Bureau, spoke from Menteng, Jakarta, stressing that the situation is under control. The article also mentions ongoing annual influenza vaccination. No official counts are provided, and no details on infection sources or imported/exported cases are reported.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型症例が急増、保健省は全国的な増加は有意ではないと発表
triage.triage_reason: 一部地域でインフルエンザA症例の増加が報告されているが、保健省は全国的には有意でなく管理下にあるとしており、詳細な統計や重症度データが不足しているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 公式統計値や感染源の詳細は報告されておらず、SNS上の個別報告が中心。保健省は状況を制御下にあるとしている。

article.articleHeadline: Cebu dengue cases rise, but no province-wide outbreak, official says
article.articleSummary: Cebu Province recorded 3,759 dengue cases and 21 deaths from Jan. 1 to Sept. 11, 2026, yielding a case fatality rate of 0.56%. While August saw a surge, officials describe transmission as elevated with localized hotspots, not a province-wide outbreak. Weekly counts peaked at 478 in week 33 (August), then 416 (week 34) and 292 (week 35); preliminary 46 cases were reported in week 36 as of Sept. 10. Medellin, Talisay City and Toledo City had the highest case concentrations during Aug–Sept. The province notes CFR under 1% but emphasizes every death prompts improvements in early consultation, management, referral and community prevention. Hospital readiness includes 16 Capitol-run facilities with 24/7 labs, IV fluids and dengue fast lanes; NS1 kits, larvicides and spraying support are provided, with refresher pediatric dengue training. Residents are urged to eliminate breeding sites and seek early care; WHO warns severe dengue can follow fever and requires urgent attention.

triage.headline_ja: セブ島でデング熱症例が増加、しかし当局は「州全体の流行ではない」と発表
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域で季節的に流行する既知の感染症であり、当局も「州全体の流行ではない」と説明しているが、局地的な症例増加と死亡例があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱は東南アジアで毎年発生する風土病であり、地元当局が既に対応体制（病院、検査キット、防除活動）を整えていることから、IHR基準には該当しない。ただし症例数・死亡者数の推移は今後も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : au cinquième mois, l'espoir grandit, mais la vigilance reste de mise (Par Guy-noël Bokeme) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: After five months, hope grows, but vigilance remains essential (By Guy-noël Bokeme) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo enters its fifth month with signs of progress, centered in Ituri province (epicentre, including Bunia). National lab and field teams report 7,258 confirmed cases and 3,510 deaths among confirmed cases, with 1,728 recoveries and 905 patients in isolation or hospital as of September 14, 2026. Overall case-fatality rate stands at 48.4%, and contact tracing has improved from under 40% to over 80% with 21‑day follow-up, though 85–100% remains the goal. More than 1,700 recoveries have been recorded across six of seven affected provinces. Zaïre strain has treatments, monoclonal antibodies, and a vaccine; Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine yet. A targeted ring vaccination campaign is planned in Ituri, prioritizing frontline workers, with potential expansion if contact identification proves difficult, as officials remain vigilant through year-end 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：発生から5か月、希望が広がるも警戒は継続（ギー・ノエル・ボケメ記者）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが5か月目に入り、致死率48.4%、確定症例7,258例・死亡3,510例と甚大な公衆衛生影響が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のアウトブレイクの経過報告であり、致死率48.4%と非常に高く、7州中6州で回復例があるものの依然として大規模な流行が継続中。国境地帯（イトゥリ州）での発生であり、周辺国への波及リスクにも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Σε κατάσταση εθνικής ανάγκης για τον ιό HIV τα Φίτζι - Ραγδαία αύξηση κρουσμάτων
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiji in a state of national emergency over the HIV virus - rapid rise in cases
article.articleSummary: Fiji declared a national health emergency over HIV due to a rapid rise in cases beyond high-risk groups. In 2025, 2,016 new HIV diagnoses were recorded, up 27% from 2024. UNAIDS estimates ~9,100 people lived with HIV in Fiji in 2025; only 39% knew their status and 22% were on antiretroviral therapy. About 1 in 60 adults are living with HIV. Known transmission is largely sexual, with over 42% related to intravenous drug use. Fiji also serves as a regional drug-trafficking hub to Australia and New Zealand, exacerbating transmission. 59 babies were born with HIV in 2025, 18 dying before age one. Infections have risen twelvefold since 2010. The government plans to expand free confidential testing,PrEP, ART, harm-reduction for people who inject drugs, and sterile-syringe programs, with support from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund and UN partners.

triage.headline_ja: フィジー、HIVウイルスに対し国家緊急事態を宣言 - 感染者数が急増
triage.triage_reason: フィジーがHIV感染急増（前年比27%増、10年間で12倍）を理由に国家緊急事態を宣言し、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と異常な感染拡大が認められるため、IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域として挙げられたオーストラリア・フィジー・インド・ニュージーランドのうち、実際の感染発生国はフィジーのみであり、フィジーは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。インドは支援国として言及されているのみで感染発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Twins Conjoined at Head Separated; Brain-Eating Amoeba Source; Mercury-Laden Lotion
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri, a rare brain-eating amoeba, infected a North Carolina teenager; officials said exposure likely occurred at a community center water feature, and the patient died. In Congo’s Ituri province, the Ebola outbreak shows progress, as transmission is going down in parts of the province, per World Health Organization Director-General, though vigilance remains essential. Pennsylvania’s measles outbreak centers in Lancaster County, with patients surging at clinics and hospitals as the outbreak persists. As of 2026-09-17, these items illustrate ongoing infectious-disease challenges across the United States and Africa reported in the same timeframe. This snapshot highlights current outbreaks and risk patterns as of Sept 17, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 頭部結合双生児の分離手術；脳を食べるアメーバの感染源；水銀含有ローション
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ・イトゥリ州のエボラ流行は継続中だがWHOは伝播減少による改善を報告しており、新規異常事態ではないため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の脳食いアメーバ症例、コンゴのエボラ流行経過、米ペンシルベニア州の麻疹流行をまとめたダイジェスト記事。対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（コンゴ）のみ。エボラは既知の流行で、WHOは伝播減少を報告しており改善傾向にあるため新規シグナルというより継続監視事案。

article.articleHeadline: Kasaï : la population appelée à observer les mesures barrières contre le Mpox - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kasaï: The Population Urged to Observe Barrier Measures Against Mpox - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 17 September 2026 in Tshikapa, Kasaï province, Democratic Republic of Congo, Governor Crispin Mukendi Bukasa urged residents to observe barrier measures against mpox, including strict hygiene and regular handwashing, and to avoid contact with individuals showing symptoms. He advised anyone with fever and skin rashes to immediately seek care at the nearest health center. The provincial administration reassured that arrangements with health-sector partners are underway to strengthen epidemiological surveillance and mpox case management. The call reflects ongoing public health efforts to curb mpox transmission in the province. It signals heightened vigilance in central DRC amid mpox concerns for residents.

triage.headline_ja: カサイ州：住民にMpox（サル痘）に対する防護対策の遵守を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続しているMpoxアウトブレイクに関する政府の対策強化・注意喚起であり、国際的に懸念されている疾患であるためフルリスク評価が推奨される。
triage.notes: 本記事はカサイ州（ツィカパ）における既存のMpox流行に対する州知事の呼びかけであり、新規発生ではなく継続的な公衆衛生対応の一環。DRCは国際的にMpoxクレードIbの発生源として注視されているため、フルRRAでの経過確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Министарство здравља Тајланда упозорава на опасан вирус који преносе крпељи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand's Ministry of Public Health warns of a dangerous virus transmitted by ticks.
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Ministry of Public Health warns of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS), a dangerous tick-borne viral infection. The main transmission is tick bite, though doctors note rare cases from contact with blood or bodily fluids of infected animals or people. Symptoms appear 1–2 weeks after exposure and include high fever, muscle and headache pain, persistent fatigue, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. A hallmark is rapid thrombocytopenia, which can progress to abnormal bleeding, neurological symptoms, and multi-organ failure, posing life-threatening risks. Infection reservoirs span both wild and domestic animals—dogs, cats, pigs, chickens, cattle, sheep, and goats—making grassy areas and animal habitats higher-risk environments. Separately, Chinese researchers identified ALTNV (Asian longhorned tick-associated virus), detected in over 10% of patients after tick bites, with fever, weakness, flu-like symptoms, and gastrointestinal issues. Emphasis remains on tick avoidance and public awareness in Thailand.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省、マダニが媒介する危険なウイルスに警告
triage.triage_reason: タイ保健省がSFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症候群）について公式警告を発しており、多臓器不全等の重症化リスクがある。加えて中国で新規マダニ媒介ウイルス(ALTNV)が確認されており、WPRO基準（異常性・重症度・曝露継続）を複数満たすためフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: タイ保健省の公式警告と、中国研究者による新規マダニ媒介ウイルス(ALTNV)の発見が同時に報じられている。具体的な症例数・発生規模の記載はなく、注意喚起的な内容のため続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Homem é mordido por Morcego em Ilha Grande, no Rio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man bitten by bat on Ilha Grande, Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: A 33-year-old man on Ilha Grande, Angra dos Reis, Rio de Janeiro, was bitten by a hematophagous bat (likely Desmodus rotundus) on March 17, 2024. He sustained a toe wound, initially painless, noticed bleeding later and sought care, receiving full post-exposure rabies prophylaxis. The incident prompted the UERJ Laboratory of Mammal Ecology to investigate the site; ten mist nets were deployed around the residence and nine bats of five species were captured. Ilha Grande, with 37 bat species, already has records of bats feeding on dogs, chickens and even humans. The study notes Desmodus rotundus, Diaemus youngii, and Diphylla ecaudata as hematophagous groups, with Desmodus rotundus as Brazil's primary rabies reservoir. Nationally, between 2014–2023, 174 bat-related rabies cases in animals in Rio de Janeiro and one human case in Angra dos Reis in 2020. The March 2024 case adds to ongoing rabies concerns from bats in the region.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州イーリャ・グランデでコウモリに男性が噛まれる
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個別咬傷事例であり、適切な曝露後予防措置が既に実施されている。公衆衛生上の異常な拡大や社会的関心の高まりを示す情報もなく、通常の風土病的リスク事例として見送り。
triage.notes: 本事例は単発の動物咬傷（狂犬病曝露後予防実施済み）であり、地域研究の一環として報告されたもの。過去10年間の同地域における狂犬病症例（動物174件、ヒト1件）は既知の風土病的背景情報であり、新規のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ancient Superbugs Emerging from Melting Himalayan Glaciers?
article.articleSummary: Ancient microbes and antibiotic-resistance genes released from melting Himalayan glaciers threaten rivers feeding Asia. In Nepal, glacial melt and floods, including Aug 2026 Bhotekoshi, foreshadow biological hazards as dormant organisms and resistance traits reach the Ganges, Indus and waterways. Ice-core work from the Tibetan Guliya cap recovered viral material up to 15,000 years old (later extended to 41,000 years with ~1,700 viral species). Pathogenic fungi and bacteria have been found in glaciers from Greenland to Svalbard; Siberia’s 2016 thaw unleashed anthrax spores, killing reindeer and infecting people. Ancient resistance genes, including a vancomycin-resistance gene from 30,000-year-old Siberian permafrost, and mobile elements exist in Himalayan samples. A 5,000-year-old Romanian bacterium showed resistance to ten antibiotics while producing anti-susceptibility compounds. The Hindu Kush Himalaya supports 1.9 billion people; Yala Glacier loss ~two-thirds since 1974. No outbreaks yet, but experts urge surveillance via DNA/metagenomics within a One Health framework and routine meltwater sampling.

triage.headline_ja: 融解するヒマラヤ氷河から出現する古代の超耐性菌？
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクは発生しておらず（記事内で明記）、氷河融解による将来的リスクを論じた科学的解説記事であるため、現時点でのシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は氷河融解に伴う古代微生物・薬剤耐性遺伝子の潜在的リスクを論じた仮説的・科学的解説であり、'No outbreaks yet'と明記されている。過去のシベリア炭疽事例（2016年）はロシアでの出来事で対象国リストに含まれず、中国チベット自治区は氷河コアのサンプリング地点として言及されているのみで、実際の感染症発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ancaman Ekonomi Afrika, Tingginya Biaya Demi Sapu Bersih Virus Ebola dari Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa's Economic Threat, The High Cost to Eradicate the Ebola Virus from the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) shows progress as WHO notes signs of control, but calls for sustained funding. In Ituri Province transmission is declining; South Kivu has reported no new cases since May. Over 1,700 patients have recovered. After four months, the outbreak in eastern DRC is largely contained, with a small Uganda outbreak quickly halted. The government reports 7,258 confirmed EVD cases and 3,510 deaths since May. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the situation remains dangerous in highly mobile regions where spread can resume. The government has outlined a 180-day response plan costing about $1.3 billion. Clinical trials are anticipated in the coming weeks, while donors are urged to provide full funding for both government response and broader humanitarian efforts.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの経済的脅威：コンゴからのエボラウイルス根絶のための高コスト
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,258例・3,510人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続中で、ウガンダへの越境拡大も発生しており、WHOが資金支援を呼びかけていることからIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの小規模流行も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarampo sobem em SP e EUA registram mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases rise in São Paulo, and the US reports deaths.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks continue in the United States and Brazil. In Pennsylvania, the largest outbreak in more than three decades has reached 693 cases in 2026, with four deaths linked to measles. Across the United States, the CDC reports 3,294 infections through September 2026. In Brazil’s São Paulo state, 36 measles cases have been identified this year, of which 32 are in the capital; 26 patients lacked vaccination history or had incomplete immunization. Three imported cases from Peru were confirmed in Tabatinga, Amazonas, with no sustained transmission reported in the country. Measles is a highly contagious airborne viral infection causing fever, red rash, cough, and eye irritation; severe complications include pneumonia and acute encephalitis, potentially fatal. There is no specific antiviral treatment; vaccination with the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine remains the primary prevention and control measure.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹症例増加、米国では死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（サンパウロ州・アマゾナス州）で未接種者を中心とした麻疹症例が続き、ペルーからの輸入例も確認されており、WPRO基準（持続曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し、米国での大規模流行と合わせて社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国（ペンシルベニア州）とペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブラジル国内では持続的なヒト-ヒト感染は報告されていないが、未接種者集団への曝露継続と輸入例の存在から流行拡大の可能性がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Thailand Medical Officials Report Surging COVID-19 Infections with an Average of About 15,000 New Cases per Week
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infections are surging in Thailand, with about 15,000 new weekly cases over the latest four weeks. From Aug 9–Sep 8, 64,937 national cases were reported, with weekly deaths averaging 2–4. Chon Buri, Bangkok and Phuket reported the highest counts. For Jan 1–Sep 15, cumulative COVID-19 cases reached 135,667 (206 per 100,000), with 26 deaths, 21 of them in the high‑risk “608” population (60+ and with conditions such as diabetes, stroke, CVD, CKD, chronic respiratory disease, cancer). The dominant SARS-CoV-2 lineage is NB.1.8.1, followed by JN.1; PQ.16.1.1 (6 cases) is under monitoring, with symptoms generally mild. The report emphasizes ongoing genomic surveillance. Influenza and RSV are also rising: 359,672 influenza cases and 57 deaths (Jan 1–Sep 8), mainly in unvaccinated children 5–9, with A/H1N1 pdm09 common; RSV at 8,578 cases and 1 infant death (two-month-old premature).

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健当局、COVID-19感染者の急増を報告、週平均約15,000人の新規感染
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザ・RSVの増加報告であり、変異株PQ.16.1.1は監視下にあるが症状は軽度。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点で確認されず、通常の季節的サーベイランス報告の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: 新規変異株PQ.16.1.1が監視下にあるが、症状は軽度と報告されており現時点で重大な懸念は少ない。継続的なゲノムサーベイランスの結果を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: DF passa a usar exame no LCR para agilizar diagnóstico de meningite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal District Begins Using CSF Test to Speed Up Meningitis Diagnosis
article.articleSummary: Suspected bacterial meningitis in the Federal District, Brazil, now benefits from a rapid cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) antigen test. The new assay detects bacterial antigens in CSF (liquor) and is available in all public health units in the Federal District (DF). It yields an initial result more quickly and is intended to complement, not replace, clinical assessment and confirmatory testing such as CSF culture. The test is requested by the care team based on clinical evaluation and other laboratory results, aiding the investigation of suspected meningitis cases. While it speeds initial triage and helps guide management, definitive diagnosis remains dependent on cultures and follow-up tests. The tool strengthens public health capacity to investigate and respond to suspected bacterial meningitis in the DF.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦直轄区、髄膜炎の診断を迅速化するためCSF（脳脊髄液）検査を導入
triage.triage_reason: 疾患名「Classical Swine Fever」はBluedotの誤認識であり、実際の記事内容は髄膜炎診断のための脳脊髄液（CSF）迅速検査導入に関するものであり、感染症の発生・流行を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 疾患名『Classical Swine Fever（豚コレラ）』はBluedot APIの誤分類。記事は『CSF』を脳脊髄液(cerebrospinal fluid)検査の略称として使用しており、豚コレラとは無関係。ブラジル連邦直轄区における細菌性髄膜炎の診断迅速化ツール導入に関する医療機関向け技術記事であり、疾病の発生・流行報告ではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Skrining aktif TB diperkuat untuk percepat eliminasi pada 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Active TB screening strengthened to accelerate elimination by 2030.
article.articleSummary: Active TB screening in Padang, West Sumatra, Indonesia, was strengthened on September 17 as the Indonesian Pulmonary Doctors Association (PDPI) Sumatera Barat chapter, together with the Padang City Health Office and private partners, conducted community TB screening at Puskesmas Pauh. The initiative deployed portable screening technology, including X-ray and molecular testing, to accelerate TB case finding, including in areas with limited electricity. The effort supports ongoing push to eliminate tuberculosis by 2030. No specific TB case counts or outcomes were reported in the summary. The program emphasizes expanding access to rapid diagnostics at primary health facilities and leveraging portable tools to reach underserved populations, facilitating earlier detection and treatment to curb transmission in the Padang metropolitan area.

triage.headline_ja: 2030年までのTB撲滅を加速するため、積極的なTBスクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の結核対策プログラムに関する定例的な報道であり、症例急増や異常事態の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 結核は地域対象国リストの対象疾患ではあるが、本記事は既存の撲滅計画に基づくスクリーニング強化の通常広報であり、症例数や異常発生の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Des pays africains s'intéressent à un nouveau vaccin russe contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Some African countries are interested in a new Russian Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, several African countries have expressed interest in a new Russian Ebola vaccine, even though clinical trials are ongoing. The Russian Foreign Ministry confirmed the interest. Preliminary tests on live Ebola virus samples have been reported by the Gamaleya National Center for Epidemiology and Microbiology, with researchers continuing the evaluation of the vaccine candidate. Initially, the project aimed to protect against multiple Ebola strains, including Sudan and Bundibugyo, but developers later narrowed to a single component to simplify development. The World Health Organization has recently alerted to several Ebola outbreaks in Central Africa, notably in the Democratic Republic of Congo, underscoring ongoing regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ諸国、エボラ出血熱に対するロシア新型ワクチンに関心
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はロシア製エボラワクチンへの関心表明であり、DRCでのエボラ流行はWHOの既存警告として言及されるのみで新規の疫学情報は含まれないため、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア製エボラワクチンへの国際的関心を報じるものであり、DRCでの現行エボラ流行の詳細（症例数・重症度等）は記載されていない。既知のDRCエボラ流行状況については別途RRAでの確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : 29 séances de sensibilisation organisées dans les écoles (Porte-parole de la Monusco) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: 29 awareness sessions organized in schools (MONUSCO spokesperson) - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, Ebola virus disease is being addressed in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where 29 Ebola awareness sessions were organized in schools over the past two weeks as part of MONUSCO's Safer Schools campaign. The sessions emphasize handwashing, hygiene, sanitation, recognition of Ebola warning signs, and rapid reporting of suspected cases to health services. They target students, teachers, parents, and community leaders to reinforce preventive behaviors in schools and surrounding communities. The campaign links school protection with health education amid ongoing circulation of Ebola across several health zones in Ituri. MONUSCO aims to support continued education while strengthening Ebola prevention in fragile areas.

triage.headline_ja: イツリでのエボラ：学校で29回の啓発セッションを実施（MONUSCO報道官）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で複数の保健区にわたりエボラウイルス病の感染が継続していることが記事内で言及されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は学校での啓発活動に関する内容だが、イツリ州の複数保健区でエボラ感染が継続中であることが述べられており、既存のアウトブレイクの継続を示すシグナルとして評価。新規症例数や致死率など詳細情報は本文からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : le gouvernement exhorté à intensifier la sensibilisation de la population - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: Government urged to intensify public awareness - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, prompts intensified public awareness as authorities combat transmission. In talks with a local leader, officials are urged to address community resistance in Mangote, Mambango, Ndindi and Bundji, attributed to communication gaps by response teams. Fiston Isambiro, coordinator of Véranda Mutsanga, calls for stronger government messaging on Ebola’s seriousness to inform residents and bolster collaboration with healthcare workers. He denies allegations that Véranda Mutsanga fuels resistance, noting the group has led response efforts since 2018 and should be involved in the response. He advocates easier access for response teams to communities and adherence to preventive measures. A rapid health response could ease economic hardships and help reopen the Uganda border, reviving cross-border trade while limiting Ebola’s spread in North Kivu, amid security concerns from ADF activity.

triage.headline_ja: ベニでのエボラ出血熱:政府、住民への啓発強化を要請 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州ベニでエボラ出血熱の発生が続いており、地域社会の抵抗や国境閉鎖などの影響も見られるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダ国境閉鎖への言及があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。エボラは既知の病原体だが地域拡大・経済影響・治安問題（ADF）が絡み、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: बच्चों पर मंडरा रहा HFMD का खतरा; सबसे ज्यादा चपेट में इस उम्र के बच्चे, जानें लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) threat looming over children; most affected are kids in this age group—know the symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) is spreading rapidly among children in Pune, India, especially 2–7 years old. Over the past five weeks, physicians report 4–5 new cases weekly, about 30 cases in a month, with some children experiencing two to three recurrences. The illness is highly contagious and common in homes, societies, and schools, with seasonal spikes from June–October and December–January. Most cases are mild, but severe episodes or in vulnerable children may require hospitalization. Symptoms include fever, mouth ulcers, fatigue, and rashes on the hands, feet, and mouth; lesions can also appear on elbows, buttocks, and knees and cause pain during eating. There is no specific treatment. Prevention focuses on frequent handwashing, disinfecting surfaces and toys, and isolating affected children. Recovery typically occurs in 7–10 days. Schools are urged to promptly segregate symptomatic children and consult doctors.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもたちに迫るHFMDの脅威;最も影響を受けるのはこの年齢層の子どもたち、症状を知る
triage.triage_reason: インドのプネーでHFMD（手足口病）が季節的に増加しているが、多くは軽症で、重大な公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性のHFMD流行であり、毎年6-10月・12-1月に発生する既知のパターン。学校や家庭内での感染拡大が見られるが、重症例は少なく、地域内での管理可能な事案と考えられる。続報があれば重症化率や地域拡大の有無を注視。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola dépasse le seuil des 7 000 cas et fait 3 000 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: the Ebola epidemic surpasses the 7,000-case threshold and has caused 3,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). In the 37th epidemiological week, the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) reports more than 7,200 cases and 3,400 deaths, a case fatality around 48.4%. About 913 patients are in isolation, 1,700 have recovered, and contact tracing reaches 88%. Despite the heavy toll, authorities note a downward trend in the epidemic curve. A new case has been identified in the South Ubangi province, while response teams maintain surveillance and meticulous contact follow-up. A coordination meeting on major epidemics in Kinshasa earlier this week emphasized the downward trend and strengthened mobilization of health actors and surveillance capacity across the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱の流行が7,000症例、3,000人の死者を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで7,000症例超・致死率約48.4%と深刻な公衆衛生影響を示し、新規州（南ウバンギ）への拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 新規症例が南ウバンギ州で確認され地理的拡大の兆候あり。致死率が高く、国際的な支援・監視強化が継続的に必要とされる状況。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Araçatuba inicia 2ª fase de busca ativa de casos de tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Araçatuba Health Department begins Phase II of active case finding for tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Araçatuba, São Paulo State, Brazil, begins Phase II of its active tuberculosis case-finding campaign from September 16 to 30, 2026, conducted by the Municipal Health Secretariat and Zatti Saúde. The effort targets identification of new TB cases and public education on prevention, symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment, with activities at Primary Health Units (UBSs), workplaces, long-term care facilities (ILPIs), shelters for people experiencing homelessness, elderly centers (CCI), Centro POP, therapeutic homes, and other planned sites. The priority groups include the general population and those at higher risk. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Koch’s bacillus) and is primarily airborne; pulmonary TB is most common, but other organs can be affected. Symptoms include persistent cough, afternoon fever, night sweats, unintended weight loss, fatigue, and chest or back pain. Diagnosis enables free treatment through the SUS. Phase I (March 16–31, 2026) yielded 186 sputum tests with 5 positives; treated via SUS.

triage.headline_ja: アラサトゥーバ保健局、結核症例の積極的発見活動の第2段階を開始
triage.triage_reason: ルーティンの結核症例発見キャンペーンであり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の重大な脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 通常の自治体レベルの結核対策活動報告であり、シグナルトリアージ対象国リストに該当するブラジルではあるが、疾患は既知の風土病であり突発的異常事象ではないため対象国リストに含めない扱いとした。

article.articleHeadline: 15 students fall ill after eating leftover food from vice-principal's private event
article.articleSummary: 15 students and a vice-principal fell seriously ill after consuming suspected contaminated food at Peddalodi Zilla Parishad High School in Munipally mandal, Sangareddy district, Telangana. Leftover food from a private function hosted at Vice-Principal Venkatesh’s residence was brought to the government school and served by staff. Students experienced vomiting, nausea and severe discomfort; the vice-principal also became ill and was transported to Sangareddy District Government Hospital for intensive care, while the pupils were taken to the Government Hospital in Sadasivpet for treatment. Health and education authorities have noted the incident, with further details awaited as officials investigate suspected food poisoning. No laboratory confirmation is reported in the account. As of 2026-09-17, authorities are investigating the incident and awaiting further details.

triage.headline_ja: 副校長の私的行事の残り物を食べた生徒15人が体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 単一の学校での食中毒疑いの事例であり、感染症の流行や国際的な拡大リスクは認められない。局所的な事案であり、フルリスク評価の対象とはならない。
triage.notes: 食中毒（食品由来の非感染性事案）であり、病原体不明のUnknown Illnessとして登録されているが、内容は学校での残り物摂取による食中毒疑い。感染症危機管理の対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC warns Ebola outbreak not 'under control'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri and spanning seven northern and eastern provinces, remains far from under control, Africa CDC director-general Jean Kaseya said on 17 September 2026, despite modest signs of progress flagged by the WHO. The outbreak has produced more than 7,200 cases and at least 3,500 deaths to date (AU figures: 7,404 cases, 3,577 deaths). Kaseya noted a plateau with a slight decline but cautioned that no one can declare the outbreak under control, citing incomplete data in some reports. Government spokesman Patrick Muyaya said the peak was reached in the third week of August. The Bundibugyo strain lacks an approved vaccine or treatment; Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe internal/external bleeding and organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラ出血熱の流行は『制御下にない』と警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,200例超・死者3,500人超に及ぶエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が7州に拡大し、ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ制御未達とAfrica CDCが公式警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による大規模流行であり、Africa CDC・WHOともに継続的な監視・支援が必要と表明している。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: "Je n'avais jamais entendu parler d'Ebola avant aujourd'hui" : en RDC, la capitale Kinshasa se prépare à l'arrivée possible du virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "I had never heard of Ebola before today": in the DRC, the capital Kinshasa is preparing for the possible arrival of the virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues across seven provinces, mainly in the northeast. By September 13, 2026, 7,258 people were infected with more than 3,500 deaths, a toll the World Health Organization says is likely undercounted. Kinshasa authorities are intensifying preparedness to prevent the virus from entering the capital, warning of a potential catastrophe if it spreads in the megacity. At the port of Bende-Bende, about 70 km upstream along the Congo River, a control post with tents and healthcare workers in blue gowns monitors arrivals to curb entry. Transmission is described as intense and geographically diffuse, underscoring ongoing risk as Kinshasa braces for a possible arrival of Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 「今日まで一度もエボラという言葉を聞いたことがなかった」：コンゴ民主共和国、首都キンシャサでウイルス到来に備え対策強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7州にまたがるエボラ流行が継続し、7,258人感染・3,500人以上死亡という深刻な公衆衛生被害が発生しており、首都キンシャサへの拡大リスクも指摘されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の感染者数・死亡者数がさらに多い可能性を指摘。キンシャサへの流入阻止のため港湾での監視体制が強化されている。

article.articleHeadline: Chuva aumenta alerta para proliferação do mosquito Aedes aegypti em Rio das Ostras
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain raises the alert for Aedes aegypti proliferation in Rio das Ostras.
article.articleSummary: Rain intensifies concerns over Aedes aegypti proliferation in Rio das Ostras, Brazil, with authorities warning that wetter conditions boost mosquito breeding, which facilitates transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Standing water from rainfall creates new larval habitats, increasing the risk of local outbreaks. Public health guidance urges residents to eliminate containers that accumulate water, such as pots, tires, and barrels, and to intensify prevention measures after rain events. No specific case counts are reported, but the situation underscores the need for source reduction, household hygiene, and community awareness to curb proliferation of Aedes aegypti in the coastal municipality. Public health authorities emphasize personal protection and ongoing community sanitation efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 雨がリオ・ダス・オストラスでのネッタイシマカ繁殖警戒を高める
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例数の報告がなく、蚊の繁殖リスクに関する一般的な注意喚起にとどまり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節的な蚊媒介感染症予防に関する定例的な注意喚起記事であり、具体的な感染者数や異常な流行の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberkulosefall in Bottmingen: 100 Kinder müssen untersucht werden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis case in Bottmingen: 100 children must be examined.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis outbreak at Bottmingen Primary School in Basel-Landschaft, Switzerland, involves a teaching staff member who is infected and receiving treatment; the teacher no longer teaches. More than 100 pupils aged eight to twelve are being advised to undergo medical examinations as a precaution. Examinations are conducted in groups at the University Children’s Hospital Basel (UKBB), including medical evaluation and, when indicated, chest radiographs. Parents have been informed, and other guardians are being notified. The Canton Basel-Landschaft urges contacting a pediatrician if symptoms such as cough or fever appear and has set up a helpline for further questions. The Federal Office of Public Health notes that infection is detectable two months after exposure. Reactions in the community range from anxiety over lack of tuberculosis vaccination to calm acceptance of proactive school/authorities communication; some parents reference TB familiarity from India.

triage.headline_ja: ボットミンゲンで結核症例発生：子ども100人が検査対象に
triage.triage_reason: スイス国内の学校での単発的な結核症例であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではないため、対象外として見送り。
triage.notes: 発生地域はスイス（Basel-Landschaft）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。インドへの言及は保護者のコメント（TBに関する経験談）に過ぎず、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Pernambuco registra quarta morte do ano por arbovirose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pernambuco records fourth death of the year from an arboviral disease.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Pernambuco, Brazil, marks the year’s fourth arboviral-death. A 60-year-old man from Olinda died May 7, with comorbidities noted. SES-PE reports 22 other arboviral deaths under investigation in 2026. Four dengue fatalities are confirmed in total this year: a 65-year-old Recife man who died in Rio de Janeiro on Feb 18; a 15-year-old Tacaratu (Sertão) girl who died Apr 14; and a 93-year-old Parnamirim (Sertão) woman who died May 5. The epidemiological bulletin covers Jan 4–Sep 12, 2026 (weeks 4–37). Pernambuco has 47,418 dengue notifications, up 37% year over year, with 11,368 confirmed dengue cases and 686 of those classified as severe. The data underscore ongoing dengue transmission and evolving arboviral activity in the state.

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブコ州、今年4人目のアルボウイルス感染症による死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルナンブコ州でデング熱による死亡例と症例数増加が報告されているが、既知の風土病であり国際的拡大リスクは低いため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱は南米で毎年流行する既知の風土病であり、ペルナンブコ州の症例数（前年比37%増）は懸念材料だが、州保健当局（SES-PE）が既にモニタリング・報告体制を有しており、フルRRAというよりは継続的な監視が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo records 7,404 cases - Diaspora Digital Media (DDM News) - Nigeria Breaking News, Africa and World News and Updates
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo records 7,404 confirmed cases and 3,577 deaths, with a case fatality rate of 48.3%. The epidemic is shifting from Ituri to North Kivu; Ituri accounts for 77.7% of cases and shows declining transmission, while North Kivu rises and treatment facilities are near capacity (373 hospitalised; bed occupancy 94.7%). So far, 1,776 patients have recovered, and the outbreak spans 62 health zones across seven provinces. Ituri has passed its peak and is on a downward slope, but North Kivu’s curve has not plateaued and remains a major hotspot. WHO Director-General Tedros notes encouraging signs in some areas yet warns the epidemic is expanding, with weekly North Kivu cases nearly doubling (from ~100 to >200). This is the largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history and the second-largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが7,404例を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（DRC史上最大規模、致死率48.3%）が拡大中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接言及するほど注目度が高く、DRC史上最大かつ2014-2016西アフリカ流行に次ぐ世界第2位の規模。北キブ州での感染拡大が続き、病床占有率94.7%と医療提供体制が危機的状況。既存のRRA対象である可能性が高いが、感染拡大の進行状況から継続的な評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UN says DR Congo violence displaces thousands, hinders Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Violence in eastern DR Congo is displacing civilians and hindering the Ebola response, per OCHA. In Mambasa Territory, Ituri Province, attacks since September have killed at least 60. In South Kivu’s Fizi Territory, over 40,000 people have been displaced since July, while fighting in North Kivu drives new displacements. As of 14 September 2026, authorities reported more than 7,300 confirmed Ebola cases and over 3,500 deaths. Three additional treatment facilities are under construction in North Kivu, and screening points are expanding for early detection. UNICEF is supporting 190 schools with infection prevention supplies; WFP provides nutritional support to patients, caregivers and frontline health workers. Parties must protect civilians and ensure unhindered humanitarian access to deliver life-saving aid and bring the outbreak under control.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国の暴力が数千人を避難させ、エボラ対応を妨げていると発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行は感染者7,300人超、死者3,500人超と極めて深刻であり、武力衝突による住民避難と人道アクセス制限が対応をさらに困難にしているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるFijiは記事内容と無関係でBluedotの誤付与と判断し除外。South Kivu・Mambasa（Ituri州）はいずれもDRC国内の地域であり、DRCとして統合した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - L'épidémie en RDC "n'est pas sous contrôle", selon l'Africa CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - The outbreak in the DRC is not under control, according to Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is not under control, Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya said, a day after WHO described encouraging signs. The current outbreak, the DRC’s 17th linked to the Ebola virus that causes hemorrhagic fever, spans seven eastern provinces, originating in Ituri in the northeast. As of September 15, it has caused 3,577 deaths and 7,404 cases. In remote, troubled areas the response has been overwhelmed by surging caseloads. Kaseya cautioned that cases appear to plateau, but available data do not prove the peak has been reached, and no one can declare the outbreak under control. RDC government spokesman Patrick Muyaya asserted the peak occurred in early August, though Kaseya called that data incomplete. WHO Director-General Tedros noted encouraging signs but warned the response will continue for months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 - コンゴ民主共和国の流行は「制御下にない」、アフリカCDCが発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（17回目）が7州に拡大し、死者3,577人・感染者7,404人に達し、Africa CDCが「制御下にない」と表明するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関心が高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: WHOとAfrica CDCで流行のピーク到達に関する見解が分かれており、今後の推移（ピーク到達の有無、対応能力）の続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Homem de 49 anos morre sob suspeita de meningite bacteriana em SC; exames ainda investigam o caso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 49-year-old man dies under suspicion of bacterial meningitis in SC; exams are still investigating the case.
article.articleSummary: A 49-year-old man dies in Joaçaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, under investigation for bacterial meningitis. Samuel Henrique dos Reis, a Capinzal resident, had been hospitalized for three days at Hospital Universitário Santa Terezinha (HUST) when he died on September 16, 2026, around 7:50 am. Initial tests at HUST were suggestive of bacterial meningitis, but current assessment finds no clinical features compatible with meningococcal disease. Complementary laboratory exams are still awaited to confirm the diagnosis. The case was reported to the Epidemiological Surveillance of Joaçaba on September 12, and the municipal surveillance unit leads the investigation. Because meningococcal disease is not suspected at this time, there is no indicated contact monitoring. The investigation remains ongoing to determine whether bacterial meningitis is indeed present and to clarify the clinical picture.

triage.headline_ja: 49歳男性、細菌性髄膜炎の疑いでSC州で死亡；検査は継続中
triage.triage_reason: 単発の死亡例で細菌性髄膜炎が疑われているが、現時点では髄膜炎菌感染症に合致する臨床像は認められず確定診断待ちのため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌感染症は現時点で否定的とされ、接触者調査も実施されていない。確定検査結果待ちの単発死亡例であり、現時点で公衆衛生上の重大な脅威とは判断されない。

article.articleHeadline: 斐济群岛艾滋病例激增 宣布"国家紧急状态
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV/AIDS cases surge in the Fiji Islands; state of national emergency declared.
article.articleSummary: HIV/AIDS surge in Fiji triggers national public health emergency. In 2025, Fiji diagnosed 2,016 HIV infections, a 16-fold increase since 2019. Estimated prevalence: about 1 in 60 adults living with HIV; 2 in 100 pregnant women HIV-positive. Among HIV-infected infants born in 2025, 59 cases were recorded, with 18 dying before age one. Health Minister Atonio Lalabalavu formally declared the national HIV emergency, pledging expanded free testing, prevention, and treatment—including rapid testing, PrEP for high-risk groups, harm-reduction for people who inject drugs, and free antiretroviral therapy. Fiji, a 900,000+ resident archipelago of 300+ islands, is relatively young (one-third aged 15–35). More than half of known transmissions are sexual; over 42% from sharing contaminated injecting equipment, with a high-risk injection-drug-use cluster among sex workers rising since around 2019. External support from Australia, New Zealand, India, Global Fund, and UN; calls for regional cooperation and solidarity.

triage.headline_ja: フィジー諸島でHIV感染例が急増、「国家緊急事態」を宣言
triage.triage_reason: フィジーでHIV感染が2019年比16倍に急増し国家緊急事態が宣言されるなど、深刻性・異常性が高くIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにフィジーは含まれないため verified_locations は空。インドは外部支援国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19: el virus que puso en jaque al planeta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: the virus that put the planet in check.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19, starting in late 2019 in China, spread rapidly to become a global health crisis tracked by SEMANA and labeled by the WHO. The pandemic triggered lockdowns, economic shocks, and stark global inequalities while healthcare systems raced to respond with vaccines, treatments, and public health measures. The article notes ongoing fears of transmission, rising testing, and persistent waves driven by variants, with WHO alerts remaining high. No country was spared; many faced reimposed or relaxed restrictions as vaccination campaigns unfolded and became a beacon toward normality. Side effects from vaccines: body aches, headaches, fever were common, while some adverse events triggered health authority alarms. In Colombia, the first domestic case was recorded and vaccines arrived, marking a pivotal moment alongside discussions of pharmaceutical profits and the enduring challenge of rebound outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19：地球を窮地に追い込んだウイルス
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19パンデミックの歴史的経緯を振り返る回顧記事であり、新規の異常事態や現在進行中の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はCOVID-19パンデミックの歴史的回顧・振り返り記事であり、中国発生初期からの経緯やコロンビアでの初期症例などを振り返る内容。新規のシグナルとして扱うべき現在進行中のイベントではないため対象国は該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola avanza in Congo. E Kinshasa si prepara: la vera difesa comincia prima del primo caso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola advances in Congo. Kinshasa prepares: the real defense begins before the first case.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus–related Ebola outbreak grows in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 7,258 confirmed cases and 3,510 deaths as of September 13, 2026 (apparent fatality ~48.4%). The outbreak covers 62 health zones across seven provinces, with Ituri still the epicenter though its share declines. Kinshasa faces elevated risk due to urban density, crowded markets and high mobility; a May suspected case from Ituri tested negative, underlining the value of rapid verification. Core public-health measures are emphasized: epidemiological surveillance, rapid laboratories, immediate isolation of suspected cases, contact tracing, segregated hospital pathways, PPE, and trained personnel, plus community trust. Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus) vaccine is recommended only within research protocols, as efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus is unproven; studies of therapies are ongoing. WHO flags very high risk in DRC, high in neighboring countries, low globally. The Italy lesson: preparedness must be permanent, with resilient hospitals ready before the first case.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大。キンシャサは備える：真の防衛は最初の症例が出る前から始まる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模アウトブレイク（致死率約48.4%）が7州62保健地域に拡大しており、WHOも国内リスクを「非常に高い」と評価。IHR基準に複数該当し、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模エボラアウトブレイクの続報。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスに対するErvebo（ザイール株ワクチン）の有効性は未証明であり、研究プロトコル下でのみ推奨されている点に留意。イタリアは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事の主題国はDRCのみのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 斐濟群島艾滋病例激增 宣布"國家緊急狀態
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV/AIDS cases surge in the Fiji Islands; national state of emergency declared.
article.articleSummary: HIV/AIDS cases surge in Fiji; Fiji declares a national health emergency to expand testing, prevention, and treatment. In 2025, 2,016 HIV infections were diagnosed, about 16 times higher than 2019. Adult prevalence is about 1 in 60; about 2 in 100 pregnant women are HIV-positive. Among births in 2025, 59 infants were HIV-infected, with 18 dying before age one. Authorities will broaden free rapid testing, prevention for high-risk groups, harm-reduction for injecting-drug users, and free HIV treatment. Fiji, a 900,000-population archipelago, faces concentrated transmission among injecting-drug users; sexual transmission accounts for over half of known cases, and over 42% of cases involve contaminated injecting equipment. The Pacific nation is a drug transit hub to Australia and New Zealand; Australia, New Zealand, India, Global Fund, and UN support the response. UN AIDS urges regional cooperation; local officials cite rising transmission since 2019.

triage.headline_ja: フィジー諸島でHIV感染症例が急増、「国家緊急事態」を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 2019年比16倍のHIV感染急増と乳児死亡を受けフィジーが国家緊急事態を宣言しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 本事案はフィジーで発生しており、対象国リスト（インド含む）に該当しないため verified_locations は空とした。インドは支援国として言及されているのみで発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Drone reforça busca por focos do Aedes aegypti em São Francisco do Glória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drone steps up search for Aedes aegypti breeding sites in São Francisco do Glória.
article.articleSummary: Drone-assisted aerial surveillance targets Aedes aegypti breeding sites in São Francisco do Glória. Conducted by Tech Dengue in partnership with the municipality’s endemic agents, the operation aims to identify risk points for mosquito proliferation and dengue transmission. The drone expands the observation area, enabling access to terrain traditionally hard to reach, broadening inspection reach and enhancing preventive actions. The collaboration fuses high-altitude surveillance with on-the-ground vector control expertise, guiding where interventions are needed most. Officials say the monitoring is part of a continuous effort to locate risk points and prioritize measures where they will have the greatest impact, reinforcing public health vigilance and population participation. Source: Prefeitura de São Francisco do Glória.

triage.headline_ja: ドローンがサンフランシスコ・ド・グロリアでネッタイシマカの発生源調査を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防的な蚊媒介対策活動に関する記事であり、疾病発生や異常事態を示す内容はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の予防的なベクターコントロール（ドローンによる蚊の発生源調査）に関する内容であり、実際の症例発生や流行についての報告ではない。ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州の一自治体の活動報告であり、対象国であるブラジルにおける疾病発生自体を報じるものではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Relatório de drone vai orientar ações contra a dengue em São Sebastião da Vargem Alegre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drone report will guide actions to combat dengue in São Sebastião da Vargem Alegre.
article.articleSummary: Drone imagery over São Sebastião da Vargem Alegre, Brazil, guides dengue control by mapping potential Aedes aegypti risk areas. TecDengue conducted another overflight to identify breeding sites and zones with transmission risk. The next step is a report detailing the precise locations captured, enabling field teams to target interventions where signals of risk are strongest. By turning aerial data into territory-specific action, the municipality aims to strengthen dengue control and transmission prevention. The recent flight continues a program of aerial surveillance for the city, combining technology with on-the-ground teams to improve outbreak vigilance and public health responses. The resulting map-based planning tool will inform prioritized attention and resource allocation at sites identified during the flight.
