triage.headline_ja: ドローン報告がサン・セバスティアン・ダ・ヴァルジェン・アレグレでのデング熱対策を導く
triage.triage_reason: デング熱対策のためのルーチン的なドローン監視・予防活動に関する内容であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増などの兆候は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の自治体（São Sebastião da Vargem Alegre）における予防的なベクター対策（ドローンによる蚊の繁殖地マッピング）を紹介する内容で、症例数や流行状況についての言及はない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、記事の焦点は日常的な公衆衛生対策であり、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : les équipes médicales face à une épidémie d'Ebola meurtrière
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: medical teams confront a deadly Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains grappling with a deadly Ebola outbreak. Medical teams operate under strenuous conditions as burials require deep digging since corpses remain contagious after death, making funeral rites hazardous. In the eastern region, violence hampers humanitarian work and access to remote areas remains difficult. On Wednesday, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said there are signs of progress in Ituri province. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare Ebola species. The situation occurs within a broader context of several outbreaks across regions. Last week, Congolese authorities announced the outbreak had spread to seven provinces—the fastest progression ever recorded for this disease—and there are, at present, no signs of slowdown.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:医療チームが致死的なエボラ流行に立ち向かう
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで7州に拡大し過去最速の進行を見せており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 希少なBundibugyoエボラウイルス種による流行で、東部の治安悪化が対応を困難にしている。WHOも進捗確認に関与しており、7州への拡大は過去最速とされる。

article.articleHeadline: O comércio de animais exóticos representa um risco crescente de doenças zoonóticas na Índia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The trade in exotic animals poses an increasing risk of zoonotic diseases in India.
article.articleSummary: Exotic-animal trade in India raises zoonotic risk as humans live in close contact with imported wildlife, many removed from habitats and kept in transit or informal settings. In Mumbai, veterinarian Rina Dev treats exotic birds and seized animals and worries about contracting pneumonia-like infections from patients. Psittacosis (ornithosis) from birds can transmit to humans via secretions and droppings, earning the label 'bird handler’s disease.' Birds, reptiles, and primates in commerce carry diverse pathogens: salmonellosis in reptiles; tuberculosis in primates; avian influenza viruses in birds. Human-primate contact raises concern for Ebola and HIV as examples of cross-species transmission. Illegal trafficking compounds risk due to lax quarantine and safety gear shortages among inspectors. Global analyses show traded mammals are 1.5 times more likely to share pathogens with humans than non-traded mammals; each decade, a traded species gains another pathogen. One Health calls for integrated human–animal–environment health responses in India.

triage.headline_ja: 外来動物取引がインドで人獣共通感染症のリスクを高めている
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの報告はなく一般的なリスク解説記事だが、複数の人獣共通感染症（オウム病、鳥インフルエンザ、結核、エボラ、HIV等）のリスクに言及しており、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定のアウトブレイクではなく、外来動物取引による人獣共通感染症の構造的リスクを論じる解説記事。具体的な患者数・地域拡大・渡航制限等の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Melonjak, Ini Imbauan Kemenkes untuk Orang Tua : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Cases Surge, Here Is the Ministry of Health's Advisory for Parents: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in several cities in Indonesia, though national levels remain not significantly elevated and are considered controllable, according to the Ministry of Health. In Jakarta, spokesperson Aji Muhawarman noted a rise in some areas, with the issue largely affecting children, including toddlers, while the elderly are also vulnerable. Reports on social media describe children with influenza-like illness and positive nasopharyngeal swabs; one example cited a Threads post about a child with fever lasting more than three days and a positive test, despite routine influenza vaccination. Symptoms are typical—fever and respiratory symptoms—and can resemble COVID, with swabs of the same type. Authorities emphasize that cases are being monitored, and antivirals were administered after diagnosis in at least one case. The situation prompts a parental advisory and continued vigilance as of 2026-09-17.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA症例が急増、保健省による保護者への注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: ジャカルタでインフルエンザA症例の増加が報告されているが、保健省は国レベルでは著しい増加ではなく管理可能と評価しており、IHR基準には該当しない。子供・高齢者への影響やSNSでの話題化があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの局地的増加であり、保健省は管理可能と発言。重症例や死亡についての言及はなく、SNSでの個別報告が主な情報源。続報の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 8 Metro Manila hospitals reach full capacity for leptospirosis
article.articleSummary: Eight Metro Manila hospitals have reached full designated bed capacity for leptospirosis. East Avenue Medical Center (53 beds) is fully occupied; Quirino Memorial Medical Center and Tondo Medical Center are also full. Amang Rodriguez Memorial Medical Center (17) and Jose R. Reyes Memorial Medical Center (11) remain saturated. Several other DOH hospitals show few or no beds left for leptospirosis, while 12 DOH hospitals still have 128 beds available, with San Lazaro Hospital (34) and Philippine Children's Medical Center (26) among the more overloaded of the available facilities. San Lazaro leads in current cases (86), followed by NKTI (17) and Rizal Medical Center (15), together accounting for 235 admissions (81.6% of all). Nationwide leptospirosis infections total 8,317 this year, up 14% from 7,280; DOH called for continued inter-facility referral and coordination to manage the surge.

triage.headline_ja: マニラ首都圏の8病院がレプトスピラ症患者でベッド満床に
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン全国でレプトスピラ症感染者が前年比14%増の8,317人に達し、マニラ首都圏の複数病院が病床満床となるなど医療逼迫が生じており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と政府（DOH）の対応が確認されるため。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はフィリピンで雨季・洪水時に毎年発生する風土病であり、感染経路はヒト-ヒト感染ではなく水・動物由来。ただし今回は病床逼迫という医療キャパシティへの深刻な影響がみられ、DOHによる病院間連携強化の呼びかけがなされている点でシグナルとして注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Fiji declares HIV emergency amid rising infection
article.articleSummary: Fiji declared HIV a national crisis on September 15 as part of a declared emergency to address growing infections. In 2025, Fiji recorded 2,016 new HIV diagnoses, about 16 times the 2019 total. Roughly one in 60 adults lives with HIV, up from one in 167 five years earlier. Among pregnant women, 2 in 100 are living with HIV; 59 babies were born with HIV in 2025, with 18 dying before their first birthday. Expanded testing is helping identify undiagnosed cases, enabling earlier treatment. The government is expanding free HIV testing, prevention services and treatment, including rapid testing, prevention medicine for people at higher risk (PrEP), harm-reduction for people who inject drugs, and free treatment for diagnosed people. International partners supporting the response include Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the United Nations.

triage.headline_ja: フィジー、感染急増を受けHIV緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: フィジーにおけるHIV感染急増事案であり、対象国（インド等）は国際支援国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため、対象外としてDISMISSと判定。
triage.notes: インド、オーストラリア、ニュージーランドは国際支援提供国として言及されているのみで、発生国はフィジー（対象国リスト外）であるため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : 63 cas confirmés interceptés depuis 15 mai aux points de contrôle (PNHF) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: 63 confirmed cases intercepted since May 15 at checkpoints (PNHF) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) surveillance in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, reports 431 alerts at border entry points since May 2026, with 380 validated and 63 confirmed EVD cases intercepted and transferred to Ebola Treatment Centers (ETCs). A total of 114 corpses were intercepted, 17 testing positive post-mortem. Dr. Théophile Ponde, provincial coordinator of the National Border Hygiene Program (PNHF/Ituri), notes that systematic traveler screening enables detection, investigation, isolation, and routing of alerts to ETCs to interrupt transmission and limit imported cases. The data illustrate border surveillance’s role in early case detection and reduced spread, as alerts are routinely investigated and directed to appropriate care facilities. Border entry points remain a crucial component of the outbreak response in Ituri as of 17 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱:5月15日以降、検問所で63人の感染確定者を摘発 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、確定症例63例、死亡例(遺体からの陽性17例)が報告されており、IHR基準の複数(深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際拡大リスク)に該当するため。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致死率が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染するため、確定症例数(63例)と死亡例(17例の遺体陽性)が報告されている時点で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が高い。国境検問所での監視体制強化が言及されており、既に対応が進行中だが、フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Фиджи объявили национальный кризис из-за распространения ВИЧ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiji declared a national crisis due to the spread of HIV.
article.articleSummary: Fiji declares HIV nationwide crisis amid a sharp rise in new infections. In 2025, Fiji identified over 2,000 HIV infections, about 16 times higher than 2019. Current estimates place HIV prevalence at roughly 1 in 60 adults. Among pregnant women, the infection is detected in 2 of 100. In 2025, 59 children were born with HIV, with 18 of those infections resulting in intrauterine death. The government will expand rapid HIV testing, prevention, and provide free treatment nationwide. Fiji is receiving support from the United Nations, Australia, New Zealand, and India. Eamon Murphy, Regional Director of UNAIDS for the Pacific, called the declaration a call to action, noting that regional cooperation and sustained international solidarity can help alter the epidemic’s trajectory. Global context: WHO reports about 41 million people living with HIV worldwide in 2025, with over 32 million on treatment.

triage.headline_ja: フィジー、HIV感染拡大により国家的危機を宣言
triage.triage_reason: フィジーにおけるHIV感染拡大の記事であり、対象国（India等）は支援国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: フィジーは対象国リストに含まれず、インド・オーストラリア・ニュージーランドは支援提供国として記載されているのみでイベント発生国ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: La Unión Africana niega que el brote de ébola haya alcanzado su punto álgido en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The African Union denies that the Ebola outbreak has reached its peak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists; Africa Union CDC says the peak has not been reached. As of September 15, 2026, there are 7,404 infections and 3,577 confirmed deaths. The outbreak spans 62 health zones in seven provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ubangi del Sur. Community transmission drives the majority of fatalities (about 69%), with more than 70% of new cases from the community and roughly 32,000 people on the contact list for over 7,000 confirmed cases. North Kivu reports bed occupancy over 143%. Vaccination began in late August with Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine), though no proven treatment or vaccine exists for Bundibugyo; the vaccine shows positive signals against Bundibugyo in animals. Uganda reported 20 cases (15 imported, 2 deaths) before the WHO ended that outbreak on Aug 26. ECG urged strengthened response, improved contact tracing, free essential services, and vaccination support.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行がピークに達したとの見方を否定
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,404感染・3,577死亡、7州62保健地区に拡大しコミュニティ感染が主体という大規模かつ重症度の高いエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行であり、ウガンダへの拡大歴もあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの関連発生（20例、2死亡）はWHOにより8月26日に終息宣言済みだが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRC国内のアウトブレイクは継続中で病床占有率143%など医療体制への圧迫も深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: La riposte contre Ebola à la frontière de Kasindi perturbe les échanges commerciaux
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola response at the Kasindi border disrupts trade.
article.articleSummary: Ebola response at the Kasindi border between the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Beni, North Kivu) and Uganda leads to border closure, disrupting cross-border trade and worsening local livelihoods. Merchants can no longer travel to Uganda for procurement, forcing costlier transfers and causing shipments to slow—from about one week to as much as three months. The economic impact extends to consumers, with staple prices rising; for example, a carton of mayonnaise in Kampala increased from $68 to $73. Households report strained purchasing power and higher living costs as markets adjust to the disruption. Officials and traders anticipate a return to normal trade only after the Ebola outbreak is contained and border circuits reopen. The article provides no epidemiological data (case or death counts) beyond noting the epidemic as the rationale for the measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：カシンディ国境でのエボラ対応が貿易を混乱させる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクに伴う国境閉鎖がDRC・ウガンダ間の貿易を混乱させており、国際的な影響（渡航・貿易制限）が確認されるためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの疫学データ（症例数・死亡数）を含まず、国境閉鎖による経済的影響に焦点を当てている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。既存の北キブ州アウトブレイクの継続報道と考えられるが、越境貿易制限という国際的影響がある点でIHR基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la société civile plaide pour l'installation d'un centre de traitement à Mungamba - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Civil society advocates for the establishment of an Ebola treatment center in Mungamba - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, civil society in Mungamba, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is advocating for the construction of an Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) in Mungamba, within the Komanda health zone of Irumu Territory. The local coordination notes there is currently no facility to manage Ebola-positive cases; teams arrive for dignified and secure burials (EDS) and then depart. Residents must travel about 25 kilometers to Komanda on a poorly maintained road to access specialized care, a barrier many cannot afford to overcome. This situation risks delaying treatment and increasing deaths, as symptomatic patients (diarrhea, vomiting) must traverse the distance, potentially exposing others. The coalition calls health authorities and response partners to establish a care facility in Mungamba to enable rapid access to care and reduce community deaths tied to transport challenges.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：市民社会がムンガンバへのエボラ治療センター設置を訴える - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、治療施設不足により症例管理・搬送に支障が生じており、地域内感染拡大と死亡増加のリスクが指摘されているため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国イツリ州コマンダ保健地区ムンガンバでの既存エボラアウトブレイクにおける治療センター不足問題を報じている。座標データに一部矛盾（Mungambaの座標がイツリ州と異なる）があるが、記事本文の記述に基づきDRCと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : un appel à l'existence d'Ebola et les mesures barrières - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: an appeal for the existence of Ebola and barrier measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: On September 17, 2026, Kisangani in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo saw an Ebola virus disease (EVD) awareness appeal. Dr. Saidon Muricho, a physician at the Ebola Treatment Center in Tshopo, urged residents to acknowledge the disease’s existence and to adopt preventive measures to curb transmission. He described EVD symptoms as fever, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and potentially bleeding, advising the public to avoid direct contact with symptomatic individuals. Emphasis was placed on regular hand hygiene using soap, alcohol-based sanitizers, or chlorinated solutions. The message reinforces belief in the disease and personal protection, rather than social isolation, noting that markets, churches, and workplaces should remain accessible so long as preventive practices are followed to reduce spread. The appeal was conveyed to ACP.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニでのエボラ出血熱：エボラの存在認識と感染予防策を求める呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニでエボラ治療センターの存在が示唆されており、エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であるためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は住民への啓発呼びかけが主体であり、症例数や死亡者数、感染拡大状況の具体的データは記載されていない。エボラ治療センターの存在から現地でのアウトブレイク対応が継続中と推測されるが、詳細確認のため続報の注視とフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 最毒變異株PJ.2.1 引發中國重症猝死者暴增 | 新冠變異株 | 中國疫情 | 重症患者
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Deadliest Variant PJ.2.1 Triggers a Surge in China's Critical Cases and Sudden Deaths
article.articleSummary: SARS-CoV-2 variant PJ.2.1 is driving a surge of critical COVID-19 cases and sudden deaths in northern China, according to internal data cited by Beijing researchers. A Changping Laboratory team led by Cao Yunlong characterizes PJ.2.1 as a saltational, highly mutated variant with markedly stronger ACE2 binding than NB.1.8.1, XFG, or BA.3.2.2, enabling rapid cell entry. Its ancestor traces to KP.3.1.1 (JN.1 lineage) from 2024, likely arising from a chronic infection in an immunocompromised person in Ontario, Canada, and later disseminated intercontinentally via wastewater signals. Wastewater surveillance showed an August peak; northern sentinel hospitals report rising severe cases and deaths, especially in Hebei and Shanxi, with Jilin and Liaoning also affected. Reports indicate a high proportion of sudden deaths due to cardiac arrest and vascular/cerebral complications. Authorities allegedly conceal data; there is no antiviral; airborne transmission persists. Protective guidance emphasizes N95 masks in crowded settings like hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: 最も毒性が強い変異株PJ.2.1が中国で重症患者・突然死の急増を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1による重症・突然死増加の主張があるが、情報源（新唐人電視台）は非公式・政治的立場の強いメディアであり、公式統計や独立検証がなく、具体的な症例数等のデータも不明のため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 情報源は法輪功系メディア（新唐人電視台）であり、中国当局への批判的立場が強く、「データ隠蔽」等の主張は独立検証されていない。公式統計・WHO報告等の確認が必要。カナダ（Ontario）は変異株起源の推定地として言及されているが、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases top 7,400 in DR Congo as outbreak shifts
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shifts, with Ituri as the long-time epicenter and North Kivu rising. As of 2026-09-15, the DRC reports 7,404 confirmed cases, 3,577 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%), and 1,776 recoveries across 62 health zones in seven provinces. Ituri accounts for 77.7% of cases, and the peak there is passed, while North Kivu becomes a growing hotspot. Treatment facilities report a 94.7% bed-occupancy rate with 373 patients hospitalized. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus notes encouraging signs in Ituri but warns weekly cases in North Kivu doubled from about 100 to over 200, describing the situation as many outbreaks in many places. This is the deadliest outbreak in DRC history and the world's second-largest since 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ感染者数が7,400人を超え、流行の中心が移動
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行で7,400例超・致死率48.3%、北キブ州で週次感染者数が倍増するなど拡大傾向にあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が『多くの場所で多くの流行が起きている』と表現。イトゥリ州はピークを過ぎたが北キブ州で新規感染が急増しており、地理的拡大・多州化が懸念される。CFR48.3%、病床占有率94.7%と医療体制への負荷も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Medical teams in DRC face difficult conditions as the race to contain Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo strain has exceeded 7,000 confirmed cases and more than 3,000 deaths since the outbreak was declared in mid-May. Medical teams, including MSF, operate under brutal conditions amid ongoing conflict in eastern DRC, facing violence, difficulty accessing remote areas, and community hostility over bodies of the deceased. The outbreak has spread to seven Congolese provinces, with confirmed infections and deaths continuing, though authorities say the rate may be slowing and the outbreak may have peaked. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain. Uganda reports 20 cases and two deaths linked to imported DRC cases, but has been declared Ebola-free. The response confronts security risks, logistical hurdles, and the challenge of tracking exposed people while trying to deliver care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の医療チーム、エボラ流行封じ込めのため過酷な状況に直面
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで7000例超・3000人超の死者を出し、7州に拡大、ウガンダへも越境感染しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療法未承認、紛争地域での対応困難など重大な公衆衛生リスクが継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Food Poisoning Suspected As 15 Students Fall Ill In Sangareddy
article.articleSummary: Fifteen students at a government school in Sangareddy district, Telangana, fell ill after eating biryani provided by the vice principal during lunch at ZPHS in Peddalodi village, Munipalli mandal, on Sept 17. The affected pupils were rushed to Sadasivpet Government Hospital where they remain under observation; the vice principal, Venkateshwarlu, was initially treated but later moved to Sangareddy Government Hospital in serious condition. Authorities say a food poisoning diagnosis is suspected following the school lunch, though officials have not yet confirmed the cause. Parents gathered at the hospitals amid concerns for their children. Officials are expected to ascertain the illness's source; further details are awaited as the investigation continues.

triage.headline_ja: サンガレディで生徒15人が体調不良、食中毒の疑い
triage.triage_reason: 単一の学校給食による食中毒疑いの局所事例であり、国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められず、社会的関心も限定的と考えられる。
triage.notes: 食中毒（食品由来）の局地的事例で、感染症のヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低いと考えられる。原因物質・病原体は未特定。

article.articleHeadline: Flughafen-Malaria: Entwarnung für BER, dritter Toter in Frankfurt am Main
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Airport Malaria: All Clear for BER, Third Death in Frankfurt am Main
article.articleSummary: Airport malaria deaths and infections near Frankfurt am Main rise; three people have died and five more are infected in the airport vicinity, while Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER) in Schönefeld is deemed not at risk due to no direct flights to malaria areas; BER staff are advised to seek malaria testing if symptoms appear. The southern BER routes (Egypt, Morocco, Doha) are not malaria regions; China is malaria-free. In Frankfurt, six airport employees and two nearby residents were infected between July and September; the two residents in Schwanheim had no recent international travel, suggesting domestic transmission. The Robert Koch Institute bulletin (Sept 17) attributes infections to Anopheles mosquitoes imported by aircraft; human-to-human transmission is not possible. Since 2015 Germany has eight airport malaria cases, all linked to Frankfurt, with eight cases in 2026. Climate change may enhance survival of imported mosquitoes; clinicians should consider malaria in feverish patients near airports and provide rapid treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 空港マラリア：BERは安全宣言、フランクフルト・アム・マインで3人目の死亡
triage.triage_reason: ドイツ・フランクフルト空港での「空港マラリア」事例であり、対象国（ザンビア・フィリピン・タイ・ガーナ・DRC・ブラジル・インドネシア・中国・ミャンマー・ベトナム・インド）のいずれにも該当しない。中国等は「マラリアフリー」との文脈で言及されているのみで発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツ国内（フランクフルト空港周辺）での空港マラリア（蚊媒介による輸入マラリア、ヒト-ヒト感染なし）の発生を報じており、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases cross 7,400 as outbreak shifts to North Kivu
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 7,404 confirmed cases and 3,577 deaths, with a case fatality rate of 48.3% and 1,776 recoveries. The outbreak spans 62 health zones across seven provinces, with Ituri as the epicentre, accounting for 77.7% of all confirmed cases. Transmission is easing in Ituri, which has passed a peak and entered a downward slope, but is rising rapidly in North Kivu where 373 patients are hospitalized and bed occupancy reaches 94.7%. North Kivu weekly cases have nearly doubled over two weeks, from about 100 to more than 200, indicating multiple outbreaks across a vast area. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cautioned that the epidemic is expanding despite encouraging signs in some areas. This is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history and the second-largest globally after 2014–2016.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ患者数が7,400人を超え、流行の中心が北キブ州へ移行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生上深刻、異常な規模、国際的拡大リスク）に加え、WHO事務局長も拡大への懸念を表明しており、フルリスク評価が必要な重大シグナルと判断。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大・最悪のエボラ流行であり、2014-2016年流行に次ぐ世界第2位の規模。Ituri州では減少傾向だが北キブ州で急速に拡大しており、病床占有率94.7%と医療体制への負荷が深刻。渡航・貿易制限の有無については記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : une causerie communautaire au profit des leaders à Kisangani - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: a community talk for the benefit of leaders in Kisangani - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 17 September 2026, in Kisangani, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, a community talk on Ebola virus disease (EVD) was held to inform leaders of civil-society organizations and mobilize community support. Organized by Action for Justice, Development and Human Rights, the session aimed to raise awareness of EVD and reduce local resistance. Jedidia Mabela, the executive director, said the campaign targets all segments of Kisangani and surrounding areas. Four main obstacles were identified: denial of Ebola's existence; mystification of the Ebola Treatment Center (ETC); misinformation and rumors spreading on social media; and reluctance to comply with safe burial protocols. Additional discussions will target religious leaders, traditional chiefs, and notables to promote barrier measures and fight Ebola, under the theme: 'Ebola exists and kills, protect yourself and save your community.'

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国ツォポ州のエボラ：キサンガニでリーダー向けコミュニティ対話を実施
triage.triage_reason: 既知のDRCエボラ流行下でのコミュニティ啓発活動に関する記事であり、新規感染拡大や症例数増加などの具体的な新情報は含まれていないが、エボラという重大疾患の継続的リスクがあるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はNGO主導のコミュニティ啓発（デナイアル、埋葬儀礼への抵抗、誤情報拡散への対応）を報じるもので、感染者数や地域拡大に関する新規データは含まれていない。既存のDRCエボラ流行に関する継続報道として位置づけられ、フルRRAの新規トリガーというより既存対応の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bunia : chlore produit localement présenté aux étudiants comme moyen de prévention - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bunia: locally produced chlorine presented to students as a means of prevention - ACP
article.articleSummary: During the Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in Bunia, Ituri Province, North-East Democratic Republic of the Congo, a locally produced liquid chlorine solution made from kitchen salt and water was showcased at the Institut supérieur pédagogique (ISP) Bunia to bolster prevention measures. The Congo Connect NGO, via program officer Charles Bahati, demonstrated a chlorine-production machine and explained its operation to help curb transmission by improving hygiene. In addition, handwashing facilities were donated to strengthen sanitation within the higher education institution. The initiative aims to empower students and the university community to enhance awareness and participation in the response, with the overarching objective of breaking the transmission chain as part of the Ebola outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでのエボラ出血熱：地元で製造された塩素が学生に予防手段として紹介される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ブニアでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する報道であり、疾患の重篤性と地域社会への継続的な曝露が確認されるため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行下での予防活動（地元製造の塩素消毒液の紹介）に関する内容であり、新規症例数や死亡者数などの疫学データは含まれていないが、エボラという疾患特性上、既知のアウトブレイク継続中である可能性が高く注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nutrition Packets Given to 76 TB Patients in Varanasi Drive
article.articleSummary: Nutrition packets were distributed to 76 tuberculosis patients at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapeeth in Varanasi on September 17, 2026, as part of the Seva Sankalp Abhiyan. Vice Chancellor Anand Kumar Tyagi handed over the packets in the presence of faculty and District Tuberculosis Officer Dr. Piyush Rai. The initiative seeks to provide TB patients with nutritious food, social support, and continued treatment, while fostering public participation in TB eradication in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh. Chief Medical Officer N P Singh underscored that an adequate, balanced diet and regular medication are crucial for recovery, and urged families, society, and institutions to support patients through completion of treatment. The packets were prepared by self-help groups, including women’s groups, highlighting community involvement. Attendees were urged to spread awareness about TB and contribute to making the district TB-free through sustained treatment adherence and nutrition support.

triage.headline_ja: バラナシで結核患者76人に栄養パックを配布
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核患者支援活動に関する広報的な記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規リスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 地域の結核撲滅キャンペーン（栄養支援配布）に関する通常の活動報告であり、感染拡大や異常事象の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola nu este sub control, avertizează Africa CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is not under control, warns Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled, Africa CDC warns, a day after WHO noted encouraging signs. The 17th outbreak, declared mid-May, spans seven eastern provinces with Ituri as the origin. As of Sept 15, 3,577 deaths and 7,404 cases have been reported. The epidemic has spread to distant eastern and northern regions, overwhelming health responses amid high population mobility, zone isolation, and attacks on aid workers. Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya says case numbers have stagnated, but data do not prove a peak or that the outbreak is under control. Government spokesman Patrick Muyaya indicated the peak occurred early August, yet data remain incomplete. WHO Director-General Tedros noted encouraging signs but warned the response will continue for months. No vaccine or treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain; about 70,000 doses of Ervebo (Zaire strain) have been shipped to DRC to assess its utility against Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行は制御下にない、とアフリカCDCが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準も全て該当する重大なエボラ流行であり、国際機関の高い関心が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国東部（イトゥリ州起源）での第17次エボラ流行。2026年9月15日時点で死者3,577人、症例7,404人。Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・治療法が存在せず、Ervebo（Zaire株用）約7万回分の有効性評価が進行中。WHOとアフリカCDCの見解に相違があり、流行の制御状況について不確実性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: La Unión Africana niega que el brote de ébola en Congo haya alcanzado su punto álgido
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The African Union denies that the Ebola outbreak in Congo has reached its peak.
article.articleSummary: AU public health agency denies that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has peaked, saying data do not confirm a peak as of Sept 15. Declared May 15 in eastern DRC, the outbreak has 7,404 cases and 3,577 confirmed deaths, with transmission not yet consistently controlled. Officials view a plateau rather than a decline, with more than 70% of new cases from the community and about 32,000 on the contact list for over 7,000 confirmed cases. The ECG urges maintaining the continental public health emergency for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, intensifying response, prioritizing North Kivu (bed occupancy >143%), and urgently addressing community deaths. No treatments or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo; vaccination with Ervebo began in DRC, with some positive animal data. The outbreak covers 62 health zones across seven provinces. Uganda reported 20 cases (2 deaths), including 15 imports from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合、コンゴのエボラ流行がピークに達したことを否定
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（7,404症例、3,577死亡）が継続し、地域拡大（ウガンダへの越境輸入例）や医療体制逼迫（病床占有率143%超）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの流行が主題であり、越境例の情報として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mưa lớn nối dài, cảnh báo dịch sốt xuất huyết tăng cao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prolonged heavy rains, warning that the dengue fever outbreak is on the rise.
article.articleSummary: Prolonged rains in Vietnam fuel dengue outbreaks. About 100,000 cases and 20 deaths have been reported nationwide in 2026, a 1.5x rise versus 2025, with hotspots in the Southern provinces and the Central Highlands. Dak Lak: 6,715 cases, 2 deaths, 314 outbreaks (90 active). Dong Nai: >11,500 cases; Tay Ninh: >8,430; Gia Lai: 5,680 (all by end August) with fatalities. Ho Chi Minh City >31,000 cases; week of 31 Aug–6 Sep adds 1,338. Severe case: 16-year-old girl requiring ECMO; high treatment costs. Hanoi: 2,769 cases in 2026, 118 wards, 124 outbreaks; Ha Dong hotspot with 43 cases in week 37. Emphasis on early diagnosis; avoid NSAIDs; Qdenga vaccine licensed in Vietnam (two doses; >80% protection at 12 months; >90% hospitalization reduction at 18 months) with rollout to children from age 4 and adults.

triage.headline_ja: 長雨続き、デング熱流行拡大の警戒警報
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム全国でデング熱症例が前年比1.5倍に増加し、死者20名・重症例（ECMO使用）も発生。長雨による蚊媒介感染拡大が継続する見込みで、WPRO基準の複数項目に該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年季節性に流行する疾患のため、IHR基準の『異常性』は低いと判断。ただし前年比1.5倍増、死者20名、重症例発生、長雨継続による蚊媒介リスク継続からWPRO基準では複数該当。ワクチン（Qdenga）導入など対応策も進行中で、現時点では国内対応能力の範囲内と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Santé : confirmation de l'épidémie Mpox au Kasaï - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health: Confirmation of the Mpox epidemic in Kasai - ACP
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (Variole du singe) outbreak officially confirmed in Kasai Province, central Democratic Republic of Congo, as of 17 September 2026, with five health zones affected: Mushenge, Kanzala, Dekese, Luebo and Ilebo. Provincial authorities announced the public health emergency after a resurgence of Monkeypox, with both suspected and confirmed cases being reported across the zones. The government, in coordination with the Ministry of Public Health, the Public Health Emergency Operations Center, and technical partners, rapidly deployed an emergency response plan to stop virus transmission. The outbreak's confirmation comes 9 months after the end of Ebola in Bulape, Mweka Territory. No case counts are provided in the report. The statement emphasizes protecting families and communities and maintaining urgent action to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 保健:カサイ州でMpox（サル痘）流行を確認 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCカサイ州で5つの保健区にわたりMpoxの流行が確認され、州当局が公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言、緊急対応計画が発動されたため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事にはケースカウントが記載されておらず重症度は不明。ケニアは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文ではDRCカサイ州のみが主題であるため除外。DRCではMpox Clade Iの流行が既に国際的懸念事項となっており、資源不足地域での再流行のため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: हिमालयी फल में खोजा बैक्टीरिया-फंगस से लड़ने वाला फॉर्मूला, उत्तराखंड के वैज्ञानिकों को मिली बड़ी सफलता - uttarakhand scientists develop seabuckthorn nanoparticles for infection control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A formula found in Himalayan fruit to fight bacteria and fungi, a major breakthrough for Uttarakhand scientists - Uttarakhand scientists develop seabuckthorn nanoparticles for infection control
article.articleSummary: Uttarakhand-based researchers from Berinag Government Postgraduate College and colleagues in Pithoragarh have developed titanium dioxide nanoparticles via green synthesis using seabuckthorn extract to combat bacteria and fungi. In laboratory tests, the nanoparticles inhibited Escherichia coli and Candida albicans; upon exposure to light, they generate reactive species that damage microbial cells and DNA, effectively destroying these pathogens. The synthesis uses no harmful chemicals, making the process environmentally friendly. Potential applications include infection control in hospitals, antimicrobial drug development, safety of medical devices, and drinking-water purification systems. Led by Manoj Prasad Tamta and guided by D. Mahesh Chandra Vishwakarma and Dr. Balm Singh Bisht, with Pramod Singh Khati, Rajesh Kumar, and Priyanka Tiwari, the work received international recognition as Journal of Mountain Research (Web of Science indexed) accepted for publication. If further trials succeed, this Himalayan biodiversity-based research could open new health and environmental opportunities.

triage.headline_ja: ヒマラヤの果実に細菌・真菌と戦う成分を発見、ウッタラーカンド州の科学者らが大きな成果
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はナノ粒子による抗菌研究成果に関する科学ニュースであり、感染症の発生・アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、研究開発に関する記事のためverified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémia eboly v Kongu podľa šéfa afrického Strediska pre kontrolu a prevenciu chorôb nie je pod kontrolou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo, according to the head of Africa CDC, is not under control.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, the Ebola outbreak in Congo (the 17th outbreak there) has 7,404 reported cases and 3,577 deaths. Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya says the epidemic is not under control, though case counts have stabilized at a level and are slightly declining. The World Health Organization notes progress but warns that armed violence, displacement, healthcare worker strikes, and large population movements complicate response. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo virus variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. By late August Congo received thousands of Ervebo doses and began vaccination, but Ervebo targets a different variant, and its effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains uncertain. WHO projects the current outbreak could surpass West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic, which killed over 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、アフリカCDC責任者によれば制御下にない
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラ流行が7,404例・3,577死亡に達し、Africa CDC責任者が「制御下にない」と発言。ワクチン効果不確実で武力衝突・人口移動により拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCのみに言及しており、Angolaでの発生については記載がないため除外した。Bundibugyoウイルス変異株に対するワクチン（Ervebo）の有効性が不確実であることが特に懸念される点。

article.articleHeadline: Pernambuco confirma quarta morte por dengue em 2026 - Portal CBN Recife
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pernambuco confirms fourth dengue death in 2026 - CBN Recife Portal
article.articleSummary: Pernambuco, Brazil, confirms its fourth dengue death in 2026. The deceased is a 60-year-old man from Olinda who died on May 7; he had comorbidities. The state’s Arboviruses Epidemiological Bulletin No. 36 covers data from January 4 to September 12, 2026, amid rising dengue activity: 47,418 suspected cases, up 37% from the same period in 2025, with 11,368 confirmed and 686 classified as severe. Dengue incidence varies across the state: 82 municipalities with low, 56 with medium, and 41 with high incidence. In addition, there are 6,653 chikungunya notifications, with 363 confirmed, and 1,235 Zika notifications, with no confirmations through September 12. The bulletin highlights ongoing arboviral transmission across Pernambuco.

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブコ州、2026年4例目のデング熱死亡例を確認 - CBN Recifeポータル
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数が前年比37%増加し重症例も発生しているが、ブラジルの風土病的な季節性流行の範囲内であり国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ペルナンブコ州における季節性デング熱流行の定期疫学速報。症例数増加と重症例の報告はあるが、地域的・風土病的流行であり国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Teen boy dies of dengue in Kalyan hospital; cops register ADR
article.articleSummary: 17-year-old Yug Krishna Dhamne from Ulhasnagar, Thane district, died of dengue complications at Fortis Hospital, Kalyan West, on Sep 16 after initial testing confirmed dengue and deterioration led to transfer from Goongi Hospital. His father reported a high fever prior to hospital admission; a pathology test had already confirmed dengue on Sep 13. He was admitted to Goongi Hospital on Sep 13, then moved to Fortis on Sep 16 where he died at 1 pm during treatment. Dengue is a notifiable disease in Maharashtra, and an Accidental Death Report (ADR) has been registered at Bazarpeth police station under BNSS Section 194, with a further probe ongoing. No details about the infection source or imported/exported cases are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: カリヤン市の病院でデング熱により10代少年が死亡、警察は事故死報告書（ADR）を登録
triage.triage_reason: 単一の死亡例報告であり、インドで流行しているデング熱の一般的な死亡例に過ぎず、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はマハラシュトラ州で通報義務のある既知の流行病であり、本件は個別の死亡例報告に過ぎない。地域的な流行状況の急激な変化を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Cas de chikungunya à La Rochelle : " un brouillard fin et froid " pulvérisé par les techniciens du service de démoustication
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Chikungunya in La Rochelle: "a fine, cold fog" sprayed by technicians from the mosquito-control service.
article.articleSummary: One adolescent girl contracted chikungunya during a trip to Indonesia, in the La Rochelle area of Charente-Maritime, France. The intervention, coordinated by the Regional Health Agency (ARS), occurred overnight September 16–17, 2026, with two mosquito-control technicians dispersing deltamethrin from a vehicle as a fine, cold fog across three seven-hectare zones: around the infected girl’s home (exact location not disclosed) in Charente-Maritime; at Lycée Léonce-Vieljeux in Lagord; and near the Pallice medical clinic in La Rochelle. On Thursday morning, the lycée’s outdoor furniture was washed with water as a precaution ahead of students’ return. The case is travel-associated, linked to a trip to Indonesia; no broader outbreak details were provided.

triage.headline_ja: ラ・ロシェルでのチクングニア熱症例：害虫駆除業者による『微細で冷たい霧』の散布
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア渡航歴のある単一の輸入例で、フランス国内での二次感染や重症化の報告はなく、当局による予防的な蚊駆除対応にとどまるため、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 感染はインドネシア渡航中に発生したとされるが、記事の主題はフランス（ラ・ロシェル）における予防的な蚊駆除対応であり、インドネシア国内での流行を示す情報はないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Akwai sauran rina a kaba a Kwango
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: There is still blood in the bucket in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Persistent Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a concern. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya acknowledges some easing of transmission after a period of pronounced surge, a day after the World Health Organization said it was making progress. The Ituri region in northeastern Congo continues to bear the brunt, with more than 3,500 deaths and over 7,200 infections reported across seven districts in the north and east. Despite indications of relief, the report emphasizes that substantial transmission persists, sustaining risk to residents and health workers in the affected areas. These findings reflect the current burden as of the report date.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:コンゴではまだ闘いの余地がある
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で3,500人以上の死者・7,200人超の感染者を出すエボラ流行が継続しており、WHO/Africa CDCも注視する重大な公衆衛生イベントであるためフルRRAへ進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: WHO及びAfrica CDCが継続的に監視・報告している既知の大規模流行。伝播はやや鈍化傾向にあるが、依然として高い死者数・感染者数を伴う深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC 'n'est pas sous contrôle', selon l'Africa CDC - RTBF Actus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC "is not under control," according to Africa CDC - RTBF Actus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled. The current surge is the DRC’s 17th Ebola epidemic, spanning seven eastern provinces and originating in Ituri (north-east). The hemorrhagic fever has caused 3,577 deaths and 7,404 cases as of 15 September, with responses strained in remote, unstable areas. Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya says case numbers appear to plateau, but data do not confirm a peak, and no one can claim the outbreak is under control. RDC government spokesman Patrick Muyaya said the peak was reached in early August, though data on contacts are not encouraging. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted encouraging signs but warned the response will need to continue for months. Historically, Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past 50 years, prior to this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は「制御下にない」、アフリカCDCが指摘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱流行が7州に拡大し、死者3,577人・感染者7,404人に達しており、アフリカCDCも「制御下にない」と明言している重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: アフリカCDCとWHOの見解に相違あり（政府はピーク到達を主張、Africa CDCはデータ不十分としピーク未確認）。遠隔・不安定地域での対応困難が継続的リスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू आउट ऑफ कंट्रोल? उत्तराखंड में 550 के पार हुआ आंकड़ा, 24 घंटे के अंदर चपेट में आए 24 लोग - Lalluram Uttarakhand Swine Flu Cases Cross 550
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu Out of Control? The figure in Uttarakhand has crossed 550, 24 people infected within 24 hours - Lalluram Uttarakhand Swine Flu Cases Cross 550
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) in Uttarakhand has reached 557 cases as of 17 September 2026, with 24 new infections in the last 24 hours—12 in Dehradun and 12 in other districts. Cumulative recoveries are 472; 83 remain under treatment, and two deaths have occurred. Of the 1,572 swine flu tests, Dehradun accounted for 370 positives and other districts 187. Age groups show widespread infection, including 61–70 years (94) and 1–10 years (88); more men than women. Parallel testing reports COVID-19: 53 positives from 787 samples; Dengue: 184 positives from about 30,606 samples (86 Dehradun, 98 others), with 158 recoveries and 26 under treatment. Common symptoms include high fever, chills, cough, sore throat, headache, body aches, fatigue, and sometimes nasal congestion or breathing difficulty. Prevention focuses on hand hygiene, masks, avoiding crowds, and isolation if symptomatic; authorities stress continuous monitoring and rapid response if cases rise.

triage.headline_ja: 豚インフルエンザが制御不能？ウッタラーカンド州で感染者数が550人を突破、24時間で24人感染 - Lalluram Uttarakhand Swine Flu Cases Cross 550
triage.triage_reason: インドUttarakhand州で季節性H1N1豚インフルエンザの症例が557件（死亡2名）に達し増加傾向にあるが、既知の病原体による地域限定的な流行であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性のH1N1豚インフルエンザ流行で、COVID-19やデング熱も並行して報告されているが、いずれも地域内での通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と見られる。継続的な症例数推移の監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Minas Gerais registra 14 mortes por febre maculosa em 2026, com três ocorrências em Jeceaba - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais records 14 deaths from Brazilian spotted fever in 2026, with three cases in Jeceaba - BH 24 Horas.
article.articleSummary: Febre Maculosa (Brazilian Spotted Fever) in Minas Gerais, Brazil: As of March 17, 2026, Minas Gerais has recorded 14 deaths and 39 confirmed cases from tick-borne febrile illness this year. In the Central region, Jeceaba — about 113 km from Belo Horizonte — accounts for three fatal cases, underscoring vector circulation in the area. SES-MG, working with the Barbacena Regional Health Unit, reports ongoing case notifications within expected seasonal levels, with a trend toward stabilization for now. The disease, caused by Rickettsia rickettsii, disproportionately affects adults 41–60 and is more common in men; Minas Gerais’ case fatality rate remains near 30%. Transmission is via infected ticks (carrapato-estrela); prevention focuses on personal protective equipment (long-sleeved coveralls), avoiding high-risk areas, and immediate antibiotic treatment when suspected (antibiotics supplied through SUS). Surveillance and environmental monitoring with Funed and local health authorities continue to identify risk areas and guide control.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州、2026年にブラジル紅斑熱で14人死亡、ジェセアバで3件発生
triage.triage_reason: ダニ媒介性の風土病であり、季節的に想定される範囲内で発生・安定化傾向にあると報告されている。ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクはなく、地域当局により通常の監視・対応が行われている。
triage.notes: 致死率約30%と高いが、これはブラジル紅斑熱（Rickettsia rickettsii感染症）の既知の特徴であり、地域衛生当局（SES-MG、Funed）が季節性のダニ媒介感染として通常監視・対応中。ヒト-ヒト感染性はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: TRÊS LAGOAS: Comitê de mobilização e combate ao Aedes aegypti apresenta ações e reforça importância do cuidado integral. - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Três Lagoas: Committee for Mobilization and Control of Aedes aegypti Presents Actions and Reinforces the Importance of Comprehensive Care. - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: On 17 September 2026, Três Lagoas, Brazil, via the Municipal Health Secretariat, held the 7th meeting of the Aedes aegypti Mobilization and Control Committee. The session reviewed dengue and chikungunya data, updated the municipal epidemiological scenario, and outlined dengue vaccination strategies. Actions across departments included Endemias (house visits, case and chemical blockades, rapid Aedes index surveys, community cleanups), Vigilância Epidemiológica, Entomologia (larvae/pupae surveillance, larvitraps, ovitraps, site monitoring), and Promoção da Saúde (population engagement) with emphasis on the Wolbachia project. The event registered 201 participants in recent activities at USFs Paranapungá, Joel Neves, and Miguel Nunes. The committee awards certificates to schools and institutions for prevention efforts. Emphasis on Setembro Amarelo highlighted comprehensive care, noting chronic chikungunya effects on mobility and mental health, and the need for integrated prevention, treatment, rehabilitation, and wellbeing for arboviruses (dengue, Zika, chikungunya).

triage.headline_ja: トレス・ラゴアス：ネッタイシマカ対策動員委員会が対策を発表、包括的ケアの重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 自治体の定例会議・啓発活動に関する内容であり、新規のアウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の媒介蚊対策委員会の定例活動報告であり、新規感染急増や異常事態の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC warns Ebola outbreak not 'under control'
article.articleSummary: On 17 September 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains far from controlled. It began in the conflict-scarred Ituri province and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces. The African Union reports 7,404 cases and 3,577 deaths. WHO says signs of progress, but Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya warns the outbreak is not under control and notes a plateau with a slight decrease. Congo government spokesman Patrick Muyaya said the peak occurred in the third week of August. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe internal and external bleeding and organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラ出血熱の流行は『制御下にない』と警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株、承認済みワクチン・治療薬なし）が7州に拡大し、死亡者数3,577人・致死率約48%と深刻。Africa CDCが制御下にないと警告しており、IHR基準複数・WPRO基準全般に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 紛争地帯（イトゥリ州）で発生し、対応ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行。国境を越えた国際拡大の具体的言及はないが、地理的近接国への拡大リスクは高いと考えられる。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases cross 16,000 in TN, health dept says rise not abnormal
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Tamil Nadu, led by the Chennai metropolis, totals 16,334 cases and 9 deaths from January 1 to September 16, 2026. Officials say the rise is not abnormal compared with the January–September period of 2025 (15,688 cases, 13 deaths); 2024 saw 34,339 cases and 13 deaths over the same window. Authorities attribute fluctuations to monsoon-driven Aedes breeding, with higher activity expected Oct–Dec. Public health measures include intensified surveillance, expanded prevention campaigns, and interdepartmental coordination; 3,697 workers are engaged in fever-control efforts; primary health centres report adequate medicine stocks. Fever clinics show Chennai city recording 3,404 fever cases in two weeks, 4,520 in August, and over 3,000 from Sept 1–16. Common dengue symptoms include fever, body ache, muscle pain, fatigue, and headache. No laboratory-confirmation details are provided; no specific imported/exported case data were reported.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱症例が16,000件を超える、衛生局は「異常な増加ではない」と発表
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱症例が増加しているが、衛生当局は例年と比較して異常な増加ではないと説明しており、モンスーン期の季節性流行として管理下にあるため、フルRRAへの即時移行は不要だが今後の推移（10-12月の増加予測）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・タミル・ナードゥ州における季節性・地域流行性の疾患であり、衛生当局自身が「例年と比較して異常な増加ではない」と明言している。死亡率も低く（9名/16,334例）、医薬品供給も十分とされる。10-12月にかけての媒介蚊活動増加予測があるため、続報を注視する必要はあるが、現時点で国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: В ВОЗ рассказали о ситуации с эпидемией Эболы в ДР Конго - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO spoke about the Ebola epidemic situation in DR Congo - News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda persists with 7,258 reported cases and over 3,500 deaths (case fatality rate ~48.4%); about 903 patients with illness are currently hospitalized. The outbreak was identified in late spring in DRC and Uganda. WHO Secretary-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says encouraging signs are emerging as treatments and relapse-prevention measures for recovered patients gain traction, and vaccines are soon to enter trials. Despite progress, transmission continues and fatalities rise. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor has tightened border-control measures, and Russian diagnostic tests for Ebola have shown effectiveness in Uganda. Financial Times suggested the outbreak could foreshadow a new global pandemic risk.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがDRコンゴにおけるエボラ流行の状況について発表
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴとウガンダで7,258症例・致死率約48.4%という大規模かつ重篤な流行が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な関心（FT報道、ロシアの国境措置）も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよびロシアは記事に登場するが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Paraná tem três casos suspeitos de sarampo em investigação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná has three suspected measles cases under investigation.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 September 2026, Paraná State, Brazil, is investigating three suspected measles cases. In 2026, Sesa received 116 notifications of suspected measles in Paraná; 113 were ruled out and three are under investigation; no confirmed cases in Paraná since 2020. Nationally, Brazil's Ministry of Health intensified measles surveillance in Amazonas after three confirmed cases in Tabatinga near the Brazil–Colombia–Peru tri-border, involving arrivals with unvaccinated people from Alto Monte, Peru. Across Brazil, 36 measles cases were reported in 2026, all imported—32 in São Paulo (Guarulhos, São Bernardo do Campo x2, and 29 in the capital). The country remains free of sustained community transmission. PAHO/WHO Americas notes 47,459 confirmed measles cases in the region through July, led by the United States, Mexico, Peru and Guatemala, with 44 deaths. Vaccination is free in Brazil; two-dose schedule; prevention measures include hand hygiene and well-ventilated spaces.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州で麻疹疑い3例を調査中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは麻疹排除認定国だが、国境地帯（アマゾナス州タバチンガ）でペルーからの未接種者を介した確定例が発生し、国内複数州（サンパウロ等）へ輸入例が拡大している点で異常性と国際的拡大の可能性がある。
triage.notes: パラナ州の疑い例3件は未確定で、確定例は主にアマゾナス州タバチンガ（ペルー国境）とサンパウロ州の輸入例。ブラジル全体で持続的な地域内感染はなく、輸入例中心。PAHO/WHOは米州全体で麻疹症例が拡大中（4.7万例超）と報告しており、地域的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: बारिश में इन बीमारियों से रहें सावधान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stay vigilant against these diseases during the monsoon.
article.articleSummary: Monsoon season raises infections including dengue and malaria from mosquito bites. Dengue causes high fever, headache, body aches, and pain behind the eyes; prevent by eliminating standing water around the home, using bed nets and repellents, and seeking medical care for high fever or unusual symptoms. Malaria presents with fever that may alternate with chills, sweating, and weakness; use mosquito nets and repellents as protective measures and do not ignore prolonged fever. Typhoid fever and Cholera risk increase with contaminated water and food during rains; drink only clean water, cook food thoroughly, and wash hands before meals and after using the toilet. Water from floods or dirty water can pose infection risks; avoid entering dirty water and wear rubber boots and gloves if needed. After rain, fever, muscle pain, or weakness warrants medical consultation. Enjoy the rains, but stay vigilant.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季にはこれらの病気にご注意を
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではなく、モンスーン時期の一般的な健康啓発記事であるため、シグナルとして扱う根拠がない。
triage.notes: この記事は特定の発生事例の報告ではなく、季節性の感染症予防に関する一般的な啓発コンテンツ（webstory形式）である。具体的な症例数、地域、日付等の情報は含まれていない。
