article.articleHeadline: H1N1 situation remains under watch as fresh testing data show no new positives
article.articleSummary: H1N1 in Madhya Pradesh remains under watch as of 17 September 2026: no new positives or deaths were reported on Thursday; four reports were received and 13 H1N1-positive patients were admitted for treatment. AIIMS Bhopal reported ~20% positivity among tested samples, reflecting referrals from multiple districts rather than Bhopal alone. Officials noted no genome sequencing of H1N1 samples has been done yet; routine diagnosis remains based on laboratory testing. No samples were sent for testing that day. Surveillance and testing continue across Madhya Pradesh to track seasonal influenza and H1N1 activity.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1の状況は監視下、最新の検査データでは新規陽性者なし
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の通常サーベイランス報道で新規陽性者・死亡者はなく深刻性は低いが、複数地区からの紹介症例で陽性率約20%と一定の活動が続いており、継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして毎年発生する疾患であり、今回の報道は新規陽性者なしという安定した状況を示す通常のサーベイランス報告。ゲノム解析は未実施だが特段の異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: confira os bairros com maior risco na última semana em Campinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: See the neighborhoods with the highest risk in the past week in Campinas.
article.articleSummary: Dengue update for Campinas, Brazil: on Sep 17, 2026, the Health Secretariat released the 38th Arboviruses Alert for 2026, reporting 29 neighborhoods at high transmission risk. From Jan 1 to Sep 14, 2026, Campinas recorded 3,951 confirmed dengue cases. High-risk areas span: East — Alto Taquaral, Parque Taquaral, Chácara Primavera, Santa Cândida, Jardim Myriam Moreira da Costa; Northwest — Jardim Novo Campos Elíseos, Jardim Campos Elíseos, Jardim Anchieta, Jardim Ipiranga, Jardim Paulicéia; North — Parque Maria Helena, Vila Renascença, Vila Padre Anchieta; Southwest — Jardim Melina 1, DIC 5, DIC 6, Jardim Rosalina, Eldorado dos Carajás, Jardim Santos Dumont II; South — Jardim Fernanda 1–2, Jardim Puccamp, Jardim Dom Gilberto, Jardim Columbia; Southeast — Jardim Carlos Lourenço, Jardim New York, Jardim Itatiaia, Jardim Santa Eudoxia, Vila Orozimbo Maia. The alert calls for intensified inspection and elimination of Aedes aegypti breeding sites. From Jan 1 to Sep 9, 2026, 1,226,517 property visits for breeding-site control and education, plus 53,382 fogging visits, were conducted by health agents, environmental control staff, and a contracted company. Residents should remove standing water, change plant-water every two days, wash plant saucers weekly, seal water tanks, and keep toilets closed when not in use; the city portal provides uniforms, badges, and official contacts, and about 80% of breeding sites are inside homes.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱:カンピーナスで先週最もリスクが高かった地区を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でのデング熱の定例的な地域監視報告であり、既知の風土病の通常の季節的活動の範囲内で、国際的拡大や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルの風土病であり、地方自治体が定例的に発表する地区別リスク情報。市当局が独自に対策（蚊の発生源除去、燻煙、啓発活動）を実施しており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Rondonópolis reforça cuidados contra o mosquito da dengue mesmo com poucas chuvas - Prefeitura Municipal de Rondonópolis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rondonópolis City Hall reinforces precautions against the dengue-carrying mosquito even with little rainfall - Rondonópolis Municipal City Hall
article.articleSummary: Rondonópolis, Brazil, reinforces precautions against Aedes aegypti, the dengue, chikungunya, and Zika vector, despite little rainfall. Municipal Health data show a sharp drop in arboviruses: chikungunya—from 5,753 to 3 cases—and dengue—from 1,986 to 14, with Zika not reported in the period. More than 80% of breeding sites are inside homes, prompting weekly household inspections and elimination of water-holding containers, proper disposal of objects, and maintenance of clean gutters, drains, and water storage areas. Plant pot saucers should be filled with sand or washed weekly; pet water bowls require weekly cleaning. Community spaces should be kept clean, and residents encouraged to report yards with trash or standing water; ACE agents must have access for inspections. Ovitrampas monitor presence/density and cover 33% of the city, expanding. Acting now with weekly checks interrupts the mosquito life cycle and protects the community.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドノーポリス市役所、降雨が少ない中でもデング熱媒介蚊対策を強化 - ロンドノーポリス市役所
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の症例数は前年比で大幅に減少しており、行政による通常の予防啓発活動に過ぎず、公衆衛生上の異常な緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の症例数が大幅に減少していることを報告し、蚊媒介対策の継続的な予防活動を紹介する内容。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、シグナルとしての緊急性はないため見送りとした。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Επιβραδύνεται η εξάπλωση του ιού σε περιοχές της ΛΔ Κονγκό, αλλά η κρίση παραμένει σοβαρή
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The spread of the virus is slowing in areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, but the crisis remains serious.
article.articleSummary: Since the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, the Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has recorded 7,258 confirmed cases and 3,510 deaths, with 1,726 recoveries, across seven provinces. Transmission is slowing in the eastern DRC but rising sharply in North Kivu, notably in the city of Butembo, where the province accounts for about 45% of cases last week. Ituri province shows signs of improvement, accounting for 78% of confirmed cases; three health zones—Anza, Kabala, and Mahagi—have reported 41 days without a new case. South Ubangi is now the seventh province affected. The WHO cautions that national trends mask local differences, and it is too early to declare a peak. About 5,000 more health workers are needed. Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains without an approved vaccine or therapy; experimental treatments and vaccines are under evaluation. UN officials warn months will pass before control is achieved.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国の一部地域でウイルス拡大は減速も、危機は依然深刻
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（7,258症例、3,510死亡）が複数州に拡大し、致死率・国際的拡大リスクともに高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo ebolavirus株による流行で、約5000人の追加医療従事者が必要とされるなど、対応能力の逼迫が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Congo is still serious, African health body says
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains serious as Africa CDC reports gaps in infection prevention and control. Data from Africa CDC's Emergency Consultative Group show a slight decrease in cases over the past two weeks, but officials say the peak may not have been reached and transmission is not consistently controlled across affected areas. Congo Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba cited encouraging signs since the mid-August peak and a gradual slowing of transmission, while Africa CDC Director‑General Jean Kaseya warned that conclusions require a sustained decline. Kaseya highlighted a modest drop in infections in eastern Ituri province. Officials say data are incomplete; authorities will need extended downward trends before declaring the peak passed. Africa CDC reiterates its ongoing support to the Congolese government amid the still-serious outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは依然深刻、アフリカ疾病予防管理センターが表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で重篤性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクなど複数該当し、WPRO基準も全て該当。Africa CDCが継続支援を表明するなど社会的・政治的関心も高いため、フルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: Ituriはコンゴ民主共和国内の州であり、別国としては扱わない。感染拡大の持続的減少が未確認であり、ピーク到達の判断も保留中。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情仍嚴峻　非洲疾管中心指尚未受控 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains severe; Africa CDC says it is not yet under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains severe and not yet under control, Africa CDC says. Although DRC Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba reported encouraging signs since the mid-August peak and a slowing of transmission, Africa CDC cautions that data are incomplete and the peak cannot be confirmed. Director Jean Kaseya notes that while the last two weeks show a slight decrease in cases and infections in Ituri Province have edged down, the outbreak is not uniformly controlled across all affected areas. The Africa CDC Emergency Advisory Panel also emphasizes that transmission has not been consistently contained. Africa CDC will continue supporting the Congolese government, but the overall situation remains grave as of September 18, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、依然として深刻な状況　アフリカCDCは「まだ制御下にない」と指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準上重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCでの流行が制御下になくアフリカCDCが継続的な支援を行っていることから、国際的拡大リスクと管理可能性への懸念がある。
triage.notes: Ituri州を含むDRC全体で流行が継続中。アフリカCDCはピークの確定ができておらず、データ不完全な状況が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Progress Being Made Against Ebola in Congo, but Outbreak Far From Over, Says WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains far from over, despite signs of headway. As of Sept 17, 2026, the National Institute of Public Health reports 7,404 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,577 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%). WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the outbreak is not a single epidemic but many outbreaks across Ituri and North Kivu, with transmission falling in Ituri but rising rapidly in North Kivu. Improved surveillance and recording may boost reported case numbers even as transmission declines in some areas. Maria Van Kerkhove warns that much work remains and the response must be sustained. Workers received Ervebo vaccine, which was effective in past Ebola outbreaks caused by a different, more common type of the virus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱、進展はあるものの終息には程遠いとWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例7,404例、死亡3,577例（致死率48.3%）と規模が大きく、複数地域で拡大が続いており、WHOも継続的な対応の必要性を強調しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: IturiとNorth KivuはいずれもDRC国内の州であり、発生地域は単一国（DRC）に集約される。北キブ州で感染が急増しており、複数の流行が並行して発生している点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Visam identifica morcego positivo para raiva em área rural
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: Visam identifies a rabies-positive bat in a rural area.
article.articleSummary: Rabies detected in a bat (genus Histiotus) found dead in the rural area of Santa Clara, Jundiaí, São Paulo, Brazil. The Environmental Health Surveillance (Visam), part of Jundiaí's Municipal Health Promotion Secretariat, confirmed presence of the rabies virus. No contact occurred between people or other animals and the bat, which was found outside a residence. The specimen was collected on September 11 following a resident's report and sent to the Centro de Controle de Zoonoses de São Paulo (CCZ-SP) for testing. Laboratory results announced on September 16 confirmed rabies. This is a single animal finding with no reported human or animal exposure, and no indication of an ongoing outbreak in the article. Highlights wildlife rabies surveillance at urban-rural interfaces in Jundiaí.

triage.headline_ja: JJ:ヴィザム、農村地域で狂犬病陽性のコウモリを確認
triage.triage_reason: 単一のコウモリでの狂犬病確認事例であり、人や他の動物への曝露報告はなく、アウトブレイクの兆候もないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 野生動物（コウモリ）における狂犬病の日常的なサーベイランス事例。人畜への感染や接触は報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: Araçatuba faz busca ativa por novos casos de tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Folha da Região: Araçatuba conducts active case finding for new tuberculosis cases.
article.articleSummary: Araçatuba, Brazil – The city’s 2026 active tuberculosis (TB) case-finding campaign entered its second stage on Wednesday, September 16, running through September 30. Led by the Municipal Health Secretariat in partnership with Zatti Saúde, the initiative aims to investigate, guide, and educate the public to identify undiagnosed TB cases and reduce transmission. Teams will operate across multiple settings, including Primary Health Units (UBSs), companies, long-term care institutions for the elderly (ILPIs), the Elderly Social Center, Centro POP, therapeutic homes, and locations frequented by people experiencing homelessness, among others. The report provides no specific case counts or laboratory confirmations. This outreach emphasizes accessible screening and community engagement within Araçatuba’s public health network.

triage.headline_ja: Folha da Região:アラサトゥーバ市、結核新規症例の積極的発見活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 定例的な結核症例発見キャンペーンに関する報道であり、具体的な症例数や異常な増加、国際的拡大リスクの記載がなく、通常の公衆衛生活動の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の地方自治体による通常の結核対策キャンペーンを報じたものであり、症例数・重症度・異常性に関する情報はない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事の内容が通常の公衆衛生活動であるため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Cuba condivide l'esperienza nella lotta contro l'Ebola con la Repubblica Democratica del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuba shares its experience in the fight against Ebola with the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Cuba reaffirmed its willingness to support the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the Ebola fight, in a video-conference between ministers. Dr. Jose Angel Portal Miranda highlighted Cuba's experience, during the 2014 West Africa Ebola epidemic when 256 Cuban professionals from the Henry Reeve Contingent assisted Sierra Leone, Liberia and Guinea Conakry. Building on that, Cuba has developed mechanisms to prevent and prepare for virus introduction and spread, including activation of the National Plan for Ebola Prevention and Response and readiness at 24 entry points with travel surveillance. Congolese authorities reported spread, with health zones increasing from four to 60 across six provinces and a case fatality above 40%. They requested support to curb spread, strengthen patient care, assist field staff, and boost monitoring. The current strain lacks a specific vaccine; a Zaire-variant vaccine is used to assess cross-protection. Remdesivir is used for treatment and to protect at-risk contacts.

triage.headline_ja: キューバ、エボラ対策の経験をコンゴ民主共和国と共有
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ発生が4保健区から60保健区・6州に拡大し、致死率40%超という重大な公衆衛生イベントであり、国際支援要請も出ているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はキューバの支援表明が主題だが、DRC当局が保健区の急増（4→60）と致死率40%超を報告し、特異な株でワクチンの交差防御を評価中という重要な疫学情報を含む。Cuba、Sierra Leone、Liberia、Guinea、Angolaは2014年西アフリカ流行の歴史的言及であり、現在の発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا بعد 4 أشهر من إعلان تفشيه حالة طوارئ: الأزمة لم تبلغ ذروتها
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Four months after declaring its outbreak a state of emergency, the crisis has not peaked.
article.articleSummary: Four months after WHO declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) outbreak continues without a peak, remaining the fastest and deadliest in the country’s half-century history and second globally after the West Africa outbreaks of 2014 and 2016. UN and WHO officials warn containment will take months. Uganda was declared Ebola-free on August 26 after the virus reached its border from the DRC. In the DRC, Ituri remains a major hotspot with mixed trends—transmission falling in some areas but rising elsewhere—driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus and complicated by intense cross-border movement. Surveillance and contact tracing have intensified, with about 45% of new cases in North Kivu and Butembo among the hardest-hit cities. A seventh province, Sud-Ubangi, has been added to affected regions; authorities urge continued vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:発生から4か月、緊急事態宣言後も危機はピークに達していない
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱流行はWHOがPHEICを宣言済みであり、複数州へ拡大し国境を越えてウガンダにも波及した既知の重大公衆衛生イベントであるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは8月26日にエボラ終息宣言済みだが、記事の主眼はDRCでの継続的流行であるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ウガンダ・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: SMS de Feira de Santana monitora surto de varicela com 14 casos confirmados em instituição de ensino
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Feira de Santana Municipal Health Secretariat monitors varicella outbreak with 14 confirmed cases in an educational institution.
article.articleSummary: Varicella (chickenpox) outbreak in a single educational institution in Feira de Santana municipality, with 14 confirmed cases—12 students and 2 teachers. The Municipal Health Secretariat’s Epidemiological Surveillance (Viep) conducted a technical visit and is monitoring cases and contacts. An outbreak is defined as cases exceeding expected levels for a given population and period; 14 cases currently trigger the designation. The surveillance team identifies susceptible contacts to determine control measures, which may include blocking vaccination when indicated. Blocking vaccination is not automatic; decisions depend on individual vaccination history and prior infection. Criteria consider those unvaccinated, uncertain about vaccination, or lacking previous disease. Feira de Santana reports 103 vaccination points to improve access; blocking vaccination will follow the epidemiological assessment. Transmission occurs via respiratory secretions and contact with lesion fluid; objective is to reduce transmission and monitor exposed individuals.

triage.headline_ja: フェイラ・デ・サンタナ市保健局、教育機関で水痘（水疱瘡）の集団発生14件を監視
triage.triage_reason: 単一の教育機関内での水痘（一般的な小児感染症）集団発生であり、重症度・国際的拡大リスクともに低く、既存の公衆衛生対応（接触者調査・ワクチン接種）で管理可能な事例。
triage.notes: 水痘はワクチンで予防可能な一般的疾患で、単一施設内の限定的な集団発生。地元保健当局が通常の疫学調査・接触者管理で対応中であり、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Yamunanagar administration seeks social support for 1,600 TB patients - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: As of 18 September 2026, Yamunanagar district in Haryana seeks to support more than 1,600 TB patients through a social participation program. District Deputy Commissioner Preeti chaired a District Secretariat meeting with industrial unit representatives and officials to recruit Nikshay Mitras to adopt TB patients and provide regular nutrition kits in addition to treatment. The initiative emphasizes nutritious diets alongside standard therapy, noting that government assistance of Rs 1,000 per month is insufficient on its own. The DC urged industry, NGOs, educational institutions, CSR units, elected representatives, Health Department staff, and other authorities or sarpanches to participate, ensuring sustained nutrition and care to bolster treatment adherence. The effort aligns with national and state TB elimination goals, promoting collective action toward a TB-free India and a TB-free Haryana by supporting patient recovery through nutrition and social support.

triage.headline_ja: ヤムナナガル行政、1,600人の結核患者への社会的支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: 既知の結核患者に対する栄養支援・社会参加プログラムに関する行政広報であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核の既存患者に対する地域的な栄養支援・地域参加イニシアチブに関する記事であり、新規感染急増やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Cruz inaugura unidade móvel para testagem de infecções sexualmente transmissíveis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Cruz Inaugurates Mobile Unit for Testing Sexually Transmitted Infections.
article.articleSummary: Santa Cruz do Sul inaugurates a Mobile Testing and Counseling Center (CTA Móvel) to expand prevention and testing for sexually transmitted infections. On Tuesday the 22nd at 9:00, in Palacinho, the unit will be unveiled and then remain at Praça da Bandeira for its initial community services. The CTA Móvel will subsequently operate at strategic locations across the municipality—including events, campaigns, neighborhood health actions, rural areas, schools, and workplaces. The van cost R$ 489,000, funded by federal transfers and state resources linked to the CRAIP (Centro Regional de Atenção Integral e Prevenção às ISTs). Services include rapid tests for HIV, syphilis, and viral hepatitis, along with prevention education, counseling, and guidance. Aims to bring health services closer to populations facing barriers to accessing reference facilities.

triage.headline_ja: サンタクルス、性感染症検査のための移動ユニットを開設
triage.triage_reason: これは新たな公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクではなく、性感染症検査を拡充するための移動検査サービス開設に関する行政広報記事であり、いずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: アウトブレイク報告ではなく、ブラジル・サンタクルスドスル市における性感染症検査体制強化の行政サービス開始に関する記事のため、トリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cai em Campo Grande em 2026 mesmo com período de chuvas mais intenso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases fall in Campo Grande in 2026 despite a more intense rainy season.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, shows lower levels in 2026 than in the same period of 2025, according to a control chart from CIEVS-CG (Center for Strategic Information on Health Surveillance). As of Epidemiological Week 36 (6–12 Sept 2026), there were 1,534 dengue notifications in Campo Grande. By Week 31 of 2025, the city had 3,505 notifications. Through August (Week 29), 2026 recorded 1,364 notifications, with no severe cases or deaths confirmed at that time. The control chart compares weekly cases to historical expectations to flag alerts. Despite conditions favorable to the Aedes aegypti vector (heat and rain), dengue remains below 2025 levels for much of the period. Public health actions continue: home visits, elimination of breeding sites, and fumigation (fumacê) in surveillance-defined areas.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年、より激しい雨季にもかかわらずカンポ・グランデのデング熱症例は減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年より減少しており、重症例・死亡例も確認されていない。異常性や社会的関心の高まりも見られない通常の流行モニタリング報告。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。デング熱は前年同期比で減少傾向にあり、重症例・死亡例なし。定期的な公衆衛生モニタリング活動の一環と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Olinda registra quarta morte por dengue confirmada em Pernambuco no ano; casos passam de 11 mil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Olinda records fourth dengue death confirmed in Pernambuco this year; cases exceed 11,000.
article.articleSummary: Pernambuco confirmed four dengue deaths in 2026, including a 60-year-old man from Olinda who died May 7 and had comorbidities. SES-PE reports 11,368 confirmed dengue cases and 47,418 notifications between Jan 4 and Sep 12, up 37% from 2025, with 686 severe cases and 22 additional deaths under arbovirus investigation. The outbreak spans 41 of Pernambuco’s 184 municipalities; 179 have some incidence, 82 low, 56 medium, 41 high. Previously confirmed deaths include a 65-year-old Recife resident who died in Rio de Janeiro on Feb 18, a 15-year-old Tacaratu resident, and a 93-year-old Parnamirim resident. The Olinda case was recorded in May but only confirmed later. Prevention emphasizes eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites (water tanks, plant pots, rain containers, gutters, tires). In Recife, a municipal mutirão to combat Aedes aegypti is planned for Sept 18–19 across eight districts.

triage.headline_ja: オリンダでペルナンブコ州内今年4人目のデング熱死亡例確認、症例数は1万1千件超
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルナンブコ州でデング熱症例が前年比37%増、重症例・死亡例も発生しているが、既知の流行病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルの風土病であり毎年季節性の流行が発生。今回は前年比37%増、686件の重症例、複数死亡例が報告されているが、地方自治体レベルで対応（防除活動）が進行中であり、外部支援の必要性は明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Siddhart Nagar News: जिला कारागार में एचआईवी एवं टीबी के प्रति किया गया जागरूक, 553 बंदियों की जांच
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Siddhart Nagar News: Awareness raised about HIV and TB at the district jail; screening of 553 inmates.
article.articleSummary: On 17 September 2026, Siddharthnagar district jail hosted a health department awareness program on HIV and Tuberculosis (TB), screening 553 inmates. The Chief Medical Officer emphasized that accurate information and timely testing are crucial to prevention. TB is curable, and symptoms to take seriously include a persistent cough for two weeks or more, fever, weight loss, night sweats, weakness, and reduced appetite; early identification enables appropriate treatment and full recovery. For HIV, the focus was on transmission routes, prevention, testing, and counseling, with efforts to dispel social myths surrounding the infection. Inmates were urged to use health department screening and counseling services as needed to ensure timely diagnosis and care.

triage.headline_ja: シッダールトナガル・ニュース: 地区刑務所でHIVとTBに関する啓発活動、553人の受刑者を検査
triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生啓発・検診プログラムに関する報道であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 刑務所内での通常のHIV/TB啓発・検診活動の報道であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão contra dengue chega a bairros de Curitiba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue control drive reaches Curitiba's neighborhoods.
article.articleSummary: Dengue control drive reaches Curitiba's neighborhoods. The Mutirão Curitiba sem Mosquito mobilizes health agents to 20 blocks in the Aurora and Vila Leão catchment (Pinheirinho and Tatuquara) on September 18 and 21, 2026, to educate residents on dengue prevention and proper disposal of debris, with waste collected by municipal trucks on September 22. In the same week, 18 blocks in the Pompéia health unit area (Tatuquara) will receive guidance on September 22–23, and collection will occur on September 24. Residents should place eligible items curbside on collection days; smaller items should be bagged. Collected items include furniture, appliances, nonfunctional items, recyclable materials, tires (up to two per residence), and vegetation up to 1 cubic meter per residence. Prohibited items include larger construction waste, unbagged organics, hazardous wastes, and vehicles.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策活動、クリチバの複数地区で実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的清掃・啓発活動であり、新規感染急増や異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・クリチバ市の定例的なデング熱予防清掃キャンペーンの案内であり、症例数や流行状況についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Crecen los casos de Virus Sincicial Respiratorio y el informe epidemiológico alerta por la leptospirosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Respiratory Syncytial Virus are increasing, and the epidemiological report warns about leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: In Santa Fe, Argentina, respiratory infections show shifting patterns in 2026: RSV accounts for rising pediatric cases, with 255 under 6 months, 148 aged 6–11 months, and 161 aged 12–23 months. Influenza A(H3N2) has 22 laboratory-confirmed cases since December 2025 (subclade J.2.4.1/K); six influenza deaths occurred, all with predisposing conditions and none vaccinated. Leptospirosis totals reach 595 notified cases through epidemiological week 35, with 72 confirmed/probable (12%), 39 hospitalizations (54%), and one death (41-year-old male in La Capital). The departments most affected are La Capital (14), General Obligado (12), and Rosario (10). Dengue season 2026–2027 began, but no confirmed dengue cases in Santa Fe; 33 dengue/dengue during pregnancy cases reported since week SE31, none confirmed. Nationally, SE34 recorded 352 suspected dengue, 2 confirmed (DENV-3, travel-related from Brazil) and 5 probable. Continuous intensified surveillance and prompt reporting for febrile syndromes are advised.

triage.headline_ja: RSVの症例が増加、疫学報告書がレプトスピラ症について警告
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチン・サンタフェ州における季節性呼吸器感染症とレプトスピラ症の地域的な疫学報告であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではない。
triage.notes: 発生地域はアルゼンチン（サンタフェ州、ロサリオ）であり、Bluedotの発生地域にBrazilが含まれるが、記事の主題はアルゼンチン国内の事例であるため対象国には該当しない。Brazil関連は渡航歴のあるデング熱1例のみで主題ではない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: Kasai province is facing a mpox epidemic
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) is circulating in Kasai province, DRC, with five health zones affected, including Kanzala in Tshikapa, where the provincial capital lies. As of 16 September 2026, officials confirmed the outbreak; Luebo reported more than 30 suspected cases and four deaths in Mukuandianga and Kambangoma zones. In Tshikapa, three family members are among suspected cases in Kanzala. The National Institute of Public Health (INSP) has strengthened epidemiological surveillance in the province. Governor Chrispin Mukendi Bukasa said treatment is free in all provincial facilities and urged calm. Public health measures emphasize barrier gestures per WHO/INSP: avoid close contact with a person with lesions; wash hands; avoid handling linens or objects of a suspected case; seek care at the nearest health center if fever, headache, skin rash, or swollen lymph nodes. First major Kasai mpox outbreak documented August 2024.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:カサイ州でエムポックス(サル痘)の流行が発生
triage.triage_reason: DRCカサイ州で複数の保健地区にまたがるエムポックス流行が確認され、死亡例も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにKenya(Busia)が含まれるが、記事本文はDRCカサイ州のみに言及しており、Kenyaでの発生記述はないため除外した。DRCでは2023年以降クレードI mpoxの継続的流行があり、本件はその一部である可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola update as of September 15
article.articleSummary: Ebola update in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of September 15, 2026 shows 7,404 confirmed cases, 3,577 deaths, 1,776 recoveries, and 930 patients in isolation, with 87.4% contact tracing. In the last 24 hours, 23 more recoveries were recorded; no new health zones were affected, with activity across 62 health zones in 7 provinces. Ongoing measures include expanded vaccination campaigns (including ERVEBO doses), entry-point screening of over 275,000 travelers, and intensified community sensitization. The update notes elevated risk in Ituri province due to over 312,900 displaced people living in poor conditions, contributing to transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の状況更新(9月15日時点)
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,404例の確定症例・3,577人の死亡者を伴う大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、避難民の増加による感染拡大リスクも指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既に7,000例超・死者3,500人超の大規模流行であり、イツリ州の避難民31万人超が感染拡大リスクを高めている。ワクチン接種・渡航者スクリーニング等の対応が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole u Kongu još nije pod kontrolom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Congo is not yet under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains serious, with Africa CDC flagging gaps in prevention and infection-control measures. DR Congo health minister Samuel Roger Kamba says there are encouraging signs and that transmission has gradually slowed since the mid‑August peak. Nonetheless, Africa CDC executive director Jean Kaseya warns that data do not confirm the peak has passed and transmission is not under sustained control across all affected areas. The agency notes a slight decrease in reported cases in the eastern Ituri province, but emphasizes that the overall situation remains grave and that further declines are needed before declaring the outbreak under control. The report highlights ongoing transmission, incomplete data, and the need for continued public health efforts in the affected regions. No detailed case counts or laboratory confirmation are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、依然として制御下にない
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱というIHR通知相当疾患がDRCで継続的に流行し、Africa CDCが制御未達を警告するなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ拡大リスクがあるため、フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: エボラはIHR2005の即時通知対象疾患であり、DRCで既知の継続流行。Africa CDCが制御未確立を警告しており、詳細な症例数・検査確定情報は記事内に無いため一部不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Civil society calls for a treatment centre to be set up in Mungamba - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) remains a concern in Mungamba, a locality in the Komanda health zone of Irumu territory, Ituri province, in north‑east Democratic Republic of Congo. On 17 September 2026, local civil society urged authorities to construct an Ebola Treatment Centre (ETC) in Mungamba, arguing there is currently no facility to treat confirmed EVD cases. Teams reportedly perform dignified and safe burials (DSB) but patients must travel about 25 kilometres to Komanda for specialist care. Civil society coordinator Augustin Kasereka warned that many deaths occur at home when patients cannot afford or access transport, and transporting symptomatic individuals (diarrhoea and vomiting) poses risks to drivers and road users. The call advocates rapid access to care and reduced community deaths by establishing an ETC in Mungamba, with health authorities and response partners urged to act.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:市民社会がムンガンバへの治療センター設置を要求 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2において常時通知対象となる疾患であり、DRC・イツリ州で治療施設不足による死亡リスクが指摘されているため、フルリスク評価に進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ流行への対応（治療センター設置要求）に関するものであり、新規発生の確認情報ではないが、エボラはIHR上常に注視対象となるためPICKUPと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Mogi das Cruzes capacita profissionais de saúde sobre sarampo e rubéola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mogi das Cruzes City Hall trains health professionals on measles and rubella.
article.articleSummary: Measles and rubella surveillance training was held in Mogi das Cruzes to strengthen local response. On 15 September, the City Hall trained physicians and nurses from public and private units to improve recognition, diagnosis, notification, and management of suspected measles and rubella cases. Conducted by the Municipal Epidemiological Surveillance team—Mariana Viveiros and nurses Juliana Lorena de Meira Cury and Milena Padilha—the session covered case definitions, diagnostics, differential diagnosis, treatment, and correct notification forms. It stressed rapid identification and immediate reporting to Surveillance services to enable timely investigation and control measures. Mogi das Cruzes has had no measles cases since 2022. The Triple Viral (SCR) vaccine, i.e., measles, mumps, and rubella, is freely available at UBSs and USFs; routine vaccination is at 12 months (first dose) and 15 months (second dose). Mass vaccination is not used; emphasis remains on routine immunization and updating delayed schedules per state guidance.

triage.headline_ja: モジ・ダス・クルーゼス市役所、麻疹と風疹に関する医療従事者向け研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例発生ではなく、医療従事者向けサーベイランス研修に関する内容であり、当地では2022年以降麻疹症例が発生していない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な研修活動の報道であり、実際の症例発生を示すものではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、実際の疾患発生がないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Alasko frozen raspberries recalled in 7 provinces over norovirus risk
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-17, the Canadian Food Inspection Agency issued a recall for Alasko brand frozen raspberries sold in seven provinces due to possible norovirus contamination. The recall follows CFIA’s investigation into a foodborne illness outbreak; illnesses have been reported, though the outbreak’s location and patient count are not disclosed. Affected products: 1-kg bags of Alasko frozen whole raspberries (UPC 6 95058 00205 4) and 5-kg bags containing five 1-kg bags (UPC 1 069505 800205 1), with best-before dates Nov 10, 2027, PO#138602, LOT SY25314. They were sold to the public and to hotels, restaurants and institutions in New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Quebec, Ontario and Manitoba. Do not consume; discard or return. Norovirus symptoms include diarrhea, vomiting, nausea, abdominal cramps; onset can be about 12 hours after exposure, most recover in 2-3 days, dehydration risk; severe cases may require medical care.

triage.headline_ja: アラスコ社の冷凍ラズベリー、ノロウイルスのリスクによりカナダ7州でリコール
triage.triage_reason: 本事案はカナダにおける食品リコールであり、対象国（Philippines等）に関する言及はサマリー上主題として存在しないため対象外。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにPhilippinesが含まれるが、記事内容はカナダ国内の食品リコールに限定されており、フィリピンでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: В ВОЗ назвали обнадеживающей ситуацию с Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO called the Ebola situation encouraging.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues, with encouraging signs per WHO Secretary General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Since starting May 15 in DRC and Uganda, the outbreak has reached 7,258 cases and 3,510 deaths (case fatality 48.4%). In DRC, 903 patients are hospitalized with Ebola like symptoms; contact tracing coverage is 78.6%. Seven of DRCs 26 provinces are affected, with Ituri province accounting for 78% of confirmed cases, making Ituri the current epicenter. Uganda declared the end of its outbreak on July 28, confirmed by WHO on August 25. Vaccination trials are expected to begin in the coming weeks as new treatments and reinfection prevention strategies are tested. The outbreak remains ongoing and deadly; past large outbreaks include 2014 to 2016 West Africa in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone with about 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths. Ebola originates from wildlife; first human case was in 1976 in the region.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはエボラの状況を「心強い」と評価
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラアウトブレイクは7,258例・3,510死亡（致死率48.4%）に達し、7州に拡大するなど深刻かつ流行性が高く、IHR・WPRO双方の複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは2026年7月28日に流行終息を宣言済み（8月25日WHO確認）のため対象国リストに含まれないウガンダは除外。シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは過去の2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の言及のみで現在の発生国ではないため除外。既に世界的に認知されている進行中の大規模アウトブレイクのフォローアップ記事。

article.articleHeadline: கொரோனா
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coronavirus.
article.articleSummary: Coronavirus article traces the origin and emergence of the coronavirus infection and its global spread, detailing how the initial outbreak progressed into a pandemic and affected populations worldwide. It blends scientific narration with Tamil literary context, featuring Thiruvalluvar’s medical couplets and other classical medical perspectives. The piece highlights the pandemic's hardships and the Tamil Nadu government’s countermeasures, illustrated with photographs. It recalls memories of the corona era, including altered eating habits and isolation rules, and discusses the public health strategies pursued. It also catalogs government health initiatives, aiming to help readers understand welfare schemes related to medicine. Authored by Professor R. Narayanan. As of 2026-09-17.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルス
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は書籍紹介であり、COVID-19の歴史的経緯やタミル文学的視点を回顧的に紹介する内容であって、現在進行中の感染症イベントに関する情報ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去のパンデミックを回顧する書籍の紹介文であり、現行の感染症発生を報告するものではないため、対象国リストへの現在の発生地としては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS: hay señales alentadoras en lucha contra el ébola en la RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: There are encouraging signs in the fight against Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says there are encouraging signs in the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as transmission declines in Ituri, the hardest-hit province. South Kivu has not reported new cases since May, and more than 1,700 people have recovered. Over four months, the outbreak has been contained mainly in northeastern DRC, with only a small outbreak in Uganda quickly stopped. Yet the epidemic continues to grow and kill, with more than 7,200 cases and over 3,500 deaths reported across seven provinces. Last week, Ituri recorded 300 new cases and 160 deaths; North Kivu saw rapid increases, with weekly cases nearly doubling in two weeks to over 200. Containment challenges include armed conflict, population movement, and attacks on aid workers and health facilities. Sustained, multi-site responses will be needed for many difficult months.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応に励みとなる兆候
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,200例超・死者3,500人超の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの小規模流行も報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。武力衝突や人口移動、医療従事者への攻撃が対応の課題として挙げられている。

article.articleHeadline: Seekor Anjing Gigit Satu Keluarga di Jembrana Bali, Suspek Rabies, Medikvet Ambil Sampel Otak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dog bites a family in Jembrana, Bali; suspected rabies, Medikvet takes brain samples.
article.articleSummary: Rabies suspected after a four-month-old pet puppy in Negara, Jembrana, Bali bit a family, injuring a 42-year-old mother Ni Komang Ayu Suarniti and two children, Conradus Febatan Tri Sandi (15) and Dominika Sanyo Bayu (23). The puppy died soon after the incident; it had not been vaccinated, though the dam was vaccinated. The bite sequence began on Sept 8, 2026, when the dog bit the mother while being bathed and showed abnormal behavior (shivering, possible earlier fight with another dog). Four days later, the puppy bit the second child on the thumb; on Sept 13, the first child was bitten as well. Medikvet Jembrana collected brain samples for laboratory testing to confirm rabies at Balai Besar Veteriner Denpasar. Emergency vaccination around the surrounding area is planned amid the suspected rabies exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ジェンブラナ・バリで犬が家族に噛みつく、狂犬病疑いでメディクベットが脳サンプル採取
triage.triage_reason: バリ島の1家族における犬咬傷事例で、狂犬病は同地域で流行が続く風土病であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: バリ島は狂犬病流行地域であり、単発の家族内咬傷事例は地域ニュースレベル。ラボ検査結果待ちで確定診断はまだない。

article.articleHeadline: Bos BGN Ungkap Banyak Kasus Keracunan MBG Dipicu Lauk-Sayur Rusak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BGN chief reveals many MBG poisoning cases triggered by spoiled side dishes and vegetables
article.articleSummary: MBG (Makan Bergizi Gratis) poisoning cases in Indonesia are linked to spoiled ingredients, especially animal-protein dishes and vegetables. BGN chief Sudaryono says health incidents in his 50 days in office stem from food quality, not cooking; even proper preparation cannot compensate for rotten raw materials. BGN will tighten controls by inspecting ingredients on delivery and is developing a marketplace-like system for animal-protein procurement to ensure quality and avoid price markups. MBG kitchens, SPPG, are being inspected; non-compliant facilities can be suspended or closed, and more than half of MBG kitchens have been checked. Some 1,276 SPPG lacking Hygiene Certificates have already been closed or suspended. Head cooks must be on-site, and oversight will involve BPOM, Kemenkes, and local health offices. Recent incidents: Tana Toraja, South Sulawesi (193 students) with E. coli in cooked chicken; Lombok Tengah, West Nusa Tenggara (352 students); Sidoarjo, East Java (748 students). Other sites under investigation include Pati, Bantul, and Madiun.

triage.headline_ja: BGN長官、MBGの食中毒事例の多くは傷んだおかず・野菜が原因と説明
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア全国の学校給食プログラム（MBG）で大腸菌による食中毒が複数地域（南スラウェシ、西ヌサトゥンガラ、東ジャワなど）で発生し、数百人規模の学生に影響しており、政府機関（BGN、BPOM、保健省）が対応中で社会的・行政的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 本件は食品衛生（食中毒）事案であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低いが、国家的な給食プログラムに関連し複数地域で継続的に発生しているため、経過を注視する必要がある。感染症としての国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Comodoro confirmó 20 casos de tuberculosis en 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Comodoro confirmed 20 cases of tuberculosis in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Argentina’s Regional Hospital of Comodoro Rivadavia reports 20 confirmed tuberculosis cases in 2026 to date, with several patients still under investigation. The Tuberculosis Program notes that annual TB cases average about 40, and current numbers are within expected values for this time of year. Epidemiologist Mariel Luna explains the program operates nationally with provincial and hospital presence, handling detection, treatment, and follow-up. TB is a respiratory infection transmitted person-to-person; symptoms include persistent cough (over two weeks), weight loss, loss of appetite, and night sweats. Diagnostic testing and free treatment are provided by public health. For each confirmed case, a focus control is conducted to study contacts, potentially identifying linked cases. Some cases involve individuals who previously resided in Santa Cruz or other provinces; others remain in the hospital’s southern Chubut region. Public health advice emphasizes ventilation, hand hygiene, mask use, and timely primary-care consultation for a persistent cough.

triage.headline_ja: コモドーロで2026年に結核20例を確認
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチン(対象国外)における結核症例数が例年並みであり、異常性・国際的懸念も認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域はアルゼンチン（Comodoro Rivadavia, Chubut州）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。フィリピンの地名がBluedotの発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事本文では言及されていないため除外。症例数も例年の範囲内で異常性なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: quatre mois après le début de l'épidémie, le pic n'a toujours pas été atteint selon Africa CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: four months after the start of the outbreak, the peak has not yet been reached according to Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak: Africa CDC said four months after the outbreak began, the peak has not been reached, contrasting with Congolese authorities who had said mid-August peak. As of now, 7,404 confirmed Ebola cases, 3,577 deaths, and 1,776 recoveries. Africa CDC official Dr. Wessam Mankoula notes progress in some health zones but not nationwide; a peak can include successive waves and plateaus, with rises if control is not maintained. After a plateau at end of July, a new rise occurred. Seven health zones have had no new cases for 42 days; six zones for 21 days. However 49 health zones still report new transmissions, representing about 80% of affected zones. Therefore, it remains too early to declare the outbreak under control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱:流行開始から4カ月、アフリカCDCによればピークはまだ到達していない
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ流行が7,404例・3,577人死亡に達し、80%の感染地域で新規感染が続いておりピークが未到達であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Africa CDCとコンゴ当局の見解に相違があり、流行制御状況の評価に不確実性が残る。致死率が高く（約48%）、continent-wideの公衆衛生上の懸念が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Panjangnya Alur Distribusi MBG Picu Risiko Pertumbuhan Bakteri Penyebab Keracunan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Length of MBG's Distribution Channel Triggers the Risk of Growth of Bacteria Responsible for Food Poisoning
article.articleSummary: Bacteria detected in MBG (free nutritious meals) samples linked to food-poisoning cases in the Yogyakarta region (DIY) include Bacillus cereus, Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, Salmonella, and Clostridium perfringens, with similar findings in outbreaks in Karo and Sidoarjo. UGM Food Safety expert Prof. Dr. Ir. Endang Sutriswati Rahayu notes bacteria occur naturally in foods and that Bacillus cereus spores can survive cooking and produce toxins. The risk stems from a long processing-to-distribution chain after cooking, where portions are prepared and shipped to schools; extended time or non-refrigerated transport can allow bacterial growth, especially with sun exposure. The most effective prevention is cooking on-site at schools and consuming meals immediately. In response, Sleman Regency’s MBG Acceleration Task Force will deploy an unannounced inspection team to evaluate SPPG SOPs across storage, preparation, and delivery to prevent recurrence of outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: MBG（無償栄養給食）の長い流通経路が食中毒を引き起こす細菌増殖リスクを誘発
triage.triage_reason: 学校給食における食品由来の細菌性食中毒（複合的な起因菌）事例であり、地域限定的な公衆衛生課題として当局が対応中。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、継続的な発生パターンのため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 食中毒は給食（MBG）プログラムの流通・調理工程の問題に起因し、複数地域（Yogyakarta、Karo、Sidoarjo）で同様の事例が報告されている。感染症というより食品安全管理の課題であり、当局（Sleman県）が是正措置（抜き打ち検査）を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا بعد 4 أشهر من إعلان تفشيه حالة طوارئ: الأزمة لم تبلغ ذروتها
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Four months after declaring its outbreak a state of emergency, the crisis has not yet peaked.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern four months after its declaration, with the crisis far from peak. The current outbreak—the 17th in the DRC over five decades—is the fastest-spreading and deadliest in the country, with transmission concentrated in the eastern region, notably North Kivu, which accounts for about 45% of new infections, including cases centered in Butembo. Uganda was declared Ebola-free on 26 August after cross-border spread from the DRC. WHO officials warn containment will take months; while there are signs of progress in Ituri and other areas, overall transmission remains high and the outbreak continues to claim lives. International partners such as MSF, UNICEF, and WFP have mobilized to protect health workers and strengthen surveillance and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:発生から4カ月、緊急事態宣言後も危機はピークを迎えず
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、DRC史上最速・最多死亡の流行であり、国境を越えた感染拡大も発生していることからIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは8月26日にエボラ終息を宣言済みだが、DRCからの越境感染が過去にあったため国際的拡大リスクの根拠とした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: Эпидемия Эболы в ДРК продолжает распространяться
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC continues to spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread but shows encouraging signs. The DR Congo Ministry reports 7,258 confirmed cases and 3,510 deaths (case fatality ~48.4%). Hospitals and isolation facilities hold 903 patients; contact tracing reaches 78.6%. Seven of 26 provinces are affected, with Ituri province accounting for about 78% of confirmed cases. The outbreak began 15 May in the DRC and in Uganda; Uganda declared an end to its outbreak on 28 July, confirmed by WHO on 25 August. Despite grim totals, progress is noted as treatment and reinfection-prevention strategies are being tested, and vaccine trials are expected to begin in coming weeks. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak; the largest occurred 2014–2016 in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone with roughly 28,600 cases and >11,000 deaths. Transmission is from wildlife; the first human case was in 1976 in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)のエボラ流行が拡大を続けている
triage.triage_reason: 確定7,258例・死亡3,510例(CFR約48%)と大規模かつ深刻な流行が継続し、複数州・複数国(ウガンダ)にまたがる拡大歴があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行は既に終息宣言済み(WHOが8/25確認)。シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-2016年の過去最大流行への言及であり、現行イベントの発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 추석 앞두고 감염병 주의...A형 간염·백일해 백신 챙겨야
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious disease caution ahead of Chuseok... Hepatitis A and pertussis vaccines should be taken.
article.articleSummary: KDCA warns ahead of the Chuseok holiday to strengthen vaccination against hepatitis A and pertussis amid rising regional outbreaks. Hepatitis A cases are increasing in Asia: Hong Kong reported 72 cases in the last year (up from 30 in 2023), and Taiwan recorded 485 cases—the highest in nine years. Transmission is via contaminated water/food or close contact; there is no specific cure, and adults commonly develop jaundice, while children are often asymptomatic. In Korea, immunity gaps exist among 20–40-year-olds due to reduced natural exposure and pre-2015 birth cohorts not covered by the national program. KDCA recommends hepatitis A vaccination for under-40 adults with no immunity without antibody testing; those 40+ should be tested and vaccinated if negative. Pertussis spreads by cough/sneeze; household secondary attack can reach 80%. Vaccination guidance includes Tdap in adolescence, Td/ Tdap every 10 years for adults, and Tdap for pregnant women at 27–36 weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 秋の名節（チュソク）を前に感染症に注意…A型肝炎・百日咳ワクチン接種を
triage.triage_reason: 韓国疾病管理庁による季節性の予防接種奨励記事であり、香港・台湾での症例増加データが引用されているが、深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な流行拡大を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は韓国国内向けの予防接種啓発（秋夕前）であり、香港（中国）と台湾のA型肝炎症例増加は地域比較データとして引用されている。台湾・韓国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、香港は中国として計上した。

Efforts include finalizing the full dossier and preparing for production and registration of new vaccines to enhance readiness against biological threats. Meanwhile, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the National Institute of Public Health records a worsening Ebola outbreak: 7,404 cases and 3,577 deaths. The situation has prompted Russia to bolster border controls in response to Ebola, and the World Health Organization notes the outbreak has expanded into a new health zone in Congo, describing it as the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic in history.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Thailand, authorities warn of the threat of a dangerous fever due to tick bites.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-17, Thai authorities warn of the threat of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) from tick bites. SFTS is a viral infection primarily transmitted by infected ticks; transmission via contact with blood or body fluids of infected animals or people is possible but rare. Symptoms appear 1–2 weeks after exposure and include high fever, muscle and headache, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea, with thrombocytopenia being characteristic. In severe cases, abnormal bleeding, neurological signs, and liver, kidney, or multiorgan failure may occur, posing life-threatening risks. Reservoirs include wild and domestic animals such as dogs, cats, pigs, chickens, cows, sheep, and goats, with grassy areas and animal habitats harboring infected ticks. No case counts or outbreaks are specified; the warning emphasizes tick avoidance in Thailand.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak shows encouraging signs of improvement -- WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread but shows encouraging signs of improvement, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Total laboratory-confirmed deaths exceed 3,500 (3,510), with 7,258 infections. Currently, 903 patients with Ebola symptoms are in hospitals or medical isolation facilities. Contact tracing stands at 78.6%. The outbreak affects seven of 26 provinces, with Ituri Province accounting for 78% of confirmed cases. The outbreak began May 15 in the DRC and Uganda; Uganda declared its outbreak over July 28, with WHO confirmation on August 25. This is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in Africa; the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) had 28,600 cases and 11,000 deaths. Ebola transmits from wild animals; the first human case was recorded in the DRC in 1976. This is the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak.

article.articleSummary: Thailand reports an average of 15,000 new COVID-19 cases per week over the past month. COVID-19 deaths have predominantly involved high-risk individuals aged 60+, with diabetes, cardiovascular disease, kidney disease, or cancer. Dominant circulating variants are NB.1.8.1 and JN.1, typically mild; six PQ.16.1.1 cases are under WHO monitoring. Seasonal influenza has surged to about 360,000 cases and 57 deaths this year, most affected are 5–9-year-olds, with A/H1N1 predominant. article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis kills 12-year-old in Quixeramobim; Ceará records 22 deaths in 2026.
article.articleSummary: 12-year-old Ana Sofia Evangelista Barbosa died September 14, 2026, in Quixeramobim, Ceará, as meningitis continues to claim lives in Ceará, with 22 deaths in 2026. As of September 7, Sinan reported 243 confirmed meningitis cases in the state for the year. Historically, Ceará recorded 429 cases and 33 deaths in 2025, and 337 cases with 36 deaths in 2024, underscoring meningitis as a persistent public health issue. The 7-year-old brother Nilson Evangelista remains hospitalized at a reference hospital in Fortaleza, receiving antibiotics and in isolation; mother Rosianne Silva requests cautious information sharing. Meningitis is an inflammation of the meninges; diagnosis relies on clinical assessment plus tests including lumbar puncture with CSF analysis, blood tests, and imaging. Treatment depends on the cause, with antibiotics required for bacterial meningitis. The piece emphasizes seeking timely medical care for compatible symptoms.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases are rising, should children be given special foods and drinks? : Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising, prompting parents to seek foods and drinks that boost immunity for children. A pediatric expert, Dr. Yogi Prawira, Sp.A, from Siloam Hospitals TB Simatupang, told Okezone’s Morning Zone that no foods, beverages, vitamins, or supplements act as a shortcut to health or immunity. The key is sustaining a healthy lifestyle with adequate sleep and a balanced, varied diet. Daily nutrition should include carbohydrates, protein, and fats, tailored to a child's age and development. Sleep requirements vary by age, from up to about 12 hours for some children to around 8–10 hours for others. In short, focus on consistent healthy habits rather than one magic food or supplement, according to the doctor.

article.articleHeadline: Nhận diện bệnh sốt mò
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Identifying tick fever.
article.articleSummary: Tick fever (scrub typhus) is an acute infection caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi, transmitted by chigger bites. On 2026-09-18, a 51-year-old woman in Hanoi was admitted to Bach Mai Hospital’s Institute of Tropical Medicine after days of fever and chills. Examination found an eschar with a dry, dark crust in the axilla; combined with exposure history and disease progression, she was diagnosed and started on antibiotics and antipyretics after one day. Not all patients have eschar; some present with rash, lymphadenopathy, or nonspecific fever. The disease is linked to grassy, bushy, humid environments and higher risk for forest workers, farmers, and gardeners. Complications include acute kidney injury, liver injury, multi-organ involvement, and altered consciousness. Prevention: wear long clothing, cover limbs, and inspect skin after outdoor work; seek care for fever of unknown origin and report exposure. Bach Mai Hospital notes it has saved many scrub typhus cases from severe outcomes.

article.articleHeadline: Kasusnya Sedang Meningkat, Apa Itu Influenza A?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases on the Rise: What Is Influenza A?
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising, with hospitals reporting surges as infections increase. Influenza is a seasonal respiratory virus; Influenza A, along with B, C, and D, drives most human disease and outbreaks. The circulating strain is Influenza A (H1N1), descended from the 2009 pandemic virus and continues to mutate seasonally. Transmission occurs via droplets, saliva, or contaminated surfaces. After exposure, the incubation is 1–3 days, and symptoms usually appear 3–7 days post-exposure (often around day 3). Common symptoms include high fever, dry cough, sore throat, congestion, fatigue, headache, loss of appetite, nausea, and muscle/joint pains; diarrhea can occur. Severe complications include fever above 38°C for more than a week, pneumonia, shortness of breath, tachycardia, hypotension, respiratory failure, and febrile seizures in children. Most recover in 4–7 days with treatment; if no improvement after a week, further evaluation is needed. Maintain health precautions and immune support amid rising Influenza A activity.

triage.notes: 本記事はインフルエンザAに関する一般啓発情報が中心で、具体的な症例数・発生地域・時系列データが欠如している。季節性インフルエンザの通常の増加である可能性が高いが、病院での急増報告があるため経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: WHO sees some progress in Congo's Ebola fight but cases surge in one area - The Korea Times
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cited encouraging signs in Congo’s Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, with transmission decreasing in Ituri province. South Kivu has reported no new cases since May. Despite local gains, the epidemic continues to grow and kill, with more than 7,200 cases and over 3,500 deaths across seven provinces. In North Kivu, weekly cases are rising rapidly, nearly doubling over two weeks from about 100 to more than 200, reflecting multiple outbreaks across a vast area. Maria Van Kerkhove, WHO epidemic and pandemic management chief, said the outlook is cautiously optimistic but emphasized that assessing trends takes time. Officials last week described Congo’s outbreak as the world’s fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, having spread to seven provinces with no signs of slowing.

article.articleHeadline: Deretan Fakta Siswa SLB di Blitar Jadi Korban Keracunan MBG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Series of Facts: Special Education Students in Blitar Become MBG Poisoning Victims
article.articleSummary: As of 18 September 2026, twenty-two students in Blitar, Indonesia, experienced symptoms after consuming Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) distributed by SPPG to SLBN 1 Kota Blitar and SMP Al Muhafizhoh students. Ten were from SLBN 1 Kota Blitar; the rest from SMP Al Muhafizhoh. Symptoms included abdominal pain, nausea, and vomiting; nine initially, with seven more, and one student briefly fainted. Some were treated at Puskesmas Kepanjenkidul; due to limited beds, others were moved to RSUD Mardi Waluyo and Klinik Siti Khodijah Kota Blitar. No one required prolonged hospitalization and all recovered. Dinas Kesehatan is investigating the cause, coordinating with SPPG and schools, and collecting samples. MBG was distributed to over 1,400 beneficiaries; about 1,029 consumed; 22 reported symptoms. Menu reportedly included kacang kapri, rice, egg rolade, melon, and tofu; consumption window 08:30–11:00 WIB.

article.articleHeadline: Influenza di Indonesia Masih Terkendali, tapi Kemenkes Beri Imbauan Ini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza in Indonesia Still Under Control, but the Ministry of Health Issues This Advisory.
article.articleSummary: Influenza in Indonesia remains in the low category, but the Ministry of Health issued an advisory as cases have risen modestly in recent weeks. Health official Aji Muhawarman notes that the uptick does not indicate a significant surge and that year-end increases are typical. As of September 12, 2026 (week 35), influenza-positive results stood at 38% of 175 specimens, up from 22% the prior week. Among detected influenza, 33% were in children aged 0–4. Testing encompassed 13 B/BLKM facilities, nine hospitals, and a Health Biomed Lab. Of the 66 positive specimens: 2 were influenza A(H3N2), 63 were influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, and 1 was influenza B/Victoria. Multipathogen testing also found HRV at 13% and PIV-1 at 6%. A(H3N2) subclade K has been detected in 13 provinces and has drawn particular attention, though the term 'super flu' is not an official designation.

article.articleHeadline: 國內新增諾氏瘧境外移入！50多歲女遊馬來西亞染疫　醫揭重症風險 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New domestically imported Knowlesi malaria case! Woman in her 50s who traveled to Malaysia contracted the infection; doctor reveals risk of severe disease.
article.articleSummary: One domestically imported Knowlesi malaria case was confirmed in Taiwan: a woman in her 50s who traveled to the tropical rainforest areas of Borneo, Malaysia, in late July to mid-August and was bitten by mosquitoes. About 10 days after returning she developed fever, chills, upper abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting. Blood smear suggested malaria and PCR confirmed Plasmodium knowlesi infection. She recovered after about a week in hospital and was discharged in early September. Knowlesi malaria carries a high risk of severe disease, second only to falciparum malaria; Southeast Asia is a high-risk region. Malaysia reports the most Knowlesi activity, with other endemic areas including the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore, Vietnam, Myanmar and Indonesia. This year Taiwan has six imported malaria cases (as of Sept 14): four quartan malaria, one falciparum, one Knowlesi. Pre-travel medical evaluation and prophylaxis are advised for high-risk areas, along with insect precautions.

article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus notes encouraging signs in the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, even as cases rise rapidly in another region. In Ituri, where Bundibugyo, the rare strain behind the outbreak, is circulating, transmission appears to be slowing in the hardest-hit areas. South Kivu has reported no new cases since May. However, the outbreak overall continues to expand, with more than 7,200 cases and over 3,500 deaths across seven provinces. In North Kivu, weekly case numbers are increasing quickly, nearly doubling in two weeks from about 100 to over 200, underscoring multiple focal outbreaks within a vast region. Maria Van Kerkhove cautioned that while cautious optimism is warranted, trends will take time to confirm. Congolese authorities reported last week that the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak globally has spread to seven provinces and shows no sign of slowing. As of 17 September 2026.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Farmers Returning to the Village After Floodwaters Recede, Take Care to Protect Livestock from Disease.
article.articleSummary: In Samastipur district, Bihar, as floodwaters recede, farmers are urged to protect livestock from disease. After floods, cattle should be housed in dry, clean shelters with clean water, avoiding floodwater, and hooves washed and dried to prevent fungal or bacterial infections. Wounds, swelling, or limping require prompt veterinary attention. In Bariyarpur Diyar region, farmer Mithilesh Rai (about 50) with around 10 cattle says families are returning home and emphasizes sanitation of shelters, routine disinfection with lime or appropriate agents, and careful feeding and water provision. Regular washing of animal housing and close monitoring of behavior, appetite, and body condition are crucial for early illness detection. Some villagers crush neem leaves into water to apply on animals, though disease diagnosis still requires veterinary confirmation.  Published date: 2026-09-18.

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal Influenza A, dari Gejala, Penularan hingga Komplikasinya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understanding Influenza A: From Symptoms to Transmission and Its Complications.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A remains a concern in Jogja (Yogyakarta), Indonesia, with circulating subtypes A(H1N1)pdm09 and A(H3N2). The influenza virus spreads mainly via coughing, sneezing, and contaminated surfaces, with an incubation of about two days (1–4 days possible). People are most contagious during the first three days after symptoms begin, though transmission can occur from one day before illness onset to five to seven days after. Typical symptoms include fever, dry cough, sore throat, runny or stuffy nose, headache, body aches, fatigue, and sometimes nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea (more common in children). Most recover in about a week, but pneumonia and complications can occur, especially in children under 5 (particularly under 2), older adults, pregnant women, and those with chronic or immunosuppressive conditions. Severe warning signs require medical care; antivirals may help if started early, and vaccination remains a key preventive measure.

article.articleHeadline: 非洲疾控中心：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情仍未得到控制
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled, per Africa CDC Director Kassaye on Sept 17, 2026. Current data cannot confirm a peak; the epidemic curve has a slight decline but is not yet stable, and transmission is not under sustained control. Authorities must map transmission chains, strengthen community surveillance, and prevent spread to new areas. The DR Congo Ministry of Health reports as of Sept 15: 7,404 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,577 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%), across seven provinces and 62 health zones, with Ituri province accounting for about 77.7% of cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said on Aug 16 that control in Ituri shows encouraging signs but the outbreak continues to expand. The outbreak began May 15; Tedros on Aug 12 called this the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled - International Online
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled as of Sept 15, with 7,404 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,577 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%), spanning 7 provinces and 62 health zones. Ituri province accounts for about 77.7% of cases. Officials say the epidemic curve has not peaked and transmission is not under sustained control, calling for mapping transmission chains, strengthened community surveillance, and measures to prevent spread to new areas. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reported encouraging signs in Ituri but stressed the outbreak is still expanding and lethal. The outbreak began May 15; on Aug 12 Tedros described it as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record.

article.articleHeadline: Sau mưa ngập, cảnh giác 7 nhóm bệnh nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the Floods, Beware of Seven Dangerous Disease Groups
article.articleSummary: Following heavy rains and flooding in Hanoi and northern Vietnam, floodwater exposure raises risks for seven disease groups. Leptospira infections (leptospirosis) and melioidosis (Burkholderia pseudomallei) can enter through skin abrasions or inhalation from contaminated mud and water, presenting with fever, myalgia, and potential organ involvement. Diarrheal diseases—acute diarrhea, dysentery, typhoid, cholera, and hepatitis A—stem from contaminated water and foods; watch for repeated stools, vomiting, cramps, and dehydration. Dengue fever risk increases in the weeks after floods as standing water persists. Eye infections (conjunctivitis) and skin/wound infections (Aeromonas, Vibrio) rise with polluted water; tetanus risk remains for dirty wounds if not vaccinated. Rural flooding elevates risk; urban pockets in Hanoi are vulnerable where water lingers. Preventive measures include boiling water, eating fully cooked food, avoiding dirty water, hand hygiene, clearing standing water, wound cleaning, and seeking early medical care for fever or dehydration.

article.articleHeadline: കായംകുളത്ത് വിദ്യാലയങ്ങളിൽ റിപ്പോർട്ട് ചെയ്തത് 24 ചിക്കൻപോക്സ് കേസുകൾ; ജാഗ്രതാ നിർദേശം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 24 chickenpox cases reported in Kayamkulam schools; vigilance advisory.
article.articleSummary: 24 chickenpox cases reported in Kayamkulam municipality, Kerala, across several schools; 22 students at Govt Boys Higher Secondary School Kayamkulam are infected. District Medical Officer urged strict adherence to prevention and hygiene: early identification, isolation until all vesicles crust, masks as a cost-effective precaution, not sending symptomatic individuals to school or work, handwashing, and not sharing clothes or bedding; keep the patient at home until healing is complete. Incubation is typically 10-21 days. Contacts should follow health workers' guidance; visits to homes with cases should be limited. Pregnant women, young children, elderly, and immunocompromised individuals should seek medical advice promptly. Teachers and parents should deter fever, rashes, or chickenpox symptoms from school and notify health authorities promptly. October 6 holiday announced for Plus One and Plus Two at Kayamkulam Govt Boys H.S.; classes to be online during holidays.

article.articleHeadline: Escola na Bahia registra surto de catapora com 12 estudantes e dois professores contaminados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: School in Bahia records chickenpox outbreak with 12 students and two teachers infected.
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox (varicella) outbreak identified at a school in Feira de Santana, Bahia, Brazil, with 12 students and 2 teachers diagnosed. The Municipal Health Secretariat of Feira de Santana is monitoring the cluster, which is being treated as an outbreak due to the concentration of cases within the institution. Health Secretary Rodrigo Matos notes that an outbreak is defined when cases reach 14 for the population and territory, and at that time there were 21 total cases. Public health teams are conducting contact tracing and targeting post-exposure vaccination and follow-up for susceptible contacts to block transmission. Vaccination decisions are not indiscriminate and are based on each contact’s vaccination history and prior infection. Feira de Santana operates 103 vaccination points and ongoing immunization activities across the municipality to maintain coverage.

article.articleHeadline: 发热、头疼、起皮疹？旅行归来警惕这种病，别乱吃退烧药
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever, headache, peeling rash? Be wary of this disease after returning from travel—don’t take antipyretics indiscriminately.
article.articleSummary: Zika virus infection linked to travel to Southeast Asia; a traveler returned to China after a 10-day trip with fever, headache and rash; Zika RNA was detected and the patient recovered in about a week. Zika is a mosquito-borne disease mainly transmitted by Aedes aegypti; outbreaks occurred in Yap Island (2007) and in Brazil (2015–2016). In 2024, global confirmed cases exceeded 30,000, with Brazil reporting nearly 10,000 in Jan–Jul. China currently reports imported cases with no sustained local transmission. Most infections are mild; incubation up to two weeks; about 25% show symptoms such as fever, rash, conjunctivitis, joint/muscle pain, fatigue, and headache; rare complications include Guillain-Barré syndrome and fetal congenital abnormalities. No specific treatment; prevention relies on mosquito bite avoidance. After returning, maintain protection for 3–4 weeks and seek care if symptoms develop, informing travel history; pregnant travelers should consult a doctor before travel.

article.articleHeadline: 老人坠入废弃水井因感染离世 原主人被判赔偿
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An elderly person dies from an infection after falling into an abandoned water well; former owner ordered to pay compensation.
article.articleSummary: An elderly man in Yichun, Jiangxi Province, China, died from a systemic infection after falling into an abandoned wastewater well at a pig farm beside a vegetable plot. In October 2025, he slipped into the unsealed well whose water had been used for pig farming and became contaminated (high pH and ammonia-nitrogen). He spent a night submerged, was rescued, but died on October 23, 2025. The well belonged to a pig farm once owned by Ding, later transferred to Liu; after the farm was demolished in 2017, the well was not sealed, and villagers ignored closure to fetch water. The two sons sued Liu, arguing the well caused the death; Liu argued the farm had been removed and he bore no responsibility. The court held Liu 5% liable, awarding about 17,000 yuan, and this ruling was upheld on appeal.

article.articleHeadline: 孩子突然高烧、浑身酸痛、精神差？医生提醒：高度怀疑流感，尽快检测
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sudden high fever, body aches, and malaise in a child? Doctors warn: strong suspicion of influenza; get tested as soon as possible.
article.articleSummary: 5-year-old boy in Shanghai diagnosed with Influenza A (H3N2) after sudden high fever (39.6°C), chills, and body aches; antiviral treatment and supportive care led to stabilization. China CDC Week 36 surveillance (Aug 31–Sep 6, 2026) shows influenza-like illness at 3.8% nationwide, with southern regions higher; two weeks nucleic acid positive rate up to 18.4%. Influenza A(H3N2) and Influenza B Victoria lineage are co-circulating. Symptoms include abrupt high fever, myalgia, fatigue; age-related presentations vary. Transmission via droplets and contact; incubation 1–4 days; children shed longer. Early antiviral treatment within 24–48 hours is ideal; oseltamivir (2 weeks+) per weight for 5 days; baloxavir marboxil (1 year+) as single dose. Home care: masks, isolation, fluids, light diet, ventilation, monitor mental status and breathing; seek urgent care if alarms: lethargy, tachypnea, dehydration. Vaccination remains the best protection; recommended for 6 months+, annual updates; catch-up vaccination possible up to next season; pre-holiday travel increases spread risk.

article.articleHeadline: Онищенко оценил угрозу эпидемий из-за экзотических инфекций в России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Onishchenko assessed the threat of epidemics due to exotic infections in Russia.
article.articleSummary: On September 18, 2026, Russian epidemiologist and RAS Academician Gennady Onishchenko stated that infections imported from abroad do not pose a threat of large-scale epidemics in Russia, as they are exotic. He said there are no pathogens likely to trigger a major rise or outbreak in the country; Ebola and cholera have not been imported, while chikungunya has been observed. He urged the public not to fear the Chinese tick-borne virus ALTNV and ruled out any risk of spread of the rare Bourbon virus in Russia. The remarks emphasize that foreign infections arriving in Russia remain atypical, with no ongoing introductions of highly transmissible agents. The report also notes media discussions on immunity, but reinforces that exotic agents do not present an imminent threat to Russia at this time.

triage.headline_ja: オニシチェンコ氏、ロシアにおける外来感染症によるエピデミックの脅威を評価

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Congo is still serious, African health body says
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-18, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains serious, according to Africa's top public health agency. The agency cites data showing gaps in infection prevention and control, underscoring ongoing vulnerabilities in outbreak response. The brief provides no case or death tallies, no dates of new events, and no information on laboratory confirmation or infection sources. It simply flags persistent seriousness and the need for strengthened preventive measures to curb transmission. The report highlights ongoing public health challenges in the DRC related to Ebola and reflects the continent's surveillance stance as of the publication date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行は依然として深刻、アフリカ保健機関が発表

article.articleHeadline: Pakar UGM Yogyakarta Ungkap Rantai Produksi Picu Keracunan MBG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UGM Yogyakarta expert reveals the production chain that triggers MBG poisoning.
article.articleSummary: MBG (Makan Bergizi Gratis) poisoning cases in DIY Yogyakarta show diverse bacteria across districts: Turi Sleman with Bacillus cereus and Staphylococcus aureus; Pandowoharjo with Bacillus cereus; Kota Yogyakarta with Escherichia coli; Nanggulan with Salmonella, Clostridium perfringens, Bacillus cereus, E. coli, Staphylococcus aureus; Bantul with Bacillus species. Bacteria similar to those found in Karo and Sidoarjo cases are noted. UGM Food Technology professor Endang Sutriswati Rahayu explains bacteria naturally occur in foods. Bacillus cereus forms endospores that survive cooking and can later produce toxins; Salmonella largely comes from animal-origin foods; Staphylococcus aureus commonly persists from human skin, necessitating glove use. Cooking does not destroy endospores; if food sits in heat, spores germinate and toxins form. Long distribution chains and sun-heated temperatures raise risk. The most effective solution is cooking directly at schools and consuming immediately, a practice exemplified by Japan to ensure food safety.

triage.headline_ja: UGMヨグヤカルタの専門家、MBG食中毒を引き起こす生産チェーンの問題を指摘
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの学校給食プログラム(MBG)における複数地域での食中毒（Bacillus cereus、E. coli、Salmonella等）が報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはなく、既知の食品衛生問題であるため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 国内の学校給食プログラム(Makan Bergizi Gratis)における食品衛生管理の問題が複数地域（ジョグジャカルタ特別州、東ジャワ等）で報告されている。ヒト-ヒト感染性はなく、食品由来細菌による散発的食中毒事例。国内対応可能な事案と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Anjing Peliharaan Serang Ibu dan 2 Anak di Jembrana, Sampel Diuji Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pet dog attacks mother and two children in Jembrana; samples tested for rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies testing is underway for a four-month-old male pet dog that bit three family members in Lingkungan Anyar Sari, Kelurahan Baler Bale Agung, Kecamatan Negara, Jembrana Regency, Bali. The unvaccinated dog died on 14 September 2026, and samples were sent to Balai Besar Veteriner (BBVet) Denpasar for rabies examination to confirm infection status. Victims are Ni Komang Ayu Suarini, 42, bitten on the right thumb while bathing the dog on 8 September; Conradus Febatan Tri Sandy, 15, bitten on the left thumb while removing fleas on 12 September; and Dominika Sayyo Bayu, 23, bitten on the left elbow when moving the animal on 13 September. The incident was reported by Puskesmas I Negara around 10:45 WITA on 14 September. The dog showed no clinical rabies signs before death; lab results will guide subsequent public health actions.

triage.headline_ja: 飼い犬が母親と子ども2人を襲撃、ジェンブラナでサンプルを狂犬病検査へ
