article.articleHeadline: สยบไข้เลือดออก! กทม. นำร่องฉีดวัคซีนเด็ก ป.4 ใน 5 เขตเสี่ยง ชู "เกิด-กัด-ฉีด" ตัดวงจรระบาด
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quell dengue fever! Bangkok to pilot vaccination for Grade 4 children in five high-risk districts, promoting "Cases-Bite-Vaccinate" to break the outbreak cycle.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Bangkok prompts a pilot vaccination for Grade 4 students in five high-risk districts: Klong San, Thon Buri, Bangkok Yai, Bang Kho Laem, and Din Daeng. From Jan 1 to Aug 19, 2026, Thailand reported 21,620 dengue cases and 31 deaths; Bangkok accounted for 1,785 cases and 4 deaths. The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration’s Bureau of Health launches a 40-school, Grade 4 vaccination program targeting 1,132 Thai students, aiming for at least 80% full-course vaccination with follow-up on safety and outcomes. If outcomes meet targets, expansion to all 50 Bangkok districts is planned. The initiative complements vector control and education under a WHO-aligned, multi-pronged strategy summarized as “Cases-Bite-Vaccinate”: reduce breeding, prevent bites, and vaccinate. Emphasis on physician assessment for suitability and ongoing data collection to inform broader rollout and public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱を抑制せよ！バンコク都、5つの高リスク区で小学4年生を対象にワクチン接種を試験導入、「発生・咬まれる・接種」で流行サイクルを断つ

triage.notes: デング熱はタイで例年発生する風土病であり、本記事はバンコク都保健局による小学生向けワクチン接種パイロット事業の発表が主題。感染者数（タイ全体21,620件、死亡31名）は例年の流行状況として報告されており、突発的な異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ cảnh báo bệnh từ bùn đất, nước bẩn sau khi nước rút
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Warn of Disease from Mud and Dirty Water After the Floodwaters Recede.
article.articleSummary: After heavy rains and floods in Hanoi and rural Vietnam, floodwater mud and waste raise post‑flood illness risk. Leptospira-caused leptospirosis, from water contaminated with animal urine, presents with fever, headache, myalgia, and calf pain; severe cases may cause jaundice and kidney/liver injury. Prevent with avoiding dirty water, wearing boots and gloves, covering wounds; seek early care for fever with myalgia or jaundice. Melioidosis (Burkholderia pseudomallei) in soil and water can enter via wounds or inhalation; farmers and diabetics are at higher risk; symptoms include prolonged fever, skin abscesses, pneumonia, sepsis. Water- and food-borne diseases (diarrhea, dysentery, typhoid, cholera, hepatitis A) can occur; eat cooked, drink boiled water. After floodwaters recede, dengue risk rises; eliminate standing water, use larvivorous fish, long sleeves, nets. For wounds, clean and disinfect; monitor health and seek care for alarming symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水後の泥や汚水による疾病に医師が警鐘

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lumpy skin disease wreaks havoc in Bharatpur, 3,000 cattle infected, know the department's crucial advisory.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) is spreading in Bharatpur district, Rajasthan, with about 3,000 cattle infected. Despite previous outbreaks, severity is lower this time as about 80% of the district’s ~100,000 cattle have been vaccinated, and 828 infected animals have recovered. The outbreak is concentrated in Sevar, Nadbai, and Uchhain, near the Uttar Pradesh border. Cases have been reported since the third week of August. Vaccination campaigns continue to push toward full coverage. A district control room (05644-224375) and Rapid Response Teams comprising a veterinarian, an LSI, and a livestock attendant have been deployed to the affected blocks. Farmers are advised to report suspected cases, isolate infected animals, maintain hygiene, and guard against flies and mosquitoes. Early signs include reduced feed/water intake, nodules on body/neck/back, fever, nasal/eye discharge, and reduced milk; timely treatment may yield recovery in 3–5 days.

triage.headline_ja: バラトプルでランピースキン病が猛威、牛3,000頭感染、獣医局の重要なアドバイザリー

article.articleHeadline: Borok SPPG Terkuak Usai 37 Siswa di Kediri Keracunan: Daging Ditaruh di Bawah, Kucing Bebas Masuk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SPPG Ulcers Revealed After 37 Students in Kediri Were Poisoned: Meat Placed Underneath, Cats Allowed to Enter.
article.articleSummary: Mass foodborne illness in Kediri, Indonesia: 37 elementary students from SDN Kampung Dalem 3, SDN Kampung Dalem 4, and SDN Kaliombo developed poisoning after meals provided by SPPG Kaliombo, the catering arm of Kediri’s Free Nutritious Meal Program (MBG). Of the 37 cases, 10 were hospitalized at RSUD Gambiran for dehydration and prolonged vomiting; 27 were treated as outpatients. The Kediri City Government halted all SPPG Kaliombo operations on 18 September 2026, with medical costs fully covered and psychological support offered to victims. An immediate cross-agency investigation found sanitation lapses: stray cats accessing raw poultry, kitchen staff not wearing PPE, and CCTV showing food preparation started earlier and lasting over four hours; cold chain storage of chicken was inadequately followed. Leftover samples are being tested for bacterial pathogens or other hazards. Investigations involve TNI, Polri, Kejaksaan, and Badan Gizi Nasional.

triage.headline_ja: SPPGの不衛生が発覚、ケディリで37人の児童が食中毒:肉は下に置かれ猫が自由に出入り

article.articleHeadline: DRC, Ebola Emergency Response 2026 - Logistics Situation Updates | 7 - 13 Sep 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola emergency response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is reviewed for 7–13 September 2026 in a Logistics and Telecommunications Cluster (LTC) Situation Update. The document delivers an operational overview of the Ebola response, detailing key epidemiological and operational developments, response challenges, and progress in delivering common logistics and telecommunications services to humanitarian partners. It outlines ongoing coordination efforts, service delivery achievements, and priority actions planned to support the evolving response and ensure partners can effectively reach affected populations. Emphasis is placed on enabling field operations through logistics and communications support, with a focus on sustaining information sharing, partner access, and coordinated service delivery amid the ongoing Ebola emergency in the DRC. The update underscores the critical role of LTC support in enabling responders to reach communities and maintain essential supply chains during the outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: India's Dr Reddy's inks distribution agreement with Takeda for dengue vaccine in India
article.articleSummary: Dengue vaccine Qdenga is set for promotion and distribution in India under a new agreement between Dr Reddy's Laboratories and Takeda Pharmaceutical Company. Dr Reddy's Laboratories (REDY.NS) said on Friday it signed a deal with Takeda (4502.T) for the promotion and distribution of Takeda’s Qdenga dengue vaccine in India. The announcement, dated 18 September 2026, covers Indian promotion and distribution responsibilities, but offered no details on launch timelines, pricing, or rollout scope. The arrangement designates Dr Reddy's to handle promotion and distribution of Qdenga in India. The Reuters piece confirms the collaboration between the Indian drugmaker and Takeda to make Qdenga available in India.

article.articleHeadline: Cách phòng chống các loại dịch bệnh trong mùa mưa lũ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ways to prevent various infectious diseases during the rainy and flood season.
article.articleSummary: During Vietnam’s rainy and flood season, multiple infections rise. Skin diseases include athlete’s foot (tinea pedis), tinea versicolor (lang ben), tinea corporis, and scabies; prevention centers on avoiding bathing in dirty water, drying the skin, and avoiding damp clothing. Respiratory illnesses such as the common cold, influenza, sore throat, and other acute respiratory infections are mitigated by keeping warm, limiting contact with the sick, and maintaining good nutrition. Diarrheal diseases linked to contaminated water and food—Escherichia coli–related diarrhea, dysentery, typhoid fever, cholera, and hepatitis A—call for safe drinking water, environmental and personal hygiene, thoroughly cooked foods, and soap-and-water handwashing. Eye infections (conjunctivitis, blepharitis, dacryocystitis) are prevented by clean washing water, not sharing towels, and fly control. Dengue fever, a mosquito-borne disease, is addressed with bed nets, long sleeves, elimination of standing water, larval source reduction, and targeted insecticide spraying in high-risk areas. Ensure safe food and water supplies in flooded zones.

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal Karakteristik dan Bahaya Infeksi Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understanding the Characteristics and Dangers of Influenza A Infection.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A infection in Indonesia is under intensified surveillance after upticks in East Java and other areas. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin said the ministry monitors case movements via sentinel sites and has directed the Directorate General of Disease Prevention and Control to review regions reporting surges. He noted that the current Influenza A variant is not the deadly H5 avian flu, though it remains transmissible, and that the feared subtype is H5. Vulnerable groups, especially infants and toddlers, may develop pneumonia, bronchiolitis, myositis, encephalitis, or cardiac complications. Prevention emphasizes hygiene: regular handwashing with soap, avoiding direct contact with the sick, not touching eyes, nose, or mouth before washing, and annual influenza vaccination. Public is advised not to panic excessively.

article.articleHeadline: 最新回应来了！知名品牌泡凤爪检出大肠菌群超标_YNET.com北青网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Here’s the latest response! A well-known brand’s pickled chicken feet detected with excessive coliform bacteria.
article.articleSummary: In Tianjin, the 2026 No.5 food safety surveillance report flagged one unqualified batch of pickled chicken feet (spicy pepper flavor) produced for You Food Co., Ltd. by Sichuan Youyou Food Development Co., Ltd. The 136 g/袋 irradiated product, production date 2026-01-27, was sold by Tianjin Jin’nan District Baohu Shengfeng Food Business Department. Five tests showed total plate count up to 1.0×10^7 CFU/g (100× the M value) and Escherichia coli up to 1.8×10^4 CFU/g (180× the M value). On Sept 17, Youyou Foods’ official customer service said retained samples tested by their own lab, Sichuan Food Testing Research Institute, and Chengdu Pidu District Market Regulatory Bureau were all qualified. Investigations by Jin’nan Market Authority attributed improper distributor storage, not production. Youyou Foods, founded 1997 in Chongqing and listed on the SSE in 2019, is nicknamed the “First Chicken Feet stock.” Potential consumer symptoms include vomiting and diarrhea.

article.articleHeadline: Какие опасные инфекции завозят в Россию: эпидемиолог оценил риск распространения
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What dangerous infections are being imported into Russia: an epidemiologist assessed the risk of spread
article.articleSummary: Russia is seeing imported exotic infections, including Ebola, cholera, and chikungunya; Ebola and cholera have not been imported yet, while chikungunya has previously arrived. Epidemiologist Gennady Onishchenko says these infections are exotic and unlikely to trigger large outbreaks in Russia. Ebola is a viral disease with fatality, transmitted via blood and bodily fluids and contaminated objects; symptoms include fever, weakness, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding. Cholera, caused by Vibrio cholerae, causes dehydration from profuse diarrhea and vomiting. Chikungunya is spread by Aedes mosquitoes; symptoms include fever and severe joint pain that can persist for months or years; there is no cure or widely available vaccine, so prevention focuses on bite avoidance and seeking medical care. Head of Rospotrebnadzor Anna Popova notes imports have doubled; main risks are imported cholera and tropical fevers, with no domestic spread. New swine flu and Hong Kong flu strains could appear, but immunity is low.

article.articleHeadline: Update Kasus Rabies di Bali, Badung Catat Kasus Gigitan Harian Terbanyak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Case Update in Bali: Badung Records the Highest Daily Bite Cases.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a public health concern in Bali, Indonesia. As of 11 September 2026, Bali Province reported 52,645 animal-bite injuries (GHPR) across nine districts/cities, with 39,193 bites from animals suspected positive for rabies (diVAR). The average is about 219 bites per day. Badung records the highest activity with 9,961 GHPR (7,262 diVAR) or roughly 42 bites daily. Karangasem has 6,566 GHPR (5,094 diVAR) and Denpasar 6,480 GHPR (5,891 diVAR) at about 27 per day. Gianyar, Tabanan, and Buleleng report 5,949 (3,513 diVAR), 5,894 (4,398 diVAR), and 5,687 (3,840 diVAR) respectively. Jembrana and Klungkung tally 5,622 (4,711 diVAR) and 3,728 (2,504 diVAR); Bangli records 2,758 (1,980 diVAR). By mid-September, seven deaths occurred (most in Buleleng), with no fatalities in Badung, Denpasar, Bangli, or Klungkung. Officials urge post-bite treatment promptly and reporting to authorities.

article.articleHeadline: Vụ chó cắn nhiều người ở Quảng Ngãi: Kết quả xét nghiệm chó dương tính với virus dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog-bite incident in Quảng Ngãi: dog tests positive for the rabies virus.
article.articleSummary: Rabies exposure in Dong Son commune, Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam, linked to a stray dog. On 15 September the unowned dog, showing lethargy, red eyes and drooling, bit five residents in four villages (Châu Thuận Tây, Châu Thuận Biển, Phú Quý, and Tân Định) before being captured and killed. On 18 September the dog’s sample DS-DAI tested positive for rabies at the National Center for Diagnostic and Testing Veterinary Medicine II in Đắk Lắk. The five bite victims received wound treatment, rabies vaccination, and rabies immunoglobulin; none developed rabies symptoms during home observation. Đông Sơn’s Public Service Center organized environmental disinfection and vaccinated all exposed owned dogs, and distributed vaccines to households for routine canine/feline vaccination. Sở Y tế Quảng Ngãi urged continued surveillance, vaccination campaigns, and culling/disposal of animals suspected of rabies. Since January 2026, Quảng Ngãi reports two rabies deaths and over 11,000 people have sought post-exposure vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ省での犬による多数咬傷事件：犬の検査結果は狂犬病ウイルス陽性

triage.notes: 本事案自体は野良犬1頭による咬傷で、被害者は全員暴露後ワクチン・免疫グロブリンを受け発症なし。ただしクアンガイ省では2026年1月以降、狂犬病による死亡2件、暴露後ワクチン希望者11,000人超と報告されており、地域的な狂犬病流行の継続が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Researchers find leptospirosis-causing bacteria across Estero de Paco
article.articleSummary: Estero de Paco in Metro Manila hosts Leptospira across five sites; screening 448 isolates from soil and water confirmed the pathogen at every site with no significant upstream downstream or soil versus water differences, implying the whole estero is a single evenly loaded reservoir. Leptospirosis outbreaks peak about two weeks after heavy rains; flooding drives transmission. In 2025, DOH recorded 3 037 cases Jan to July, including 1 114 within a week after the rainy season began. DOH also reported 8 317 cases Jan 1 to Sept 5, 2026, up from 7 280 in the same period last year. Historical outbreaks include Ondoy Ketsana 2009 with 2 089 cases and 162 deaths; Sendong Washi 2011 with more than 400 cases and 22 deaths. Transmission occurs via contact with urine, blood or tissue of infected animals; bacteria persist in floodwater and soil, incubation up to 28 days. Genetically two pathogenic Leptospira strains with lipL32 were found, identified as Leptospira yasudae, newly sequenced in the Philippines and divergent from global genomes.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者ら、エステロ・デ・パコ全域でレプトスピラ症原因菌を検出

triage.notes: 記事は環境中のレプトスピラ菌調査・新種発見に関する研究報告が主体で、DOHの年次症例数増加傾向も言及されているが、急性の集団発生や国際的懸念を示す情報はない。今後の症例動向・新種の病原性評価を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Dr Reddys signs agreement for distribution of Takeda's dengue vaccine in India
article.articleSummary: Dr Reddy's Laboratories and Takeda have signed a distribution agreement to promote and distribute Takeda's dengue vaccine QDENGA in India's private market for pediatric and adult vaccination. The vaccine received CDSCO marketing authorization in July 2026 for individuals aged 4–60 years, making it India's first approved dengue vaccine. Under the deal, Dr. Reddy's will lead promotion and distribution, with availability anticipated in the first half of 2027, subject to completion of applicable processes with local authorities. The collaboration between Takeda Biopharmaceuticals India and Dr. Reddy's Laboratories marks a milestone in India's dengue prevention and management efforts by expanding access to vaccination across private sector channels.

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal H1N1pdm09, Influenza A yang Lagi Mendominasi Kenaikan Kasus di RI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Getting to Know H1N1pdm09, the Influenza A Strain Currently Dominating the Rise in Cases in Indonesia
article.articleSummary: H1N1pdm09 influenza A is identified as the leading cause of the recent rise in respiratory infections in Indonesia, according to the Ministry of Health (Kemenkes RI). The H1N1pdm09 virus first emerged in April 2009 in Mexico, prompting it to be called the Mexican flu or swine flu. By June 2009 the WHO declared a pandemic with 74 countries reporting infections; the October 2009 global tally exceeded 440,000 cases. After the pandemic phase, routine WHO reporting ended; by August 2010, the post-pandemic status was declared and at least 18,449 deaths were recorded worldwide. Public health experts say H1N1pdm09 is no longer as dangerous as during the 2009 outbreak; influenza A remains the most common flu type, with B and C infections being unusual. The article notes H1N1pdm09 is currently the dominant influenza A strain in circulation in Indonesia rather than indicating greater severity.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1pdm09を知る：インドネシアで感染増加の主流となっているインフルエンザA型
triage.triage_reason: H1N1pdm09は既知の季節性インフルエンザ株であり、記事自体も2009年当時より危険性は低いと明記している。異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスクのいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア保健省がH1N1pdm09を現在の呼吸器感染症増加の主因として説明する解説記事であり、歴史的背景（2009年メキシコでの発生・WHOパンデミック宣言）を紹介する内容が中心。現在の流行は季節性の範囲内で深刻ではないと述べられている。

article.articleHeadline: भोपाल में स्वाइन फ्लू जांच का 'रेट कार्ड' अलग-अलग, 1800 से लेकर 4000 तक फीस, मरीज परेशान | Swine Flu Testing Charges Range From 1800 To 4000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Bhopal, Swine Flu Testing Rate Cards Vary; Fees Range From 1800 To 4000, Patients Worried.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 September 2026, swine flu (H1N1) testing in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, shows wide private-lab price variation: INR 1,800–4,000. Ashoka Garden labs charge about INR 3,200; Kolar around INR 2,500; Chunabhatti about INR 4,000. Jay Prakash and Hamidia hospitals do not offer testing; AIIMS Bhopal provides free H1N1 testing, with city samples routed there. Gandhi Medical College lab was directed to start testing earlier this year, but equipment hasn’t been installed. COVID-era RT-PCR price caps have not been extended to H1N1 tests, leading to inconsistent charges. In 2026, Bhopal has reported 71 swine flu cases; across Madhya Pradesh last year only seven cases were recorded, with 2019 exceeding 100, and 2021 and 2022 reporting 22 and 48 respectively. OPD viral infections total 450–500 at Hamidia and Jay Prakash. Health officials urge targeted testing and continued precautions; no overcharging complaints have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールでスワインフル検査の「料金表」がばらばら、1800～4000ルピーの費用差に患者困惑
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はH1N1検査費用のばらつきという医療サービス・行政問題であり、症例数（Bhopal市71件）も過去の年次データの範囲内で異常な増加や重症化の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性H1N1（スワインフル）検査の価格ばらつきと検査体制の不備に関するもので、感染症危機としての新規性・異常性は認められない。過去数年のケース数（2019年100件超、2021年22件、2022年48件、2025年7件）と比較しても2026年の71件は特筆すべき急増とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Dispuesta Cuba a ayudar nuevamente en el enfrentamiento al ébola - Radio Habana Cuba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuba Ready to Help Again in the Fight Against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Cuba expressed willingness to aid the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo after a virtual meeting between Health Ministers José Ángel Portal Miranda and Samuel Roger Kamba. The DRC reported a surge from four to 60 health zones affected across six provinces, with case fatality over 40%, seeking support to halt spread, strengthen patient care, back field teams, and enhance surveillance—including weekly risk assessments, epidemiological mapping, contingency planning, and pre-positioning supplies. The article recalls Cuba’s 2014 West Africa deployment of the Henry Reeve Contingent: over 12,000 volunteers, 400 selected, 256 who served after excluding those with chronic conditions, trained at the Pedro Kourí Institute, with malaria prophylaxis. During that mission, Cuban teams confronted Ebola and other diseases; one nurse died of malaria in 2015. In Liberia, Sierra Leone, and Guinea, the UN later declared virus-free after 90 days of intense surveillance, citing 28,634 cases and 11,314 deaths. The Cuban experience informs current collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: キューバ、エボラ対策で再び支援の用意
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ感染地域が4から60保健地区に急拡大し致死率40%超と報告されており、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクが高くIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はキューバの支援申し出とDRCでのエボラ拡大状況を報じており、他国(キューバ、シエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニア)は2014年西アフリカ流行の歴史的言及のみで現発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Is Only the Beginning
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus, began at least eight months ago in the northeastern town of Mongbwalu. By mid-May the Congolese government, with WHO support, confirmed the source, and since then the epidemic has killed more than 3,500 people across Congo, making it the deadliest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in the country. Uganda confirmed two cases, a cross-border transmission. The outbreak’s case-fatality rate sits around 50%, with about 60% of deaths between mid-July and late August outside health facilities, signaling undercounted illness and transmission beyond health systems. Despite some progress, containment remains elusive four months after confirmation. The episode underscores global health-security weaknesses, including rising Ebola and Marburg outbreaks (12 in Biden era vs five previously) and concerns about AI-aided misuse, funding gaps, and US policy shifts—withdrawal from WHO and USAID dissolution—that weaken outbreak response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはまだ始まりに過ぎない
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で3,500人以上が死亡し、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認された、致死率約50%の史上最悪・最速拡大のエボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの2例確認は越境感染として言及されているが、ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。記事は主にDRCの流行の深刻さとグローバルヘルスセキュリティの弱体化を論じている。

article.articleHeadline: Bilaspur News Update : शराब के लिए पैसे नहीं देने पर कार-बाइक में लगाई आग... महिला की स्वाइन फ्लू जांच रिपोर्ट आई पॉजिटिव... म्यूल बैंक खातों के गिरोह का भंडाफोड़... झरने में नहाने गए ग्रामीण की मौत...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bilaspur News Update: After not paying for liquor, someone set fire to a car and a bike... Woman tests positive for swine flu... Mule bank accounts gang busted... Villager dies while bathing at a waterfall.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) detected in a woman in Janjgir-Champa district, Chhattisgarh, with laboratory confirmation. As of 18 September 2026, the district has six or more suspected cases, with most patients referred to higher medical centers after initial treatment. Earlier, a Raipur resident who had traveled to the district tested positive. One swine flu death has been reported in the state/district. Symptoms include sudden high fever, chills, dry cough, sore throat, fatigue, body aches, headache, nasal congestion, with vomiting/diarrhea in some cases. Health authorities maintain strict surveillance and urge those with flu-like symptoms to seek medical care promptly to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: ビラースプル・ニュースアップデート：酒代を払わなかったことで車とバイクに放火…女性のスワインフルー検査結果が陽性に…ミュール銀行口座の詐欺グループを摘発…滝で水浴びをしていた村人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドのチャッティースガル州で季節性のH1N1（スワインフルー）症例が複数確認され死亡例もあるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の重大性を示す情報はなく、既知の疾患であるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: H1N1はインドで季節性・地域流行的に発生する既知の疾患であり、複数の疑い例と1件の死亡が報告されているが、記事は地方ニュースの一項目として簡潔に触れているのみで詳細情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Peningkatan Kasus Influenza A, Puan Dorong Penguatan Infrastruktur Kesehatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Influenza A cases, Puan urges strengthening of health infrastructure.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia — Rising Influenza A activity prompts Speaker of the Indonesian House, Puan Maharani, to urge strengthened health infrastructure. She calls the government to provide clear information, accessible protection, and guaranteed care, including emergency department services, across areas where transmission is high. Citing the Health Ministry, she notes that young children are the most vulnerable amid the current rise. While the Health Ministry regards the increase as seasonal, Puan emphasizes preparedness of healthcare facilities to cope with higher caseloads and persistent outbreaks. She also urges transparent public communication to prevent reliance on unverified reports and to educate the public about transmission, affected groups, and recommended actions when a family member shows symptoms. She urges reinstating public health measures: wear masks outdoors, frequent handwashing, and nutritious diet; and advises the ill to rest at home and seek medical care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型感染症例の増加、プアン議長が医療インフラ強化を促す
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザとして保健省が認識しているが、政治的関心（国会議長の発言）が高まっているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 保健省は季節性の増加と評価しており、新型株や異常な病原性の報告はない。政治家（国会議長）の発言により社会的・政治的関心が高まっている点が注視点。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases in Albay hit over 2,000
article.articleSummary: From January through September 12, 2026, dengue in Albay province, Philippines, has reached 2,179 cases with 14 deaths, according to the Albay Provincial Information Office (PIO) citing a Provincial Incident Management Team (IMT) report issued on September 15, 2026. The figure is 84.19% higher than the 1,183 cases recorded during the same period in 2025. The data, reported in Naga City, indicate ongoing dengue activity in Albay. The report does not provide details on transmission sources or symptoms. The sharp year-over-year rise underscores heightened public health concern in the Bicol region and highlights the need for continued vector-control and community-awareness efforts to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アルバイ州のデング熱症例が2,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・アルバイ州でデング熱症例数が前年比84%増、死亡14人と報告されているが、デング熱自体は同国で季節性・流行性が既知の疾患であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは限定的。今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで毎年季節的に流行する疾患であり、今回の増加は例年のパターンの延長とみられるが、前年比大幅増と死亡例の増加は注視すべき。ベクター対策の継続が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Vụ chó cắn 5 người ở Quảng Ngãi: Phát hiện có vi rút gây bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five people bitten by a dog in Quảng Ngãi: Rabies virus detected.
article.articleSummary: Five people in Dong Son commune, Quang Ngai Province, Vietnam were bitten by a dog on 15 September; the dog was later confirmed positive for rabies, with laboratory results released to the local service center by the Central Veterinary Diagnostic and Testing Center II. As of 18 September 2026, local authorities are administering the second dose of rabies vaccine to the five bite victims and monitoring for symptoms, urging immediate medical care if symptoms appear. Officials are tracing those who killed the dog and assessing exposure risk for anyone potentially exposed to the animal’s saliva, especially with wounds. The dog’s burial site has been disinfected with chloramine B. The Quang Ngai Department of Health issued guidance to isolate and monitor dogs and cats in the outbreak area, vaccinate healthy animals, restrict animal movement, and enforce PPE for personnel; the provincial CDC will coordinate surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ省で5人が犬に噛まれた事件：狂犬病ウイルスを検出
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム国内での散発的な狂犬病曝露事例であり、地元当局が適切に対応（ワクチン接種・監視・消毒）しているため国際的拡大の懸念は低いが、動物由来感染症として継続的な動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率が高い疾患だが、本件は局地的な動物咬傷事例で当局が迅速に対応しており、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクはない。国内の公衆衛生対応事例として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Sau mưa ngập, nhiều bệnh có thể phát sinh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After floods, many diseases may emerge.
article.articleSummary: Flooding in Hanoi and northern provinces after heavy rains creates multiple infectious risks from floodwater, mud, and contaminated food. Leptospira bacteria cause leptospirosis, entering through skin abrasions during exposure to water or mud; early symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, and fatigue, with potential jaundice and kidney/liver injury in severe cases. Whitmore (melioidosis), due to Burkholderia pseudomallei in soil and water, affects farmers and diabetics and can present as prolonged fever, skin abscesses, pneumonia, or septicemia; cases are still reported during the rainy season at the Central Hospital for Tropical Diseases. Water- and foodborne illnesses (diarrhea, dysentery, cholera, hepatitis A) may rise from contaminated foods and water, with dehydration risk. Post-flood dengue risk may increase as standing water remains; remove standing water, cover containers, and use mosquito protection. Aeromonas and Vibrio wound infections; tetanus risk; cleanse wounds and seek care for deep or infected injuries. Boiled water, cooked foods, and handwashing are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水後、多くの疾病が発生する可能性
triage.triage_reason: ハノイ及び北部での洪水後に複数の感染症リスク（レプトスピラ症、類鼻疽、コレラ、A型肝炎、デング熱等）が指摘されているが、実際の症例数や規模の情報がなく一般的な注意喚起記事のため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性の洪水後感染症リスクに関する一般的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数の急増や集団発生の報告はない。複数疾患（レプトスピラ症、類鼻疽、コレラ、A型肝炎、デング熱、ビブリオ症、破傷風）が併記されているが、いずれも個別の新規アウトブレイクとしての性質は薄い。

article.articleHeadline: Jembrana Gelar Vaksinasi Darurat, Pasca Satu Keluarga Digigit Anak Anjing Usia 4 Bulan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jembrana Holds Emergency Vaccination, After a Family Was Bitten by a Four-Month-Old Puppy
article.articleSummary: Rabies alert in Jembrana, Bali, after a four-month-old puppy bit a family. Emergency vaccination of three pet animals was conducted by Tim Medikvet Kecamatan Negara in Lingkungan Anyar Sari, Kelurahan Baler Bale Agung, Negara District, on 18 September 2026. The bite victims were Ni Komang Ayu Suarniti (42) and her two children, Conradus Febatan Tri Sandi (15) and Dominika Sanyo Bayu (23); the puppy died shortly after the attack. Brain samples were collected for laboratory testing at Balai Besar Veteriner Denpasar; results will guide further action, including possible expanded vaccination around the incident area if rabies is confirmed. Three pets have been vaccinated so far; the area is sparsely populated. This case adds to ongoing rabies concerns in Bali, with earlier reports in Badung.

triage.headline_ja: ジェンバラナで緊急ワクチン接種を実施、生後4カ月の子犬に一家が噛まれる事案を受けて
triage.triage_reason: バリ島で狂犬病の疑いのある咬傷事例が発生し地域的なワクチン接種が行われているが、検査結果待ちで確定診断はなく、既存の風土病的な狂犬病問題の一環とみられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: バリ島（ジェンバラナ、以前はバドゥン）で狂犬病の咬傷事例が続いており、地域的な風土病化の懸念があるが、本件は検査結果待ちで確定診断されていない局所的事案。

article.articleHeadline: Mưa lớn ngập úng nhiều nơi, bác sĩ cảnh báo nguy cơ lây nhiễm nhiều bệnh nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Heavy rains cause widespread flooding in many areas; a doctor warns of the risk of transmission of many dangerous diseases.
article.articleSummary: Heavy rains across Hanoi and northern provinces have caused widespread flooding, with floodwaters carrying mud, waste, animal carcasses, and wastewater that contaminate water sources and the environment, increasing exposure as people wade and clean mud. Leptospirosis (Leptospira) and melioidosis (Burkholderia pseudomallei) are typical flood-related diseases, presenting with fever and muscle pain and potentially organ involvement; prevention focuses on avoiding direct contact with dirty water, wearing boots and gloves, and protecting skin. Water- and food-borne illnesses—diarrhea, dysentery, typhoid, cholera, and hepatitis A—are common after floods, with symptoms of diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and dehydration. After waters recede, dengue risk rises due to standing water; remove water-holding containers, use larvivorous fish, and shield against mosquitoes. Eye infections (conjunctivitis) and wound infections (Aeromonas, Vibrio) and tetanus risk from dirty wounds are noted. Six preventive measures include using clean water, cooking food, minimizing contact with dirty water, handwashing, disinfection, and removing standing water to curb vectors.

triage.headline_ja: 大雨により各地で浸水、医師が多くの危険な感染症のリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後に想定される複数感染症（レプトスピラ症、類鼻疽、コレラ、腸チフス、A型肝炎、デング熱等）への一般的な予防啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数・集団発生の報告がないため情報不足。今後の疾病発生状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は洪水後の感染症予防に関する医師の一般的な注意喚起であり、実際の患者発生数や集団感染の報告は含まれていない。今後、具体的な症例報告が出た場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Онищенко рассказал, какие инфекции завозят в Россию чаще всего
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Onishchenko explained which infections are imported into Russia most often.
article.articleSummary: Russia predominantly imports exotic infections from abroad, says epidemiologist and Russian Academy of Sciences academician Gennady Onishchenko. He stressed there is no current indicator of an epidemic surge, only exotic pathogens being brought in. Popova added that about 500 cases of imported dangerous infections have been registered in Russia. Among imported infections is chikungunya fever. There have been no imported cases of Ebola or cholera. Earlier, Rospotrebnadzor reported imported West Nile fever from Thailand, Mali, and the Central African Republic (per 360.ru). The statements underscore that these are foreign-origin infections with no sustained domestic transmission, highlighting ongoing vigilance for imported pathogens entering Russia. Published date reference: 2026-09-18.

triage.headline_ja: オニシチェンコ氏、ロシアに最も多く輸入される感染症について説明
triage.triage_reason: ロシアへの輸入感染症に関する専門家の一般的な統計コメントであり、特定の異常なアウトブレイクや緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア国内の輸入感染症サーベイランスに関する専門家コメントであり、タイ・マリ・中央アフリカ共和国は過去の輸入西ナイル熱症例の感染地として言及されているのみで、これらの国での現在進行中のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。対象国リストにあるタイも主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nhận biết sớm để chủ động phòng các bệnh truyền nhiễm trong và sau ngập úng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early identification to proactively prevent infectious diseases during and after flooding.
article.articleSummary: Heavy rains and floods in Hanoi and northern Vietnam leave floodwaters contaminated with animal waste and mud, raising risks of leptospirosis and melioidosis, plus diarrheal, hepatitis A, and other water- and soil-borne diseases as people wade and clean mud. Leptospirosis begins with fever, headache, muscle pain (calves), and fatigue; severe cases can cause jaundice and kidney/liver injury. Melioidosis can present with fever, skin abscesses, pneumonia, or sepsis; prevention aims to avoid direct mud contact and wash hands after work. Gastrointestinal infections (diarrhea, dysentery, typhoid, cholera, hepatitis A) rise from contaminated water/food; ensure safe water, cook thoroughly, discard flood-affected foods, and wash hands. After water recedes, dengue risk rises from standing water; remove containers, cover tanks, use nets, and wear protective clothing. Eye, skin, wound infections and tetanus risk require prompt medical care; respiratory infections also rise; keep homes warm and well-ventilated.

triage.headline_ja: 浸水中・浸水後の感染症を早期発見し、能動的に予防するために
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の感染症リスクに関する一般的な啓発・予防情報であり、具体的な患者数や集団発生の報告はないが、複数疾患（レプトスピラ症、メリオイドーシス、腸管感染症、デング熱等）の流行しやすい環境が形成されているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な発生報告ではなく、洪水後の公衆衛生啓発記事。実際の症例数・規模の情報がないため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo các bệnh truyền nhiễm sau mưa lớn, ngập úng liên tục nhiều nơi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning about infectious diseases after heavy rainfall, with ongoing flooding in many areas.
article.articleSummary: Following heavy rain and flooding in Hanoi and northern Vietnam, water and mud contaminated with animal urine facilitates Leptospira infection (leptospirosis) via skin breaks; symptoms include fever, headache, myalgia, with possible jaundice and kidney/liver injury. Melioidosis (Burkholderia pseudomallei) from soil and water causes prolonged fever, skin abscesses, pneumonia or septicemia; cases recur each monsoon. Prevent by avoiding dirty floodwater, wearing boots/gloves, covering wounds, washing after exposure, and seeking prompt care for fever with myalgia or jaundice. Diarrheal diseases (typhoid, cholera, dysentery) and hepatitis A rise from contaminated water/food; watch for diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain and dehydration. Dengue risk increases weeks after floods; eliminate standing water, cover tanks, use larvivorous fish, wear long clothing and nets. Eye infections (conjunctivitis) and wound infections by Aeromonas/Vibrio; tetanus risk from muddy wounds; seek medical attention for severe wounds or eye symptoms, and keep homes dry to reduce respiratory infections.

triage.headline_ja: 大雨・浸水後の感染症に警戒、多くの地域で洪水が継続
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後に典型的に見られる複数の感染症（レプトスピラ症、類鼻疽、コレラ、腸チフス、A型肝炎、デング熱等）への一般的な注意喚起記事であり、具体的な症例数や集団発生の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の重大な緊急事態を示す情報は不明。
triage.notes: 本記事は洪水後の季節性感染症に関する一般的な啓発・予防情報であり、具体的な発生数や集団感染の報告は含まれていない。政府系メディア（baochinhphu.vn）による注意喚起記事。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲疾控中心：刚果金伊波拉疫情仍未得到控制
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled, centered in Ituri province around Bunia. As of Sept 15, 2026, DR Congo reports 7,404 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,577 deaths (case fatality 48.3%), across seven provinces and 62 health zones, with Ituri accounting for about 77.7% of cases. Africa CDC says the outbreak curve shows a slight overall decline but is not yet stable, and peak cannot be confirmed; authorities must map transmission chains and bolster community surveillance to prevent spread to new areas. The World Health Organization noted on Aug 16 that there are encouraging signs in Ituri, yet transmission continues and fatalities accrue. The outbreak began May 15; by Aug 12 it was described as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.notes: 史上2番目に大きい規模のエボラ流行とされ、Africa CDCとWHOが継続的に監視・声明を発表している。

article.articleHeadline: Jaundice outbreak in Odisha's government residential school, 70 girls test positive in 10 days
article.articleSummary: Jaundice outbreak at a government tribal girls' residential school in Rebadi, Kolnara block, Rayagada district, Odisha, with more than 70 students testing positive within 10 days and about 100 more showing jaundice-related symptoms. The school houses around 370 girls. First cases were reported on September 7, with six students developing yellowing of the eyes and vomiting. Health teams collected blood samples from all inmates; at least five students were hospitalised—four at Rayagada district headquarters hospital and one shifted to MKCG Medical College and Hospital in Berhampur, discharged on Wednesday. The immediate concern is the drinking water source; a borewell on campus has been stopped after a suspected link, though causality is not yet established. Students are receiving boiled water via tankers. About 20 parents have taken daughters home for traditional or herbal treatments instead of continuing care at the hostel. Daily health teams visit, with alternate drinking water arrangements.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州の寄宿制公立学校で黄疸の集団発生、10日間で70人の女子生徒が陽性
triage.triage_reason: 水系感染が疑われる黄疸（肝炎の可能性）の集団発生で、脆弱な集団（寄宿学校の女子生徒）に一定規模の影響が出ているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、原因病原体・因果関係も未確定のため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 疾患は『黄疸(jaundice)』としか報告されておらず、A型・E型肝炎など具体的な病原体は未確定。井戸水（ボアウェル）との因果関係も未確定。地域限定の学校内アウトブレイクであり、現地保健当局が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: फिजी में तेजी से बढ़ रहे एचआईवी के मामले, नेशनल इमरजेंसी घोषित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapidly Rising HIV Cases in Fiji, National Emergency Declared.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 September 2026, Fiji has declared a national HIV emergency after infections surged to 1 in 60 adults, with 9,100 people living with HIV in a 900,000 population. Five years ago the rate was 1 in 167. Free testing, treatment, and prevention are being rolled out nationwide, and child HIV-related deaths are rising. Health Minister Antonio Lalabalavu announced the emergency, citing urgency; aid comes from India, Australia, New Zealand, the Global Fund, and the UN. UNAIDS says Fiji’s new infections are among the fastest-growing globally. The region is a transit hub for methamphetamine and cocaine bound for Australia and New Zealand, with usage rising in local markets. Globally, Eswatini, South Africa, Lesotho, Botswana, Mozambique, and Zimbabwe are among the most affected. In India, 2.6 million live with HIV; adult prevalence ~0.2%; new infections declined ~44% since 2010; antenatal testing and 30 million free HIV tests annually.

article.articleHeadline: Епидемијата на ебола во ДР Конго сè уште не е под контрола | Скопско Ехо
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is still not under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains serious and not under control. Africa CDC warns of gaps in prevention and infection-control systems. Although the past two weeks show a modest decline in cases, data are incomplete, and transmission is not consistently controlled across all affected areas. Congolese Health Minister Samuel Roge Kamba says there are encouraging signs and that the outbreak's spread is slowing gradually. Africa CDC cautions that assessments are based on incomplete data. Director-General Jean Kaseya says a sustained decline in new cases is needed before the hardest phase can be declared over. He welcomed reduced infections in the eastern Ituri province, but emphasizes that the overall situation remains serious.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、依然として制御下にない

article.articleHeadline: Dr Reddy's signs India distribution deal for Takeda's Qdenga dengue vaccine
article.articleSummary: Dr Reddy's Laboratories signed an agreement with Takeda Pharmaceutical to promote and distribute the Qdenga dengue vaccine in India. India approved Qdenga for use in both children and adults, making it the first dengue vaccine cleared in the country. The vaccine is expected to be available in India in the first half of 2027. Qdenga is administered as two 0.5 ml doses three months apart and can be used irrespective of prior dengue infection, removing the need for pre-vaccination screening. Dengue, a mosquito-borne viral disease, remains among the world's fastest-growing vector-borne illnesses. The World Health Organization reported a global 2024 tally of 14.4 million dengue cases and 11,201 deaths, including 232,425 cases and 233 deaths in India.

triage.notes: 記事はデング熱ワクチンの商業的流通契約に関するもので、既存の疾病動向（2024年のWHO統計）を引用しているのみ。新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Zoo Landau züchtet von Afrikanischer Schweinepest bedrohte Art
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Landau Zoo Breeds a Species Threatened by African Swine Fever
article.articleSummary: An international rescue plan for African swine fever (ASP)-threatened wild boar species is proposed in a scientific study with contributions from Landau, Germany. The plan identifies twelve Asian wild suid species at risk, five of which are listed by the IUCN Red List as Critically Endangered and one as Endangered. ASP, which emerged in China in 2018 and has since spread across Asia, endangers island populations in Southeast Asia, including the Philippines, where Visayan warty pigs persist only on Negros and Panay. One of the species is being bred at Landau Zoo in the Palatinate. The study argues that conservation breeding must begin now while populations and genetic diversity remain viable, positioning zoos as critical safeguards. Beyond biodiversity, ASP threatens ecosystems, food security, and livelihoods, with pig-farming losses estimated up to $192 billion.

triage.headline_ja: ランダウ動物園、アフリカ豚熱で絶滅の危機に瀕する種を繁殖
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はアフリカ豚熱（ASF）による野生イノシシ種の絶滅危機と保全繁殖に関する科学研究・動物園の取り組みを扱ったものであり、新たな感染症アウトブレイクの探知情報ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事は2018年に中国で発生し以降アジアに拡大したASFの歴史的経緯と、フィリピンなど東南アジアの野生イノシシ種保全に関する科学研究・動物園の繁殖プログラムを扱っており、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。人の健康リスクにも直接関連しない野生動物保全トピックのため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: 창원특례시, 벼멸구 적기 방제∙예찰 강화 당부
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changwon Special City Urges Strengthening of Timely Rice Planthopper Control and Surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Changwon Special City Agricultural Technology Center warns of rising rice planthopper (Nilaparvata lugens) pressure due to record heat, urging rice farmers to intensify early surveillance and timely pesticide applications. Planthoppers migrate from China during low-pressure periods in June–July, feed on rice stalks, and can cause hopperburn with yield losses. The city has completed three joint pest-control rounds and is funding a fourth round to maximize effectiveness. Farmers should inspect deeply into the leaf sheaths and ensure only registered pesticides are used under the PLS (Pesticide-Allowed Substances) system to avoid penalties. Separately, the center ran a three-day Farm Safety Practice Enhancement education (Sept 14–16) addressing hazard analysis, machinery safety, and tick-borne diseases (scrub typhus, SFTS) to protect harvests. In another effort, 2,878 pregnant women are served by the Eco-friendly Agricultural Products Support for Pregnant Women program, with supplier Hansalim Gyeongnam, including quality checks, packaging hygiene, and residue/radiation test results.

triage.headline_ja: 창원特例市、稲ウンカの適期防除・予察強化を要請

triage.notes: 対象国リストに韓国は含まれず、記事の主題も農業害虫対策であり感染症イベントではないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: வேகம் எடுக்கும் டெங்கு...தமிழகத்தில் இதுவரை 16,577 பேர் பாதிப்பு!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue on the rise... 16,577 people have been affected in Tamil Nadu so far!
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is surging in Tamil Nadu, with 16,577 cases reported this year as of September 18, 2026. The majority of transmission is centered in Chennai and surrounding northern districts—Thiruvallur, Chengalpattu, and Kanchipuram—where intense spread coincides with the monsoon rainfall and persistent standing water that boosts Aedes mosquito breeding. Hospitals in both public and private sectors have set up dedicated dengue wards and expanded bed capacity to accommodate rising patient load. A single-day tally recorded 244 new dengue diagnoses. Vector-control drives are active across affected districts, including removal of discarded tires, plastic drums, broken vessels, and stagnant water containers from homes and streets. Fogging operations continue, and public health officials are distributing neem-water and ORS packets. Residents are urged to seal water tanks and maintain clean surroundings to curb transmission and protect families.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が拡大中…タミル・ナードゥ州でこれまでに16,577人が感染！
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱の増加であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、症例数が多く医療体制への負荷があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 毎年モンスーン期に発生する季節性デング熱の増加であり、地域の公衆衛生当局が対応中。国レベルでの異常事態や国際的懸念の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dr Reddy's shares gain 2% after Takeda dengue vaccine distribution deal - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: Dr Reddy's Laboratories and Takeda Pharmaceutical struck a distribution deal for Takeda's dengue vaccine Qdenga in India. Dr Reddy's will exclusively market and distribute Qdenga in India's private market, while Takeda retains public-market commercialization rights and will manufacture and import the vaccine into India. The vaccine, designed to protect against all four dengue serotypes, has regulatory clearance in India for use in both children and adults; Qdenga is expected to launch in India in the first half of 2027. The two-dose schedule is 0.5 mL per dose, given three months apart, and pre-vaccination screening for prior dengue infection is not required. The deal coincides with dengue's public health burden: globally, 14.4 million cases and 11,201 deaths in 2024 per WHO; India saw 232,425 cases and 233 deaths in 2024. Dr Reddy's shares rose up to 2% on 18 Sep 2026 on the announcement.

article.articleHeadline: Fiji declares national HIV emergency as cases surge
article.articleSummary: Fiji declares an HIV national emergency as cases surge. About 9,000 people were living with HIV in 2025 in a country of under 1 million, with prevalence roughly 1 in 60 adults; only 39% know their status and 22% receive antiretroviral treatment. Two in every 100 pregnant women carry HIV, and 18 of 59 HIV-exposed babies died before their first birthday. HIV infections have risen 12-fold over the past 15 years, with more than half of known transmissions from sexual contact and over 42% from injecting drug use. The government will expand free HIV testing, rapid testing, prevention medications, harm-reduction measures for people who inject drugs, and free treatment for those diagnosed. External support comes from Australia, New Zealand, India, the Global Fund, and the UN. Transmission rise began around 2019 linked to high-risk injecting drug users, including in sex worker communities.

article.articleHeadline: Rusia ultima nuevas vacunas contra fiebre de Marburgo y el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia finalizes new vaccines against Marburg fever and Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Russia reports that clinical trials of new vaccines against Marburg fever and Ebola will soon conclude, with plans to finalize production paperwork and register the vaccines via Rospotrebnadzor. Moscow says the vaccines would bolster national and global readiness by enabling production and deployment to counter diverse health threats. Border controls have been tightened to screen travelers returning from epidemiologically unfavorable countries. The announcement comes amid international concern over an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which the country's National Institute of Public Health says has reached 7,404 confirmed cases and 3,577 deaths since the outbreak began. The numbers reflect a continuing outbreak and heightened attention to cross-border health security.

triage.notes: 記事の主眼はロシアのワクチン開発だが、DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の症例数・死亡数（7,404例・3,577名）が言及されており、これは過去のエボラアウトブレイクと比較して極めて大規模。数値の正確性については確認が必要だが、深刻な公衆衛生イベントとして扱うべき。ロシア（Moscow/Russian Federation）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: People, stay alert! Dengue cases have risen to 16,577: How to protect yourself?
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Tamil Nadu continue to rise, reaching 16,577 with 9 deaths as of September 18, 2026. The preceding day saw 1,320 fever cases, of which 244 were laboratory-confirmed dengue. The 2025 dengue tally was 25,585. Up to September 15, 2026, Tamil Nadu had 15,933 dengue cases; current figures show 16,577. Chennai reported 156 fever admissions, with 87 confirmed dengue. Public Health authorities have ordered intensified mosquito-control efforts statewide. Citizens are urged to prevent mosquito breeding by eliminating standing water and promptly discarding rainwater; maintain cleanliness at home. If fever occurs, seek medical care promptly and do not send febrile children to school. Additional guidance includes using face masks for cough, cold, or respiratory symptoms. The outbreak underscores persistent dengue risk in Tamil Nadu, including Chennai, necessitating ongoing vector control and vigilant public health precautions.

triage.headline_ja: 皆さん、注意してください！！デング熱感染者数が16,577人に増加：自己防衛の方法は？

article.articleHeadline: Pakar IDAI Beberkan Beda Influenza A dengan Pilek, Sama-sama Banyak Tulari Bocil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IDAI expert reveals the difference between Influenza A and the common cold, both highly contagious to children.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 September 2026, Indonesian pediatric infectious disease experts highlight Influenza A as the dominant flu strain and a rising concern across several regions of Indonesia. Prof Dr Anggraini Alam, IDAI, notes that Influenza A is the most frequently detected influenza type and tends to mutate rapidly, with animal reservoirs including pigs. While commonly grouped with the common cold due to shared respiratory tract involvement, Influenza A generally produces more severe illness. The virus enters cells, hijacks cellular machinery to replicate, damages host cells, and triggers inflammation that underpins the signs and symptoms, with inflammation potentially persisting for weeks. In some cases, infection can extend beyond the respiratory tract if the virus or inflammatory response affects other systems, potentially becoming systemic. These distinctions underscore the importance of surveillance and public health awareness in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: IDAI専門家がインフルエンザAと風邪の違いを解説、どちらも子供に感染しやすい
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAに関する専門家の一般的な解説記事であり、異常な発生や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザAと一般的な風邪の違いに関する教育的・啓発的な内容であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事象の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Anak Rentan Terkena Influenza A, Dokter Soroti Penitipan di Day Care
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Children at Risk of Contracting Influenza A, Doctors Highlight Daycare Arrangements
article.articleSummary: Influenza A infections are rising in Indonesia, with children most at risk. At a Sept 18, 2026 briefing by the Indonesian Pediatric Society (IDAI), Prof Anggraini Alam reported that 5% of pediatric Influenza A cases require hospitalization, and 80% of those hospitalized are under 2 years old. Children are roughly twice as likely to develop symptomatic flu as adults, due to immature immunity and smaller body size. Daycare is a key risk factor: closed, crowded rooms and limited ventilation facilitate ongoing transmission, and air conditioning can aid virus persistence in such settings. Influenza A is described as heavier and more contagious than the common cold, with infection causing respiratory inflammation and potentially weeks of recovery. Principal pediatric symptoms include fever, headache, body aches, dry cough, nasal congestion, sneezing, and nausea or vomiting; alarm signs include difficulty waking, poor intake, or seizures—seek hospital care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 子どものインフルエンザA型感染リスク、医師がデイケアでの管理を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの小児感染増加に関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、小児重症化や集団感染の可能性から経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழ்நாட்டில் வேகமாக அதிகரிக்கும் டெங்கு பாதிப்பு: ஒரே நாளில் 244 பேருக்கு பாதிப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue infections rising rapidly in Tamil Nadu: 244 people affected in a single day.
article.articleSummary: Dengue infections are rising in Tamil Nadu, with 244 laboratory-confirmed cases reported on 17 September, including 87 in Chennai. Chennai, Chengalpattu, Coimbatore, Tiruvallur, Krishnagiri, and Salem districts show higher case counts, while Tiruvallur, Kanchipuram, Thanjavur, and Viluppuram districts are also experiencing a rising trend. In response, the health department is expanding dengue testing and treatment facilities across all districts and intensifying mosquito-control, surveillance, and healthcare capacity to curb transmission. Public health authorities emphasize the ongoing outbreak and the need to accelerate vector-control measures, disease surveillance, and expanded medical facilities to manage the surge.

article.articleHeadline: Pasca Gigit 3 Anggota Keluarga, Anjing di Jembrana Ditemukan Mati, Suarniti Digigit Saat Memandikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog in Jembrana Found Dead After Biting Three Family Members; Suarniti Was Bitten While Being Bathed.
article.articleSummary: Four-month-old puppy in Jembrana, Bali, bit three family members and was later found dead, with veterinary staff collecting brain tissue to test for rabies. The incidents occurred in Lingkungan Anyar Sari, Kelurahan Baler Bale Agung, Negara District. Owner Ni Komang Ayu Suarniti, 42, was bitten while bathing the puppy on Sept 8, 2026; the wound on her hand did not bleed. The puppy, whose dam was vaccinated but the pup itself was not, had other injuries suggesting possible prior fighting. Four days later, on Sept 12, 2026, Suarniti's 15-year-old son, Conradus Febatan Tri Sandi, was bitten on the thumb while checking for fleas and was treated at the emergency room. Officials collected the dog's brain tissue to confirm rabies via lab testing. No rabies diagnosis has been reported yet. The case underscores rabies risk from unvaccinated dogs in Bali.

triage.headline_ja: 3人の家族を噛んだ後、ジェンブラナの犬が死んでいるのが発見される。スアルニティさんは入浴中に噛まれた
triage.triage_reason: バリ島で未確認の狂犬病疑い事例（犬による複数人咬傷、犬は死亡）だが、検査結果は未報告であり、確定診断がないため続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 狂犬病の検査結果（脳組織検査）は未報告のため、確定事例ではない。バリ島は狂犬病流行地域として知られており、未接種犬による咬傷事例は継続的なリスクを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Why Millions of People Around the World Will Contract Measles in 2026
article.articleSummary: Measles is projected to cause 11 million infections in 2026, with most cases in Africa and Asia and outbreaks in the Americas and Europe. There is no treatment; vaccines are safe and prevent disease, but unvaccinated people face serious complications including deafness, blindness, and death, especially when undernourished. Herd immunity requires vaccination above 95%. Europe averages 94% one-dose and 88% two-dose; the U.S. exceeds 90% for at least one dose and over 92% for two doses. In low- and middle-income countries, about 80% have one dose and 70% have two doses, leaving many zero-dose children after COVID-19 disruptions. Outbreaks are reported in Burundi, DRC, Somalia, Sudan, Yemen, with Maldives and Zambia also affected; India is surging. Bangladesh has the year\'s highest measles burden with >900 deaths; early 2026 mass vaccination vaccinated more than 1,000,000 children, amid Gavi shortfalls and reduced donor support.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年に世界中で数百万人が麻疹に感染する理由
triage.triage_reason: 複数のIHR基準（重篤な影響・国際的拡大）に該当し、DRC・ザンビア・インドで具体的な麻疹アウトブレイク/急増が報告されているため。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年の麻疹流行予測に関するグローバルな総括記事であり、特定の単一アウトブレイク速報ではない。DRC・ザンビア・インドについては明確に流行/急増が言及されているため対象国として抽出したが、他の対象国（フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム）は記事に登場しない。バングラデシュ、スーダン、イエメン、ソマリア、ブルンジ、モルディブは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Penyebab Kasus Influenza A Kembali Meningkat, Ini Penjelasan Dokter : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Causes of the resurgence of Influenza A cases, This is the doctor's explanation: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases have risen recently, driven by non-new strains H1N1 and H3N2, according to Dr. Yogi Prawira, Sp.A, Subsp.ETIA(K), a pediatric specialist at Siloam Hospitals TB Simatupang, during Morning Zone on YouTube Okezone. He emphasizes that Influenza A is not a new virus but part of seasonal flu; H1N1 has circulated since the 2009 pandemic and is now a common seasonal subtype. The uptick is attributed to antigenic drift—gradual mutations that can diminish protection from prior infections. As a result, previous immunity may not fully shield against circulating strains, and infections can present with relatively heavier symptoms, especially in unvaccinated individuals. Incidence data can be referenced to the Ministry of Health. The discussion highlights ongoing respiratory flu activity rather than a new pathogen, with surveillance context from Indonesian health authorities.

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon And Diabetes: Why Infection Risk Increases During The Rainy Season
article.articleSummary: India faces heightened infection risk during monsoon for people with diabetes. Hyperglycaemia weakens neutrophil function, reducing migration, pathogen recognition, and killing, raising risks of urinary tract infections (nearly 2×), surgical-site infections (about 1.5×), and bacteraemia (2–3×). Glycosuria feeds urinary bacteria, notably E. coli, promoting biofilms and colonization; impaired insulin signaling in kidneys can also blunt antibacterial defenses independently of glucose. Rain fosters warmth and humidity, and prolonged wet skin and footwear enable fungal infections—athlete’s foot, ringworm, and jock itch—and diabetic foot ulcers that can progress to infection or gangrene. UTIs may ascend to pyelonephritis; rare invasive mucormycosis is reported in poorly controlled diabetes. Prevention during the season emphasizes thorough drying of the feet, careful foot care, and prompt wound treatment.

article.articleHeadline: Takeda, Dr Reddy's enter distribution agreement for QDENGA dengue vaccine in India
article.articleSummary: QDENGA dengue vaccine will be available in India's private market for paediatric and adult vaccination in the first half of 2027, subject to local authority processes. Takeda Biopharmaceuticals India Pvt Ltd and Dr. Reddy's Laboratories have signed a distribution agreement designating Dr. Reddy's as exclusive promoter and distributor in India's private market; Takeda retains rights to promote/distribute QDENGA in the public market and maintains ownership and medical/brand oversight. CDSCO approved QDENGA in July 2026 for ages 4–60, making it India's first approved dengue vaccine. India faces dengue as a public-health challenge, with cases increasing 11-fold over two decades. ICMR surveillance shows all four serotypes co-circulating; 1 in 14 patients are infected with multiple serotypes. Since 2022, Takeda's dengue vaccine has been approved in 43 countries including India, with over 32 million doses distributed. Parliamentary Committee on Health recommended considering dengue vaccine for the Universal Immunization Program.

triage.headline_ja: 武田薬品とドクター・レディーズ、インドでデング熱ワクチン「QDENGA」の販売契約を締結
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチンの商業的な流通契約に関するビジネスニュースであり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: インドにおけるデング熱の流行状況（罹患数の増加や複数血清型の共循環）は背景情報として言及されているが、記事の主題はワクチンの商業流通契約であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため対象国としない。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழகத்தில் டெங்கு காய்ச்சல் பாதிப்பு 16,577 ஆக உயர்வு! ஒரே நாளில் 244 பேர் பாதிப்பு!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever cases in Tamil Nadu rise to 16,577! 244 people affected in a single day!
article.articleSummary: On 18 September 2026, Tamil Nadu reports 16,577 dengue fever cases this season with 9 deaths. On 17 September, 1,320 fever cases were recorded, of which 244 were laboratory-confirmed as dengue. In Chennai, 156 fever cases were reported yesterday, with 87 dengue confirmations. Dengue activity spans 10 districts, including Chengalpattu, Thiruvallur, and Kanchipuram. Over 25,000 health workers are engaged in mosquito control and sanitation efforts. Authorities urge prompt hospital testing for fever and warn private hospitals against charging excessive fees for dengue treatment. The government continues vector-control measures as dengue transmission persists across the state.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱患者数16,577人に増加！1日で244人が新たに感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱の流行拡大であり、地域の風土病的性質が強いが、症例数増加と死亡例の存在から継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド南部で季節性に流行する既知の疾患であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、症例数と死亡者数の増加傾向は継続的な観察が必要。
